en.description: Strong activations often fall on Debbie and she; they also occur on tokenized fragments in names, URLs, bedsheets, common words, and code identifiers. The pattern is inconsistent and may be influenced by subword boundaries or accidental spelling overlap.

patterns.name: Debbie in proper names
patterns.context: The name Debbie appears in email recipients, legal document witnesses, or signatures; some texts also contain other names with similar letter sequences
patterns.domain: Email, legal documents, encyclopedia and general web text

patterns.name: Pronoun she and in-word fragments
patterns.context: The full pronoun she appears in narrative or conversational contexts; in one instance she crosses into a proper-name/URL-like string, and in another it is embedded in the spelling of bedsheets
patterns.domain: Email, legal narratives, web, patent texts

patterns.name: Weak overlap at tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: The activated fragment lies within a name or email address and may not be a complete word; it is related to names such as Debbie/Chapman, but is not one stable trigger

patterns.name: Coincidental substrings in common words
patterns.context: A complete word or its internal letters happen to resemble the names/substrings above; no stable shared semantic condition is evident

patterns.name: Weak fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Occurs in a C++ function parameter type identifier, with no context matching names or pronouns

1_86.description: 强激活多落在 Debbie 与 she；但也见于名称、网址、 bedsheets、常见词和代码标识符的分词片段。模式不统一，可能受子词边界或偶然拼写重合影响。

patterns.name: 特殊专名中的 Debbie
patterns.trigger: «Debbie»10；另有 «bbie»10、«bb»1 等被分词显示的名字片段
patterns.context: 人名 Debbie 出现在邮件收件人、法律文书证人或署名等位置；个别文本中也出现其他含相近字母序列的名字
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律文书、百科及一般网页文本

patterns.name: she 的代词与词内片段
patterns.context: 完整代词 she 出现在叙述或口语语境中；另有一次 she 跨入专名/网址式字符串，一次嵌在 bedsheets 的拼写中
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律叙事、网页、专利文本

patterns.name: 分词边界处的弱重合
patterns.context: 激活片段位于人名或邮箱地址内部，未必是完整词；与 Debbie/Chapman 等名字有关，但并非同一种稳定触发
patterns.domain: 邮件、姓名及电子邮件地址

patterns.name: 常见词的偶然子串
patterns.context: 完整词或词内字母偶然与上面的名字/子串相似；缺少稳定共同语义条件

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的弱片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C++ 函数参数类型标识符中，未见与姓名或代词一致的上下文

en.description: All fragments highlight the consecutive characters she: sometimes the feminine pronoun, sometimes embedded in a name, URL, citation marker, or word; capitalization and surrounding contexts vary considerably.

patterns.name: she and feminine pronoun
patterns.context: The standalone pronoun she/She appears, or the sequence occurs as part of a name/string; the context may involve the pronoun or merely the letter sequence.
patterns.domain: Across corpora, including email, legal testimony, fiction, patents, web, and academic text

patterns.name: she inside words or marked strings
patterns.context: The highlighted position is embedded in a username, URL, citation marker, name, or other continuous string, rather than functioning syntactically as a feminine pronoun.
patterns.domain: Web/forums, URLs, paper citations, email names

patterns.name: she referring to a woman in narratives or testimony
patterns.context: she is the subject of a sentence and refers to a previously mentioned or contextual woman; it is sometimes followed by an auxiliary verb, predicate, or additional description.

patterns.name: she at a patent term boundary
patterns.context: The characters she occur across an ordinary spelling fragment in the word sheets and do not form a pronoun.

1_86.description: 全部片段都标亮连续字符 she：有时是女性代词，有时嵌在姓名、网址、引文标记或单词中；大小写及周边语境变化较大。

patterns.name: she 及女性代词
patterns.context: 出现独立代词 she/She，或作为姓名/字符串的一部分；语境可在代词前后，也可能只是字母序列。
patterns.domain: 跨语料，包括邮件、法律证词、小说、专利、网页及学术文本

patterns.name: she 的词内或标记串内出现
patterns.context: 高亮位置嵌在用户名、URL、引文标记、姓名或其他连续字符串中，并非句法上的女性代词。
patterns.domain: 网页/论坛、网址、论文引文、邮件姓名

patterns.name: she 在叙事或证词中指代女性
patterns.context: she 是句子中的主语，指代已提及或上下文中的女性；有时后接助动词、谓语或补充描述。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律证词、小说叙事

patterns.name: she 出现在专利术语边界
patterns.context: 字符 she 跨越普通拼写片段而出现在 sheets 一词中，不构成代词。

en.concept: she-containing subword fragments and several heterogeneous markers
en.description: Strong activations repeatedly fall on she/she’d and name fragments containing she; they also occur on role, the code identifier Patch, dates, and time numerals. The contexts and parts of speech vary, making it difficult to assign a single semantic category.

patterns.name: she / she’d forms
patterns.context: she as a standalone personal pronoun or the stem of the contraction she’d; both capitalization forms occur.
patterns.domain: News blogs, literary reporting, business email, legal testimony

patterns.name: she in role names or compounds
patterns.context: she is part of a name spelling, appearing in a person’s name and an email address, rather than as a pronoun.

patterns.name: Abstract academic noun role
patterns.context: role appears in noun phrases describing a system’s role or function.

patterns.name: Patch identifier in code
patterns.context: Patch/Patch[] is used as a type or variable name in code, surrounded by function declarations, parameters, or comments.

patterns.name: Numeric time markers
patterns.context: Numbers and colons in a time range; this segment also contains the primary activation on she’d.

patterns.name: Date numerals in web paths
patterns.context: Numeric fragments representing year, month, and day in URL paths.

1_86.concept: 含 she 的词片段及若干异质标记
1_86.description: 强激活反复落在 she/she’d 及含 she 的姓名片段；另在 role、代码标识符 Patch、日期和时间数字上激活。不同语境和词类并存，难归为单一语义。

patterns.name: she / she’d 词形
patterns.context: she 作为独立人称代词，或缩写 she’d 的词干；大小写均见。
patterns.domain: 新闻博客、文学报道、商务邮件、法律证词

patterns.name: 角色名称或复合词中的 she
patterns.context: she 是姓名拼写的一部分，分别出现在人名和邮件地址中，并非代词。

patterns.name: 抽象学术名词 role
patterns.context: role 出现在描述系统作用、功能的名词短语中。

patterns.name: 代码中的 Patch 标识符
patterns.context: Patch/Patch[] 作为代码中的类型或变量名，周围有函数声明、参数或注释。

patterns.name: 数字时间标记
patterns.context: 时间范围中的数字和冒号；该段还含有主要激活的 she’d。

patterns.name: 网页路径中的日期数字
patterns.context: URL 路径里表示年月日的数字片段。

en.description: Activations fall on a variety of in-word fragments, names, and identifiers, with examples in code configuration, email lists, tables, and legal or encyclopedia text. There is no stable unifying semantics; local patterns are mainly determined by each segment’s format and morpheme boundaries.

patterns.name: Specific morphemes inside compounds
patterns.context: These morphemes occur within longer words or proper names, with activation at morpheme boundaries; no single fixed meaning or part of speech explains them.

patterns.name: English word-final or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across complete English words, names, and affix-like fragments, often combining with adjacent letters to form a word; no stable semantic or positional rule is apparent.
patterns.domain: Patents, email, legal texts, encyclopedia entries, and code

patterns.name: Code configuration and identifier fragments
patterns.context: Occurs within keys, string values, or code identifiers in JSON/configuration objects; common in newline-indented lists and configuration snippets.

patterns.name: Email addresses and contact lists
patterns.context: Embedded in addresses, names, or semicolon-separated contact lists in Enron email headers; activations concentrate on local fragments of names and addresses.

patterns.name: Country names in tables
patterns.context: Located in newline-separated tables arranged by code, number, or abbreviation, where country names are table entries; activation occurs especially on “Emirates”.

patterns.name: Judge titles and court documents
patterns.context: Appears near judges’ names, titles, and court document headers; the body then moves on to the case facts.

patterns.name: People’s names and entry lists
patterns.context: Appears as a name fragment in encyclopedia biographies and “See also” related-people lists.

patterns.name: Patch objects and code comments
patterns.context: Occurs in PHP test functions, variable names, and type comments, surrounded by webhook requests and patch-handling logic.

1_86.description: 激活落在多种词内片段、姓名和标识符上；在代码配置、邮件名单、表格及法律或百科文本中均有实例。没有稳定统一的语义，局部规律主要由各段格式和词素边界决定。

patterns.name: 复合词中间的特定词素
patterns.context: 这些词素出现在较长词或专名内部，激活落在词素边界处；无法由一种固定词义或词类解释。

patterns.name: 英文词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 激活散布在完整英文词、姓名及词缀式片段中，常与相邻字母共同组成词；看不出稳定的语义或位置规则。
patterns.domain: 专利、邮件、法律文本、百科及代码

patterns.name: 代码配置与标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 JSON/配置对象中的键名、字符串值或代码标识符内；常见于换行缩进的列表和配置片段。

patterns.name: 邮件地址和联系人名单
patterns.context: 嵌在 Enron 邮件头的地址、姓名或分号分隔联系人列表中，激活集中在姓名及地址的局部片段。

patterns.name: 表格中的国家名
patterns.context: 位于按代码、数字或缩写分列的换行表格中，国家名是表格条目；激活尤其出现在“Emirates”。

patterns.name: 法官称谓与法院文书
patterns.context: 出现在法官姓名、职衔及法院文书抬头附近，正文随后转入案件事实。

patterns.name: 人物姓名及条目列表
patterns.context: 在百科人物条目及“See also”相关人物列表中作为姓名片段出现。

patterns.name: 补丁对象与代码注释
patterns.context: 出现在 PHP 测试函数、变量名和类型注释中，周围是 webhook 请求及补丁处理逻辑。

en.description: Primarily responds to “paragraph” and its numbering in documents, especially when citing, locating, or revising a paragraph; also appears in legal clauses and standards citations. There is a weaker response to court document headers.

patterns.name: “paragraph” and paragraph numbers
patterns.context: A paragraph is cited, discussed, or labeled in legal text, email, or press releases; the number may follow directly or be spelled out.

patterns.name: Revising and explaining paragraph content
patterns.context: Discusses rewriting, checking, or updating a paragraph and identifies its location in the document or the reason for the change.
patterns.domain: Business email, news editing, online comments

patterns.name: Other legal document structure markers
patterns.context: Formatted metadata such as headings and docket information in legal opinions or court documents; no obvious paragraph trigger word is present.

patterns.name: Clause references in the C language standard
patterns.context: A technical Q&A cites a specific paragraph of the C standard; it also discusses pointer types and type conversions.

1_86.description: 主要响应文档中的“paragraph”及其编号，尤其在引用、定位或修改段落时；也出现在法律条款和标准引用中。另对法院文书标头有较弱反应。

patterns.name: “paragraph”及段落编号
patterns.trigger: «paragraph»，以及邻近的编号或序数，如 «paragraph»10、«paragraph»9、«paragraph» seven
patterns.context: 在法律文本、邮件或新闻稿中引用、讨论或标注某个段落；编号可紧随其后，也可用文字表示。
patterns.domain: 法律、商务邮件、新闻/编辑文本

patterns.name: 段落内容的修订与说明
patterns.context: 讨论重写、检查或更新某一段落，并指出它在文档中的位置或修改原因。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、新闻编辑、在线评论

patterns.name: 其他法律文书结构标记
patterns.trigger: «United» «States» «District» «Court»，及案名、法院、日期等标头字段
patterns.context: 法律判决或法院文书的标题、案卷信息等格式化元数据；未见明显段落触发词。

patterns.name: C 语言标准中的条款引用
patterns.context: 技术问答中引用 C 标准的具体段落；同时包含指针类型与类型转换讨论。

en.description: The strongest activation in each segment is on “War” in different capitalization forms: sometimes at the beginning of Warwick, sometimes at the beginning of war/War-related words, including warfarin, War Picture, World War, and Warnecke; domains and contexts vary.

patterns.name: Warwick internal fragment
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the initial portion of Warwick, not the whole word; it occurs in institutional addresses, university locations, or descriptions of places
patterns.domain: Academic addresses, institutional descriptions, email signatures, encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: war internal fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial portion of war, followed by “farin” (warfarin), “Picture” (War Picture), “ of Independence” (War of Independence), “necke” (Warnecke), or forming part of a compound word

1_86.description: 各段最强激活都在大小写形式的“War”上：有时是 Warwick 的词首，有时是 war/War 相关词的词首，包括 warfarin、War Picture、World War、Warnecke 等；领域与上下文多样。

patterns.name: Warwick 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活集中落在 Warwick 的首段，而非整个词；出现在机构地址、大学所在地或地点介绍中
patterns.domain: 学术地址、机构介绍、邮件签名、百科条目

patterns.name: war 词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 war 的首段；后接 “farin”（warfarin）、“Picture”（War Picture）、“ of Independence”（War of Independence）、“necke”（Warnecke），或作为复合词的一部分

en.description: Activations concentrate on specific strings in structured text: U.S. Code citations, February in dates, legal opinion metadata, birth/death date separators, as well as the surname Williams and figure markers.

patterns.name: U.S.C. § in U.S. Code citations
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in the U.S. Code abbreviation or its section number; sometimes the number follows §, and sometimes a title number also precedes it
patterns.domain: Legal, patent documents, and code snippets

patterns.name: February in dates
patterns.context: Occurs in people’s birth/death dates, case dates, or opinion filing dates; often surrounded by a day, year, and separator

patterns.name: Legal opinion headings and metadata
patterns.context: Occurs near docket information, titles, or filing dates in court opinions
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal documents

patterns.name: Separator in birth/death dates
patterns.context: Between birth and death dates, which are often written in day-month-year or month-day-year format

patterns.name: Williams in names
patterns.context: Repeatedly appears as part of a person’s full name, followed by a birth date and biography

patterns.name: Figure citation markers
patterns.context: Occurs in markers or body text containing figure citations and supplementary material links

1_86.description: 激活集中于结构化文本中的特定字符串：美国法典引文、日期中的 February、法律意见书元数据、生卒日期连接号，另有 Williams 姓名和图表标记。

patterns.name: 美国法典引文中的 U.S.C. §
patterns.context: 触发点出现在美国法典缩写或其条款编号中；有时编号紧随 §，有时前面还带标题编号
patterns.domain: 法律、专利文书及代码片段

patterns.name: 日期中的 February
patterns.context: 出现在人物生卒日期、案件日期或意见书提交日期中；周围常有日、年份及连接号
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记与法律文书

patterns.name: 法律意见书标题与元数据
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见书的案头信息、标题或提交日期附近
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律文书

patterns.name: 生卒日期中的连接号
patterns.context: 夹在出生与死亡日期之间，日期常以日月年或月日年形式书写

patterns.name: 姓名中的 Williams
patterns.context: 作为人物全名的一部分重复出现，随后附出生日期及简介

patterns.name: 图表引用标记
patterns.context: 出现在带有图表引用及补充材料链接的标记或正文中
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文 XML/标记文本

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the month name December in dates across many genres; it also responds to September in dates and to year and hyphen in age-group labels.

patterns.name: December in dates
patterns.context: Occurs in dates, followed by a day number; it is also typically part of a year, date range, or parenthetical date information.
patterns.domain: Date expressions across domains, including medical papers, astronomical archives, encyclopedia entries, legal documents, and project budgets; present in nearly all segments.

patterns.name: September as a month name
patterns.context: Appears as the month in a date, followed by “in”, within abstract text comparing different age groups.

patterns.name: Year in date/time units
patterns.context: Embedded in the age-group labels “5-14-year-olds” and “15-24-year-olds”; the hyphens in age ranges and compound adjectives are also marked.

1_86.description: 主要对日期中月份名 December 强烈响应，跨多种文体出现；另对 September 日期月份及年龄组标签中的 year 和连字符有响应。

patterns.name: 日期中的 December
patterns.context: 在日期中，后接日号；通常也处于年份、日期范围或括号中的日期信息内。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的日期表达，包括医学论文、天文档案、百科条目、法律文件和项目预算；覆盖几乎所有片段。

patterns.name: 月份名 September
patterns.context: 作为日期中的月份出现，后接“in”，并处于对不同年龄组进行比较的摘要文字中。

patterns.name: 日期／时间单位中的年
patterns.context: 嵌在年龄组标签“5-14-year-olds”“15-24-year-olds”中；年龄范围和复合形容词中的连字符也被标记。

en.description: The most stable trigger is “October” in dates, appearing across birth/death records, event dates, email subjects, paper metadata, and medical and legal texts. Other months, nearby years, or day numbers occasionally elicit weaker responses; a few local terms cannot be confirmed as independent patterns.

patterns.name: October in dates
patterns.context: Appears in dates, date expressions, or time ranges; it is the main trigger shared by all segments, often adjacent to a year or day number.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographies, email, paper metadata, medical abstracts, legal documents, and astronomy papers

patterns.name: Adjacent day numbers in dates
patterns.context: Adjacent to a month or complete date; marking and activation on the numbers themselves are inconsistent and may be accompanying features of the month-date pattern.

patterns.name: Other months in dates and time ranges
patterns.context: Appears when describing events, birth/death dates, or paper receipt dates; significant activation remains concentrated on October, while responses to other months are weaker and less stable.

patterns.name: Meeting/event wording in email subjects
patterns.context: Appears in an email subject line, which also contains «October»10 and a year; whether it is independent of the date trigger is uncertain.

patterns.name: Local non-date terms
patterns.context: These words or word fragments each occur in a single segment and fit the local semantics, but cannot be confirmed as stable trigger patterns from other segments.
patterns.domain: Astronomy papers, legal documents, medical abstracts

1_86.description: 最稳定的触发是日期中的“October”，跨人物生卒、事件日期、邮件主题、论文元数据及医学和法律文本出现。其他月份、相邻年份或日号偶有较弱反应；少量局部词项无法确认是否独立模式。

patterns.name: 日期中的 October
patterns.context: 在日期、年月日或时间范围表达中出现；是所有片段共有的主要触发形式，常与年份、日号相邻。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、邮件、论文元数据、医学摘要、法律文书及天文学论文

patterns.name: 日期中相邻的日号
patterns.context: 与月份或完整日期相邻；数字自身的标记和激活并不一致，可能是月份日期模式的伴随特征。

patterns.name: 日期及时间范围中的其他月份
patterns.context: 在叙述事件、人物生卒日期或论文接收日期时出现；显著激活主要仍集中在 October，其他月份的反应较弱且不稳定。
patterns.domain: 论文、人物传记及日期元数据

patterns.name: 邮件主题中的会议活动措辞
patterns.context: 出现在邮件主题行，且同一主题含 «October»10 和年份；是否独立于日期触发不确定。

patterns.name: 局部非日期词项
patterns.context: 这些词或词片段各出现在单个片段，且与局部语义相符，但无法从其他片段确认是稳定触发模式。
patterns.domain: 天文学论文、法律文书、医学摘要

en.description: Primarily sensitive to date expressions and their components, especially day numbers after months, years, and start–end ranges; dates appear in study periods, legal documents, metadata, historical entries, and financial tables. There are also sporadic activations on Jan in author names and on judge titles; some passages are not fully explained by date patterns.

patterns.name: Date numbers after month names
patterns.context: A day number follows a month, commonly in full dates, date ranges, or statistical periods; activation concentrates on the month and the immediately adjacent number.
patterns.domain: Date and time expressions; spans papers, legal documents, emails, and encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Numbers in years and date ranges
patterns.context: Years appear in dates, start–end ranges, or historical birth and death information; they are usually adjacent to months, prepositions, or range connectors.
patterns.domain: Year expressions in papers, legal documents, emails, and encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Date ranges and their connectors
patterns.context: Expressions of time spans or validity periods; triggers include words indicating start and end, coverage, or duration, and their dates.
patterns.domain: Paper methods and data descriptions; email tables

patterns.name: Date field labels
patterns.context: Dates appear as table fields, metadata fields, or legal case information.

patterns.name: Jan in author names
patterns.context: Jan is part of an author's name, not a month or date.

patterns.name: Judge titles
patterns.context: Legal text uses Judge to identify a judge or judicial personnel; the passage also contains a date, but activation here stands out beyond the date pattern.

patterns.name: Author and acceptance information before dates
patterns.context: Paper YAML/reference-style metadata, with dates embedded in publication-process information such as received and accepted.

patterns.name: Names and historical birth and death dates
patterns.context: A biographical entry gives a person's name, followed by birth, death, or related historical dates in parentheses.

patterns.name: Statistical periods and experimental context
patterns.context: Month and day indicate the statistical period for a study or disease incidence.

patterns.name: Specialized time-series records
patterns.context: A table of futures contract expiration dates, with months, days, and years listed alongside instruments and validity-period notes.

1_86.description: 主要对日期表达及其构成敏感，尤其是月份后的日号、年份和起止区间；日期出现在研究周期、法律文书、元数据、历史条目和金融表格中。另有作者名中的 Jan、法官称谓等零散激活，部分段落无法由日期模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 月份名称后的日期数字
patterns.context: 月份后跟日号，常见于完整日期、日期范围或统计时间区间；激活集中在月份及紧邻数字
patterns.domain: 日期与时间表达；覆盖论文、法律文书、邮件和百科文本

patterns.name: 年份与日期范围中的数字
patterns.context: 年份出现在日期、起止区间或历史生卒信息中；通常邻接月份、介词或范围连接词
patterns.domain: 论文、法律文书、邮件、百科文本中的年份表达

patterns.name: 日期范围及其连接词
patterns.trigger: « from»1« 2000»2« to»1 2009、« covering»3 from…« to»1、« between»…« and»2、« extended until further« notice»2
patterns.context: 时间跨度或有效期表达；触发点包括表示起止、覆盖范围或延续期限的词及其日期
patterns.domain: 论文方法与数据描述、邮件表格

patterns.name: 日期字段标签
patterns.context: 日期作为表格字段、元数据字段或法律案件信息出现
patterns.domain: 邮件、论文元数据、法律文书

patterns.name: 作者名中的 Jan
patterns.context: Jan 是作者名字的一部分，而非月份日期
patterns.domain: 代码注释中的作者署名

patterns.name: 法官称谓
patterns.context: 法律文本中以 Judge 标记法官或司法人员信息；该段同时含日期，但此处激活突出于日期模式之外

patterns.name: 日期前的作者与接受信息
patterns.trigger: « Evidence»2 of；前文含 Received 8 April 2016; Accepted 24 February 2017
patterns.context: 论文 YAML/参考文献式元数据，日期嵌在接收、接受等出版流程信息中

patterns.name: 姓名及历史生卒日期
patterns.context: 人物条目先给出姓名，随后以括号列出生卒或相关历史日期

patterns.name: 统计周期与实验背景
patterns.trigger: « TB»2 from« January»10 to« June»7 2016；背景含信息提取与噪声检验
patterns.context: 月份日期标示研究或疾病发生率的统计区间

patterns.name: 专业时间序列记录
patterns.context: 期货合约到期日期表格，月份、日号和年份与品种及有效期说明并列

en.description: All passages contain month names, especially January, and many occur in dates or time ranges that include years or day numbers; triggers also cover astronomical observations, seasonal covariates, and project dates, not just medical research.

patterns.name: January in dates
patterns.context: In date ranges, study enrollment periods, or event times, often adjacent to a year and from/to, between/and, a hyphen, or a month and day; activation primarily falls on the January token fragments.
patterns.domain: Paper methods, research abstracts, and project budgets/schedules; also astronomical observation narratives

patterns.name: December in date ranges
patterns.context: Paired with January to form start and end dates for studies or projects, often with specific days and years.

patterns.name: Other months in date ranges
patterns.context: Appears as the endpoint of a date range or as an observation month; March also appears in a month range for seasonal covariates.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, epidemiological modeling, astronomical observations

patterns.name: Date-range wording
patterns.context: Marks the start and end of a study or observation period around months such as January; these words do not activate universally, and local date context is more important.
patterns.domain: Methods sections, research abstracts, project schedules, and observation records

patterns.name: Non-date uses of January
patterns.context: Not limited to clinical study enrollment periods: also used for astronomical observation dates, preseason month ranges for model covariates, and a Dates column in a budget project.

1_86.description: 所有段都出现月份名称，尤其是 January，且多处处于带年份或日号的日期/时间范围中；触发也覆盖天文观测、季节性协变量和项目日期，并非只限医学研究。

patterns.name: 日期中的 January
patterns.context: 在日期范围、研究纳入时段或事件时间中，常与年份及 from/to、between/and、连字符或月份日号相邻；触发点主要是 January 的 token 分片。
patterns.domain: 论文方法、研究摘要及项目预算/时间表；另有天文观测叙述

patterns.name: 日期范围中的 December
patterns.context: 与 January 配对组成研究或项目的起止日期，常带具体日号和年份。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、项目描述

patterns.name: 日期范围中的其他月份
patterns.context: 作为日期区间终点或观测月份出现；March 也出现在季节性协变量的月份范围中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、流行病学建模、天文观测

patterns.name: 日期范围措辞
patterns.context: 在 January 等月份前后标示研究或观测的起止时间；这些词并非普遍激活，局部日期语境更关键。
patterns.domain: 方法部分、研究摘要、项目时间表及观测记录

patterns.name: 非日期的 January 用法
patterns.trigger: «January» 与观测、季节性指标或项目日期并列
patterns.context: 不仅是临床研究纳入期：也用于天文观测日期、模型协变量的 preseason 月份范围，以及预算项目的 Dates 栏。
patterns.domain: 天文学、流行病学建模、项目/预算文档

en.description: All passages contain a marked January, often in a year, date range, or list of observation dates; December, June, and other months, as well as connectors, activate occasionally. Medical research-method terms are often accompanying features, and the astronomy passage also fits the date pattern.

patterns.name: Month name January
patterns.context: January in a date or study period, often appearing with a year, range connectors such as and/to, and other months. Activation primarily falls on January; numbers or months in a few contexts are also marked.
patterns.domain: Study methods, cohort and case descriptions in biomedical papers; also astronomical observation records

patterns.name: Other time words in date ranges
patterns.context: Other date ranges containing January or multiple observation dates listed chronologically. The specific months and connectors activated vary by passage and are usually weaker than January.
patterns.domain: Enrollment periods, follow-up periods, literature search periods, or observation dates in research papers

patterns.name: Case-study methods template (incidental)
patterns.context: The background involves study design, methods headings, or descriptions of case/patient enrollment; these terms are not common triggers across passages and may co-occur with date-range templates.
patterns.domain: Medical paper abstracts and main text

patterns.name: Astronomical date expressions
patterns.context: Lists the months in which telescope observations took place; this is not a medical research date range, but January appears in a similar date-listing structure.

1_86.description: 所有段都含被标记的 January，常位于年份、日期区间或观测日期列表中；December、June 等月份及连接词偶有激活。医学研究方法词多为伴随特征，天文段也符合日期模式。

patterns.name: 月份名称 January
patterns.context: 日期或研究时间范围中的 January；常与年份、范围连接词 and/to 及其他月份并列出现。激活主要落在 January，少数上下文中的数字或月份也被标记。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的研究方法、队列与病例描述；另有天文学观测记录

patterns.name: 日期范围中的其他时间词
patterns.trigger: « December»、« June»、« February»、« March»、« April»、« May»；以及 « and»、« to»
patterns.context: 与 January 同处日期区间或按时间顺序列出的多个观测日期。各段激活的具体月份与连接词不一致，强度通常低于 January。
patterns.domain: 研究论文中的纳入时间、随访时间、文献检索期或观测日期

patterns.name: 病例研究方法模板（附带）
patterns.context: 以研究设计、方法标题或病例/患者纳入描述为背景；这些词并非各段共同触发条件，可能与日期区间模板共现。

patterns.name: 天文日期表述
patterns.context: 列举望远镜观测发生的月份；不属于医学研究日期范围，January 仍在相似日期列举结构中出现。

en.description: Primarily responds to day numbers after months in date expressions, especially dates after January; also responds more weakly to day numbers after December, June, March, and April. Common in study periods or observation dates; other passage features are insufficient to explain it.

patterns.name: Date numbers after January
patterns.context: Day numbers after January are marked in date ranges or specific observation dates; number formats vary, while adjacent commas and years are usually unmarked.
patterns.domain: Methods/results in medical papers, astronomy observation papers

patterns.name: Day numbers after other months in date ranges
patterns.context: Day numbers after other months may also trigger when listed alongside January date ranges, but marking is weaker and inconsistent.

patterns.name: Other date numbers in astronomy papers
patterns.context: Day numbers are marked in observation months listed alongside January; the month names themselves are unmarked.

1_86.description: 主要响应日期表达中的月份后日号，尤其 January 后的日期；也会较弱地响应 December、June、March、April 后的日号。常见于研究时间范围或观测日期，其他文段特征不足以解释。

patterns.name: 月份 January 后的日期数字
patterns.trigger: « January» 后紧接日期数字，如« January»10、« January»9
patterns.context: 日期范围或具体观测日期中，January 后的日号被标记；数字形式不固定，且相邻的逗号、年份通常未标记。
patterns.domain: 医学论文方法/结果、天文观测论文

patterns.name: 日期范围中的其他月份日号
patterns.context: 与 January 日期范围并列出现时，其他月份后的日号也可触发，但标记强度较弱且不稳定。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及研究时间范围

patterns.name: 天文论文中的其他日期数字
patterns.context: 与 January 同列的观测月份中，日号被标记；对应月份名称本身未标记。

en.concept: Academic paper structure and formatting cues
en.description: Primarily responds to academic paper structure and layout cues, especially section references, section organization, and methods descriptions; also covers journal metadata, study date ranges, physics terms, observation notation, and graph theory content, with some patterns appearing only once.

patterns.name: Journal/paper layout metadata
patterns.context: Numbers, volume and issue information, placeholders, dates, and uppercase publication labels occur consecutively, resembling headers, citations, or manuscript metadata; passage [6].

patterns.name: Paper structure headings and section references
patterns.context: Introduces the organization, methods, or contents of sections in a research paper, often with section labels, numbers, or links; passages [3][4][7][9][10].

patterns.name: Date-range boundaries
patterns.context: A study enrollment or literature search period described by start and end dates; passages [1][2].

patterns.name: used to in research methods
patterns.context: Passive-voice description of a principle or database used for research purposes; passage [2].

patterns.name: Word fragments and compounds in scientific terminology
patterns.context: Technical terms, models, or variables appear in the main text of a theoretical physics paper; passages [3][4][7].

patterns.name: Digital technology and unit notation
patterns.context: Numbers, measurement units, angular scales, and dates appear together in astronomical observation descriptions; passage [8].

patterns.name: Graph theory terms and title fragments
patterns.context: Defines a graph using geometric objects and their intersection relations; graph-related terms appear in both the title and body; passage [5].

patterns.name: Properties and discourse connectors in academic writing
patterns.context: Organizes the discussion, points to subsequent sections, or summarizes analysis steps in a paper; passages [3][9].

1_86.concept: 学术论文结构与格式线索
1_86.description: 主要响应学术论文的结构与排版线索，尤其章节引用、章节安排及方法叙述；同时覆盖期刊元数据、研究日期范围、物理术语、观测记法和图论内容，部分模式仅个别出现。

patterns.name: 期刊/论文排版元数据
patterns.context: 数字、卷期、占位符、日期和大写出版标签连续出现，类似页眉、引文或稿件元数据；段[6]

patterns.name: 论文结构标题与章节引用
patterns.context: 研究论文中介绍章节安排、方法或章节内容，常出现章节标签、编号或链接；段[3][4][7][9][10]

patterns.name: 日期区间边界
patterns.trigger: “1 January 2010 and 31 December 2013”“1 January 2000 and 31 December 2017”
patterns.context: 研究纳入或文献检索的时间范围，以起止日期描述；段[1][2]

patterns.name: 研究方法中的 used to
patterns.trigger: “were used to provide”“was used to identify”
patterns.context: 被动语态描述某种原则或数据库被用于研究目的；段[2]

patterns.name: 科学术语中的分词/复合词片段
patterns.context: 理论物理论文正文出现技术术语、模型或变量；段[3][4][7]

patterns.name: 数字化技术与单位记法
patterns.trigger: “2 x 7.3 arcmin²”“10 m”“1996 January, March and April”
patterns.context: 天文观测描述中，数字、测量单位、角尺度和日期组合出现；段[8]

patterns.name: 图论术语与标题碎片
patterns.context: 以几何对象及其相交关系定义图，标题和正文均出现 graph 相关术语；段[5]

patterns.name: 学术表达中的性质与论述连接
patterns.trigger: “properties in Sec”“However, we will first provide”“followed in the numerical analyses”
patterns.context: 论文中组织论述、指引后文或概述分析步骤；段[3][9]

en.concept: Structure and technical markers in academic text
en.description: Activations are distributed across paper titles and section markers, date months, English function words, numerical units, and fragments of technical terms and abbreviations; most occur in technical academic text, but triggers are not uniform.

patterns.name: Paper structure headings and section references
patterns.context: Near titles, section names, cross-references, or subsection descriptions; often accompanied by section numbers, markers, or separators.
patterns.domain: Academic papers (astrophysics, graph theory, medicine, etc.)

patterns.name: Month names in dates
patterns.context: A month as part of a date, often adjacent to a day or year; also occurs in paper headers or tables.
patterns.domain: Academic paper dates, observation records, and tables

patterns.name: English function words and phrase boundaries
patterns.context: Prepositions or conjunctions in ordinary English sentences connect nouns, actions, or clauses; the context domain is not fixed.

patterns.name: Numbers, units, and technical quantities
patterns.context: A number followed by a time or physical unit, range symbol, or measurement-uncertainty notation.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods, physics and medical papers

patterns.name: Specific abbreviations or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Internal fragments of proper names or abbreviations in table fields, network terminology, equipment names, or correction notices; contexts vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Research tables, computer networking, experimental equipment, publishing corrections

patterns.name: Fragments within technical terms and compounds
patterns.context: Trigger fragments are embedded in technical terms or word forms rather than being standalone general concepts.
patterns.domain: Nuclear physics, graph theory, and other technical texts

patterns.name: Experimental procedures and equipment descriptions
patterns.context: In sentences describing experimental steps, instruments, or operational results.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods and medical procedure descriptions

patterns.name: Date and numerical records in tables
patterns.context: Objects, dates, and measurement/count values are listed in rows and columns.

1_86.concept: 学术文本中的结构与技术标记
1_86.description: 激活分散于论文标题和章节标记、日期月份、英文功能词、数值单位，以及专业术语和缩写片段；多数出现在技术性学术文本，但触发点并不统一。

patterns.name: 论文结构标题与章节引用
patterns.context: 标题、章节名、章节交叉引用或小节说明附近；常伴随章节编号、标记或分隔线
patterns.domain: 学术论文（天体物理、图论、医学等）

patterns.name: 日期中的月份名称
patterns.context: 月份作为日期的一部分，常与日、年相邻；也见于论文页眉或表格
patterns.domain: 学术论文日期、观测记录及表格

patterns.name: 英文功能词与短语边界
patterns.context: 普通英文句子中介词或连词连接名词、动作或分句；上下文领域并不固定

patterns.name: 数字、单位及技术量值
patterns.context: 数字后接时间或物理单位、范围符号及测量误差记号
patterns.domain: 实验方法、物理与医学论文

patterns.name: 特定缩写或专名片段
patterns.context: 表格字段、网络术语、设备名称或更正声明中的专名/缩写内部片段；各例上下文差异较大
patterns.domain: 科研表格、计算机网络、实验设备、出版更正

patterns.name: 专业名词及复合词内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段嵌在专业术语或词形中，而非独立的通用概念
patterns.domain: 核物理、图论及其他技术文本

patterns.name: 实验操作与器材表述
patterns.context: 描述实验步骤、器械或操作结果的句子中
patterns.domain: 实验方法及医学操作描述

patterns.name: 表格中的日期与数值记录
patterns.context: 以行列形式列出对象、日期及测量/计数数值

en.description: Activations are scattered across several word fragments: paper subsection references are the most concentrated; Jared, compared, November, checked, and correction also appear in email, film, medical, paper-metadata, and journal-correction contexts, respectively.

patterns.name: Subsection/section references
patterns.context: Uses section cross-references to organize research content in the body of a paper, often accompanied by a summary of a section's content.

patterns.name: Name Jared
patterns.context: The name appears in email signatures or film-cast descriptions; activation is concentrated at the end of the name.

patterns.name: ared within a comparison word
patterns.context: Compares surviving and nonsurviving patients in a medical abstract; activation falls on a fragment within compared.

patterns.name: November in year-date expressions
patterns.context: A paper date or author information in parentheses, with the month adjacent to a year and author information.

patterns.name: Checking action
patterns.context: Describes an experimental method as double checked to avoid or confirm measurement error.

patterns.name: Opening of a correction notice
patterns.context: The title or opening of a journal correction notice, followed by publication details for the original paper.

1_86.concept: 词片段与标记格式触发
1_86.description: 激活分散在若干词片段上：论文小节引用最集中；另见 Jared、compared、November、checked 与 correction，分别来自邮件、影视、医学、论文元数据及期刊更正。

patterns.name: 小节/章节引用
patterns.trigger: «Sect»、«Sec» 后接章节编号或 LaTeX 引用，如 «Sect»10.\[«Discussion»2.«sec»4\]、«Sec»10. \[«sec»54\]
patterns.context: 论文正文中用章节交叉引用来组织研究内容，常伴随对某节内容的概述。

patterns.name: 姓名 Jared
patterns.context: 姓名出现在邮件署名或电影演员介绍语境中；触发位置集中在名字末尾。

patterns.name: 比较/对照词中含 ared
patterns.context: 医学摘要中比较存活与未存活患者；激活落在 compared 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 年份日期中的 November
patterns.context: 括号中的论文日期或署名信息，月份与年份、作者信息相邻。

patterns.name: 校验动作
patterns.context: 描述实验方法经过 double checked，以避免或确认测量误差。

patterns.name: 更正通知开头
patterns.context: 期刊更正说明的标题或开头，后接原论文的出版信息。

en.concept: Academic text structure and scientific unit markers
en.description: Primarily responds to Section/section markers and section references in academic papers; also responds to Å, mm, and K in crystallographic parameter strings. A few isolated activations involve the text fragments quenching, Yonsei, and ASS/ell, which are difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: “Section” section references and heading markers
patterns.context: Appears in academic manuscripts to refer to a section, define a section anchor, or form part of a section heading; capitalization and combinations with numbers, punctuation, and anchor text vary.
patterns.domain: ArXiv or PubMed Central academic papers and their structured text

patterns.name: Å unit in crystallographic data
patterns.context: Appears in crystal structure/experimental data strings, adjacent to numbers, chemical formulas, or lattice parameters.
patterns.domain: Crystallographic data in PubMed Central scientific papers

patterns.name: mm unit
patterns.context: Appears near numbers and negative exponents as a measurement unit; the context is experimental crystallography parameters.
patterns.domain: Experimental data in PubMed Central scientific papers

patterns.name: K radiation symbol
patterns.context: Appears after a number to indicate experimental temperature; the same passage also contains a radiation source and crystallographic data.
patterns.domain: Crystallographic experimental parameters in PubMed Central scientific papers

patterns.name: Colon after section numbers
patterns.context: Follows a section marker and number, connecting to a section anchor name.
patterns.domain: Structured section markers in ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Other terms or formula fragments
patterns.context: Each appears in a separate context: a physics term, an institution-name fragment, and formatted text in a machine-learning title/keywords; there is insufficient evidence for a shared trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Nuclear physics, institutional affiliations, machine-learning papers

1_86.concept: 学术文本结构与科学单位标记
1_86.description: 主要响应学术论文中的 Section/section 章节标记及章节引用；另对晶体学参数串中的 Å、mm 和 K 有响应。少数孤立激活涉及 quenching、Yonsei 和 ASS/ell 等文本片段，难以与主模式统一。

patterns.name: “Section”章节引用与标题标记
patterns.context: 出现在学术文稿中，指向章节、定义章节锚点，或作为章节标题的一部分；大小写及与数字、标点、锚点文本的组合不一。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 或 PubMed Central 学术论文及其结构化文本

patterns.name: 晶体学数据中的单位符号 Å
patterns.context: 出现在晶体结构/实验数据串中，邻接数值、化学式或晶格参数。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 科学论文的晶体学数据

patterns.name: 量纲单位 mm
patterns.context: 出现在数字及负指数附近，作为测量单位；上下文是晶体学实验参数。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 科学论文的实验数据

patterns.name: 单位辐射符号 K
patterns.context: 出现在数字之后，表示实验温度；同段还包含辐射源和晶体学数据。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 科学论文的晶体学实验参数

patterns.name: 章节编号后的冒号
patterns.context: 紧跟章节标记和编号，并连接章节锚点名称。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的结构化章节标记

patterns.name: 其他术语或公式碎片
patterns.context: 各自在单独语境中出现，分别是物理术语、机构名片段和机器学习标题/关键词中的格式化文本；没有足够证据形成共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 核物理、机构署名、机器学习论文

en.concept: Academic text formatting and terminology fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across formatting and terminology common in academic literature: section references, crystallographic parameters (Å, Kα, mm⁻¹), corrections and DOI, as well as a few physics-paper metadata items and business email terms; there is no clear unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: “section” heading or cross-reference
patterns.context: Appears in paper body section references, section headings, or subsection anchors; sometimes adjacent to « graph».

patterns.name: Å unit in crystallographic tables
patterns.context: In crystallographic data records, Å is followed by a number or exponent notation; the same row often contains radiation, temperature, and unit-cell parameters.
patterns.domain: Data tables in PubMed Central crystallography papers

patterns.name: Kα radiation record
patterns.context: Appears in a crystallographic experimental data row, alongside parameters such as element, absorption coefficient μ, and temperature T.
patterns.domain: Data tables in PubMed Central crystallography papers

patterns.name: Negative-exponent length unit mm⁻¹
patterns.context: The unit of μ, appearing in crystallographic radiation parameter records.
patterns.domain: Data tables in PubMed Central crystallography papers

patterns.name: Correction statement and literature identifier
patterns.context: Begins a journal article correction notice, followed by a citation and DOI.

patterns.name: Quenching and author information in physics papers
patterns.context: A nuclear physics problem description is followed by a South Korean university address and date; activations are distributed across separate terms.
patterns.domain: ArXiv physics paper metadata or manuscript

patterns.name: See and signature terms in business emails
patterns.context: The email body refers to an attached revised draft and ends with Regards and the signature Jared.

1_86.concept: 学术文本格式与术语片段
1_86.description: 激活分布在学术文献中常见的格式与术语：section 引用、晶体学参数（Å、Kα、mm⁻¹）、校正与 DOI，以及少量物理论文元数据和商务邮件词项；没有明显统一的语义触发点。

patterns.name: “section”标题或交叉引用
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文的章节引用、章节标题或小节锚点中；有时与« graph»相邻。

patterns.name: 晶体学表格中的 Å 单位
patterns.context: 晶体学数据记录中，Å 后接数值或幂次记号；同一行常含辐射、温度和晶胞参数。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 晶体学论文的数据表

patterns.name: Kα 辐射记录
patterns.context: 出现在晶体学实验数据行，前后列有元素、吸收系数 μ、温度 T 等参数。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 晶体学论文的数据表

patterns.name: 负指数长度单位 mm⁻¹
patterns.context: 作为 μ 的单位，出现在晶体学辐射参数记录中。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 晶体学论文的数据表

patterns.name: 校正声明及文献标识符
patterns.context: 以期刊文章校正通知开头，随后出现引文和 DOI。

patterns.name: 物理论文中的 quenching 与作者信息
patterns.context: 核物理问题描述后接韩国大学地址和日期，激活分散在不同词项上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 物理论文元数据或文稿

patterns.name: 商务邮件中的 See 与署名名词
patterns.context: 邮件正文指向附件修订稿，结尾为 Regards 和 Jared 署名。

en.concept: Formatting and terminology fragments in scientific and technical text
en.description: Primarily responds to units, element/radiation symbols, and scientific-notation formats in crystallographic reports; also activates on local fragments in date months, paper section references, astrophysics narratives, table units, and network terminology.

patterns.name: Crystallographic parameters and unit symbols
patterns.context: Lattice parameters, radiation source, absorption coefficient, temperature, and scientific-notation numbers occur adjacent to one another in crystal structure data rows; activation often falls on symbols, units, and number-format fragments.
patterns.domain: Crystallographic paper data tables or structure reports in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Months in dates
patterns.context: A month appears in a date with a day, year, or author information; one is a paper date, the other a date in an observation log.
patterns.domain: Paper author information and astronomy observation tables

patterns.name: Letter fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation fragments are embedded within institution names or technical abbreviations rather than being standalone words; examples include Yonsei and VLANs.
patterns.domain: Physics author affiliations; computer networking encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Paper structure section references
patterns.context: Refers to sections in a paper using Sect. or Sect. followed by a number, often near discussion, observations, or results.

patterns.name: Astrophysics terms and prose words
patterns.context: Appears in continuous academic prose describing galaxies, observations of nuclear regions, and paper results; not all triggers belong to the same narrow word class.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics paper abstracts or main text

patterns.name: Table value-column labels
patterns.context: Units or count-rate units appear in table column headings and near values in astronomy observation tables.

patterns.name: Network protocol path descriptions
patterns.context: Technical discussion of the spanning tree protocol, path forwarding, and VLANs; some trigger fragments are substrings within words.

patterns.name: Isolated table text and number formats
patterns.context: A crystallographic parameter row contains a color description or blank field, and number-format fragments activate; this partly overlaps with the other crystallographic parameter pattern.

1_86.concept: 科学技术文本中的格式与术语片段
1_86.description: 主要响应晶体学报告中的单位、元素/辐射符号及科学计数法格式；另对日期月份、论文章节引用、天体物理叙述、表格单位和网络术语中的局部片段激活。

patterns.name: 晶体学参数与单位符号
patterns.context: 晶体结构数据行中，晶格参数、辐射源、吸收系数、温度及科学计数法数值相邻出现；激活常落在符号、单位及数字格式片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 的晶体学论文数据表或结构报告

patterns.name: 日期中的月份
patterns.context: 月份出现在带有日、年或作者信息的日期中；一个为论文日期，一个为观测记录表中的日期。
patterns.domain: 论文作者信息与天文观测表

patterns.name: 专名内部的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活片段嵌在机构名或技术缩写内部，而非独立词；分别见 Yonsei 与 VLANs。
patterns.domain: 物理作者地址；计算机网络百科文本

patterns.name: 论文结构标题引用
patterns.context: 以 Sect. 或 Sect.加编号引用论文中的章节，周围常有讨论、观察或结果等行文。

patterns.name: 天体物理术语与行文词
patterns.trigger: « properties»、« extinction»、« analyzed»、« detail»、« show»、« results»
patterns.context: 出现在描述星系、核区观测及论文结果的连续学术叙述中；不都由同一窄词类触发。
patterns.domain: 天体物理论文摘要或正文

patterns.name: 表格数值列标签
patterns.context: 单位或计数率单位出现在天文观测表的列标题、数值附近。

patterns.name: 网络协议路径描述
patterns.context: 讨论生成树协议、路径转发及 VLAN 的技术说明；触发片段部分是词内子串。

patterns.name: 孤立的表格文本与数值格式
patterns.context: 结构参数行中夹有颜色描述或空白字段，且数值格式片段激活；与其余晶体学参数模式部分重叠。

en.concept: beauty vocabulary and a few instances of involved
en.description: Strongly responds primarily to the English word beauty, covering different referents such as beauty products, nature, experiences, ethnic groups, mythology, and art; two other segments mark involved in different contexts. The triggering substring is the same, but the semantics and contexts differ.

patterns.name: The word beauty
patterns.context: The English noun beauty itself is marked; it often appears in of beauty or before a comma, and also directly in contexts involving industries and natural landscapes. Its specific referent may be beauty products, a social networking site, nature, an experience, an ethnic group, a mythological figure, or an artistic work.
patterns.domain: Various genres: business, biography, online discussion, product promotion, reviews, history, mythology, and art

patterns.name: involved in a machine-learning context
patterns.context: Appears in the expression “you're involved with machine learning”; activation falls on involved, while learning in the same sentence is unmarked.

patterns.name: involved in a startup Q&A context
patterns.context: Appears in “there is no salary involved,” describing an unpaid startup employment arrangement.

1_379.description: 主要对英文 beauty 一词强烈响应，涵盖美妆、自然、体验、民族、神话及艺术等不同所指；另两段在不同语境中标记 involved，触发子串相同但语义和上下文不同。

patterns.name: beauty 一词
patterns.context: 英文名词 beauty 本身被标记；多处位于 of beauty 或 beauty 后接逗号，也有直接接在行业、自然景观等语境中。具体所指可为美妆、社交网站、自然、体验、民族、神话人物或艺术创作。
patterns.domain: 多种文体：商业、人物传记、网络讨论、产品宣传、评论、历史、神话与艺术

patterns.name: 机器学习语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 出现在“you're involved with machine learning”这一表达中；激活落在 involved，而同句的 learning 未标记。

patterns.name: 创业问答语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 出现在“there is no salary involved”中，描述无薪酬的创业雇佣安排。

en.concept: Lexical triggers related to beauty and participation
en.description: The strongest and recurring pattern is the token beauty: it activates in texts from multiple domains discussing beauty, attractiveness, or the value of beauty. There are also two instances of activation on involved, concerning participation in machine learning and an unpaid arrangement, respectively; the contexts differ.

patterns.name: General use of beauty
patterns.context: The noun beauty appears in sentences describing beauty, aesthetics, or attractiveness; it may modify industries, communities, social networks, experiences, countries, artworks, or deities.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including beauty and health, community introductions, personal experiences, historical reviews, art, and mythology

patterns.name: involved in a machine-learning context
patterns.context: Appears in a conditional sentence asking whether the reader participates in a field, followed by “with machine learning”.

patterns.name: involved in an employment / compensation context
patterns.context: Modifies “salary” in a question about equity for a startup's first engineer, expressing an arrangement with no salary.

1_379.concept: 涉及美与参与的词汇触发
1_379.description: 最强且反复的模式是词元 beauty：多领域文本中谈及美感、美貌或美的价值时激活。另有两例在 involved 一词上激活，分别涉及参与机器学习和无薪酬安排，语境彼此不同。

patterns.name: beauty 的一般性使用
patterns.context: 名词 beauty 出现在描述美、美感或美貌的句子中；修饰对象可以是产业、社群、社交网络、体验、国家、艺术作品或神祇。
patterns.domain: 美容与健康、社群介绍、个人体验、历史评论、艺术和神话等多种文体

patterns.name: 机器学习语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 出现在询问读者是否参与某领域的条件句中，后接“with machine learning”。
patterns.domain: 技术教程／机器学习博客

patterns.name: 雇佣／薪酬语境中的 involved
patterns.context: 修饰“salary”，出现在创业公司首位工程师股权的问句中，表达没有薪水的安排。
patterns.domain: 创业公司／技术论坛讨论

en.description: Activations are scattered across the code identifier HM, the word involved, beauty, and a subword fragment within psychiatry; the first three categories each recur locally but have no unified semantics. No clear corresponding trigger appears in the PubMed samples.

patterns.name: HM code identifier
patterns.context: An uppercase identifier fragment in code, often surrounded by camel case or all-uppercase identifiers; both segments occur in Windows/display-related C code.

patterns.name: involved
patterns.context: The trigger is involved, appearing respectively in “no salary involved” and in “involved with/in” constructions; the latter refers to participation in machine learning or biosynthesis, or association with depression.
patterns.domain: Forum articles, machine-learning tutorials, PubMed/NIH academic abstracts

patterns.name: beauty
patterns.context: beauty appears in an introduction to the personal care industry and in a journalist's career history, where it is listed alongside health, nutrition, and fitness.
patterns.domain: Business introduction, biography / news career profile

patterns.name: beauty industry adjacent topic
patterns.context: A subword fragment in psychia-try occurs in a behavioral psychologist context after a title; it has no clear lexical or syntactic connection to the other triggers.

1_379.description: 激活分散于代码标识符 HM、词 involved、beauty，以及 psychiatry 的词内片段；前三类各有局部重复，但彼此无统一语义。PubMed 样本未见明确对应触发。

patterns.name: HM 代码标识符
patterns.context: 作为代码中的大写标识符片段，周围常有驼峰命名或全大写标识符；两段都处于 Windows/显示器相关 C 代码中。

patterns.name: involved
patterns.context: 触发词为 involved，分别出现在“no salary involved”和“involved with/in”结构中；后者表示参与机器学习、生物合成或与抑郁相关。
patterns.domain: 论坛文章、机器学习教程、PubMed/NIH 学术摘要

patterns.name: beauty
patterns.context: beauty 出现在个人护理行业介绍及记者职业经历中，后者与健康、营养、健身并列。
patterns.domain: 商业介绍、人物传记/新闻职业简介

patterns.name: beauty industry adjacent topic
patterns.context: psychia-try 的词内片段出现在标题后的行为心理学家语境；与其他触发词没有明显词义或句法联系。

en.description: Activation is scattered across the year 1956, the case-sensitive substring HM, the phrase Concert, and subword fragments in psychiatrist(s) and STRANGERS; each depends on different surface forms or local contexts, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Year 1956
patterns.context: The year appears in a television program title or a person's birth information.

patterns.name: Uppercase HM substring
patterns.context: The uppercase letter sequence HM appears in a flag field, identifier, code, or medical text; it may be joined to following characters.
patterns.domain: Code, medical abstracts, database gene names

patterns.name: Concert phrase
patterns.context: In and around the phrase “One Love Reggae Peace Concert History”.

patterns.name: psychiatrist(s)
patterns.context: The word psychiatrist(s) appears in texts about behavior, interviews, or interdisciplinary collaboration.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in STRANGERS
patterns.context: Activation falls on a contiguous fragment within STRANGERS in the all-uppercase title “CANDY WITH STRANGERS”.

1_379.description: 激活模式分散：年份1956、大小写敏感的HM子串、Concert短语、psychiatrist(s)及STRANGERS词内片段；各自依赖不同的词面或局部语境，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 年份 1956
patterns.context: 年份出现在电视节目标题或人物出生信息中

patterns.name: 大写 HM 子串
patterns.context: 大写字母串 HM 出现在标志字段、标识符、代码或医学文本中；可与后续字符连在一起
patterns.domain: 代码、医学摘要、数据库基因名

patterns.name: Concert 短语
patterns.context: 短语“One Love Reggae Peace Concert History”及其相关叙述中

patterns.name: psychiatrist(s)
patterns.context: psychiatrist(s) 一词出现在有关行为、访谈或跨学科合作的文本中
patterns.domain: 心理健康、学术项目介绍

patterns.name: STRANGERS 的词内片段
patterns.context: 全大写标题“CANDY WITH STRANGERS”中，激活落在 STRANGERS 的连续片段上

en.description: Activation falls mainly on letter strings such as Pres and HM and a few specific fragments (1956, Arch-top, Cindy); other activations occur on various fields, proper nouns, and technical-term fragments with no obvious shared semantics, spanning multiple domains.

patterns.name: Pres substring
patterns.context: The letter string Pres appears in identifiers, configuration fields, or ordinary English words; surrounding characters vary, and all show high activation.

patterns.name: HM abbreviation
patterns.context: HM appears in medical diseases or gene/biomedical abbreviations, with neighboring characters varying by context.

patterns.name: Number 1956
patterns.context: The year appears in a historical event description in a program title.

patterns.name: Field value 0
patterns.context: Field names and their values in structured configuration or serialized text; high activation concentrates on a substring of the field name, not the numeric value.

patterns.name: Standalone title field
patterns.context: The characters HM occur in the value of a Flags field in image/font-related metadata.

patterns.name: Guitar in an instrument title
patterns.context: In a work title related to an Arch-top guitar, the Arch/top subword fragments also activate.

patterns.name: Name fragment Cindy
patterns.context: The proper noun is tokenized as C and indy, occurring in a musician's biography.

patterns.name: Other sporadic subword fragments
patterns.context: Trigger locations differ across segments, relating respectively to Fiji word forms, drug terminology, metadata/encoding fields, and texture configuration; no shared local semantic condition is apparent.

1_379.description: 激活主要落在 Pres、HM 等字母子串及少数特定片段（1956、Arch-top、Cindy）；另有多种无明显共同语义的字段、专名和术语片段，跨领域分布。

patterns.name: Preserve 子串
patterns.context: 字母子串 Pres 出现在标识符、配置字段或普通英文词中；周围字符不同，均有高激活。
patterns.domain: GitHub 配置文本、专利文本

patterns.name: HM 缩写
patterns.context: HM 出现在医学疾病或基因/生物医学缩写中，邻接字符因语境而异。

patterns.name: 数字 1956
patterns.context: 年份出现在节目标题的历史事件描述中。

patterns.name: 字段值 0
patterns.context: 结构化配置或序列化文本中的字段名及其值；高激活集中于字段名子串，而非数值。

patterns.name: 独立标题字段
patterns.context: 字符 HM 位于图像/字体相关元数据的 Flags 字段值中。

patterns.name: 乐器标题中的 Guitar
patterns.context: Arch-top guitar 相关作品标题中，Arch/top 等分词片段也激活。

patterns.name: 人名片段 Cindy
patterns.context: 专名被分词为 C 与 indy，发生在音乐家传记中。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 各段触发位置不同，分别涉及 Fiji 词形、药物术语、元数据/编码字段和纹理配置；未见共同的局部语义条件。

en.description: Activation often falls on the letter strings onic/sonic or Ish, including medical-term endings, physics and immunology terms, proper nouns, and titles; several other activations fall inside abbreviations or technical terms, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: myotonic / dystonic-related endings
patterns.context: In medical contexts, appears in the disease name “myotonic dystrophy” or “dystonic contraction”; [1] also contains «val»5«onic»10, related to the disease name mevalonic aciduria.

patterns.name: -onic string in other words
patterns.context: The letter substrings in “π-f interaction” and “opsonic antibodies” do not clearly have the same semantic function as medical disease-name endings.

patterns.name: Ish string in names
patterns.context: Activation falls inside names or proper nouns beginning with Ish; segments include Ishihara, Kenji Ishii, Ishin...omaki, Ishkur.
patterns.domain: Patent citations, paper authors, hospital names, encyclopedia text

patterns.name: SONIC string
patterns.context: The contiguous letters Sonic occur in a name; here, it is a music title or group name, not a medical term.

patterns.name: Other instances of the consonant string onic
patterns.context: These fragments have no identifiable shared meaning or contextual trigger; activation spans different substrings within terms, abbreviations, and proper nouns.
patterns.domain: Medicine, experimental techniques, ancient Near Eastern proper nouns

1_379.description: 激活点多落在 onic/sonic 或 Ish 字母串上：包括医学术语词尾、物理和免疫术语、专名及标题；另有若干落在其他缩写或术语内部，未见一致语义条件。

patterns.name: myotonic／dystonic 相关词尾
patterns.context: 在医学语境中，出现在疾病名称“myotonic dystrophy”或“dystonic contraction”中；[1]还出现 «val»5«onic»10，与疾病名 mevalonic aciduria 相关。

patterns.name: 其他词中的 -onic 字符串
patterns.context: 分别是“π-f interaction”和“opsonic antibodies”中的字母子串，不明显具有与医学疾病词尾相同的语义功能。

patterns.name: Ish 人名字符串
patterns.context: 激活落在 Ish 开头的人名或专名内部；片段中出现 Ishihara、Kenji Ishii、Ishin...omaki、Ishkur。
patterns.domain: 专利引文、论文作者、医院名称、百科文本

patterns.name: SONIC 字符串
patterns.context: 作为名称中的连续字母 Sonic 出现；此处是音乐标题或团体名称，而非医学术语。

patterns.name: 辅音字母串 onic 的其他实例
patterns.context: 这些片段没有可确认的共同词义或上下文触发条件；激活跨越术语、缩写及专名内部的不同子串。
patterns.domain: 医学、实验技术、古代近东专名

en.description: All segments mark fragments within words beginning with mult, covering different meanings such as multisystem, multigene, multijoint, multistep, multiferroic, multisensory, multivalent, multilayer, multitemporal, and multivalued; segment 1 also marks disease and genetic words, while segments 3 and 4 contain sporadic marks.

patterns.name: Beginning of mult- compounds
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on mult-; following affixes and meanings vary. It commonly occurs inside compounds containing multi-/multi, without requiring a specific semantic category.
patterns.domain: Medical, biological, physical, psychological, remote-sensing, mathematical, and related paper abstracts

patterns.name: Description of multisystem disease
patterns.context: Multi- terms occur in disease names and descriptions of genetic or systemic degenerative diseases; marks are scattered across different words.

patterns.name: multi- gene family in a title
patterns.context: The title discusses a gene family, with multi- forming multigene.

patterns.name: Motor control terms
patterns.context: Discusses hand control, with multi- forming multijoint; a mark also falls in the preceding word musculotendon.

patterns.name: Multistep process
patterns.context: An oncology title describes a process as multistep; tobacco and other words in the same title are also marked.

patterns.name: Multiferroic materials term
patterns.context: In a materials science abstract, multi- forms multiferroic, describing the phase structure of a strained film.

patterns.name: Multisensory term
patterns.context: Discusses sensory integration in bodily self-awareness and illusion, with multi- forming multisensory.

patterns.name: Multivalent counterions
patterns.context: Multivalent counterions occur in colloidal suspensions and polyelectrolyte solutions.

patterns.name: Multilayer bilayer membrane

en.description: All segments strongly activate the word-initial fragment “Ge”, but it occurs in geographic words, names, philosophical terms, technical terms, and biological taxonomic names; a few sporadic fragment activations are specific to individual segments, with no stable commonality.

patterns.name: “Ge” fragment within words
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the word-initial fragment “Ge” with uppercase G, while the following meaning and complete spelling vary; the same fragment appears in different words, including Geografia, Geórgia, Geremek, Geistes, Gecko, Geometridae, Geographical.
patterns.domain: Across Portuguese, Italian, Spanish, German, and English, as well as structured data; genres include place names, personal names, taxonomy, technical material, and bibliographic text

patterns.name: Geographic / place-name vocabulary
patterns.context: “Ge” is at the start of geography-related words such as Geografia, Geórgia, and Geographical; however, this meaning is not required for activation.

patterns.name: Geometridae moth taxonomy name
patterns.context: “Ge” begins Geometridae; it appears in descriptions of moth family names, and the same set of entries also contains other moth names without that family name.

patterns.name: Other names or terms beginning with Ge
patterns.context: The activated “Ge” continues into Geremek, Geistes, and Gecko; these words differ considerably in meaning and context.
patterns.domain: European Parliament eulogy, philosophical bibliography, Ubuntu technical forum

patterns.name: Non-Ge subword fragments in moth entries
patterns.context: In addition to the “Ge” fragment, weaker positive activations occur in species or genus names in moth entries; the fragments vary, with no stable shared word form.

patterns.name: Portuguese word-final / internal fragments
patterns.context: Several sporadic positive activation fragments occur in Portuguese sentences, including word endings, internal fragments, and ordinary function words; they do not form a unified, clear trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Spanish internal fragments
patterns.context: Several internal fragments in Spanish philosophical discussion and bibliographic citations show weak activation; no clear semantic connection to the highly activated “Ge” is apparent.

patterns.name: Other sporadic function-word or internal-word activations
patterns.context: A few segments also show sporadic low-to-moderate activations in function words, ordinary words, or internal fragments, without a discernible pattern consistent across segments.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, technical forums, and Github JSON

en.description: Activations are scattered across papers, medical abstracts, project text, business discussions, philosophy, and code: these include expressions of research focus or current status such as focus/Current/Importance, as well as local terms such as vital, light, age, and kind reference, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: Core terms in research titles
patterns.context: In title-like phrases, activation falls on the words “Importance” and “Guarantee”; section headings and Markdown heading formats surround them.

patterns.name: Ontology and importance / integrity
patterns.context: When discussing the creation, simplification, or application of ontologies, activation occurs on “focus” and expressions related to importance and integrity.

patterns.name: CSS font-weight word light
patterns.context: In a Tailwind CSS @apply style class, “light” after the hyphen is marked; other style tokens in the same segment do not show the same activation.

patterns.name: Medical term vital
patterns.context: In a dental medicine phrase, the adjective “vital” is marked, referring to pulpotomy of a primary tooth.

patterns.name: Focus in a research plan
patterns.context: In a project description sentence, “focus,” meaning the research emphasis, is activated.

patterns.name: light in a neural network model name
patterns.context: In a citation or model name related to a 3D CNN, “light” is marked as part of the model name.

patterns.name: age in a list of diversity dimensions
patterns.context: In a discussion of organizational diversity, “age” is marked when listing dimensions such as gender, age, and region.

patterns.name: Kind reference in philosophy
patterns.context: When discussing entities, existence, and related topics in philosophy of language, “reference” in the term “kind reference” activates.

patterns.name: Aging and age-related research
patterns.context: When describing normal aging and age-related neurodegenerative diseases, age-related words are marked.

patterns.name: Current and focus in a sleep disorder
patterns.context: In a sleep monitoring analysis abstract, “Current” and the expression “focus” for the research topic are marked.

en.description: Activation concentrates on specific endings of several technical terms, such as «ance» in Importance and «old» in threshold.
