en.concept: Emoji word form and sporadic subwords
en.description: The most stable signal is o in the word emoji, occurring across varied genres; other activations are scattered across proper nouns, code, French/Romanian word forms, drug names, and local subwords in Unicode terminology, and are difficult to explain with a single rule.

patterns.name: emoji string
patterns.context: The letter o in the stem emoji is marked; it can occur in varied contexts such as ordinary discussions, design questions, and technical documentation.
patterns.domain: Forums, Q&A, medical abstracts, encyclopedias, etc.

patterns.name: m within English words
patterns.context: Inside English proper nouns or code identifiers; there are few examples, so it is unclear whether this relates to the emoji pattern.

patterns.name: Aut word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the code header filename “«Aut»osave” and at the start of Romanian text, “-«Aut»oritatea”; the specific trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: French word endings and internal fragments
patterns.context: Fragments of several words in French parliamentary texts are marked, including “«e». «Cec«i»”, “d«'»une”, “touch«ées»”; activations are scattered and may reflect subwords or local morphological features.

patterns.name: Romanian word fragments
patterns.context: Several internal fragments in formal Romanian speeches are marked, such as “Aut«or»itatea”, “dom«nil»or”, and “do«res»c”; there is no clear shared semantics.

patterns.name: empathize word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in “em«path»«ize» phase” in a discussion of the empathy stage of design thinking; the adjacent “ize” and “phase” are also marked.

patterns.name: Medical drug-name fragments
patterns.context: Appears within the drug name emtricitabine as “em«t»ricit«it»abine”; nearby markings also include drug-abbreviation fragments.

patterns.name: Untouchables word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the band name “«Un»«touch»ables”; it shares the surface substring touch with other passages, but the context differs.

patterns.name: Unicode variation sequence
patterns.context: Encyclopedia text describes Unicode variation selectors for emoji-style and text presentation; this aligns with the emoji theme, but markings are distributed across multiple fragments.

1_379.description: 最稳定线索是 emoji 一词中的 o，且出现于多种文体；其余激活分散在专名、代码、法语/罗马尼亚语词形、药名及 Unicode 术语的局部子词中，难以由单一规则解释。

patterns.name: emoji 字符串
patterns.context: 词干 emoji 中间的字母 o 被标记；可出现在普通讨论、设计问题、技术文档等不同上下文中。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、医学摘要、百科等

patterns.name: 英文词内的 m
patterns.context: 英文专名或代码标识符内部；片段很少，无法确定是否与 emoji 模式相关。

patterns.name: Aut 词片段
patterns.context: 出现在代码头文件名“«Aut»osave”及罗马尼亚语文本开头“-«Aut»oritatea”中，具体触发条件不明。

patterns.name: 法语词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 法语议会文本中多个词的片段被标记，包括“«e». «Cec«i»”, “d«'»une”, “touch«ées»”；触发分散，可能是子词或局部形态特征。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语正式讲话中若干词内片段被标记，如“Aut«or»itatea”“dom«nil»or”“do«res»c”；没有明确共同语义。

patterns.name: empathize 词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“em«path»«ize» phase”中，讨论设计思维的同理心阶段；相邻的“ize”“phase”也被标记。

patterns.name: 医学药名片段
patterns.context: 出现在“em«t»ricit«it»abine”药名 emtricitabine 内；其余附近标记为药物缩写片段。

patterns.name: Untouchables 词片段
patterns.context: 出现在乐队名“«Un»«touch»ables”中；与其他段的 touch 子串表面相同，但上下文不同。

patterns.name: Unicode 变体序列
patterns.context: 百科文本描述 emoji-style 与文本呈现的 Unicode 变体选择符；与 emoji 主题一致，但标记分布在多个片段。

en.description: The strongest recurring trigger is o in the spelling of emoji; empathy/empathize forms also trigger, as does t in emtricitabine. Other activations are scattered across course titles, names, band names, and Italian words, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: Letter o in the spelling of emoji
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the letter o in the English string emoji; it is sometimes accompanied by a hyphen or explanatory text about emoji.
patterns.domain: Ordinary text in HackerNews, Wikipedia, and EuroParl

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the empathy root
patterns.context: Occurs in forms related to empathy/empathize, involving empathy relationships and the design-thinking stage.

patterns.name: Drug-name fragment in emtricitabine
patterns.context: Occurs within the spelling of emtricitabine, a drug related to HIV/HBV prophylaxis and treatment.

patterns.name: Word boundaries and Italian internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on boundaries between adjacent words or inside ordinary Italian words; no stable shared meaning or context is apparent.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in personal and band names
patterns.context: Occurs in musicians’ names and hardcore band names, with no clear connection to emoji or empathy forms.

patterns.name: Other sporadic English fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across comments, URLs, usernames, and ordinary words, without a confirmed recurring pattern.

1_379.description: 最强且重复的触发是 emoji 拼写中的 o；另在 empathy/empathize 词形中触发，也有 emtricitabine 内的 t。其余激活零散分布于课程标题、人名、乐队名和意大利语词语，无法统一解释。

patterns.name: emoji 拼写中的字母 o
patterns.context: 英文字符串 emoji 中，激活集中在字母 o；周围有时带连字符或有关 emoji 的说明文字。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、Wikipedia 及 EuroParl 中的普通文本

patterns.name: empathy 词根内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 empathy/empathize 相关词形中，分别涉及共情关系和设计思维阶段。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述、StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: emtricitabine 药名片段
patterns.context: 出现在 HIV/HBV 预防治疗相关药物 emtricitabine 的拼写内部。

patterns.name: 多词边界及意大利语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在相邻词的边界或普通意大利语词内部；未见稳定的共同词义或语境。
patterns.domain: 营销/阅读课程标题、意大利语法律论述

patterns.name: 人名和乐队名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 出现在音乐人姓名和 hardcore 乐队名称中，与 emoji 或共情词形无明显联系。

patterns.name: 其他零散英文片段
patterns.context: 散落在评论、URL、用户名及普通词语中，未形成可确认的重复模式。

en.concept: Cross-corpus word fragments and subword boundaries
en.description: Activations often fall on internal fragments of split words, including parliamentary texts in multiple languages, emoji, proper nouns such as Eloise, years and page numbers, usernames, and anomalous strings; no unified semantic trigger is apparent so far.

patterns.name: Split “emoji”
patterns.context: The word emoji appears in English sentences, with activation concentrated on the split o portion; it may be preceded by a hyphen or other modifiers.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, HackerNews; explanatory text, forum discussions

patterns.name: Romanian internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Internal word fragments in continuous Romanian text, spanning word-initial and medial positions; Romanian diacritics also appear in the same passage.

patterns.name: French internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Fragments of ordinary words in French parliamentary speeches; high activation falls on «iter», followed by «a», in the context of profiter(a).

patterns.name: Italian internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across internal fragments in Italian parliamentary text; stronger activations concentrate on «i» and «uti» in compiuti.

patterns.name: Portuguese internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Internal fragments in Portuguese parliamentary speeches; the highest activation falls on «v» in desvio.

patterns.name: Years and numeric ranges
patterns.context: Bibliographic year entries and page ranges; «13» activates significantly more strongly than adjacent numbers.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: The personal name Eloise; the fragment appears in encyclopedia entries or descriptions of fictional characters.

patterns.name: Garbled numeric and alphabetic strings
patterns.context: Nonstandard strings, usernames, or truncated text in forum posts, with no clear semantic cues.

patterns.name: Fragments inside user identifiers
patterns.context: Strings resembling usernames, names, or identifiers in forum text; activation occurs on internal fragments.

1_379.concept: 跨语料词片段与子词边界
1_379.description: 激活常落在拆分后的词内片段：包括多种语言的议会文本、emoji、Eloise 等专名，以及年份页码、用户名和异常字符串；目前看不出统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 拆分的 “emoji”
patterns.context: 在英语句子中出现单词 emoji，激活集中于拆分后的 o 部分；周围可接连字符或其他修饰语。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语连续文本中的词内片段，跨越词首、词中等位置；同段还出现罗马尼亚语变音符号。

patterns.name: 法语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言中的普通词语片段；高激活落在 «iter»，其后接 «a»，并处于 profiter(a) 语境。

patterns.name: 意大利语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 意大利语议会文本中，激活分布于词内片段；较强处集中在 compiuti 的 «i» 及 «uti»。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会发言中的词内片段；最高激活落在 desvio 的 «v»。

patterns.name: 年份与数字范围
patterns.context: 书目式年份条目和页码范围；«13» 激活显著高于邻近数字。

patterns.name: 专名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 人物姓名 Eloise；片段出现在百科条目或虚构人物介绍中。

patterns.name: 乱码式数字与字母串
patterns.context: 论坛帖子中的非标准字符串、用户名或残缺文本，缺少清晰语义线索。

patterns.name: 用户标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 论坛文本中类似用户名、名称或标识符的字符串；激活出现在其内部片段。

en.description: Activations often fall on letters inside or at the ends of Italian and Portuguese words; the most repeatable are i in Portuguese experiência and o in English emoji. Others are scattered across multilingual formal texts, academic texts, and forum contexts, without a unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: i in the middle of Portuguese experience-related words
patterns.context: Portuguese words are marked as split; activation falls on the i in experiência, in expressions such as “experiência que adquirimos”, “essa experiência”, and “experiência estética”.
patterns.domain: European Parliament texts, Portuguese philosophical texts

patterns.name: ta in a long Italian word
patterns.context: Activation falls in the middle of Italian “tutta”; the phrase is “a tutta prima”.

patterns.name: i in an Italian compound word
patterns.context: Activation falls inside Italian “compiti”; the context concerns progress made by the former Yugoslav Republics.

patterns.name: Italian verb ending
patterns.context: Activation falls at the end of the Italian demonstrative “Questo”; it is followed by an academic statement about methodological aims.

patterns.name: o in the spelling of emoji
patterns.context: Activation falls on the o in the English word “emoji”; the context directly discusses emoji keyboards, scales, or character presentation.

patterns.name: ta in a formal title
patterns.context: Activation falls inside Italian “presentata”, introducing a report submitted by a member of parliament.

patterns.name: Final sound in a noun suffix
patterns.context: Activation falls on the latter part of Italian “onore”, in a formal introduction of Erik Meijer.

patterns.name: Romanian internal word fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls inside Romanian “Autoritatea”; it is followed by a chairperson’s title and a formal address.

patterns.name: vocês in a Portuguese question
patterns.context: Activation falls on the second-person plural possessive “vossas”, in a repeated-question expression.

patterns.name: emocion- in a Portuguese formal address
patterns.context: Activation falls on the o at the beginning of “emoção”; the context conveys joy and emotion to an audience.

patterns.name: e in the Portuguese word for present
patterns.context: Activation falls on the e in “presente”; it is used in a publication context meaning “this issue/edition”.

patterns.name: Other unclassified fragments
patterns.context: Highlights fall on multilingual function words, affixes, or isolated letters, with no stable pattern apparent.

1_379.description: 激活多落在意大利语、葡萄牙语等词的内部字母或词尾；最可重复的是葡萄牙语 experiência 中的 i，以及英语 emoji 中的 o。其余分散于多语言正式文本、学术文本和论坛语境，缺乏统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语经历类词中间的 i
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语词语被拆分标记，激活落在 experiência 的 i；出现在“experiência que adquirimos”“essa experiência”及“experiência estética”等表达中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、葡萄牙语哲学文本

patterns.name: 意大利语长词中的 ta
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语“tutta”中间；句中为“a tutta prima”。

patterns.name: 意大利语复合词中的 i
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语“compiti”的词内；涉及前南斯拉夫共和国取得的进展。

patterns.name: 意大利语动词词尾
patterns.context: 激活位于意大利语指示词“Questo”的末尾；后接关于方法论目标的学术陈述。

patterns.name: emoji 拼写中的 o
patterns.context: 激活落在英语单词“emoji”的 o；上下文直接讨论 emoji 键盘、量表或字符呈现。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 论坛讨论、维基百科说明

patterns.name: 正式称谓中的 ta
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语“presentata”的词内，介绍议员提交的报告。

patterns.name: 名词后缀中的尾音
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语“onore”后半部，出现在称呼 Erik Meijer 的正式介绍中。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词中片段
patterns.context: 激活落在罗马尼亚语“Autoritatea”内部；紧接着是主席称谓及正式致辞。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语疑问表达中的 vocês
patterns.context: 激活落在第二人称复数所有格“vossas”，出现在重复提问的表达中。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语正式致辞中的 emocion-
patterns.context: 激活落在“emoção”开头的 o；语境为向听众传达喜悦与感动。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语现在一词中的 e
patterns.context: 激活落在“presente”的 e；用于“本期/本版”这一出版物语境。

patterns.name: 其他未归纳片段
patterns.trigger: 无法从所示高亮确定一致的词形或语义触发
patterns.context: 高亮落在多语言功能词、词缀或零碎字母上，未显现稳定模式。
patterns.domain: 多语言议会与学术语料

en.description: Activations fall inside split words across several languages: Portuguese exper-iência, various Italian internal fragments, Romanian emo-ție, English un-turned, and o in emoji. They share the phenomenon of internal subword positions, but their semantics and domains vary.

patterns.name: Portuguese exper-iência internal fragment
patterns.context: The word is marked as split in Portuguese; surrounding text discusses acquiring, having, or discussing experience.

patterns.name: Portuguese aesthetic experience
patterns.context: Discusses phenomenology, hermeneutics, and aesthetic experience.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Italian progress-related words
patterns.context: Discusses reports and progress achieved by the former Yugoslav Republics.

patterns.name: o in the emoji string
patterns.context: The word emoji appears; surrounding text mentions emojis, their scale, misinterpretation, or text/emoji presentation forms.
patterns.domain: Hacker News discussions and Wikipedia technical explanations

patterns.name: Romanian internal fragment in an emotion word
patterns.context: Expressing emotion or greetings in Romanian parliamentary addresses.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment in English turned
patterns.context: Describes turning the page of a paper book and the experience of reading a physical book.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Italian preposition-articles and nouns
patterns.context: Lists citizens’ emphasis on implementation and issues of omission.

1_379.description: 激活落在多语种拆分词内部：葡语 exper-iência、意语多种词内片段、罗马尼亚语 emo-ție、英语 un-turned，以及 emoji 的 o；共享词内子词位置现象，但语义与领域分散。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语 exper-iência 词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中该词被拆分标记；前后谈及获取、拥有或讨论经验

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语审美经验
patterns.context: 讨论现象学、诠释学与审美经验

patterns.name: 意大利语进展相关词内片段
patterns.trigger: «i»9，出现在 «comp«i»uti»；同段还有 «i»6 出现在 «su«i»»
patterns.context: 讨论报告及前南斯拉夫共和国所取得的进展
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会、意大利语报告

patterns.name: emoji 字符串中的 o
patterns.context: 出现 emoji 一词；周围提及表情符号、其尺度、误解或文本/emoji 呈现形式
patterns.domain: Hacker News 讨论及维基百科技术说明

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语情绪词内片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会致辞中表达情绪或问候

patterns.name: 英语 turned 的词首片段
patterns.context: 描写翻开纸书页面、纸书阅读体验
patterns.domain: 英语散文/书籍与应用讨论

patterns.name: 意大利语介词冠词与名词中的词内片段
patterns.context: 罗列公民对执行情况及缺失问题的强调
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会、意大利语政策文本

en.description: Mainly responds to i in Portuguese “experiência” and o in English emoji; there are also activations on Italian final i, Romanian word fragments, and sporadic Unicode and Portuguese substrings, whose triggers are unclear.

patterns.name: Syllable in “experiência”
patterns.context: The complete Portuguese word “experiência”, in sentences about policy experience, question-and-answer experience, or aesthetic experience.
patterns.domain: European Parliament speech transcripts, academic bibliographic text

patterns.name: Letter o in the word emoji
patterns.context: English text explicitly mentions emoji, smiley faces, or emoji-style presentation; activation falls on the o in emoji.

patterns.name: Italian morphological ending i
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of “modi”; nearby text discusses European citizens emphasizing an issue in various ways. There is no obvious trigger shared with the other patterns.
patterns.domain: Formal European Parliament texts in Italian

patterns.name: i in a plural ending
patterns.context: Occurs in Italian “progressi compiuti”, describing progress made by former republics; activation concentrates on the plural ending i.

patterns.name: Romanian internal syllable
patterns.context: In Romanian addresses, strong activation occurs near “doresc” and “emoţie”; unlike other passages, it does not clearly fall on the o in emoji or on Portuguese experiência.
patterns.domain: Formal European Parliament addresses in Romanian

patterns.name: Sporadic internal substrings
patterns.context: Activations in [9] are scattered across fragments of multiple words in Portuguese texts about entrepreneurship education; the strong activation in [7] falls on a numeric string in an explanation of Unicode variation selectors. The provided local contexts do not establish a specific shared trigger.

1_379.description: 主要响应葡语“experiência”中的 i，以及英语 emoji 中的 o；另对意大利语词尾 i、罗马尼亚语词片段及零散 Unicode、葡语子串有激活，后几类触发条件不明确。

patterns.name: “experiência”中的音节
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中完整词“experiência”；位于谈论政策经验、问答经验或美学经验的句子中。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会口语转录、学术书目文字

patterns.name: emoji 一词中的字母 o
patterns.context: 英文文字明确提到 emoji、笑脸表情或 emoji 风格；激活落在单词 emoji 的 o 上。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论、Wikipedia 技术说明

patterns.name: 意大利语形态词尾 i
patterns.context: 出现在“modi”一词末尾，附近文字谈及欧洲公民以多种方式强调某问题；没有明显与其他模式相同的触发词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语正式文本

patterns.name: 数字串中的 i
patterns.context: 出现在意大利语“progressi compiuti”中，描述前共和国取得的进展；激活集中在复数词尾 i。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会意大利语报告

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内音节
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语致辞中，“doresc”及“emoţie”附近出现较强激活；不像其他段那样明确落在 emoji 的字母 o 或葡萄牙语 experiência 上。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会罗马尼亚语正式致辞

patterns.name: 零散词内子串
patterns.context: [9] 的激活散落于葡萄牙语创业教育文字的多个词片段；[7] 的强激活落在 Unicode 变体选择符说明中的数字串。无法从给出的局部上下文确认具体共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 学术论述；百科技术说明

en.concept: boast stem and several intraword fragments
en.description: Most passages activate on boast/boasts, spanning promotional, poetic, forum, and political texts; intraword fragments in kinase, Neutropenic, Neoescolástica, Neurorestoration, Neumann, and other words also trigger, across diverse topics and contexts.

patterns.name: Verb boast stem/inflection
patterns.context: boast or boasts appears, often connected to a possessive, subject, or object; may also occur in the phrase boast about.
patterns.domain: Travel accommodation promotions, product descriptions, poetry, forum quotations, historical/political texts

patterns.name: kinase in the phrase MAP kinase kinase
patterns.context: A sequence of protein/enzyme names in a biomedical title; this passage contains no boast.

patterns.name: 动词 boast 的词干/分词

patterns.name: MAP kinase kinase 词组中的 kinase
patterns.context: 生物医学标题中的连续蛋白/酶名称；本段没有 boast。

patterns.name: 中性粒细胞败血症词中的 Ne
patterns.context: 跨英语和西班牙语语料，在较长词内部出现 Ne/Neut 字符串；分别处于医学术语、机构名称、哲学术语。

patterns.name: Neumann 姓氏片段

en.description: The clearest triggers are the complete word boast and the substring Ne embedded in different longer words; there is also one kinase activation. A few common function words activate as well, without a stable association.

patterns.name: boast stem
patterns.context: Strongly activates when the word boast itself appears; occurs in different syntactic and semantic contexts.
patterns.domain: Web promotions, poetry, forum discussions, historical discourse

patterns.name: Ne substring in proper names or terms

patterns.domain: Institution names, philosophical texts, medical abstracts, mathematical physics

patterns.name: kinase in kinase terminology

patterns.name: General sentence-initial or function-word activation
patterns.context: Several sentence-initial words or common grammatical words also show moderate activation, but no stable semantic or syntactic pattern emerges across passages.

1_787.concept: 词形与子串检测
1_787.description: 最清楚的触发是完整词 boast，以及嵌在不同长词中的子串 Ne；另有一次 kinase 激活。少量常见功能词也亮起，未显示稳定关联。

patterns.name: boast 的词干
patterns.context: 单词 boast 本身出现时强烈激活；在不同句法和语义环境中均出现。
patterns.domain: 网页宣传、诗歌、论坛讨论、历史论述

patterns.name: 专名或术语中的 Ne 子串
patterns.context: Ne 位于较长名称或术语内部，如 Neurorestoration、Neurotechnology、Neoescolástica、Neutropenic、Neumann；激活集中在子串 Ne。
patterns.domain: 机构名称、哲学文本、医学摘要、数学物理

patterns.name: 激酶术语中的 kinase
patterns.context: 生物医学术语 MAP kinase kinase 中，kinase 及其重复出现处激活。

patterns.name: 一般句首或功能词激活
patterns.context: 若干句首或常见语法词也有中等激活，但跨段不形成稳定的语义或句法模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to “boast”; also strongly activates on the capitalized “Ne” subword fragment, and responds to whitespace, tabs, and line breaks in web or list-style text. Other weakly activating subword fragments and punctuation are sporadic, with no stable pattern.

patterns.name: boast word forms
patterns.context: When describing something or a characteristic that a person or thing is proud of or boasts about; may occur in different syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: Accommodation promotions, poetry, forum text, manufacturing promotions, historical narrative

patterns.name: Words beginning with Ne
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the capitalized letter sequence “Ne”, followed by different letters; it may occur at the start of a word or in a proper name.

patterns.name: Layout whitespace and table fragments
patterns.context: Tabs, spaces, and line breaks in web navigation or table/list-style content; often occur alongside image placeholders and line-by-line numbers.
patterns.domain: Web-scraped text, tables or lists in email

patterns.name: Low-intensity subword fragments and punctuation
patterns.context: Sporadic activations on word endings, common words, and punctuation, without consistent semantic or grammatical conditions across passages.

1_787.concept: boast 及 Ne 词片段
1_787.description: 主要响应“boast”；另对大写“Ne”词片段有强激活，并在网页或名单式文本中响应空白、制表符和换行。其他弱激活词片段与标点零散，未见稳定模式。

patterns.name: 排版空白与表格碎片

en.concept: Multiple modes: boast word and formatting/substring features
en.description: The first five passages strongly activate on the word boast; remaining activations are distributed across Ne character fragments, email layout/table formatting, and xa in biomedical words, indicating multiple local trigger patterns.

patterns.name: Word-final or stem fragment «boast»
patterns.context: Activation concentrates when the complete word boast appears, followed by collocations such as about, of, and world-class; it is not limited to a particular syntax or meaning.
patterns.domain: Web descriptions, poetry, forum text, encyclopedic narrative

patterns.name: Ne substring
patterns.context: Appears across a word boundary in Nearest («K»-«Ne»arest), and in the name Neal («Ne»al); the local character fragment is consistent, but contextual uses differ.
patterns.domain: Forum code/algorithm titles; names in corporate email

patterns.name: Special line-break or formatting token
patterns.context: Appears in email tables, lists, or indented layout; activation falls on line breaks, tabs, and related formatting tokens.
patterns.domain: Corporate email and embedded web content

patterns.name: Document header and field separators
patterns.context: In a formal memo header, recipient and sender fields are formatted with colons, spaces, and capitalized abbreviations.

patterns.name: Numerical table entries

patterns.name: Fragment «xa» in a scientific term
patterns.context: Appears in the tokenized chemical name docosahexaenoic acid; nearby are abstract terms such as diet and platelet function.

patterns.name: Other unmarked formatting fragments
patterns.context: Forwarded/embedded email content mixes web navigation with image placeholders; apart from formatting fragments, there is no clear lexical trigger.

1_787.concept: 多模式：boast词与格式/子串特征
1_787.description: 前五段共同强烈激活词 boast；其余激活分散在 Ne 字符片段、邮件排版/表格格式及生物医学词 xa 中，显示多个局部触发模式。

patterns.name: 词尾或词干片段 «boast»
patterns.context: 激活集中在完整词 boast 出现时，后接 about、of、world-class 等搭配；并非只限某种句法或含义。
patterns.domain: 网页介绍、诗歌、论坛文本、百科叙述

patterns.name: Ne 子串
patterns.context: 出现在跨词边界的 Nearest（«K»-«Ne»arest），以及人名 Neal（«Ne»al）；局部字符片段一致，但上下文用途不同。
patterns.domain: 论坛代码/算法标题；企业邮件中的人名

patterns.name: 特殊换行或格式 token
patterns.context: 出现在邮件表格、列表或带缩进的排版中；激活落在换行、制表符及相关格式 token 上。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件及其嵌入的网页内容

patterns.name: 文档头部与字段分隔符

patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的表格/列表

patterns.name: 科学名词中的片段 «xa»
patterns.context: 出现在被分词切开的化学名称 docosahexaenoic acid 中；周围是饮食、血小板功能等摘要术语。

patterns.name: 未标记的其它格式碎片

patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的网页快照

en.concept: Multiple local word-form and formatting features
en.description: High activation often falls on boast, spanning “possess/boast” and poetry, promotional, and commentary contexts; other instances include Appellees in case captions, French séance, web tabs, and several isolated intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Infinitive word-form fragment
patterns.context: The word boast is followed by an object or prepositional phrase, meaning to boast, to be proud of something, or “feature” in hotel/manufacturing promotional copy.

patterns.name: Appellees in legal case captions
patterns.context: Appears after the name of the appellee in a case caption, usually followed by a period and docket number.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment “sé” in French
patterns.context: Appears in the parliamentary minutes heading procès-verbal de la séance.

patterns.name: Tabs and image placeholders in web tables/navigation
patterns.context: Dense tabs, line breaks, and image placeholders make up the web layout; high activation falls on tabs.

patterns.name: boast in hotel room copy
patterns.context: The subject is a hotel unit/room, followed by amenities such as fireplace, meaning “is equipped with.”

patterns.name: boast in manufacturing copy
patterns.context: The subject is company operations, followed by world-class manufacturing equipment, meaning “has/is equipped with.”

patterns.name: boast in a line of poetry
patterns.context: Occurs with words such as love and my in a line of poetry, meaning to take pride in love.

patterns.name: boast in an Orwell quotation
patterns.context: Occurs with about it, describing the desire to discover something and boast about it.

patterns.name: Anomalous intraword fragments
patterns.context: High activation falls on the split intraword fragments xa (docosahexaenoic) and anion (the ending of an expanded Rooms); no stable connection to other high-activation triggers is apparent.

patterns.name: hemin fragment in a disease name
patterns.context: Occurs in the term hemin and iron transport.

1_787.concept: 多种局部词形与格式特征
1_787.description: 高激活常落在 boast，涵盖“拥有/夸耀”及诗歌、宣传和评论语境；另见判例标题 Appellees、法语 séance、网页制表符，以及若干孤立词内片段。

patterns.name: 动词不定式词尾片段
patterns.context: 词形 boast 后接宾语或介词短语，分别表示夸耀、以某物为傲，或作为酒店/制造业宣传文案中的“拥有”
patterns.domain: 网页宣传、诗歌、评论文本

patterns.name: 法律案名中的 Appellees
patterns.context: 出现在案名中被上诉方名称之后，通常紧接句点及案号

patterns.name: 法语词内片段“sé”
patterns.context: 出现在 procès-verbal de la séance 这一议会会议记录标题中

patterns.name: 网页表格/导航的制表符与图像占位符
patterns.context: 密集的制表符、换行和图像占位符构成网页布局；高激活落在制表符上

patterns.name: 酒店客房文案中的 boast
patterns.context: 主语为酒店单元/客房，后接 fireplace 等设施，表示“配有”

patterns.name: 制造业文案中的 boast
patterns.context: 主语为公司运营，后接 world-class manufacturing equipment，表示“拥有/具备”

patterns.name: 诗行中的 boast
patterns.context: 与 love、my 等词同现，处于诗歌行句中，意为以爱为傲

patterns.name: Orwell 引文中的 boast
patterns.context: 与 about it 相连，描述想发现某事并把它夸耀出去的欲望

patterns.name: 词内异常切分片段
patterns.context: 高激活分别落在被拆分的词内部片段 xa（docosahexaenoic）和 anion（扩展 Rooms 的词尾）；看不出与其他高激活触发项的稳定联系
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、网页宣传文本

patterns.name: 疾病名中的 hemin 片段
patterns.context: 位于 hemin and iron transport 的术语中

en.description: The strongest activations center on the complete word Appellees (the appellees in legal case captions) and the subword au: the latter appears both in Auctions-related words and in the French preposition au. Legal caption formats, auction contexts, and French text are all represented.

patterns.name: Appellees in legal case captions
patterns.context: Appears in case-party captions, usually immediately after the defendant’s name or a list of parties, and at the end of a line or before a line break; often accompanied by formats such as Plaintiffs/Appellants, Defendants, v., and docket numbers.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions and legal documents

patterns.name: Auctions
patterns.context: The trigger Auctions is tokenized into subwords; appears in Yahoo Auctions or auction(s)-related contexts involving auction platforms, auction items, or bidding.

patterns.name: French au
patterns.context: Occurs in the French phrases «au»« car»refour and «au»« tit»re as the preposition au, not the beginning of Auctions; appears in a book title and an email disclaimer, respectively.
patterns.domain: French bibliographic text and business email

1_787.concept: Appellees / au 子词
1_787.description: 最强激活集中在完整词 Appellees（法律案件标题中的被上诉人）和子词 au：后者既出现在 Auctions 拍卖相关词中，也出现在法语介词 au 中。法律标题格式、拍卖语境及法语文本均有覆盖。

patterns.name: 法律案件标题中的 Appellees
patterns.context: 出现在案件当事人标题中，通常紧接被告名称或当事人列举，并位于句末或换行前；常伴随 Plaintiffs/Appellants、Defendants、v.、案号等格式。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律文书

patterns.name: 拍卖 Auctions
patterns.context: 触发词 Auctions 被拆成子词；出现在 Yahoo Auctions 或 auction(s) 相关语境中，涉及拍卖平台、拍卖物品或竞拍。
patterns.domain: 商业、互联网与新闻邮件

patterns.name: 法语 au
patterns.context: 位于法语短语 «au»« car»refour、«au»« tit»re 中，是介词 au，而非 Auctions 的词首；分别出现在书名和邮件免责声明中。
patterns.domain: 法语书目文本与商务邮件

en.description: Highly sensitive to the string “Convention”: this includes the Convention Against Torture, names of institutional or party conventions, and the same-form fragment in conventionally; the same word-form trigger spans multiple fields.

patterns.name: Convention Against Torture in law
patterns.context: In immigration appeals or asylum cases, appears alongside asylum and withholding of removal, referring to the Convention Against Torture and related relief.

patterns.name: Convention in institutional or political meeting names
patterns.context: Forms part of the names of international organizations, institutions during the French Revolution, or U.S. political party nominating conventions.
patterns.domain: Legal definitions, political history, and news/encyclopedias

patterns.name: Word-form fragment in Conventionally
patterns.context: Describes common applications or assumptions in a financial theory context; activation marks the “Convention” fragment within the word.

1_787.concept: Convention 词形识别
1_787.description: 对字符串“Convention”高度敏感：包括《禁止酷刑公约》、机构或政党会议名称，以及 conventionally 一词中的同形片段；多种领域共享同一词形触发。

patterns.name: 法律中的 Convention Against Torture
patterns.trigger: “Convention” 后接 “Against Torture”，包括 “the Convention Against Torture” 和 “the Convention Against Torture (CAT)”
patterns.context: 移民上诉或庇护案件中，与 asylum、withholding of removal 并列，指《禁止酷刑公约》及相关救济

patterns.name: 机构或政治会议名称中的 Convention
patterns.trigger: “Convention” 出现在专名中，如 “International Convention”“National Convention”“Democratic National Convention”“Republican National Convention”
patterns.context: 作为国际组织、法国革命时期机构或美国政党提名会议名称的一部分
patterns.domain: 法律定义、政治史及新闻/百科

patterns.name: Conventionally 的词形片段
patterns.context: 金融理论语境中描述常见的应用或假设；激活标记落在词内的 “Convention” 片段

en.concept: State and word fragments in legal contexts
en.description: The most stable cue is State in legal texts, meaning a state, state government, state court, state defendant, or part of a proper name; there are also isolated triggers such as redevelopment, coal, and constituents, plus fragments from citations and legal content words, with no confirmed common mechanism.

patterns.name: State-level jurisdiction in legal citations
patterns.context: In U.S. legal texts, “State” appears as a state, state government, or part of a case name; it is often adjacent to a state name, state agency, or party designation.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: redevelopment word form
patterns.context: In legal background passages about cities or counties establishing redevelopment agencies, activation spans the tokenized word form.
patterns.domain: Legal documents/local government and land development

patterns.name: coal in a coal-tar-related definition
patterns.context: Appears in a definition explaining that heating coal to remove volatile components forms coke; the activation is within a material definition.

patterns.name: State in court captions and legal terminology
patterns.context: Describes a federal court remanding claims against state defendants to state court; “State” refers to a state court or state defendant.

patterns.name: State in governing-law clauses
patterns.context: A contract clause states that the agreement and credit were made and granted in Michigan and are governed by the corresponding law.

patterns.name: State Farm in an insurance case
patterns.context: Appears as part of an insurer’s name in a case citation.

patterns.name: State in a state name or state-level case citation
patterns.context: In a citation title, State is followed by a line break, with the case name or citation information continuing afterward.

patterns.name: State in a discussion of state intervention rights
patterns.context: A constitutional passage discusses state intervention in parental rights under specific circumstances.

patterns.name: constituents of endowed assets
patterns.context: Explains the principle that an endowment institution’s investment returns should be spent equitably among current and future beneficiary groups.

patterns.name: Formatting fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Company names, court reporters, and page numbers in case citations are split into subwords or punctuation fragments; their semantic connection to other activated words is unclear.

patterns.name: Sporadically highlighted words in litigation language
patterns.context: Several words in legal fact or background narratives are individually marked, with no unified trigger beyond the legal context of the passage.

patterns.name: Sporadically highlighted words in legal reasoning
patterns.context: Several legal content words in the Eleventh Amendment text are marked, but no single word form recurs across passages as consistently as State.

patterns.name: Sporadically highlighted words in general legal narrative
patterns.context: Appears in procedural narrative with varied capitalization and meaning; it is unclear whether it shares the main state-jurisdiction pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadically highlighted words in contract clauses
patterns.context: Headings, contract terms, and place-name fragments appear in contract governing-law clauses; apart from State in the same passage, there is no common trigger feature.

patterns.name: Sporadically highlighted words in insurance cases
patterns.context: Legal concept words in an insurer’s subrogation argument; their activation may not share a source with State in State Farm.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in citations
patterns.context: Case names, citation reporters, and numbers are split and marked, making it difficult to group them into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic words in rights arguments
patterns.context: Content words marked in constitutional and parental-rights discussions; whether they share a mechanism with State is unclear.

patterns.name: Sporadic words in an intergenerational equity passage
patterns.context: Ordinary words sporadically marked in an encyclopedic definition do not form an obvious repeated pattern with constituents, which is highlighted at the end.

1_787.concept: 法律语境中的 State 及词片段
1_787.description: 最稳定的线索是法律文本里作为州、州政府、州法院、州被告或专名组成部分的 State；另有 redevelopment 词形、coal、constituents 等孤立触发，以及多处引证和法律内容词碎片，无法确认同一机制。

patterns.name: 法律引用中的州级司法辖区
patterns.context: 美国法律文本中，“State”作为州、州政府或案件名称的一部分出现；常邻接州名、州机构或当事方称谓。

patterns.name: redevelopment 词形
patterns.context: 关于市县设立 redevelopment agencies 的法律背景段落，激活跨越拆分的词形片段。
patterns.domain: 法律文书／地方政府与土地开发

patterns.name: 煤焦油相关定义中的 coal
patterns.context: 在介绍焦煤经加热去除挥发成分、形成 coke 的定义中出现；激活词位于物质定义内。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的技术定义／煤炭

patterns.name: 法院标题与法律术语中的 State
patterns.context: 描述联邦法院将针对州被告的请求发回州法院；“State”指州级法院或州被告。

patterns.name: 合同适用法条款中的 State
patterns.context: 合同条款说明协议及信贷在密歇根州签订、授予并受相应法律解释。

patterns.name: 保险案件中的 State Farm
patterns.context: 判例引证中作为保险公司名称的一部分出现。

patterns.name: 州名或州级案件引证中的 State
patterns.context: 引证标题中 State 后接换行，后文继续案件名称或引证信息。

patterns.name: 关于州干预权利的 State
patterns.context: 讨论州在特定情况下干预父母权利的宪法性段落。

patterns.name: endowed assets 的 constituents
patterns.context: 阐释捐赠机构投资收益应在当前与未来受益群体间公平支出的原则。
patterns.domain: 百科／机构投资与代际公平

patterns.name: 法律引证中的格式碎片
patterns.context: 判例引证的公司名、法院报告集与页码被拆分为子词或标点片段；这些片段本身与其他激活词的语义联系不明确。

patterns.name: 诉讼表达中的零散高亮词
patterns.context: 法律事实或背景叙述中的多个词被分别标记，未显示出除该段法律语境外的统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的零散高亮词
patterns.context: 第十一修正案文本中若干法律内容词被标记，但没有单一词形像 State 那样贯穿多段。

patterns.name: 一般法律叙述中的零散高亮词
patterns.context: 程序性叙述中出现，大小写与语义不一；不能确定是否与主要的州级司法辖区模式相同。

patterns.name: 合同条款中的零散高亮词
patterns.context: 合同适用法律条款中出现的标题、合同词及地名片段，除同段的 State 外缺少共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 保险判例中的零散高亮词
patterns.context: 保险人追偿论证中的法律概念词；其与 State Farm 名称内的激活未必同源。

patterns.name: 引证中的零散片段
patterns.context: 案件名、引证报告集及数字被拆分标记，难以归为一个独立语义模式。

patterns.name: 权利论证中的零散词
patterns.context: 宪法与父母权利讨论中被标记的内容词，是否与 State 共用机制不明确。

patterns.name: 代际公平段落中的零散词
patterns.context: 百科式定义中零散标记的普通词，与结尾高亮的 constituents 不构成明显重复模式。

en.description: Activation is concentrated in appellate decisions: denial of constitutional rights, independent judicial review, and county-court or prisoner contexts; there is also one sentence-initial Because. The top activation right in passage 2 has no clear corresponding pattern.

patterns.name: Denial of constitutional rights
patterns.context: Appears in habeas, appeals for a certificate, or constitutional-rights claims, especially “denial of a constitutional right”; related contexts include “Sixth Amendment« right»10 to counsel” and “First Amendment” rights claims.
patterns.domain: Federal appellate decisions, constitutional law, and criminal procedure

patterns.name: Independent review
patterns.context: A court states that the appellate court independently reviews a legal question or the record; common phrases include “resolves independently” and “reviewed the record”.
patterns.domain: Appellate decisions on standards of review and reasoning

patterns.name: Reasoning introduced by Because
patterns.context: At the beginning or within a sentence, Because introduces the reason for a preceding ruling, claim, or conclusion; this trigger appears only once in the supplied excerpts.

patterns.name: County-level custody and prisoners
patterns.context: Discusses county courts, county governments, or county detention facilities and their prisoners; triggers concentrate on county and prison(er)-related wording.
patterns.domain: State law, local governance, and prison law

1_787.concept: 上诉法律意见中的法律术语
1_787.description: 激活主要落在上诉判决：宪法权利被否定、法院独立审查，以及县级法院或囚犯语境；另有一次句首 Because。第2段的最高激活 right 未见明确对应模式。

patterns.name: 宪法权利遭否定
patterns.trigger: «denial»8 of« a»3« constitutional»4« right»10；«denial»8 of« a»2« constitutional»4« right»10
patterns.context: 出现在 habeas、上诉许可或宪法权利主张中，尤指“denial of a constitutional right”；相关语境也包括“Sixth Amendment« right»10 to counsel”和“First Amendment”权利主张。
patterns.domain: 联邦上诉判决、宪法与刑事诉讼

patterns.name: 独立审查
patterns.context: 法院说明上诉法院独立审查法律问题或记录；常见搭配为“resolves independently”“reviewed the record”。
patterns.domain: 上诉判决的审查标准与判决理由

patterns.name: Because 引出的理由
patterns.context: 句首或句中以 Because 引出对前述裁决、主张或结论的理由；该触发在所给片段中仅出现一次。

patterns.name: 县级羁押与囚犯
patterns.context: 讨论县法院、县政府或县级羁押设施及其囚犯；触发集中在 county 一词及 prison(er) 相关措辞。
patterns.domain: 州法、地方治理与监狱法律

en.description: Primarily responds to formulations about constitutional rights and their denial in court contexts, especially the substantial-showing standard for a certificate of appealability; it also responds to legal language about prisoner classification, right to counsel, ability-to-pay hearings, First Amendment rights, and independent review.

patterns.name: Constitutional rights and their denial
patterns.context: Legal documents discuss whether constitutional rights were violated, or whether an applicant made a substantial showing that a right was denied; also includes claims involving specific rights.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal and state court decisions, appeals, and habeas corpus proceedings

patterns.name: Certificate of appealability and substantial-showing standard
patterns.context: States that a certificate of appealability (COA) may issue only when the applicant makes a substantial showing that a constitutional right was denied.
patterns.domain: Federal appeals, habeas corpus decisions, and statutory citations

patterns.name: County-level custody and prisoner classification
patterns.context: Concerns municipal detention facilities, county boards, and the legal classification or management authority over sentenced prisoners.
patterns.domain: Wisconsin statutes and criminal justice legal texts

patterns.name: Right to counsel and related amendments
patterns.context: Discusses a lawyer’s or party’s Sixth Amendment right-to-counsel claim, as well as Miranda warnings and Fifth or Sixth Amendment rights.

patterns.name: Debatability of procedural rulings
patterns.context: Under the Slack standard, evaluates whether a procedural ruling and constitutional-rights claim are debatable.
patterns.domain: Federal habeas corpus and appellate-eligibility decisions

patterns.name: Fines and ability-to-pay hearings
patterns.context: Challenges whether imposing fines and surcharges without an ability-to-pay hearing violated due process rights.

patterns.name: First Amendment and public employee rights
patterns.context: Cites cases establishing that public employees have rights including freedom of association and speech.
patterns.domain: Public employee constitutional-rights decisions and case citations

patterns.name: Independent review of statutory interpretation
patterns.context: States that statutory interpretation is a question of law, reviewed independently by the appellate court without deference to the trial court’s conclusion.
patterns.domain: Appellate standards of review or case summaries in court decisions

1_787.concept: 宪法权利与司法审查
1_787.description: 主要响应法院语境中关于宪法权利及其被否认的表述，尤其是上诉证明书的实质性证明标准；另对囚犯分类、律师权、支付能力听证、第一修正案权利和独立审查等法律措辞有反应。

patterns.name: 宪法权利及其被否认
patterns.context: 法律文书中讨论宪法权利是否受到侵害，或申请人是否对权利被否认作出实质性证明；也包括具体权利的主张。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦及州法院判决、上诉与人身保护令程序

patterns.name: 上诉证明书与实质性证明标准
patterns.trigger: “certificate of appealability”“substantial showing”“denial of a constitutional right”
patterns.context: 说明上诉证明书（COA）仅在申请人就宪法权利被否认作出实质性证明时才能签发。
patterns.domain: 联邦上诉、人身保护令判决及法条引述

patterns.name: 县级羁押与囚犯分类
patterns.trigger: “municipal detention facilities”“county boards”“county prisoners”“prisoners under sentence”
patterns.context: 围绕市级拘留设施、县级董事会及服刑囚犯的法律分类或管理权限。
patterns.domain: 威斯康星州成文法及刑事司法法律文本

patterns.name: 律师帮助权及相关修正案
patterns.trigger: “Sixth Amendment”“right to counsel”“appointed counsel”“Miranda warnings”“Fifth or Sixth Amendment”
patterns.context: 讨论律师或当事人提出的第六修正案律师权主张，以及米兰达警告、第五或第六修正案权利。

patterns.name: 程序性裁定的可争辩性
patterns.context: 依据 Slack 标准，评估程序性裁定和宪法权利主张是否具有可争辩性。
patterns.domain: 联邦人身保护令与上诉资格判决

patterns.name: 罚金与支付能力听证
patterns.context: 质疑法院未举行支付能力听证便处以罚金和附加费用，是否违反正当程序权利。

patterns.name: 第一修正案与公共雇员权利
patterns.trigger: “First Amendment”“right of public employees to associate”
patterns.context: 引用判例说明公共雇员享有结社、言论等权利。
patterns.domain: 公共雇员宪法权利判决及判例引文

patterns.name: 独立审查法定解释
patterns.context: 说明法定解释属于法律问题，上诉法院独立审查，不受审判法院结论拘束。
patterns.domain: 法院判决中的上诉审查标准或判例摘要

en.concept: Institutional proper names and formal citations
en.description: The most salient shared trigger is “University” in institutional proper names. Other positive activations occur in U.S. legal cases, litigation procedure, campus place names and facilities, bibliographic publication information, and tax-law citations, reflecting several local patterns in proper names and formal-text vocabulary.

patterns.name: “University” in university names
patterns.context: Occurs in full institutional names, court case citations, or university-related descriptions; often preceded or followed by a place name or institution name.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, academic debates, encyclopedia entries, campus information

patterns.name: Subsequent proper name in a university name
patterns.context: The proper-name component of a university’s full name; the sentence discusses the institution’s leadership, board, or position.
patterns.domain: Commentary on academic and religious institutions

patterns.name: Court or case terms in legal citations
patterns.context: In legal arguments or case citations, concerning court decisions, constitutional rights, and attorney qualifications.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal commentary

patterns.name: Litigation procedure and remedies in legal documents
patterns.context: Discusses petitions, procedural rulings, preliminary injunctions, or litigation claims and their conditions.

patterns.name: Institutions, parties, and litigation actions in legal citations
patterns.context: Describes employment-discrimination litigation, EEOC charges, and court proceedings.

patterns.name: “Park” in place names and campus parking terms
patterns.context: Occurs as part of a place name or in descriptions of campus parking facilities and lots.
patterns.domain: Case-law place names, campus facilities information

patterns.name: Campus buildings and street locations
patterns.context: Describes school buildings, relocation after a fire, and specific addresses.

patterns.name: Publication and bibliographic formats
patterns.context: Bibliographic entries list publishers, titles, regions, and publication years; “University” is also part of a publisher’s name.

patterns.name: Street and parking-lot terms in legal and campus contexts
patterns.context: Occurs in municipal addresses, parking-lot names, or campus parking descriptions; its use in place names in case law is not entirely the same.

patterns.name: Tax and publication titles in legal citations
patterns.context: In legal article titles and conference-material citations discussing how restrictions on stock transfers affect estate-tax and gift-tax valuation.
patterns.domain: Tax law and legal academic citations

1_787.concept: 机构专名与正式引文
1_787.description: 最显著的共同触发是机构专名中的“University”；其余正激活分布于美国法律判例、诉讼程序、校园地名与设施、书目出版信息及税法引文，呈现专名和正式文本词汇的多种局部模式。

patterns.name: 大学名称中的“University”
patterns.context: 出现在机构全名、法院判例引用或大学相关叙述中；前后常接地名或机构名称。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、学术争论、百科条目、校园信息

patterns.name: 大学名称中的后续专名
patterns.context: 大学全名中的专名部分；句中讨论校方领导、董事会或其立场。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的法院或判例词
patterns.context: 法律论证或判例引文中，围绕法院裁决、宪法权利及律师资格展开。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的诉讼程序与救济
patterns.context: 讨论请愿、程序裁决、临时禁令或诉讼请求及其条件。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的机构、当事人与诉讼动作
patterns.context: 叙述就业歧视诉讼、EEOC 指控及法院处理。

patterns.name: 地名中的“Park”及校园停车词
patterns.context: 作为地名的一部分，或出现在校园停车设施、停车场说明中。
patterns.domain: 判例地名、校园设施信息

patterns.name: 校园建筑与街道地点
patterns.context: 描述学校建筑、火灾后的迁址及具体地址。

patterns.name: 出版物与参考书目格式
patterns.context: 书目条目列出出版社、题名、地区和出版年份；其中“University”也属于出版社名。

patterns.name: 法律与校园语境中的街道、停车场词形
patterns.context: 出现于市政地址、停车场名称或校园停车说明；与法律判例中的地名用法并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 法律引文中税务与出版标题
patterns.context: 法律文章标题及会议资料引用中，讨论股票转让限制对遗产税、赠与税估值的影响。

en.concept: Proper names and institutional names in legal contexts
en.description: A strong pattern is “City” in proper names or institutional names in legal texts, especially New York City and Oregon City. Other activations occur mainly in case citations, litigation terminology, and institutional titles, with one political-office biography.

patterns.name: City as part of a proper name
patterns.context: “City” occurs in a proper place or institutional name, usually combining with an adjacent city name, state name, department, or institutional term; it does not refer generically to a city.
patterns.domain: Primarily case law, legal citations, and litigation documents; also Wikipedia biographies

patterns.name: Citations and procedural terminology in legal texts
patterns.context: Legal discussion, case citations, court captions, or litigation procedure; these markers often co-occur with “City” in proper names, but City does not appear in every passage.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Institutional names in legal/academic titles
patterns.context: Institutional names or academic publication titles contain terms such as “University”; this example also occurs in legal tax discussion.

patterns.name: Independent place names and public-office background
patterns.context: A biography recounts political service and names a city council and state legislative body; its genre differs from the legal citations in the other passages.

1_787.concept: 法律语境中的专名与机构名称
1_787.description: 强烈模式是法律文本中专名或机构名称里的“City”，尤见 New York City、Oregon City 等；其余激活多落在判例引证、诉讼术语、机构标题，另有政治任职传记。

patterns.name: City 作为专名组成部分
patterns.trigger: «City»10；邻近地名或机构名称中的 “City”，如 “Portland, Maine City Council”、“New York City Transit Auth.”、“Oregon City”
patterns.context: “City”出现在专有地名或机构名称中，通常与前后相邻的城市名、州名、部门或机构词共同构成名称；不是泛指普通城市。
patterns.domain: 主要是判例、法律引文与诉讼文书；另有 Wikipedia 人物传记

patterns.name: 法律文本中的引证与程序术语
patterns.context: 法律论述、判例引用、法院抬头或诉讼程序语境；这些标记常与专名中的 “City” 同现，但并非每段都出现 City。

patterns.name: 法律／学术标题中的机构名称
patterns.trigger: “New York University”、“Fifth Annual Institute on Federal”
patterns.context: 机构名或学术出版物标题中出现 “University” 等机构名称用词；本例同时处于法律税务论述中。

patterns.name: 独立的地名与官职背景
patterns.context: 人物传记交代政治任职经历，并出现市议会及州级立法机构名称；与其他片段的法律引证体裁不同。

en.description: Activations are concentrated in criminal-procedure and appellate legal vocabulary in U.S. opinions, and also occur in constitutional attorney-rights discussions, evidence review, sentencing challenges, party designations, and dense case citations. Several high-frequency components may reflect legal-document register rather than a single legal concept.

patterns.name: Constitutional amendments and attorney rights
patterns.context: Discusses attorney rights in criminal proceedings, when the rights take effect, appointed-counsel fees, or constitutional claims

patterns.name: Legal procedure and judicial-review language
patterns.context: The court explains the standard of review, the effect of error, or conditions for applying a procedure

patterns.name: Conviction evidence and fact-finding
patterns.context: Discusses whether evidence supports a conviction, or the defendant’s identity or conduct and the jury’s findings

patterns.name: Sentences and challenges to judgments
patterns.context: Discusses the right or time limit for challenging an unlawful sentence

patterns.name: Case-citation format
patterns.context: Cites cases, statutes, or judicial opinions in legal arguments; activation falls on various legal abbreviations and formatting tokens in citations

patterns.name: Legal entity names and litigants
patterns.context: Party, state, or local-government names appear in case narratives or cited opinions

patterns.name: Ambiguous wording about phone searches
patterns.context: Discusses whether cellphone location tracking constitutes a search and implicates federal or state constitutional protections
patterns.domain: Privacy and search disputes in criminal proceedings

patterns.name: Ambiguous activation on citation numbers and punctuation
patterns.context: Numbers, abbreviations, and punctuation within citation sequences; no distinct semantic trigger beyond legal citation format is evident

1_787.concept: 美国判决法律语汇
1_787.description: 激活集中于美国判决中的刑事程序与上诉法律语汇，也出现在宪法律师权利、证据审查、刑罚挑战、当事人称谓及密集判例引证中；多个高频部分可能反映法律文书语域而非单一法律概念。

patterns.name: 宪法修正案与律师权利
patterns.context: 讨论刑事诉讼中的律师权利、权利何时生效、指定律师费用或宪法权利主张

patterns.name: 法律程序及司法审查措辞
patterns.context: 法院说明审查标准、错误影响或程序适用条件

patterns.name: 定罪证据与事实认定
patterns.context: 讨论证据能否支持定罪，或被告身份、行为及陪审团判断

patterns.name: 刑罚及判决攻击
patterns.context: 讨论对非法刑罚提出挑战的权利或时限

patterns.name: 判例引证格式
patterns.trigger: 法院或当事人名称及引证中的«State»、«v»、«F»、«U» «.» «S» «.» «C»，并伴随卷号、页码和括号
patterns.context: 在法律论证中引用判例、法规或法院意见；激活落在引证中的多种法律缩写和格式 token 上

patterns.name: 法律实体名称与诉讼当事人
patterns.context: 案件叙述或引用判决中出现当事人、州或地方政府名称

patterns.name: 不明确的电话搜查表述
patterns.context: 讨论手机定位行为是否构成搜查并涉及联邦或州宪法保护
patterns.domain: 刑事诉讼中的隐私与搜查争议

patterns.name: 不明确的引证数字与标点激活
patterns.context: 引证序列内部的数字、缩写和标点；难以确定除法律引证格式外的独立语义触发

en.description: Every passage contains County/county: mainly U.S. county names, county courts, or county-level institutions. These occur in case-law text and often accompany court captions, legal citations, litigation procedures, and judicial language.

patterns.name: County in county names
patterns.context: Occurs in U.S. county names or possessive forms of county; county is often preceded or followed by a place name, court, institution, or litigation-related wording.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal memoranda

patterns.name: Court and legal-document format
patterns.context: Opinion captions, case-procedure descriptions, paragraph numbering, or court hierarchy; often co-occurs with county names.
patterns.domain: Captions and body text of U.S. judicial opinions

patterns.name: Litigation and judicial language
patterns.context: Discusses appeals, litigation, adjudication, or remedies, often in the context of county courts or county-level disputes.

patterns.name: County names in legal citations
patterns.context: County is part of a proper name in precedent citations or court and public-institution names; a state name, citation, or procedural outcome may appear nearby.

1_787.concept: 美国判例中的 County
1_787.description: 所有片段都含 County/county：主要是美国县名、县法院或县级机构；共同出现在判例文本中，并常伴随法院标题、法律引证、诉讼程序与裁判措辞。

patterns.name: 县名中的 County
patterns.trigger: « County»、«County»，以及所有格“«county»'s”，包括“McHenry« County»10”“Broward« County»9”“the« county»4's”
patterns.context: 出现在美国县名或 county 的所有格形式中；county 前后常有地名、法院、机构或诉讼相关措辞。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决及法律意见书

patterns.name: 法院与法律文书格式
patterns.trigger: « Court»、«¶»、«Judgment»、«Appeal»，以及章节标题“I.”和诉讼程序词语
patterns.context: 判决标题、案件程序说明、段落编号或法院层级等格式和语境；常与县名同现。
patterns.domain: 美国司法判决的标题及正文

patterns.name: 法律诉讼及裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: “we affirm”“we reverse”“filing an action”“challenging the validity”“trial court”“temporary injunction”等
patterns.context: 讨论上诉、诉讼、裁判或救济，且往往出现在县法院或县级争议语境中。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的县名
patterns.trigger: “v.”后或案件名称、法院名称中的县名，如“Jackson County”“Tarrant County”“Jefferson County”
patterns.context: 先例引证或法院、公共机构名称中，County 是专名的一部分；有时附近出现州名、引注或程序结果。

en.concept: Proper names and citations in U.S. legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to proper names and structures in U.S. legal texts, especially County place names and case/institutional citations. It also covers immigration, property, land surveying, taxation, appeals, and injunctions, plus one 401(k) question-and-answer passage.

patterns.name: County in place names
patterns.context: County occurs in U.S. place names, court names, or legal citations, often adjacent to a state, town, or parcel description.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal texts, opinions, and deeds

patterns.name: Legal names with Board of Trustees
patterns.context: Part of an institution or case name, followed by the name of a local government, school, or union.

patterns.name: Citation format in legal references
patterns.context: Occurs in case names, statutory provisions, or opinion citations, often surrounded by abbreviations, numbers, and punctuation.

patterns.name: U.S. immigration agencies and status abbreviations
patterns.context: Background to an immigration application or litigant, often co-occurring with terms such as visa, petition, and Attorney General.

patterns.name: 401(k) retirement account
patterns.context: Asks about personal experience in a question title addressed to a community.

patterns.name: Parcel surveying and cadastral descriptions
patterns.context: Lists township, range, section, directions, and distances to define a land location.

patterns.name: Tax treatment and airport leases
patterns.context: Discusses airport-related legislation and whether an airport lease qualifies for favorable tax treatment.

patterns.name: Wills/joint ownership and farms
patterns.context: Mentions joint-tenancy survivorship and transfer of a family farm, alongside appellate language.

patterns.name: Leave to appeal and constitutional rights
patterns.context: Discusses whether to grant leave to appeal and cites federal statutes and constitutional-rights standards.

patterns.name: Standard for preliminary injunctions
patterns.context: Discusses whether a preliminary injunction may issue when factual disputes remain unresolved and cites case names.

1_787.concept: 美国法律文本中的专名与引文
1_787.description: 主要响应美国法律文本中的专名与结构，尤其 County 地名、判例/机构引文；也覆盖移民、产权、土地测绘、税务、上诉及禁令等法律语境，另有一条401(k)问答。

patterns.name: 地名中的 County
patterns.context: County 出现在美国地名、法院名称或法律引文中，常与州、镇、地块描述相邻。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文本、判决及地契

patterns.name: Board of Trustees 法律名称
patterns.context: 作为机构或案件名称的一部分，后接地方政府、学校或工会名称。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的引注格式
patterns.trigger: « v»、法院缩写及卷页/法条编号，如“v. Cook”“S.C. § 2253(c)(1)”
patterns.context: 判例名、法规条文或判决引文中出现，周围常有缩写、数字和标点。

patterns.name: 美国移民机构及身份缩写
patterns.context: 移民申请或诉讼当事人背景，常与签证、请愿、Attorney General 等词同现。

patterns.name: 401(k) 退休账户
patterns.context: 询问个人经验，置于面向社区的提问标题中。

patterns.name: 地块测量与地籍描述
patterns.context: 连续列出 township、range、section、方向及距离，以界定土地位置。

patterns.name: 税收待遇与机场租赁
patterns.context: 讨论机场相关立法及某机场租赁能否获得优惠税务待遇。

patterns.name: 遗嘱/共同产权与农场
patterns.context: 谈及共同产权存续者及家庭农场转让，伴随上诉裁判语句。

patterns.name: 上诉许可与宪法权利
patterns.context: 讨论是否签发上诉许可，并引用联邦法条及宪法权利标准。
patterns.domain: 联邦刑事/人身保护令判决

patterns.name: 临时禁令的裁判标准
patterns.context: 讨论事实争议未决时是否可颁发临时禁令，并引用案件名。

en.description: Primarily responds to U.S. judicial opinions and their vocabulary, institutions, and citation formats, especially Texas Department, prisoner, judicial-procedure language, and names containing Citizens and County. There is also an isolated activation on ks in a question about 401ks.

patterns.name: Bank names in legal citations
patterns.context: Activation occurs on Citizens in bank names appearing in legal-opinion citations or party names; also includes cases where the name is split across multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and case citations

patterns.name: The ks suffix in retirement-account abbreviations
patterns.context: The ks suffix immediately following 401 in “401ks,” in a question about self-directed retirement accounts.

patterns.name: County names in legal cases
patterns.context: County following a place name in U.S. legal texts, especially county names in case facts or institutional names.

patterns.name: Texas Department names
patterns.context: Names of government agencies beginning with Texas Department in legal opinions, including the Department of Human Services and the Department of Criminal Justice.

patterns.name: The ending of the legal term prisoner
patterns.context: The word prisoner, referring to a person in custody or serving a sentence in a legal context; activation falls on a split subword or the complete word.
patterns.domain: Legal-dictionary citations, criminal and civil opinions

patterns.name: Court-procedure terms in legal texts
patterns.context: Occurs when describing a court issuing a judgment, terminating parental rights, filing a pleading, or serving a sentence, and related procedural or legal statuses.

patterns.name: Sentencing and judicial-agency language
patterns.context: Describes days of imprisonment and a state prison department in sentencing language, common in plea-bargain and criminal-opinion narratives.

patterns.name: Legal argument and adjudication language
patterns.context: Appellate opinions state how evidence is evaluated, legal rules applied, disputes decided, or judicial relief granted.

patterns.name: Legal-document layout and citation markers
patterns.context: Occurs near page breaks, paragraph numbering, punctuation, or citation formatting in opinions; some activations may be triggered by formatting or split tokens.

1_787.concept: 美国法律文本与名称
1_787.description: 主要响应美国法律判决及其词汇、机构和引文格式，尤其是 Texas Department、prisoner、裁判程序语及含 Citizens、County 的名称；另对401ks提问中的ks有孤立激活。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的银行名称
patterns.trigger: «Cit»«izens» … «Bank»，包括“First-Citizens Bank & Trust Co.”、“Citizens Nat. T. & S. Bank”
patterns.context: 法律判决的引文或当事人名称中，银行名称出现 Citizens 时激活；也包括名称拆分成多个 token 的情形。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、案例引文

patterns.name: 退休账户缩写 ks
patterns.context: “401ks”中紧接数字 401 的 ks 后缀，且处于关于 self-directed 退休账户的提问中。

patterns.name: 法律案件中的县名
patterns.context: 美国法律文本中地名后的 County，尤其是案例事实或机构名称中的县名。

patterns.name: Texas Department 名称
patterns.context: 法律判决中以 Texas Department 开头的政府机构名称，包括 Department of Human Services 和 Department of Criminal Justice。

patterns.name: 法律词语 prisoner 的词尾
patterns.context: 法律语境中指被羁押或服刑者的 prisoner 一词；激活落在拆分词片或完整词上。
patterns.domain: 法律词典引述、刑事及民事判决

patterns.name: 法律文本中的法院程序词语
patterns.context: 描述法院作出判决、终止亲子关系、提交诉状或服刑等程序与法律状态时出现。

patterns.name: 刑期与司法机构措辞
patterns.context: 量刑句中描述监禁天数及州监狱部门，常见于 plea bargain 和刑事判决叙述。

patterns.name: 法律论证与裁判用语
patterns.context: 上诉意见中陈述证据评价、法律规则适用、争议裁定或法院救济。

patterns.name: 法律文书版式与引文标记
patterns.trigger: «¶»、«-»、«.»、«» 引号及案例引文中的缩写片段
patterns.context: 判决文本的页码分隔、段落编号、标点或引文排版附近出现；个别激活可能由格式或拆分 token 触发。

en.concept: Formal names and specialized text formats
en.description: Activations are concentrated in formal names and legal texts, especially City in place names, institutional or company names, and the abbreviations and punctuation formats of statutes and case citations. There are also two isolated patterns: 401ks and nautical rigging and vessel-type vocabulary.

patterns.name: City in legal names, institutions, and place names
patterns.context: Occurs in formal names, often alongside place names such as New York, Iowa, Minot, and Bessemer; sometimes repeated in names or case citations within the same passage.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal documents, party addresses, and case citations

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory formats
patterns.context: Markers occur in statute numbers, case citations, abbreviations, and section numbers; the pattern is not limited to a single word.

patterns.name: Proper names in institutions and legal terminology
patterns.context: Part of the name of a formal institution, program, company, or legal term.
patterns.domain: Legal documents and historical company names

patterns.name: Account abbreviations in financial Q&A
patterns.context: Follows 401 to form the retirement-account name 401ks.

patterns.name: Nautical rigging and vessel-type vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of rigging use and lists of vessel types.

1_787.concept: 正式名称与专门文本格式
1_787.description: 激活主要集中在正式名称和法律文本，尤其是地名中的 City、机构或公司名称，以及法条、判例引文的缩写与标点格式。另有 401ks 和航海索具、船型词汇两个孤立模式。

patterns.name: 法律名称、机构和地名中的 City
patterns.context: 出现在正式名称中，常与 New York、Iowa、Minot、Bessemer 等地名相连；有时反复出现在同段的名称或判例引文中。
patterns.domain: 美国法律文书、当事人地址与判例引文

patterns.name: 法律引文与法条格式
patterns.context: 标记出现在法规编号、判例引文、缩写和条款编号中；不只限于某个单一词语。

patterns.name: 机构和法律术语中的专名
patterns.context: 正式机构、项目、公司或法律术语名称的一部分。
patterns.domain: 法律文书及历史公司名称

patterns.name: 金融问答中的账户缩写
patterns.context: 紧跟 401，构成退休账户名称 401ks。

patterns.name: 船舶索具与船型词汇
patterns.context: 出现在索具用途说明和船型列表中。

en.concept: The ks substring and legal-text formatting
en.description: Activations are concentrated on the ks substring across multiple contexts and on case-citation formats in U.S. legal texts; there is also a response to capitalized jurisdictions and court names in legal documents. The shared feature of ks is more orthographic than semantic.

patterns.name: The ks / k’s substring at word endings
patterns.context: The substring occurs at the end of English words or in plural/possessive forms; contexts have no consistent semantics and refer respectively to ships, bark, surnames, and retirement accounts.
patterns.domain: Nautical books, popular science, biographies, personal-finance Q&A

patterns.name: Abbreviations and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs in case names, reporter citations, courts, or years in legal references; activation falls on abbreviation letters and formatting elements such as periods and parentheses.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal literature

patterns.name: Title-case place and court names in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in litigation captions or court and jurisdiction names, often in uppercase or title-case typography; it is adjacent to citation formatting but is not limited to abbreviations.

1_787.concept: ks 子串与法律文本格式
1_787.description: 激活最集中于多种语境中的 ks 子串，以及美国法律文本中的判例引注格式；另对法律文书中大写的辖区、法院名称有反应。ks 的共同点偏向字形而非语义。

patterns.name: 词尾 ks / k’s 的子串
patterns.context: 子串出现在英语单词末尾或复数/所有格形式中；上下文并无一致语义，分别指船只、树皮、姓氏和退休账户。
patterns.domain: 航海书籍、科普、传记、个人理财问答

patterns.name: 法律引证中的缩写与标点
patterns.trigger: 如 «U»«.»«S»«.»、«S»«.»«W»«d»、«Tex»«.»«App»、«(»年份«)»，以及引证中的字母缩写
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称、记者引证、法院或年份等法律引注中；激活落在缩写字母及句点、括号等格式成分上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判例与法律文献

patterns.name: 法律文书中的标题式大写地名与法院名称
patterns.context: 出现在诉讼标题或法院、辖区名称中，常以大写或标题式排印；与引注格式相邻，但不只是缩写。

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in U.S. legal texts: jurisdictions and court names, statutes and case citations, litigation-procedure terms, and case captions. There are also sporadic activations on nautical rigging terms and bark in the botanical sense.

patterns.name: Jurisdiction names in legal documents
patterns.context: Proper names such as states, counties, and courts occur in legal facts, rulings, or case narratives; often adjacent to legal place-name markers such as Court, County, and State
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Legal citation and statutory-number formats
patterns.context: Combinations of abbreviations and punctuation in citations to codes, case reporters, docket numbers, and volumes/pages in legal documents

patterns.name: Litigation procedure and judicial language
patterns.context: Legal contexts describing appeals, rulings, applications, remedies, or procedural actions by parties

patterns.name: Proper names and title formats in legal documents
patterns.context: Case captions, party names, institutional names, or job titles, often formatted in uppercase, abbreviations, or title style
patterns.domain: U.S. case captions and case narratives

patterns.name: Maritime rigging vocabulary and headings
patterns.context: Discusses ropes, ship rigging, and sailing-ship categories; strings such as rig/rigged and bark(s) occur within words or at word endings

patterns.name: Bark in plant names
patterns.context: When describing plants or sources of bark, bark occurs as a plural noun

1_787.concept: 法律文书格式与专名
1_787.description: 激活主要集中于美国法律文本：司法辖区与法院名称、法条和判例引文、诉讼程序词及案件抬头；另对航海索具词及植物意义的bark有零星激活。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的司法管辖区名称
patterns.context: 州、县、法院名称等专名出现在法律事实、裁判或案情叙述中；常邻接 Court、County、State 等法律地名标记

patterns.name: 法律引文与法规编号格式
patterns.context: 法律文书中法典、判例汇编、案卷编号及卷页引文的缩写和标点组合

patterns.name: 诉讼程序与裁判用语
patterns.context: 描述上诉、裁判、申请、救济或当事人程序行为的法律语境

patterns.name: 法律文书中的专名与头衔格式
patterns.context: 案件标题、当事人姓名、机构名称或职务称谓，常以大写、缩写或标题排版出现
patterns.domain: 美国判例抬头及案件叙述

patterns.name: 海事索具词汇及标题
patterns.context: 讨论绳索、船舶索具与帆船类别，词中或词尾出现 rig/rigged、bark(s) 等字样

patterns.name: 植物名称中的 bark
patterns.context: 描述植物或树皮来源时，bark 作为树皮名词复数出现

en.concept: Legal citations and fragments of legal text
en.description: Primarily activates on statutory provisions, case citations, and litigation terminology in U.S. legal texts. A few nautical and nature-related examples are triggered by the forms “rig” or “bark(s)” and do not fit entirely into the legal pattern.

patterns.name: U.S. Code citation format
patterns.context: Forms code names, section numbers, and subsection citations in U.S. legal texts; activation is distributed across multiple characters or fragments in the citation.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions, pleadings, and statutory citations

patterns.name: Supreme Court case citations
patterns.context: Case names and United States Reports citations, especially United States and U.S. reporter volumes and pages.
patterns.domain: U.S. judicial opinions and case citations

patterns.name: Fixed terms in legal arguments
patterns.context: Discusses evidentiary standards of review, legal conclusions, exemptions, or statutory violations; these terms occur near citations or in judicial-argument sentences.

patterns.name: Procedural or claim language in legal texts
patterns.context: Describes filing an application, criminal charges, or litigation procedure; often adjacent to statutory numbers, offenses, or case facts.
patterns.domain: Legal pleadings and judicial fact statements

patterns.name: Nautical terms containing rig and section headings
patterns.context: Nautical equipment, vessel types, and section headings; “bar{ks}” refers to bark(s) here, not legal citations.

patterns.name: Natural-history words containing ks
patterns.context: In parallel descriptions of the bark of pine, yew, and other trees, activation falls within the word barks; this overlaps in form with bark(s) in nautical passages, but the context differs.

1_787.concept: 法律引文与法律文本片段
1_787.description: 主要对美国法律文本中的法典条款、判例引文及诉讼术语激活；另有少量由“rig”或“bark(s)”词形触发的航海和自然类例子，不能完全归入法律模式。

patterns.name: 美国法典引文格式
patterns.context: 在美国法律文本中组成法典名称、条款编号和子款引文；激活分布在引文的多个字符或片段上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见、诉状及法规引文

patterns.name: 最高法院判例引文
patterns.trigger: «v»、«United»、«States»、«U»、«S»及卷页格式，如“Reina v. United States, 364 U.S. 507”“340 U.S. 135”
patterns.context: 案件名称及《美国判例汇编》引文，尤其 United States 和 U.S. 报告卷页。
patterns.domain: 美国司法判决及判例引用

patterns.name: 法律论证中的固定术语
patterns.context: 讨论证据审查标准、法律结论、豁免或违反法规；这些词在引文附近或司法论证句中出现。

patterns.name: 法律程序或主张表述
patterns.context: 描述提交申请、刑事指控或诉讼程序；常与法规编号、罪名或案件事实相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律诉状与司法事实陈述

patterns.name: 含 rig 的航海词及章节标题
patterns.context: 航海器具、船型及章节标题；“bar{ks}”在此指 bark(s)，不是法律引文。

patterns.name: 含 ks 的自然词
patterns.context: 在松树、紫杉等树皮的并列描述中，激活落在 barks 一词内部；与航海段的 bark(s) 词形重合，但语境不同。
patterns.domain: 化学或自然类说明文字

en.concept: Academic research and medical quantitative expressions
en.description: One pattern activates on researchers in academic contexts; another strongly activates on the Quant- initial subword fragment in medical titles, followed by various quantitative forms covering blood flow, valves, biomarkers, metabolites, drugs, electrical activity, and comorbidities.

patterns.name: researchers
patterns.context: “researchers” appears in academic sentences, followed by their research, roles, or research subjects; examples include “Chemical Technology researchers develop…”、“In many experimental situations, researchers have…”及“Nurses play key roles … and researchers to eliminate…”
patterns.domain: Research funding/technology research and medical papers

patterns.name: Quant- initial subword fragment
patterns.context: Medical paper titles or title-like phrases begin with Quant, forming expressions for quantification, quantitative analysis, or quantifying diseases; subsequent words and research subjects vary

1_1165.concept: 学术研究与医学量化表述
1_1165.description: 一类激活于学术语境中的 researchers；另一类强烈激活于医学标题中 Quant 词首片段，后接多种量化词形，涉及血流、瓣膜、标志物、代谢物、药物、电活动及合并症。

patterns.name: researchers
patterns.context: 学术句子中出现“researchers”，后接其研究、角色或研究对象；分别为“Chemical Technology researchers develop…”、“In many experimental situations, researchers have…”及“Nurses play key roles … and researchers to eliminate…”
patterns.domain: 科研资助/技术研究与医学论文

patterns.name: Quant 词首片段
patterns.context: 医学论文标题或标题式短语以 Quant 开头，构成数量化、定量分析或量化疾病的表达；后续词语和研究对象不固定
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文标题或摘要

en.description: Activation occurs primarily on the Quant- initial subword fragment in medical literature titles, and also on researchers; the former covers various quantitative analysis topics, while the latter occurs in descriptions of researchers’ activities or roles.

patterns.name: Quant- initial subword fragment
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the Quant initial subword fragment, which appears at the beginning of titles or phrases; subsequent word formation and topics vary
patterns.domain: PubMed medical paper titles or abstract fragments

patterns.name: researchers
patterns.context: The word appears in sentences describing researchers’ work or roles; surrounding topics vary
patterns.domain: NIH project descriptions and PubMed medical abstracts

1_1165.concept: 科研与定量研究术语
1_1165.description: 激活主要落在医学文献标题中的 Quant- 词首，也落在 researchers 一词；前者涵盖多种定量分析主题，后者见于科研人员活动或角色描述。

patterns.name: Quant- 词首
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Quant 这一词首片段，出现在标题或短语开头；后续构词和主题各异
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学论文标题或摘要片段

patterns.name: researchers
patterns.context: 该词出现在描述研究人员开展工作或承担角色的句子中；前后主题不同
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述及 PubMed 医学摘要

en.description: All segments contain researchers, which is the strongest activation point; research, scientific, investigate, and other research-related terms also activate weakly in some segments. Other marked words are sporadic and difficult to group under a single condition.

patterns.name: The word researchers
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the noun researchers; in some examples, it is followed by research goals, subjects, or actions.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, medical abstracts, and research project texts

patterns.name: Other research-related words
patterns.context: Words related to research activities or scientific fields show weaker activation; however, they are not common triggers across all segments, and strong activation remains on researchers.

patterns.name: Unclear activation on neighboring words
patterns.context: Sporadic words are marked as activated in individual segments, but there is insufficient evidence of recurrence across segments to confirm a stable pattern.
patterns.domain: Chemistry, statistics, public health, medicine, and other genres

1_1165.concept: 科研人员
1_1165.description: 所有段均含 researchers，且该词是最强激活点；若干段中 research、scientific、investigate 等科研词也弱激活。其余标记词分散，难归为统一条件。

patterns.name: researchers 一词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 researchers 这个名词上；部分例子位于 researchers 后接研究目标、研究对象或动作的语境中。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、医学摘要及科研项目文本

patterns.name: 其他科研相关词
patterns.context: 科研活动或科学领域的词汇出现时有较弱激活；但这些词并非各段共同触发因素，且强激活仍落在 researchers 上。

patterns.name: 未明的邻近词激活
patterns.trigger: « small»1、« approaches»2、« measured»3、« covariates»4、« essential»4 等
patterns.context: 零散词语在个别段落标记为激活，但缺少跨段重复证据，难以确认其是否属于稳定模式。
patterns.domain: 化学、统计、公共卫生及医学等不同文体

en.description: Every fragment activates on “researchers.” It occurs across disciplines, genres, and semantic contexts; surrounding text often describes researchers’ work, teams, or data, but segment 9 discusses online privacy, so the core trigger appears to be the word itself.

patterns.name: The word “researchers”
patterns.context: The word itself is the most stable trigger; it functions in the sentence as a noun for a group of researchers, without requiring a particular syntax or topic in the surrounding text.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, research project descriptions, and general online text

patterns.name: Researchers conducting or participating in research
patterns.context: Researchers appear as the agents, participants, or target groups of research activities; no single discipline or method is required.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, public health, psychopathology, chemical technology, neuroscience, and social sciences

patterns.name: Researchers and data or public issues
patterns.context: Researchers are described as parties obtaining data or information; this is not a typical account of a research team in an academic abstract.
patterns.domain: Online commentary and discussions of privacy and data disclosure

1_1165.concept: researchers（研究者）
1_1165.description: 所有片段都在“researchers”处激活。它跨学科、文体和语义场景出现；周围常描述研究者的工作、团队或数据，但第9段是网络隐私讨论，故触发核心更像该词本身。

patterns.name: “researchers”一词
patterns.context: 该词本身是最稳定的触发点；在句中作为研究者群体的名词，前后文不要求特定句法或主题。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、研究项目描述及一般网络文本

patterns.name: 研究者开展或参与研究
patterns.trigger: “researchers”及其周围关于研究、研究团队、科学或研究数据的表述，如 «researchers»10 develop、«researchers»10 observed、«researchers»10 studying
patterns.context: 研究者作为研究活动的主体、参与者或目标群体；不局限于单一学科，也不要求特定方法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、公共卫生、心理病理学、化学技术、神经科学及社会科学

patterns.name: 研究者与数据或公共议题
patterns.trigger: «researchers»10 附近出现数据发布及其影响的叙述，如 “Giving the search history … to «researchers»10”
patterns.context: 研究者作为获取数据或信息的一方；此处不是典型学术摘要中的研究团队叙述。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、隐私与数据发布讨论

en.concept: The designation researchers in research contexts
en.description: Strong activation is concentrated on researchers, especially the plural designation in research abstracts or project texts; it also occurs in contexts involving collaborative teams, project participants, and target audiences. No other related words are marked as strongly activated.

patterns.name: Researcher designation researchers
patterns.context: Appears in the context of scientific papers or research projects, often as the subject of verbs such as “develop,” “have,” and “include,” or as participants, audiences, or team members; the token itself is marked as strongly activated.
patterns.domain: Scientific research abstracts, research plans, and project descriptions

patterns.name: Variants of the researcher designation researchers
patterns.context: Appears as forum participants, research project members, or team categories in research projects or collaborative research contexts; comparatively weaker activation.

patterns.name: Possible research/researcher semantic cues
patterns.context: Related to research/research team, but the strong activation markers actually fall on researchers or its variants, so it cannot be determined whether these words themselves are triggers.
patterns.domain: Scientific research abstracts and project descriptions

1_1165.concept: 科研语境中的研究者称谓
1_1165.description: 强激活集中于 researchers，尤以科研摘要或项目文本中的复数研究者称谓为显著；也见于协作团队、项目参与者和目标受众语境。其他相关词未标出强激活。

patterns.name: 研究者称谓 researchers
patterns.context: 出现在科研论文或研究项目语境中，常作“develop”“have”“include”等动词的主语，或作为参与者、受众、团队成员；该词 token 本身标出强激活。
patterns.domain: 科学研究摘要、研究计划与项目描述

patterns.name: 研究者称谓 researchers 的变体
patterns.context: 科研项目或协作研究语境中，作为论坛参与者、研究项目成员或团队类别出现；相对激活较弱。

patterns.name: 可能的研究/研究者语义线索
patterns.context: 与 research/research team 相关，但强激活标记实际落在 researchers 或其变体上，不能确定这些词本身是否触发。
patterns.domain: 科学研究摘要与项目描述

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to the English noun couple, covering uses such as partners, an approximate number, and paired objects; it also responds to a few instances of the verb couple meaning to link or combine. The shared form is couple, but the meanings and syntactic functions differ.

patterns.name: Noun couple
patterns.context: As a noun, refers to a pair of partners, two people, or a pair of objects; examples include “the couple”“a couple of”“observations par couple”“a couple of local hard disk drives” and other constructions.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including news, research, encyclopedic, and technical texts

patterns.name: Verb couple
patterns.context: Means to connect or couple a receptor to an intracellular second-messenger system; this is a verbal use, not a reference to a pair of people or things.

patterns.name: couple in a phrase and concatenation in a quotation
patterns.context: “couple” is a verb meaning to combine two research topics; the surrounding text introduces an institution and CRISP entries, then a topic in quantum dynamics.

1_1165.concept: couple 词形
1_1165.description: 神经元主要响应英文名词 couple，涵盖伴侣、约数及成对对象等用法；也响应少量表示耦联、结合的动词 couple。共同形式是 couple，但词义和句法功能不同。

patterns.name: 名词 couple
patterns.context: 作为名词指一对伴侣、两个人，或一对成对的对象；包括“the couple”“a couple of”“observations par couple”“a couple of local hard disk drives”等不同搭配。
patterns.domain: 新闻、科研、百科、技术文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 动词 couple
patterns.context: 表示将受体与细胞内第二信使系统连接或耦联；此处为动词用法，而非指一对人或物。

patterns.name: 短语 couple 与引文中的拼接
patterns.context: “couple”作动词，表示把两个研究主题结合；前后文介绍机构和 CRISP 条目，随后接量子动力学主题。
patterns.domain: 科研资助/研究介绍文本

en.concept: Specified entities and their applicability relations
en.description: The most salient pattern is those followed by a modifier, relative clause, or noun identifying a specific entity; activation also commonly occurs on for introducing a use or target and on and as a coordinator. Other local patterns include psychological relational judgments, religious salvation, people with accessibility needs, and HTML template markers.
