patterns.context: Concerns graphs, vertex sets, and their properties; two snippets separately address graph definitions and graph-theoretic properties.
patterns.domain: Graph theory papers and mathematics Q&A

patterns.name: Algebraic topology and Goodwillie derivatives
patterns.context: Discusses the derivatives of the identity functor on based spaces and structures on their homology.

patterns.name: Abelian varieties and homology in algebraic geometry
patterns.context: Moves from the algebraic closure of a field to the Jacobian of a curve and its rational homology.

patterns.name: Cohen–Macaulay property in combinatorial commutative algebra
patterns.context: Discusses Cohen–Macaulay properties of rings or modules related to simplicial complexes.

patterns.name: Weyl representations in representation theory
patterns.context: States properties of symplectic group representations associated with finite abelian groups of odd order and their multiplicities.

patterns.name: Fubini property in set theory and measure theory
patterns.context: Discusses ideals satisfying the Fubini property and gives the ideal of null sets as an example.

patterns.name: Mathematical paper abstracts or formal academic style
patterns.context: Abstracts or paper bodies formally summarize research objects, results, and extensions; this stylistic pattern spans multiple topics.

1_1290.concept: 数学学术文本中的形式化表述
1_1290.description: 激活集中最稳定的共同背景是数学学术文本：公式符号与正文交界、形式化定义用语及数学论文文体。其下分布于代数、图论、拓扑、几何、表示论和集合论等多个具体主题，未见单一主题能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 数学表达式附近的美元符号
patterns.context: 激活集中出现于数学公式或符号表达式与正文交界处；未必需要特定公式内容

patterns.name: 形式化数学引入语
patterns.trigger: “Let”、“be”、“is”、“and”等数学定义或陈述中的常见词
patterns.context: 这些词位于数学对象、集合、群、环、理想或性质的形式化定义与论证中；单独看是常见词，但片段整体有密集数学记号
patterns.domain: 数学论文、StackExchange 数学问答

patterns.name: 抽象代数与环论术语
patterns.context: 术语出现在环、理想、群及代数结构的定义或论述中

patterns.name: 图论结构与性质
patterns.context: 围绕图、顶点集及其性质展开；两个片段分别涉及图的定义和图论性质

patterns.name: 代数拓扑与 Goodwillie 导数
patterns.context: 讨论基点空间上恒等函子的导数及其同调上的结构

patterns.name: 代数几何中的阿贝尔簇与同调
patterns.trigger: “algebraic closure”、“complex abelian variety”、“first rational homology group”
patterns.context: 由域的代数闭包转入曲线雅可比及其有理同调

patterns.name: 组合交换代数中的 Cohen–Macaulay 性
patterns.context: 讨论单纯复形相关的环或模的 Cohen–Macaulay 性质

patterns.name: 表示论中的 Weyl 表示
patterns.context: 陈述有限奇阶阿贝尔群关联的辛群表示及其重数性质

patterns.name: 集合论与测度论中的 Fubini 性质
patterns.context: 讨论满足 Fubini 性质的理想，并以零测集理想为例

patterns.name: 数学论文摘要或正式学术文体
patterns.trigger: “abstract:”、“In this paper we show”、“We also extend”、“is shown”
patterns.context: 摘要或论文正文以正式方式概述研究对象、结果与扩展；该文体模式跨越多个主题

en.description: Activations center on mathematical texts, especially the introduction of objects or notation, rings and ideals, groups and their structures; they also cover graph-theoretic properties, higher homological structures, definitions of topological and Borel notation, and abstract-style conclusions. Formula boundary markers also commonly activate.

patterns.name: Algebraic statements about rings and ideals
patterns.context: Mathematical text uses definitions, assumptions, or formulas to describe rings, ideals, endomorphism rings, and other algebraic objects; triggers often fall on object names and nearby definitional language.
patterns.domain: Commutative algebra, algebraic geometry, and abstract algebra papers or Q&A

patterns.name: Group-theoretic objects and group actions
patterns.context: When discussing finite groups, group representations, group actions, or subgroup structure, activations occur near groups and related classification terms.
patterns.domain: Group theory and representation theory papers

patterns.name: Definitional introduction of mathematical objects
patterns.context: Introduces objects, specifies notation, or explains symbols using Let, By, or similar expressions; not restricted to a single mathematical field.
patterns.domain: Definitions and notation in mathematical papers and mathematics Q&A

patterns.name: Properties and quantifier conditions in graph theory
patterns.context: Defines graph conditions using indexed property symbols and quantifies over the vertex set.

patterns.name: Higher structures and homological objects
patterns.context: Describes algebraic structures on derived objects and their homology; terminology centers on structures, derivations, and homology groups.
patterns.domain: Algebraic topology and homotopy theory papers

patterns.name: Notation for topological spaces and their measurable structures
patterns.context: First specifies a space, then defines its topology or a family of sets such as its Borel σ-algebra.
patterns.domain: Descriptive set theory and topology papers

patterns.name: Correspondences between group theory and algebraic structures
patterns.context: Derives a near-field or other algebraic structure from the action or transitivity conditions of a specific group, and states its defining properties.
patterns.domain: Finite group and algebraic structure theory papers

patterns.name: Abstract-style statements of research results
patterns.context: In an abstract or paper statement, briefly reports the research object, result, or proof conclusion; activations may also fall on technical terms in the sentence.

patterns.name: Markers near symbols and formula boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur near variables, formulas, or LaTeX symbol boundaries in mathematical typesetting; some strong activations fall directly on dollar-sign markers and may relate to formula tokenization or marker position.

patterns.name: Finiteness and order conditions for finite groups
patterns.context: Discusses group finiteness, group order, or odd-prime conditions; overlaps with the group theory pattern, but conditions such as odd order are prominent in several passages.
patterns.domain: Finite group theory and representation theory

1_1290.concept: 数学定义与结构陈述
1_1290.description: 激活集中于数学文本，尤其是对象或记号的引入、环与理想、群及其结构；也覆盖图论性质、高阶同调结构、拓扑与Borel记号定义，以及摘要式结论。公式边界标记亦常激活。

patterns.name: 环与理想的代数陈述
patterns.context: 数学文本中以定义、假设或公式描述环、理想、端同态环等代数对象；触发常落在对象名称及其邻近定义语句上。
patterns.domain: 交换代数、代数几何与抽象代数论文或问答

patterns.name: 群论对象与群作用
patterns.context: 讨论有限群、群表示、群作用或群的子群结构时，群及其相关分类术语附近激活。

patterns.name: 数学对象的定义式引入
patterns.trigger: “Let $G$ be”“Let $I$ and $J$ be”“By … we denote”“stands for the identity”
patterns.context: 以 Let、By 或类似表达引入对象、给出符号约定或解释记号；不局限于单一数学领域。
patterns.domain: 数学论文与数学问答中的定义、记号说明

patterns.name: 图论中的性质与量词条件
patterns.context: 通过带下标的性质符号定义图的条件，并对顶点集量化。

patterns.name: 高阶结构与同调对象
patterns.context: 描述导出对象上的代数结构及其同调，术语集中于结构、导子和同调群。
patterns.domain: 代数拓扑与同伦论论文

patterns.name: 拓扑空间及其可测结构的记号定义
patterns.context: 先指定空间，再定义其拓扑或 Borel σ-代数等集合族记号。
patterns.domain: 描述集合论与拓扑论文

patterns.name: 群论与代数结构之间的对应
patterns.trigger: “tame, algebraic structure theory”“associate a near field”“division ring”
patterns.context: 从特定群的作用或传递性条件导出近域等代数结构，并说明其定义性质。
patterns.domain: 有限群与代数结构理论论文

patterns.name: 摘要式研究结论表述
patterns.trigger: “abstract:”“In this paper, we show”“is shown to”
patterns.context: 摘要或论文陈述中，以简短句式报告研究对象、结果或证明结论；激活也可能落在该句中的专业名词。

patterns.name: 符号与公式边界附近的标记
patterns.context: 数学排版中变量、公式或 LaTeX 符号边界附近出现激活；部分强激活直接落在标记的美元符号上，可能与公式分词或标记位置有关。

patterns.name: 有限群的有限性与阶条件
patterns.trigger: “finite group”“finite abelian group”“odd order”“odd prime number”
patterns.context: 讨论群有限性、群阶或奇素数条件；与群论模式重合，但奇数阶等条件在若干段中显著出现。

en.description: Responds to descriptions of formal objects and structures in technical mathematical texts, especially groups, rings, algebras, representations, and homology; also covers graph-theoretic properties, hyperplane intersections, and definitions of topological spaces and Borel sets.

patterns.name: Groups, rings, and algebraic structures in mathematical abstracts/formal exposition
patterns.context: Introduces objects, structures, representations, homology, or theorems in mathematical paper abstracts or bodies; often accompanied by LaTeX notation and definitional language.
patterns.domain: Pure mathematics, especially algebra, representation theory, algebraic topology, number theory, and algebraic geometry

patterns.name: Definition of vertex sets and properties in graph theory
patterns.context: Defines graph properties and formalizes them using conditions involving vertex sets, intersections, or containment.

patterns.name: Families of hyperplanes and geometric intersection problems
patterns.context: Discusses families of hyperplanes containing a given point and the number of their intersections with an object.
patterns.domain: Algebraic geometry or projective geometry Q&A

patterns.name: Definitional descriptions of topological spaces and Borel sets
patterns.context: First declares an uncountable Polish space, then defines its topology and Borel σ-algebra.

1_1290.concept: 数学形式化结构
1_1290.description: 对数学技术文本中的形式化对象与结构描述反应，尤其是群、环、代数、表示和同调；也覆盖图论性质、超平面相交及拓扑空间/Borel 集定义。

patterns.name: 数学论文摘要／形式化叙述中的群、环与代数结构
patterns.context: 数学论文摘要或正文中介绍对象、结构、表示、同调或定理；常伴随 LaTeX 数学符号与定义性措辞。
patterns.domain: 纯数学，尤为代数、表示论、代数拓扑、数论与代数几何

patterns.name: 图论中顶点集合与性质的定义
patterns.context: 定义图的性质，并以顶点集及其相交、包含等条件形式化陈述。

patterns.name: 超平面族与几何相交问题
patterns.context: 讨论包含给定点的超平面族及其与对象的交点数。
patterns.domain: 代数几何或射影几何问答

patterns.name: 拓扑空间与 Borel 集的定义性描述
patterns.context: 先声明不可数 Polish 空间，再定义其拓扑及 Borel σ-代数。
patterns.domain: 描述集合论／拓扑学论文正文

en.description: Activations center on technical mathematical texts, especially algebraic structures, groups and rings, topology and homology, Borel sets, and formula-adjacent snippets; there are also specialized patterns for graph theory, algebraic geometry, and Langlands terminology.

patterns.name: Abstract algebra, group, and ring terminology
patterns.context: Algebraic structures, groups, rings, ideals, or related properties occur in mathematical exposition; includes terms themselves and nearby formula snippets.

patterns.name: Homology and topological structure terminology
patterns.context: Topological, homological, or descriptive set theory contexts, often centered on mathematical objects such as groups, sets, and spaces.

patterns.name: operad word form with an operator
patterns.context: The word is split into multiple tokens in “operad structure” and related mathematical exposition; the context concerns derivatives or algebraic structures.

patterns.name: Vertex set conditions in graph theory
patterns.context: Graph-theoretic properties quantify over pairwise disjoint vertex sets.

patterns.name: Projective geometry hyperplane intersections
patterns.context: Discusses intersections between a family of hyperplanes containing a given point and an algebraic variety.

patterns.name: Number theory and Langlands terminology
patterns.context: An abstract states the fundamental lemma, spherical Hecke algebra, and characteristic conditions.

patterns.name: Symbols and variables in piecewise formulas
patterns.context: Variables occur inside formulas expressing set or function-space conditions; some activations may be affected by formula boundaries or symbol patterns.

patterns.name: Polish spaces and Borel sets in set theory
patterns.context: Defines the topology and Borel σ-algebra of an uncountable Polish space.

1_1290.concept: 数学形式化术语与公式
1_1290.description: 激活集中于数学技术文本，尤其代数结构、群环、拓扑与同调、Borel集合及公式邻近片段；另有图论、代数几何和Langlands术语等专门模式。

patterns.name: 抽象代数、群与环的数学术语
patterns.context: 在数学论述中出现代数结构、群、环、理想或相关性质；包含术语本身及其附近公式片段

patterns.name: 同调与拓扑结构术语
patterns.context: 拓扑、同调或描述集合论语境，常以“群”“集合”“空间”等数学对象为中心

patterns.name: 带操作符的 operad 词形
patterns.context: 在“operad structure”及相关数学论述中，词被分成多个 token；上下文涉及导数或代数结构

patterns.name: 图论中的顶点集合条件
patterns.context: 图论性质以互不相交的顶点集合为量化对象

patterns.name: 射影几何的超平面交点
patterns.context: 讨论包含给定点的超平面族与代数簇的交点

patterns.name: 数论与 Langlands 术语
patterns.context: 摘要中陈述基本引理、球面 Hecke 代数及特征条件

patterns.name: 分段公式中的符号与变量
patterns.trigger: «X»、«H» 等公式变量及 «Borel»、«set» 等邻近文字
patterns.context: 变量嵌在集合或函数空间条件的公式中，部分激活可能受公式边界或符号模式影响

patterns.name: 集合论中的 Polish 空间与 Borel 集
patterns.context: 定义不可数 Polish 空间上的拓扑及其 Borel σ-代数

en.concept: Structural terminology in formal mathematical texts
en.description: Mainly responds to groups, rings, algebraic structures, and their symbolic representations in mathematical texts; also responds to graph theory and geometric-combinatorial conditions, number theory and representation theory abstracts, and definitions of topology and Borel sets. The common feature is a formal mathematical context dense with technical terminology.

patterns.name: Groups and algebraic structures in mathematical papers
patterns.context: Groups, rings, algebraic structures, and their properties appear as central objects in mathematical definitions, theorems, or research abstracts; often accompanied by formulas and symbolic representations.
patterns.domain: Abstract algebra, group theory, homological algebra, and related mathematical papers

patterns.name: Graphs and combinatorial properties in graph theory
patterns.context: Discusses graph properties and vertex sets, or conditions on intersections between geometric objects and hyperplanes.
patterns.domain: Graph theory, combinatorics, and algebraic geometry Q&A

patterns.name: Technical field terminology in mathematical paper abstracts
patterns.context: An abstract states the proof of a theorem in a specific mathematical field, using dense terminology and formal paper style.

patterns.name: Polish spaces and Borel set terminology
patterns.context: Defines a topology and the family of measurable sets it generates, with terminology interspersed with symbols.
patterns.domain: Descriptive set theory and measure theory

1_1290.concept: 正式数学文本中的结构术语
1_1290.description: 主要响应数学专业文本中群、环、代数结构等对象及其符号化表述，也响应图论和几何组合条件、数论表示论摘要，以及拓扑与博雷尔集合定义；共同特点是正式数学语境和专业术语密集。

patterns.name: 数学论文中的群与代数结构
patterns.context: 在数学定义、定理或研究摘要中，群、环、代数结构及其性质作为核心对象出现；常伴随公式和符号化表述。
patterns.domain: 抽象代数、群论、同调代数及相关数学论文

patterns.name: 图论中的图与组合性质
patterns.context: 讨论图的性质、顶点集合，或几何对象与超平面的交点条件。
patterns.domain: 图论、组合数学与代数几何问答

patterns.name: 数学论文摘要中的专业领域术语
patterns.context: 摘要陈述特定数学领域中的定理证明，术语密集且带有正式论文文体。

patterns.name: 波兰空间与博雷尔集合术语
patterns.context: 定义拓扑及其生成的可测集合族，术语与符号交替出现。

en.description: Activates on plus signs in base-arithmetic expressions, malformations and stent terminology in medical texts, and specific words in music reviews and lawyer-discipline decisions. These triggers span multiple genres and show no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Plus signs in math problems
patterns.context: Occurs in arithmetic expressions in base-arithmetic problems, typically adjacent to negative numbers, digit strings, and question marks.

patterns.name: Medical term malformations
patterns.context: Appears as part of longer medical words, especially congenital malformations and cerebellar malformations; activation falls on an internal subword fragment.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts and NIH project descriptions, medicine/biomedicine

patterns.name: Coronary stent-related words
patterns.context: Appears in titles about coronary or intracranial endovascular interventions.

patterns.name: Three-dimensional analysis phrase in medical titles
patterns.context: Titles use three-dimensional analysis to describe interactions between stents in vivo and coronary arteries.

patterns.name: Music-style and instrument terms
patterns.context: Describes Romantic music and the fusion of flamenco with other musical traditions.

patterns.name: Legal terminology for disciplinary proceedings
patterns.context: Appears in court opinions describing a lawyer's consent to disciplinary action and related rules.

1_1413.description: 激活涵盖进制算术式中的加号、医学文本中的 malformations 与支架术语，也包括音乐评论和律师纪律处分判决中的特定词语；这些触发点横跨多种文体，未显示统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 数学题中的加号
patterns.context: 出现在进制算术题的运算式中，通常与负数、数字串及问号相邻。

patterns.name: 医学术语 malformations
patterns.context: 作为较长医学词汇的一部分，尤其是 congenital malformations、cerebellar malformations；激活落在词内片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要及 NIH 项目描述，医学/生物医学

patterns.name: 冠脉支架相关词
patterns.context: 出现在冠状动脉或颅内血管介入治疗的标题中。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的三维分析短语
patterns.context: 标题以三维分析描述体内支架与冠状动脉相互作用。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要，医学研究标题

patterns.name: 音乐风格与乐器术语
patterns.context: 描述浪漫音乐作品及 flamenco 与其他音乐传统的融合。

patterns.name: 纪律处分法律用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见中，描述律师同意纪律处分及相关规则。

en.description: Activations occur on numbers and symbols in arithmetic problems, stent and malformations in medical texts, and rule numbers in legal texts and set in music descriptions. They span domains, with no single stable semantic or syntactic trigger.

patterns.name: Arithmetic symbols and digit fragments in number strings
patterns.context: At or near numbers and arithmetic expressions; segments 1 and 2 are addition and subtraction problems in different bases, while segment 10 is a sequence problem. Some activation falls on digit blocks, symbols, or preceding spaces.

patterns.name: stent in medical titles
patterns.context: Appears in paper titles about coronary stent interactions or stroke after stenting; in segment 3 it is split into «stent» and subsequent «--» etc., and in segment 6 it is followed by -ing.

patterns.name: Medical word malformations
patterns.context: In medical titles and abstracts about birth defects, brain malformations, or cardiovascular malformations; activation concentrates on the stem and suffix of malformations.

patterns.name: Legal rule numbers
patterns.context: Appears as the rule number Rule 413 in a legal disciplinary consent agreement; it has the same form as digit fragments in math segments but a different context.

patterns.name: set in descriptions of Romantic music styles
patterns.context: Describes a collection of nuevo flamenco musical works; nearby text discusses its Romantic style and musical fusion.

1_1413.description: 激活分布在算术题的数字与符号、医学文本中的 stent 和 malformations，以及法律规则编号和音乐描述中的 set；跨领域，未见单一稳定语义或句法触发条件。

patterns.name: 数字串中的算术符号与数字片段
patterns.context: 数字或算术表达式内部或邻近位置；段1、2是不同进制的加减题，段10是数列题。部分激活落在数字块、符号或其前置空格上。

patterns.name: 医学标题中的 stent
patterns.context: 出现在冠状动脉支架相互作用或支架术后卒中的论文标题中；段3中拆分为«stent»和后续«--»等，段6中接着-ing。

patterns.name: 医学词语 malformations
patterns.context: 在先天缺陷、脑部畸形或心血管畸形的医学标题和摘要中；激活集中在 malformations 的词干及后缀。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、医学研究简介

patterns.name: 法律规则编号
patterns.context: 法律纪律同意协议中，作为 Rule 413 的规则编号出现；与数学段中的数字片段同形，但语境不同。

patterns.name: 浪漫音乐风格描述中的 set
patterns.context: 形容一组 nuevo flamenco 音乐作品，附近描述其浪漫风格及音乐融合。

en.concept: In-word fragment of medical malformation terminology
en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the in-word fragment formations in malformations in medical contexts, spanning congenital, cerebrovascular, and fetal malformations and related research, statistics, and prevention texts. It also activates on fragments in several medical compounds and a sporadic word fragment in a music blurb. Segment 5 has no clear malformation term.

patterns.name: Suffix in congenital malformations
patterns.context: The trigger is the English word malformations in medical contexts, especially near words such as congenital and fetal; activation concentrates on formations and its internal subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, clinical and public health texts

patterns.name: Medical titles and collocations related to malformations
patterns.context: Appears in medical titles describing cerebrovascular malformations, coronary stents, or fetal anomalies; the trigger is not necessarily malformations itself and may be associated with specific medical terms.

patterns.name: Malformation statistics and prevention
patterns.context: Activates in comparisons of pregnancy complication prevalence and descriptions of prenatal risk, screening, and postnatal detection; suffix activation is weaker than in some title examples.
patterns.domain: Perinatal medicine, epidemiology, and public health

patterns.name: Subword fragments within medical words
patterns.context: Activation covers subword fragments within medical compounds or technical terms; the first concerns malformation-related words, while the latter two occur in contexts involving valve formation and cerebral arteriovenous malformations, respectively.

patterns.name: Sporadic triggers in Romantic and music copy
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of nuevo flamenco music, genre blending, and portraits of musicians; it has no clear connection to the medical malformation theme and may be an independent word-fragment trigger.

1_1413.concept: 医学畸形术语的词内片段
1_1413.description: 主要对医学语境中 malformations 的词内片段 formations 强烈响应，覆盖先天、脑血管、胎儿畸形及相关研究、统计和预防文本；另对若干医学复合术语片段及一段音乐文案中的零散词片段激活。第5段无明确畸形词。

patterns.name: 先天畸形词尾
patterns.context: 触发点是医学语境中的英文单词 malformations，尤其是 congenital、fetal 等词附近；激活集中在 formations 及其词内拆分片段。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、临床与公共卫生文本

patterns.name: 畸形相关医学标题与搭配
patterns.trigger: «mal»3«formations»9，及 «mal»3«formations»9 前后的 «vascular»、«stent»、«diagnosis» 等医学词
patterns.context: 在描述脑血管畸形、冠状动脉支架或胎儿异常的医学标题中出现；不一定是单词 malformations 本身触发，也可能与特定医学名词搭配。

patterns.name: 畸形统计及预防
patterns.context: 在妊娠并发症患病率比较，以及产前风险、筛查和出生后检测的描述中激活；词尾激活强度低于若干标题实例。
patterns.domain: 围产医学、流行病学与公共卫生

patterns.name: 医学单词内部的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖医学复合词或专业术语内部的子词片段；前者为畸形相关词，后两者分别出现在瓣膜形成和脑动静脉畸形语境。

patterns.name: 浪漫与音乐文案中的零散触发
patterns.context: 出现在关于新弗拉门戈音乐、混合流派及人物肖像的描述中；与医学畸形主题无明显联系，可能是独立的词片段触发。

en.description: Strongly responds mainly to the word-final formations, especially in the medical compound malformations, spanning congenital, brain, and vascular malformations. It also responds to the same-spelling formations substring in German Informationen and biotransformations.

patterns.name: Malformation-related compounds
patterns.context: The term appears in medical contexts, especially congenital, brain, cardiovascular, or vascular malformations; activation concentrates on formations and the compound ending.

patterns.name: formation substring in an information term
patterns.context: The substring occurs in the German word “Informationen”; it does not have a medical malformation meaning.

patterns.name: formation substring in a biotransformation term
patterns.context: The substring occurs in “biotransformations,” referring to chemical/biochemical transformations rather than malformations.

1_1413.description: 主要对单词末尾 formations 强烈响应，尤其是医学复合词 malformations，覆盖先天、脑部及血管畸形；也响应德语 Informationen 和 biotransformations 中同形的 formations 子串。

patterns.name: 畸形相关复合词
patterns.context: 词项出现在医学语境，尤其是先天、脑部、心血管或血管畸形；激活集中在 formations 及复合词末尾。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 信息词中的 formation 子串
patterns.context: 子串出现在德语“Informationen”一词中；并非医学畸形含义。

patterns.name: 生物转化词中的 formation 子串
patterns.context: 子串出现在“biotransformations”中，指化学/生物化学转化，而非畸形。

en.description: Strong activation mainly falls on formations in words split across tokens: English malformations, the chemistry term biotransformations, and German Informationen. English medical passages often discuss congenital or vascular malformations, but the trigger form also occurs across domains.

patterns.name: Morphological boundary in malformations
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the final formations segment of the English word malformations when split across tokens; prefixes and meanings vary.

patterns.name: Word ending in biotransformations
patterns.context: The formations substring in the full word biotransformations activates strongly, with weaker activation on the preceding split portion as well.

patterns.name: Word ending in Informationen
patterns.context: The spelling substring formations occurs in the German compound Informationen; the surrounding text discusses public information and awareness.

1_1413.description: 强激活主要落在跨 token 单词中的 formations：英语 malformations、化学术语 biotransformations，以及德语 Informationen；英语医学段落多谈先天或血管畸形，但触发形式也跨领域出现。

patterns.name: malformations 的形态边界
patterns.context: 激活集中在跨 token 拆分的英语单词 malformations 的末段 formations；前缀和词义各异。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科研项目介绍

patterns.name: biotransformations 的词尾
patterns.context: 完整单词 biotransformations 中的 formations 子串被强烈激活，前面的拆分部分也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: Informationen 的词尾
patterns.context: 德语复合词 Informationen 中出现拼写子串 formations；前后文讨论公共信息与意识。

en.description: Strong activation mainly falls on malformations (often split as mal/formations) and films in movie-related corpora; samples in Kannada and physics texts also occur. Each pattern depends on different terms and local contexts.

patterns.name: Medical term malformations
patterns.context: Malformation-related terminology occurs in medical contexts; it can refer to fetal, congenital, cerebellar, or cerebrovascular malformations.

patterns.name: Film category labels
patterns.context: The term appears in category labels at the end of Wikipedia entries, often alongside Indian films, decades, languages, or genres.

patterns.name: Kannada term
patterns.context: Appears in biographies introducing film producers and their works, as part of the language/film industry name Kannada.

patterns.name: samples in a physics context
patterns.context: Appears in sentences discussing experimental samples or materials that can be used to build devices.

1_1413.description: 强激活主要落在 malformations（常被拆分为 mal/formations）及电影语料中的 films；另有 Kannada 和物理文中的 samples。各模式依赖不同词项与局部语境。

patterns.name: 医学术语 malformations
patterns.context: 医学语境中出现畸形相关术语；可指胎儿、先天性、小脑、脑血管等畸形。

patterns.name: 电影类别标签
patterns.context: 词项位于 Wikipedia 条目末尾的分类标签中，常与印度电影、年代、语言或类型并列。

patterns.name: Kannada 词项
patterns.context: 出现在介绍电影制片人及其作品的传记中，构成语言/电影产业名称 Kannada。

patterns.name: 物理语境中的 samples
patterns.context: 出现在讨论可用于构建设备的实验样品或材料的句子中。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on specific fragments of analyse/analysed and academia; there are also sporadic fragments in medical word endings, code identifiers, names, and abbreviations/numbers, with no unified semantics across contexts.

patterns.name: analyse in academic English
patterns.context: The verb occurs in academic or explanatory text, often followed by a research subject, data, or task; activation concentrates on specific subword fragments, such as «analyse»10 and «analysed»6.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, web descriptions, ArXiv, Wikipedia

patterns.name: Academic term academia
patterns.context: academia is split into academ + ia, with activation on «academ»9; used to describe research or career destinations.

patterns.name: Word fragments in medical phrases
patterns.context: Appears respectively in Urinary tract stone disease and BAL cytology; the contexts are medical terms, but they share no clear complete-word meaning or syntactic function.

patterns.name: aly in code identifiers
patterns.context: A token fragment in code paths/build filenames triggers activation; this does not align with ordinary English semantics.

patterns.name: aly in a name
patterns.context: Appears in the name Dr. Skaly, with activation on part of the surname.

patterns.name: Other in-word fragments
patterns.context: Appears respectively in 96 well, CFAR, and O​​EH abbreviations or numeric expressions; activation is local, with no unified contextual condition.

1_1413.description: 激活主要落在 analyse/analysed 与 academia 的特定词片段；另有医学词尾、代码标识符、人名及缩写/数字中的零散片段，跨语境并无统一语义。

patterns.name: 学术英语中的 analyse
patterns.context: 动词出现在学术或说明性文本中，常接研究对象、数据或任务；激活集中在词内特定子词片段，如 «analyse»10、«analysed»6。

patterns.name: 学术词汇 academia
patterns.context: academia 被切分成 academ + ia，激活在 «academ»9；用于描述研究或职业去向。

patterns.name: 医学短语中的词片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 Urinary tract stone disease 和 BAL cytology 中；上下文为医学术语，但没有明显共同的完整词义或句法功能。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的 aly
patterns.context: 代码路径/构建文件名中的分词片段触发；与普通英语语义不一致。

patterns.name: 人名中的 aly
patterns.context: 出现在人名 Dr. Skaly 中，激活落在姓氏片段。

patterns.name: 其他词内片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 96 well、CFAR、O​​EH 等缩写或数字表达中，局部激活，未见统一上下文条件。

en.description: The strongest activation repeatedly falls on English plural -ors endings, with additional repeated responses to odor-related words. Other weaker activations occur sporadically in course names, fragments within proper nouns, and words in title lists; domains and parts of speech are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Plural genitive endings
patterns.context: Often occurs in English nouns ending in -or/-ors; sometimes the ending is split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: academic abstracts, encyclopedias, code, web content

patterns.name: Odor-related words
patterns.context: Odor terms and their plural forms; both occurrences are in contexts about odors or body odor.

patterns.name: Discipline and course names
patterns.context: Appears in course lists; some discipline terms activate weakly, most notably «Art».

patterns.name: Occasional proper names and endings
patterns.context: Sporadic in-word fragments occur in nationality terms, abstract nouns, medical terms, and football league names; there is no shared context.

patterns.name: Title-like words in headings or lists
patterns.context: Appears in web-style text such as headings, links, or course lists, with inconsistent parts of speech and ending forms.

1_1413.concept: 英语复数 -ors 词尾偏好
1_1413.description: 最强激活反复落在英文复数 -ors 词尾，另对气味相关词有重复响应；其余较弱激活散见于课程名、专名词内片段及标题列表词，领域和词类不统一。

patterns.name: 复数属格词尾
patterns.trigger: 高激活的词尾或词内片段：«ors»10、«ors»9、«ors»10（如 od«ors»、construct«ors»、Scul«pt»«ors»、Err«ors»、tut«ors»、«Spons»«ors»）
patterns.context: 多出现在以 -or/-ors 结尾的英文名词中；有时词尾被分割成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：学术摘要、百科、代码、网页内容

patterns.name: 气味相关词语
patterns.context: 气味词及其复数形式；两处都处在关于气味或体味的语境中。
patterns.domain: 嗅觉研究与生物学摘要

patterns.name: 学科与课程名称
patterns.context: 出现在课程清单中，部分学科词获得弱激活，最明显的是«Art»。

patterns.name: 个别专名及词尾
patterns.context: 零散词内片段，分别出现在国籍词、抽象名词、医学术语和足球联赛名称中；无共同语境。

patterns.name: 标题或列表中的标题式词
patterns.context: 出现在标题、链接或课程列表等网页式文本中，且词类与词尾形态不一致。

en.description: The main pattern is the English word “review” in contexts such as book reviews, peer review, journal reviews, or regulatory review. There are also several characters in Chinese code comments and one fragment within a name, with no clear connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: The word review itself
patterns.context: The complete word “review” appears in English text; it can function as a noun and cover book reviews, peer review, literature reviews, and formal review.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including encyclopedias, reviews, academic publishing, and policy texts

patterns.name: Non-English character sequence (uncertain)
patterns.context: Trigger positions occur respectively in Chinese comments/code text and within a name in an English academic passage; no shared clear meaning or contextual condition is evident.

1_1413.description: 主要模式是英语词“review”在书评、同行评审、期刊综述或法规审查等语境中出现。另有中文代码注释中的若干字符及一处姓名内部片段，难以与主模式建立联系。

patterns.name: review 一词本身
patterns.context: 英语文本中出现完整词“review”；在句中可作名词，涵盖书评、同行评审、综述及正式审查等不同用法。
patterns.domain: 百科、评论、学术出版、政策文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 非英语字符序列（不确定）
patterns.context: 触发位置分别位于中文注释/代码文本和英语学术段落中的姓名内部；未见共同的明确词义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: Github 代码注释；生态学论文

en.description: Primarily responds to references to genera, subgenera, families, orders, and species in biological taxonomy, with genera and taxonomic nouns as prominent triggers. There are also occasional high activations on geographic and disciplinary term endings, proper nouns, and a few isolated words.

patterns.name: Genus-level classification in taxonomy
patterns.context: In biological classification or species-description contexts, discussing genera, subgenera, species, and their classification, identification, or phylogeny; sometimes adjacent to numbers or lists.

patterns.name: Laurales / Lauraceae taxonomy terms
patterns.context: Laurales or Lauraceae appears in plant classification lists, alongside genus names, botanical names, or references.

patterns.name: Genus-name ending in a taxonomy heading
patterns.context: In a list of people or an entry title, the discipline name Geography is marked as split; no clear biological taxonomy context is evident.

patterns.name: Sporadic trigger on genera in a proper name
patterns.context: Club appears in the name Peterborough Handball Club; unrelated to biological taxonomy.

patterns.name: -ography ending in a proper noun
patterns.context: The ending of Astrophotography is marked; unrelated to biological taxonomy.

patterns.name: Other sporadic activations at names or token boundaries
patterns.context: Appears respectively near code comments, biographical introductions, paper introductions, and references; there is insufficient evidence that these words share a stable semantic trigger.

1_1413.description: 主要响应生物分类语境中关于属、亚属、科、目及物种的表述，尤以 genera 及分类名词为显著触发；另有地名学科词尾、专名与少数孤立词的偶发高激活。

patterns.name: 分类学中的属级分类
patterns.context: 生物学分类或物种描述语境，谈及属、亚属、物种及其分类、鉴定或系统发育；有时紧邻数字或列表。
patterns.domain: 分类学、生态学及生物学论文

patterns.name: Laurales / Lauraceae 分类词
patterns.context: 植物分类列表中出现目名 Laurales 或科名 Lauraceae，伴随属名、植物学名称或参考文献。

patterns.name: 分类标题中的属名词尾
patterns.context: 人物列表或条目标题中，学科名称 Geography 被切分标记，未见明显生物分类上下文。

patterns.name: 专名中带有 genera 的偶发触发
patterns.context: Peterborough Handball Club 的名称中出现 Club；与生物分类语境无关。

patterns.name: 专名中的 -ography 词尾
patterns.context: Astrophotography 一词的词尾被标记；与分类学语境无关。

patterns.name: 其他名称或分词边界的偶发激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在代码注释、人物简介、论文引言和参考文献附近；没有足够证据表明这些词共享稳定语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、百科全书、生物医学论文

en.concept: Specific word forms and equals-sign delimiters
en.description: The strongest triggers are equals-sign section dividers and the word anthropology; isolated examples also occur in Sahara and within a biological genus name. Several astronomy papers contain equals-sign dividers, but they do not explain the other marked tokens.

patterns.name: Divider-style section heading
patterns.context: A section heading is underlined with consecutive equals signs, appearing after an Introduction or Related work heading; may also occur alongside a marker on the paper’s first page

patterns.name: Anthropology and academic titles
patterns.context: The word anthropology appears in interdisciplinary research topics or academic titles; capitalization varies, but all contexts are academic text

patterns.name: Sahara proper-name fragment
patterns.context: The triggered fragment is a substring within Little Sahara, not the whole word; context is a place name and recreational area name

patterns.name: In-word fragment in a taxon name
patterns.context: A subword fragment appears in the butterflyfish genus name Parachaetodon; strong activation falls within the name rather than on a general semantic word

1_1413.concept: 特定词形与等号分隔符
1_1413.description: 最强触发集中在等号式小节分隔线，以及 anthropology 一词；另有 Sahara 和生物属名内部片段的孤例。多篇天文学论文虽含等号分隔线，但无法说明其余被标记 token。

patterns.name: 分隔线式小节标题
patterns.context: 以连续等号作为章节标题下划线，出现在 Introduction 或 Related work 标题之后；同时可伴随论文首页标记
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的 Markdown/文本转换格式

patterns.name: 人类学及其学术职衔
patterns.context: 词语 anthropology 出现在跨学科研究主题或学者职衔中；大小写不同，语境均为学术文本

patterns.name: Sahara 专名片段
patterns.context: 触发片段是 Little Sahara 中的词内子串，而不是完整词；上下文为地名及休闲区域名称

patterns.name: 分类群名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 在蝴蝶鱼属名 Parachaetodon 中出现分词片段；强激活落在名称内部而非一般语义词

en.description: Sensitive to paper-structure formatting (especially long equals-sign dividers, section headings, and anchors) and formal research prose. Several passages involve astronomy terminology; it also covers machine-learning paper structure and terminology, physics paper titles, and keyword metadata.

patterns.name: Equals-sign section dividers
patterns.context: Long dividers made of equals signs, often following a section heading or section anchor and appearing between line breaks.

patterns.name: Paper sections and structure markers
patterns.context: Section headings, section references, page markers, or formatting markers before or after headings in papers; sometimes appearing with equals-sign dividers.

patterns.name: Astronomy and astrophysics terminology
patterns.context: Discusses stars, galaxies, observations, spectra, or astrophysical properties; often appears near section-structure markers, but no fixed pairing is required.

patterns.name: Scientific abstracts and research-report prose
patterns.context: Formal paper prose reporting research observations, methods, results, or conclusions.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers (primarily astronomy, also machine learning)

patterns.name: Machine-learning methods and evaluation terminology
patterns.context: Discusses model architectures, datasets, evaluation metrics, or graph neural networks; no clear astronomy topic.

patterns.name: Paper metadata and introduction formatting
patterns.context: Title or introduction area at the beginning of a paper, containing title fields and separators above and below.
patterns.domain: Metadata/opening format of high-energy physics papers

patterns.name: Catalog-style subject terms and classification terms
patterns.context: Subject terms separated by colons, or lists of astronomical classes and research objects before the introduction.
patterns.domain: Keyword or classification metadata in astronomy papers

1_1413.description: 对论文结构格式（尤以长等号分隔线、章节标题和锚点为突出线索）及正式研究叙述敏感。多段涉及天文学术语；也覆盖机器学习论文结构和术语、物理论文题名及关键词元数据。

patterns.name: 等号分隔的章节标题
patterns.context: 等号组成的长分隔线，常紧随章节标题或章节锚点，并位于换行之间。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文的 Markdown/网页转储格式

patterns.name: 论文章节与结构标记
patterns.context: 论文中的章节标题、章节引用、页面标记或标题前后的格式标记；有时与等号分隔线一起出现。

patterns.name: 天文学与天体物理术语
patterns.context: 讨论恒星、星系、观测、光谱或天体物理性质；多出现在章节结构标记附近，但不要求固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 天文学与天体物理研究论文

patterns.name: 科学论文摘要与研究报告表达
patterns.context: 报告研究观测、方法、结果或结论的正式论文叙述。
patterns.domain: 科学论文（天文学为主，也包含机器学习）

patterns.name: 机器学习方法与评估术语
patterns.context: 讨论模型架构、数据集、评价指标或图神经网络；没有明显天文学主题。

patterns.name: 论文元数据与引言格式
patterns.context: 论文开头的题名或引言区域，包含标题字段及上下分隔符。
patterns.domain: 高能物理论文的元数据/开篇格式

patterns.name: 目录式主题词与分类词
patterns.trigger: 「galaxies: high-redshift, galaxies: luminosity function」「stars: abundances」「Population II」
patterns.context: 以冒号分隔学科主题词，或在引言前列出天体类别和研究对象。
patterns.domain: 天文学论文的关键词或分类元数据

en.description: The strongest and most recurring pattern is the spectroscopic/spectroscopy stem, appearing in both biomedical and astronomy literature; a few astronomy terms and section-divider equals signs also activate. The spectroscopy-stem activation is prominent in passage 5, but its context is truncated; passage 10 also has local activations that do not fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: Spectroscopic spelling and forms
patterns.context: Activation on the spectroscopy stem in forms such as Spectroscopic, spectroscopic, and spectroscopy; the stem may be split across tokens.
patterns.domain: Abstracts, academic paper text, and section headings; including biochemistry and astronomy

patterns.name: NIR spectroscopy-template terminology
patterns.context: Context of near-infrared observations, bands, and templates of galaxy stellar populations; besides the spectroscopy stem, band in HK-band is also marked.

patterns.name: Narrowband imaging terminology
patterns.context: band in narrowband imaging terminology is marked when discussing high-redshift star formation and observational techniques.

patterns.name: Starburst-related terminology
patterns.context: When discussing other starburst events, starbursts is split into tokens and activates.

patterns.name: Strongly activated format marker
patterns.context: Consecutive equals signs used as a section divider in a paper; appearing after an observational data section heading.

1_1413.concept: 谱学词干及论文格式标记
1_1413.description: 最强且反复的模式是 spectroscopic/spectroscopy 词干，在生物医学和天文学文献中均出现；另有少量天文术语及章节分隔等号激活。第5段谱学词干激活明显，但所在上下文截断；第10段另有无法归入主模式的局部激活。

patterns.name: spectroscopic 拼写与词形
patterns.context: 对大小写形式 Spectroscopic、spectroscopic 及 spectroscopy 等词形中的谱学词干激活；词干可能跨 token 拆分。
patterns.domain: 摘要、学术论文正文和章节标题；覆盖生物化学与天文学等领域

patterns.name: NIR 光谱模板术语
patterns.context: 近红外观测、波段及星系恒星族群模板的语境；除谱学词干外，HK-band 中的 band 也被标记。

patterns.name: 窄带成像术语
patterns.context: 讨论高红移恒星形成及观测技术时，窄带成像术语中的 band 被标记。

patterns.name: 星爆相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论其他星爆事件时，starbursts 一词被分词拆开并激活。

patterns.name: 强激活格式标记
patterns.context: 论文中作为章节标题分隔线的连续等号；出现在观测数据章节标题之后。

en.description: Primarily responds to the word spectroscopic, especially in paper titles, abstracts, or observational contexts; there is also activation on the endings of sculptors, Architectures, and engineers, and within the word Geographic.

patterns.name: Spectroscopy terminology
patterns.context: spectroscopic paired with academic words such as studies, study, or interaction; mainly in paper titles or abstracts, also in body text discussing astronomical observations.

patterns.name: Sculptor word forms
patterns.context: sculptor(s) appears in biographies or artist profiles; activation falls on the ending ors.

patterns.name: Geographic information system terminology
patterns.context: Explains the geographic feature numbers indicated by parenthesized numerals in a lake inventory; activation is concentrated within Geographic.

patterns.name: Architectures of Control proper name
patterns.context: A HackerNews post mentions a blog called Architectures of Control; activation falls on the ending of architectures.

patterns.name: Engineer suffix
patterns.context: An institutional profile lists scientists, engineers, and clinicians; activation falls on the ending of engineers.

1_1413.description: 主要响应 spectroscopic（光谱学）一词，尤其在论文标题、摘要或观测语境中；另对 sculptors、Architectures、engineers 等词的词尾，以及 Geographic 一词内部有激活。

patterns.name: 光谱学术语
patterns.context: spectroscopic 与 studies、study 或 interaction 等学术词搭配；以论文标题或摘要为主，也见于讨论天文观测的正文。
patterns.domain: 天文学、化学、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 雕塑家词形
patterns.context: sculptor(s) 出现在人物生平或艺术家介绍中，激活落在词尾 ors。

patterns.name: 地名信息系统术语
patterns.context: 解释湖泊清单中括号内数字所指的地理要素编号；激活集中在 Geographic 的词内部分。

patterns.name: Architectures of Control 专名
patterns.context: HackerNews 帖子提及名为 Architectures of Control 的博客，激活落在 architectures 的词尾。

patterns.name: 工程师词尾
patterns.context: 机构介绍中并列列举科学家、工程师和临床医生；激活落在 engineers 的词尾。

en.concept: Word endings er/ers and local lexical features
en.description: The most stable pattern is the -er ending across tokens in engineer-related words, generalizing to endings in astronomers, Architectures, and other words; there are also a few independent responses to reviews, best, and the Picasa subword.

patterns.name: Nominal ending -er
patterns.context: Words appear in forms such as engineer/engineered; activation is concentrated on the ending er across token boundaries, with varying roots.

patterns.name: Nominal ending -ers
patterns.context: The -ers ending in plural occupational or identity nouns.

patterns.name: Ending -ures
patterns.context: The ending -ures occurs in plural nouns; engineering semantics are not required.

patterns.name: Book-review publication name
patterns.context: reviews/review appears in the name of a publication or book-review column, surrounded by lists of media and periodicals.

patterns.name: best in school rankings
patterns.context: In a business-school ranking sentence, best modifies business schools.

patterns.name: Noun stem Picasa
patterns.context: The proper noun Picasa is split into tokens; appears in a discussion about whether software is closed source.

1_1413.concept: 词尾 er/ers 及局部词汇特征
1_1413.description: 最稳定的模式是工程师及相关词语中跨 token 的 -er 词尾，也泛化到 astronomers、Architectures 等词尾；另有少数对 reviews、best、Picasa 子词的独立响应。

patterns.name: 名词性词尾 -er
patterns.context: 词语以 engineer/engineered 等形式出现；激活集中在跨 token 边界的词尾 er，词根可不同。

patterns.name: 名词性词尾 -ers
patterns.context: 复数职业或身份名词中的 -ers 词尾。

patterns.name: 词尾 -ures
patterns.context: 词尾 -ures 出现在复数名词中；不要求工程师语义。

patterns.name: 书评出版物名称
patterns.context: reviews/review 出现在出版物或书评栏目名称中，周围列举媒体、刊物。

patterns.name: 学校排名中的 best
patterns.context: 商业学校排名句中，best 修饰 business schools。

patterns.name: 名词词干 Picasa
patterns.context: 专有名词 Picasa 被拆分为 token；出现在软件是否闭源的讨论中。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the final s of English plural nouns, especially in sculptors, Architects, climbers, and shoreline; there are also weak responses to line breaks and fragments within proper names, plus a single response to a code-variable suffix. Two other passages have no clear match.

patterns.name: English plural ending s
patterns.context: Activation falls on the final s or an adjacent letter, especially in plural nouns; also occurs on s within proper names or compounds.

patterns.name: Line breaks and formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Weak activation at line breaks between paragraphs, list items, or headings; often occurs in the same passage as final-s activation.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries and other formatted text

patterns.name: Uppercase suffix in code identifier
patterns.context: In an uppercase, underscore-separated build-variable identifier, AN activates strongly, while FILES activates more weakly.

patterns.name: Local spelling in proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on an in-word fragment of a name or proper noun; strength varies and may be adjacent to or overlap with the final-s pattern.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia texts about people, institutions, and places

1_1413.concept: 英文词尾 s（尤指复数）
1_1413.description: 主要对英文复数名词词尾 s 有强响应，尤其 sculptors、Architects、climbers、shoreline；另有弱换行、专名内片段响应，及单例代码变量后缀响应。另两段未见清楚对应。

patterns.name: 英文复数词尾 s
patterns.context: 激活落在词尾 s 或紧邻词尾的字母上，尤其是名词复数；也见于专名或复合词内部的 s。

patterns.name: 换行及格式边界
patterns.context: 段落、条目或标题之间的换行处有弱激活；常与词尾 s 激活同段出现。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目及其他带格式文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的大写后缀
patterns.context: 大写、下划线分隔的构建变量标识符中，AN 强激活，FILES 也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 专名中的局部拼写
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名或专名的词内片段；强度不一，可能与词尾 s 模式相邻或重叠。
patterns.domain: 百科人物、机构及地名文本

en.description: Most passages activate on the ors ending of English plural nouns, especially role terms such as sculptors, contractors, directors, and operators; there are also local activations in the code identifier DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR and a Chinese authentication sentence.

patterns.name: English plural suffix ors
patterns.context: Occurs in plural English nouns, especially occupational, personnel, or role names; trigger roots vary and no specific syntactic position is required
patterns.domain: General English, encyclopedia, administrative, legal, technical, and code text

patterns.name: Python-style directory constant split
patterns.context: In PHP code, the DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR identifier is split into multiple subword fragments; activation is concentrated on DIRECTORY and subsequent fragments

patterns.name: Chinese authentication and token sentence
patterns.context: Chinese technical documentation describes using a token to access a URL requiring authentication; activation is concentrated on the second character of “鉴权”

1_1413.description: 多数段落在英文复数名词的 ors 词尾激活，尤其是雕塑家、承包商、董事、经营者等人员称谓；另有代码标识符 DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR 及中文鉴权语句中的局部激活。

patterns.name: 英文复数后缀 ors
patterns.trigger: 子串「ors」，尤见于 «sculpt»…«ors»、「subcontract»…«ors»」及「direct»…«ors»」；激活主要落在复数词尾
patterns.context: 处于英文名词复数形式中，尤其是职业、人员或角色名称；触发词根各异，不要求特定句法位置
patterns.domain: 一般英文、百科、行政、法律、技术及代码文本

patterns.name: Python 风格目录常量拆分
patterns.context: PHP 代码中，DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR 标识符被分成多个子词片段；激活集中于 DIRECTORY 及其后续片段
patterns.domain: Github 中的 PHP 代码

patterns.name: 中文鉴权与令牌语句
patterns.trigger: 「令牌」「访问」「鉴权」「网址」附近的片段，包括 «访»3 与 «权»9
patterns.context: 中文技术说明描述使用令牌访问需鉴权的网址；激活集中在“鉴权”后半字

en.description: The strongest and most repeated trigger is the -ors ending in subcontractors, occurring in institutional, construction, and legal contexts; other activations are scattered endings or terms involving governance, geography, coastal mapping, software, data trajectories, and anthropology, with no shared semantic cue.

patterns.name: Ending of subcontractors
patterns.context: The marked fragment is the -ors ending of subcontractors; the word occurs in contexts involving volunteer/staff management, institutional partnerships, construction labor, and legal liability.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, research-funding descriptions, patent background, legal text

patterns.name: Organizational governance and staffing
patterns.context: Governance or staffing of institutional boards, employee teams, and volunteer groups; appears alongside subcontractors in the same passage.

patterns.name: Institutional collaboration and management
patterns.context: Describes project leads managing a project through their institutions and interacting with NIH, US institutions, and subcontractors; the main activation still falls on the ending of subcontractors.

patterns.name: Construction employment and work hours
patterns.context: In construction contracts, records of hours worked by temporary or non-permanent employees, personnel movement, and work across multiple sites.

patterns.name: Damages and contractual liability
patterns.context: Discusses damages caused by other subcontractors, or liability for damages borne by subcontractors and their agents or employees.

patterns.name: Island and geographic names
patterns.context: Introduces Adams Island, the Auckland Islands, and their geographic locations; no clear connection to the subcontractor topic.

patterns.name: Coastal mapping terminology
patterns.context: Discusses satellite imagery, research areas, and comparison of coastal mapping methods; no clear connection to the other passages.

patterns.name: Software components and designers
patterns.context: Programming Q&A context involving VCL styles, components, StyleHook, and designers; no clear connection to the other passages.

patterns.name: Data-trajectory centerlines
patterns.context: Describes centerlines of phase-quadrature burst pairs and their relative spacing in data trajectories; no clear connection to the subcontractor topic.

patterns.name: Archipelago and cultural background
patterns.context: Introduces the cultural background of Tanna in Vanuatu and its archipelagic location, in a discussion of ideas about disease, death, and human origins.

1_1413.description: 最强、最重复的触发是 subcontractors 的词尾 -ors，见机构、施工和法律语境；另有若干彼此分散的词尾或术语激活，涉及治理、地理、海岸线制图、软件、数据轨道及人类学，缺少共同语义线索。

patterns.name: subcontractors 词尾
patterns.context: 标记集中在 subcontractors 的词尾 -ors；该词出现在志愿者/工作人员管理、机构合作、施工用工及法律责任等上下文。
patterns.domain: 百科、科研资助说明、专利背景、法律文本

patterns.name: 组织治理与人员配置
patterns.context: 围绕机构董事会、员工团队和志愿者队伍的治理或配置；与同段 subcontractors 一起出现。

patterns.name: 机构合作与管理
patterns.context: 描述项目负责人依托所属机构管理项目，并与 NIH、美国机构及分包商互动；主激活仍落在 subcontractors 的词尾。

patterns.name: 施工雇佣与工时
patterns.context: 施工合同中临时或非固定雇员的工时记录、人员流动和多工地工作。
patterns.domain: 专利背景/商业法律说明

patterns.name: 损害与合同责任
patterns.context: 讨论由其他分包商造成的损害，或分包商及其代理人、雇员对损害承担责任。

patterns.name: 岛屿与地理名称
patterns.context: 介绍 Adams Island、奥克兰群岛及其地理位置；与分包商主题无明显联系。

patterns.name: 海岸线制图术语
patterns.context: 讨论卫星影像、研究区域及海岸线制图方法比较；与其他段主题无明显联系。

patterns.name: 软件组件与设计器
patterns.context: VCL 样式、组件 StyleHook 及设计器的编程问答语境；与其他段主题无明显联系。

patterns.name: 数据轨道中心线
patterns.context: 描述相位正交的突发对中心线及其相对数据轨道间距；与分包商主题无明显联系。

patterns.name: 群岛与文化背景
patterns.context: 介绍瓦努阿图 Tanna 的文化背景与群岛地理位置，用于讨论疾病、死亡和人类起源等思想领域。

en.description: The strongest shared pattern is the ors ending of subcontractors, appearing in five passages about institutions, projects, and legal contexts. Other highlights are scattered across the endings of Designer, archipelago, Eulerian, and Companion, as well as the mathematical symbol Gamma, with no unified semantic or contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Plural ending of subcontractors
patterns.context: The trigger is the final plural suffix ors in subcontractors; occurs in contexts involving organizational staffing, project management, employment, and liability provisions
patterns.domain: Institutional profiles, grant applications, labor regulations, legal contracts

patterns.name: Endings of other split words
patterns.context: Highlights fall on suffixes or final segments within words, not a unified semantic category; each occurs in a different word and context
patterns.domain: Advertising, geographic encyclopedia entries, environmental science, fiction

patterns.name: Gamma in mathematical notation
patterns.context: Refers to the Euler Gamma function in a formula; the same passage also contains the Psi symbol, which is not marked

1_1413.description: 最强共同模式是 subcontractors 的词尾 ors，见于五段机构、项目及法律语境。其余高亮分散在 Designer、archipelago、Eulerian、Companion 的词尾，以及数学符号 Gamma，未见统一语义或上下文模式。

patterns.name: subcontractors 复数词尾
patterns.context: 触发位置是单词 subcontractors 的末尾复数后缀 ors；出现在组织人员构成、项目管理、雇佣和责任条款等语境中
patterns.domain: 机构介绍、项目申请、劳动法规、法律合同

patterns.name: 其他被切分词的词尾
patterns.trigger: “«er»8”于 Designer、“«ago»8”于 archipelago、“«ian»8”于 Eulerian、“«ion»7”于 Companion
patterns.context: 高亮落在词内部的后缀或末段，并非统一的语义类别；各自处于不同词和上下文中
patterns.domain: 广告、地理百科、环境科学、小说

patterns.name: 数学符号中的 Gamma
patterns.context: 在公式中指欧拉 Gamma 函数；同段也有 Psi 符号，但未标记

en.description: The main pattern is the -ors ending of “subcontractors,” occurring in institutional, contract, employment, and legal texts; there are also local activations in the PHP directory identifier DIRECTORY, template-constant fragments, and scattered endings, punctuation, and marketing-word fragments, which are difficult to group into one semantic feature.

patterns.name: subcontractors word form
patterns.context: The -ors ending of “subcontractors” is highlighted; preceding text discusses institutional staff, contracts, work duties, or legal liability.
patterns.domain: Institutional governance, project management, construction employment, and legal texts

patterns.name: DIRECTORY identifier
patterns.context: The DIRECTORY identifier in code appears in expressions related to PHP constants, directory paths, or directory separators; activation falls on an in-word fragment.

patterns.name: General word form directory
patterns.context: “DIRECTORY” appears in a title-style directory name, not a code path.
patterns.domain: Website promotional copy or directory headings

patterns.name: -ary ending
patterns.context: Activation falls respectively on the word-final fragments -ARY and -ian; the two examples occur in different contexts, with no stable shared contextual condition.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in template constants
patterns.context: PHP code involving template-directory constants and directory separators; activation lies within substrings of identifiers.

patterns.name: Scattered punctuation and formatting markers
patterns.context: These markers occur sporadically across passages, with no consistent semantic or contextual trigger; they may be secondary activations or tokenization-boundary effects.
patterns.domain: Various prose, code, and formatted text

patterns.name: Phrase fragments in marketing copy
patterns.context: Appears in a product-promotion email, with activation distributed across fragments in the marketing subject line and product description.

1_1413.concept: 词内后缀与标识符片段
1_1413.description: 主模式是“subcontractors”词尾 -ors，见于机构、合同、用工及法律文本；另有 PHP 目录标识符 DIRECTORY、模板常量片段，以及零散词尾、标点和营销词片段，难以归为同一语义特征。

patterns.name: subcontractors 词形
patterns.context: “subcontractors”一词的词尾 -ors 被突出；前文谈及机构人员、合同、工作责任或法律责任。
patterns.domain: 机构治理、项目管理、建筑用工与法律文本

patterns.name: DIRECTORY 标识符
patterns.context: 代码中的 DIRECTORY 标识符，出现在 PHP 常量、目录路径或目录分隔符相关表达中；激活落在词内片段。

patterns.name: directory 一般词形
patterns.context: “DIRECTORY”出现在标题式目录名称中，而非代码路径中。
patterns.domain: 网站宣传文案或目录标题

patterns.name: -ary 词尾
patterns.context: 激活分别落在词尾片段 -ARY 和 -ian；两例语境不同，未见稳定的共同上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 活动宣传文案；科学论文

patterns.name: 模板常量词内片段
patterns.context: PHP 代码中模板目录常量及目录分隔符名称；激活位于标识符内部的子串。

patterns.name: 零散标点与格式标记
patterns.trigger: « at»、« a»、« staff»、« with»、« interactions»、« work»、« there»、« over»、« for»、« at»、« ,»、« time»、« Show»、«case»、« <?»、«_»、« .»、« '»、«↵»
patterns.context: 这些标记在各段零散出现，缺少一致的语义或上下文触发条件；可能是次要激活或分词边界现象。
patterns.domain: 多种散文、代码及排版文本

patterns.name: 营销宣传中的词组片段
patterns.context: 出现在产品宣传邮件中，激活分布于营销标题和产品描述中的词片段。

en.concept: English word forms and subword fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to rallied (rebound, catch up, or recover) and selective forms, with isolated activation on fragments in Julie and Minority Communities; the latter two have unclear relations to the main pattern.

patterns.name: rallied forms
patterns.context: The stem rall followed by -ied, appearing in contexts of stock rebounds, teams catching up from a deficit, or someone recovering their composure.

patterns.name: selective-related forms
patterns.context: Selective or selective in compounds; concerns selectivity, non-selectivity, or selective treatment of a specific target.
patterns.domain: School descriptions, materials science, pharmacology, molecular biology

patterns.name: The name Julie
patterns.context: Greeting the recipient Julie at the start of an email; activation is concentrated on the name’s final ie.

patterns.name: The phrase minority communities
patterns.context: Minority Communities in the name of an HIV prevention research project.

1_1608.description: 主要响应 rallied（反弹、追赶或振作）及 selective 词形，另对 Julie 和 Minority Communities 中的片段有孤立激活；后两者与主模式的关系不明。

patterns.name: rallied 词形
patterns.context: 词干 rall 后接 -ied，出现在股票反弹、球队从落后局面追赶、或某人重新振作等语境。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育报道、邮件叙述

patterns.name: selective 相关词形
patterns.context: selective 或复合词中的 selective；涉及选择性、非选择性或特定对象的选择性处理。
patterns.domain: 学校介绍、材料科学、药理学、分子生物学

patterns.name: 姓名 Julie
patterns.context: 邮件开头对收件人 Julie 的称呼，激活集中在姓名末尾 ie。

patterns.name: minority communities 短语
patterns.context: HIV prevention research 项目名称中的 Minority Communities。

en.description: The most stable triggers are intra-word rall (always in rallied) and words related to selective; there is also activation on fragments within several proper names, company names, personal names, and Latvian words. Sporadic vocabulary is difficult to explain as a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Morphological fragment of rally within a word
patterns.context: The intra-word substring rall followed by -ied; used to describe stock-market gains, teams overcoming a deficit, and people responding or bouncing back.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in words related to selectivity
patterns.context: Appears in selective or its compounds, including non-selective; concerns school admissions characteristics and growth or pharmacological selectivity.

patterns.name: Token-like fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within proper names or names, rather than on complete word boundaries.

patterns.name: Cisco string fragment
patterns.context: The company name Cisco is split into C and isco; the same passage also mentions its stock rising, but activation is not on rally.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in the name Julie
patterns.context: The personal name Julie has split, intra-word activation; the context is a brief email opening.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Latvian
patterns.context: Appears within word forms in Latvian text; activation is distributed across multiple intra-word fragments and is difficult to explain with a single word meaning.

patterns.name: Other sporadic vocabulary activations
patterns.context: Isolated occurrences in political, materials-science, and other texts, with no common trigger condition confirmed by the available samples.

1_1608.description: 最稳定的触发是词内 rall（均为 rallied）和 selective 相关词；另有若干专名、公司名、人名及拉脱维亚语词内片段激活，零散词汇难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 词内 rally 的形态片段
patterns.context: 词内子串 rall 后接 -ied；分别用于描述股市上涨、球队扳回劣势，以及人物回应或反弹。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育叙事、对话/评论

patterns.name: 选择性相关词的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 selective 或其复合词中，包括 non-selective；涉及学校招生属性及生长/药理选择性。
patterns.domain: 百科、材料科学、生物医学

patterns.name: 专名内的分词式片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或名称的内部子词片段，而非完整词边界。
patterns.domain: 百科、体育、生物医学项目名称

patterns.name: Cisco 字符串片段
patterns.context: 公司名 Cisco 被拆成 C 与 isco 两段；同段还提及其股票上涨，但激活并未标在 rally 上。

patterns.name: Julie 名字内部片段
patterns.context: 人名 Julie 在词内拆分激活；上下文是简短邮件开头。

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在拉脱维亚语文本的词形内部；激活分布于多个词内片段，难以由单一词义说明。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本/拉脱维亚语

patterns.name: 其他零散词汇激活
patterns.context: 孤立分布于政治、材料科学等文本中，未形成可由现有样本确认的共同触发条件。

en.concept: Detection of specific stems and subword fragments
en.description: Strongly responds primarily to the rall fragment in rallied and intra-word fragments in selective; there is also sporadic activation on split fragments in Param, Minority, Wolverhampton, vapour, and code identifiers.

patterns.name: Stem fragment in rallied
patterns.context: The English past-tense verb rallied is split into rall + ied, with activation concentrated on the stem fragment rall; occurs in contexts including stock prices, team comebacks, and people responding.

patterns.name: Stem fragment in selective
patterns.context: Forms such as selective, non-selective, area-selective, and pathway-selective; strong activation on an internal word fragment in selective.
patterns.domain: School descriptions, materials-science papers, pharmacological research

patterns.name: ParamServiceReference type name
patterns.context: The compound code identifier ParamServiceReference and a subsequent type conversion error; activation is concentrated on the Param fragment.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragment in Minority
patterns.context: In the proper-name phrase Minority Communities, the word is split into Min and ority; activation is concentrated on the latter fragment, ority.

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments in Wolverhampton
patterns.context: The UK place and school name Wolverhampton is tokenized into multiple fragments, with activation on parts such as olver and ham.

patterns.name: Fragment in the compound term vapour-liquid-solid
patterns.context: In the materials-growth term vapour-liquid-solid, the initial fragment of vapour and the hyphen are activated.

patterns.name: ParametricPlot in plotting code
patterns.context: Activation on the Param fragment of the Mathematica-style function name ParametricPlot; the same passage also contains plotting parameters and label code.

patterns.name: Other rare intra-word fragments
patterns.context: A few proper names, brands, or all-caps error messages are split into multiple subword fragments; no clear shared semantics with the main stem pattern.

1_1608.concept: 特定词干与子词片段探测
1_1608.description: 主要对 rallied 中的 rall 片段及 selective 的词内片段强烈响应；另对 Param、Minority、Wolverhampton、vapour 等被拆分的词片段和代码标识符有零散激活。

patterns.name: rallied 的词干片段
patterns.context: 英文过去式动词 rallied 被切分成 rall + ied，激活集中在词干片段 rall；见于股价、球队逆转和人物回应等不同语境。

patterns.name: selective 的词干片段
patterns.context: 出现 selective、non-selective、area-selective 或 pathway-selective 等形式；对 selective 的内部词片段有明显激活。
patterns.domain: 学校介绍、材料科学论文、药理研究

patterns.name: ParamServiceReference 类型名
patterns.context: 代码中的复合标识符 ParamServiceReference 及其后续类型转换错误；激活集中于 Param 词片段。

patterns.name: Minority 的词内片段
patterns.context: 专名短语 Minority Communities 中，词被切分为 Min 与 ority；激活集中于后半片段 ority。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目名称、公共卫生

patterns.name: Wolverhampton 的词内片段
patterns.context: 英国地名及学校名称 Wolverhampton 被分词为多个片段，激活涉及 olver、ham 等部分。

patterns.name: vapour-liquid-solid 复合术语片段
patterns.context: 材料生长术语 vapour-liquid-solid 中，vapour 的起始片段及连字符有激活。

patterns.name: 绘图代码中的 ParametricPlot
patterns.context: Mathematica 风格代码中 ParametricPlot 函数名的 Param 片段激活；同段还有图形参数与标签代码。

patterns.name: 其他稀有词内切分片段
patterns.context: 少数专名、品牌或全大写错误提示被拆分为多个子词片段；与主要词干模式没有明确共同语义。

en.description: The strongest and most repeated trigger is tokenized rallied (4 segments); there is also strong activation on fragments in portfolio, code identifiers Param/Parametric, and the patent term foaming. The triggers span multiple domains and show no unified semantic or stylistic condition.

patterns.name: rallied form
patterns.context: In English, the stem of rallied is split into the two tokens rall and ied; it can occur in sentences describing a rebound, recovery, or resumption of action.
patterns.domain: News, sports reporting, and general narrative

patterns.name: Other forms containing rall
patterns.context: The same tokenized stem occurs in non-obvious semantic collocations, such as “rallied” in response to criticism; no other rall forms are observed.

patterns.name: portfolio substring
patterns.context: The complete word portfolio, referring either to a collection of work or an investment portfolio; contexts include a webpage-link question and a discussion of financial assets.

patterns.name: Param substring in code
patterns.context: Param/Parametric in code identifiers, including uses for parameter types, service references, or encoding parameters.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments in foaming
patterns.context: In patent technical text, foaming is split into fo and aming, describing a foam-filled space in a door-frame construction.

1_1608.description: 最强且重复的触发是分词后的 rallied（4段）；另对 portfolio、代码标识符 Param/Parametric 及专利词 foaming 的片段有强激活。触发词跨多个领域，未显示统一语义或文体条件。

patterns.name: rallied 词形
patterns.context: 英语中 rallied 的词干被分成 rall 与 ied 两个 token；可出现在句中描述反弹、恢复或重新行动。
patterns.domain: 新闻、体育报道及一般叙述

patterns.name: 含 rall 的其他词形
patterns.context: 同一分词形式的词干出现在非显然的语义搭配中，如“rallied”回应质疑；未见其他 rall 词形。

patterns.name: portfolio 子串
patterns.context: 完整单词 portfolio，分别指作品集或投资组合；上下文分别为网页链接问题和金融资产讨论。

patterns.name: 代码中的 Param 子串
patterns.context: 代码标识符中的 Param/Parametric，包含参数类型、服务引用或编码参数等用法。

patterns.name: foaming 拼写片段
patterns.context: 专利技术文本中，foaming 被拆成 fo 与 aming，描述门框构造中的发泡填充空间。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on “portfolio” (collection of work or investment portfolio), “rallied” (rebounded or recovered), and a few investment terms; there is also sporadic activation in a passage about ACA politics that is difficult to unify with the main pattern.

patterns.name: The word portfolio
patterns.context: The word itself appears in contexts involving a collection of work or an investment portfolio; it triggers both in the compound “portfolio-style” and in financial contexts.
patterns.domain: Web Q&A, academic abstracts, financial and business texts

patterns.name: rallied and its forms
patterns.context: Describes a rise, rebound, or recovery; the subjects include global stock markets, teams, people, or stocks.
patterns.domain: Economic news, sports encyclopedia, personal narratives

patterns.name: Investment-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Mentions investment in financial or economic contexts; may occur near infrastructure, portfolios, or risk and return.
patterns.domain: Economic news, corporate email, personal finance Q&A

patterns.name: ACA political passage
patterns.context: A sentence about Rand Paul opposing the Affordable Care Act and “Obamacare Lite”; several common words in it appear only in this passage.

1_1608.description: 激活集中于“portfolio”（作品集或投资组合）、“rallied”（反弹或振作）及少量投资词；另有一段 ACA 政治语句中的零散激活，难与主模式统一。

patterns.name: portfolio 一词
patterns.context: 词本身出现在作品集、投资组合等语境；无论是复合词“portfolio-style”还是金融语境均触发。
patterns.domain: 网页问答、学术摘要、金融与商业文本

patterns.name: rallied 及其词形
patterns.context: 描述回升、反弹或重新振作；主语分别是全球股市、球队、人物或股票。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、体育百科、个人叙述

patterns.name: 投资相关词汇
patterns.context: 金融或经济语境中提及投资；可与基础设施、投资组合或风险收益相邻。
patterns.domain: 经济新闻、企业邮件、个人理财问答

patterns.name: ACA 政治语段
patterns.context: 关于兰德·保罗反对《平价医疗法案》及“Obamacare Lite”的句子；其中多个常见词仅在此段出现。

en.description: Activation is most prominent on portfolio and the stem rall (often in rallied), but the latter spans financial, sports, and everyday contexts. There are also intra-word fragments in medical terms, academic abstract formatting, and sporadic words, which are difficult to explain with a single semantic account.

patterns.name: portfolio
patterns.context: Mentions investment portfolios, particularly portfolio diversification or bond portfolios; in passage 1 it also appears in a collection-of-work context in a webpage-link question.

patterns.name: rallied and its forms
patterns.context: The stem rall followed by an ending triggers in descriptions of stocks/markets rising, teams overcoming a deficit, or someone regaining composure; semantics and domains vary.
patterns.domain: Financial news, sports reporting, personal narratives

patterns.name: Fragments in medical vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical terms or their intra-word fragments are marked after splitting; a strong marker falls on an intra-word fragment in “masquerading,” while other examples activate more weakly.

patterns.name: Abstract formatting and mathematical terms
patterns.context: The opening format of an ArXiv abstract and technical statements in abstracts; strong activation is concentrated on portfolio, while format markers themselves are weaker.

patterns.name: Other sporadic words and local markers
patterns.context: Distributed across different syntactic positions and contexts, with no common semantics or stable context; some are common function words or split words.

1_1608.concept: 不一致的词汇与子词特征
1_1608.description: 激活以 portfolio 及词干 rall（常见于 rallied）最突出，但后者跨金融、体育和日常语境。另有医学词内片段、学术摘要格式及零散词语，难以由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: portfolio
patterns.context: 提到投资组合，特别是组合多元化或债券组合；第1段也出现在网页链接问题中的作品集语境。
patterns.domain: 金融、投资及网页/设计问答

patterns.name: rallied 及其词形
patterns.context: 词干 rall 后接词尾，在描述股票/市场上涨、球队扳回劣势或某人恢复镇定时触发；语义和领域并不一致。
patterns.domain: 金融新闻、体育报道、个人叙述

patterns.name: 医学词汇中的片段
patterns.context: 医学术语或其词内片段被拆分标记；较强标记落在“masquerading”的词内片段，其他例子激活较弱。

patterns.name: 摘要格式及数学术语
patterns.context: ArXiv 摘要开头格式，以及摘要中的技术表述；强激活集中在 portfolio 一词，格式标记本身较弱。
patterns.domain: 学术论文摘要（物理、金融）

patterns.name: 其他零散词语与局部标记
patterns.trigger: «Q»、« a»、« specific»、« benefits»、« upset»、« Obamacare»、« investments»、« important»、« profess»
patterns.context: 分布于不同句法位置和语境，未见共同语义或稳定上下文；其中部分是常见功能词或被拆分的词。

en.description: Activation falls mainly on administration (drug administration or application) and its collocations with dosage and experimental conditions in biomedical texts, as well as mild modifying injuries or diseases (mild or mild-to-moderate); it also responds to administration in the project/system management sense and more weakly to medical research terminology.

patterns.name: administration and its collocations
patterns.context: In research or experimental descriptions, refers to administering or applying drugs, ethanol, stimuli, etc., and often appears with dosage, timing, and experimental conditions.

patterns.name: Mild trauma and mild-to-moderate injuries
patterns.context: The severity modifier mild, often adjacent to traumatic, injury, TBI, disorder, or insult; sometimes extended to mild-to-moderate.
patterns.domain: Clinical medicine, biomedical abstracts and research plans

patterns.name: Administrative usage
patterns.context: Administration means management of a project, contract, or system, rather than drug administration; occurs in project planning or personal system-management contexts.

patterns.name: Other medical experimental descriptions
patterns.context: Neuroimaging research mentions brain-region activation, or tissue-engineering/muscle research discusses regenerative capacity; neither has the above administration or mild-injury collocation.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central neuroscience papers; PubMed biomedical abstracts

1_1608.description: 激活主要落在生物医学文本中的 administration（给药或施用）及其剂量、实验条件搭配，以及 mild（轻度/轻中度）修饰损伤或疾病；另能响应项目/系统管理义的 administration，并较弱涉及医学研究术语。

patterns.name: administration及其搭配
patterns.context: 在研究或实验描述中，指药物、乙醇、刺激物等的给药或施用，并常连着剂量、时间、实验条件。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、实验研究计划

patterns.name: 轻度创伤及轻中度损伤
patterns.trigger: «mild»10 traumatic brain injury；«mild»9-«moderate» cannabis use disorder；«mild»-«moderate» TBI；«mild» physical or chemical insult
patterns.context: 严重程度修饰语 mild，常与 traumatic、injury、TBI、disorder 或 insult 相邻；有时扩展为 mild-to-moderate。
patterns.domain: 临床医学、生物医学摘要与研究计划

patterns.name: 行政管理用法
patterns.context: administration 指项目、合同或系统管理，而非药物施用；出现在项目安排或个人系统管理的语境中。
patterns.domain: 项目管理说明、HackerNews 技术讨论

patterns.name: 其他医学实验描述词
patterns.context: 神经影像研究提及脑区激活，或组织工程/肌肉研究谈再生能力；未见上述 administration 或 mild 损伤搭配。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 神经科学论文；PubMed 生物医学摘要

en.concept: Methods and technical expressions in academic papers
en.description: Most notable activation is on the academic-text use of “resort to” and on “kinetics”; the rest is distributed across iterative computation, paper structure and scientific discussion, and split technical terms, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition across these patterns.

patterns.name: Methodological use of resort
patterns.context: Appears in the structure “need/having to resort to,” meaning having to adopt a different method or means; the trigger is mainly resort and does not require a fixed domain.
patterns.domain: Academic paper body text, including machine learning, theoretical physics, and mathematical proofs

patterns.name: Kinetics and chemical reaction terminology
patterns.context: Appears as a term in academic titles or body text for studying the kinetics of reactions or processes.

patterns.name: Terms related to iterative processes
patterns.context: Describes computational methods or processes performed repeatedly, often near approximation, solving, and acceleration.

patterns.name: Academic paper title or abstract opening
patterns.context: Paper-structure markers or opening phrasing in abstracts; activation words vary, with no single stable lexical item.

patterns.name: Scientific evaluation and research descriptions
patterns.context: Describes experimental evaluation, research work, or argumentative results, with no shared immediately adjacent grammatical structure.

patterns.name: Technical terms and complex-term fragments
patterns.context: Technical terms are tokenized or split and include scientific concepts, but the topics of the terms vary.
patterns.domain: Physics, mathematics, and computational science papers

1_1608.concept: 学术论文中的方法与技术表达
1_1608.description: 激活最明显的是学术文本中的“resort to”用法及“kinetics”；其余分布于迭代计算、论文结构与科学论述、拆分的技术术语，未见这些模式共享的稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: resort 的方法论用法
patterns.context: 出现在“need/having to resort to”结构中，表示不得不改用某种方法或手段；触发点主要是 resort，本身不要求固定领域
patterns.domain: 学术论文正文，涉及机器学习、理论物理、数学证明等

patterns.name: 动力学与化学反应术语
patterns.context: 在学术标题或正文中，作为研究反应或过程动力学的术语出现
patterns.domain: 化学、物理及交叉学科论文

patterns.name: 迭代过程相关术语
patterns.context: 描述反复执行的计算方法或过程，常与近似、求解及加速相邻
patterns.domain: 计算科学与数值方法论文

patterns.name: 学术论文标题或摘要开头
patterns.context: 论文结构标记或摘要开场措辞；激活词并不统一，缺乏单一稳定词项

patterns.name: 科学评估与研究描述
patterns.context: 描述实验评估、研究工作或论证结果，未显示共同的紧邻语法结构

patterns.name: 技术名词及复杂术语片段
patterns.context: 技术术语被分词或拆分，包含科学概念，但术语间主题各异
patterns.domain: 物理、数学与计算科学论文

en.concept: Expressions of methods, constructions, and principles
en.description: Responds strongly to expressions related to methods, constructions, and principles, such as construction and principle, across academic and patent texts; it also responds to proofs, definitions, theories, and section descriptions. Quantum popular science, mathematical notation, and engineering background are distinct contexts, with no single narrow topic evident.

patterns.name: Construction and its academic description
patterns.context: Describes proposing, using, or proving a construction, method, principle, or theoretical result in a paper abstract or body; often a noun has a modifier before it or is followed by its use or proof basis.
patterns.domain: Academic papers spanning quantum information, networks, mathematics, physics, and other fields

patterns.name: principle in proper names
patterns.context: The word appears in the name of a specific method or theory, rather than in the general sense of a principle: for example, “maximum entropy principle,” “Kepler’s principle,” “transfer principle,” and “principle layers.”
patterns.domain: Proper names, terminology, and technical definitions in academic papers

patterns.name: Quantum-theory terminology
patterns.context: Discusses quantum fields, quantum theory, or vacuum effects; activation here is concentrated on “theory” and “principle” in related terminology.

patterns.name: Section and definitional structures
patterns.context: The paper reviews definitions by section, fixes notation, and explains the mathematical constructions needed later.

patterns.name: Terminology for layers in a layered system
patterns.context: Describes a layered system that groups atoms into sufficiently thick layers; activation covers “principle” and adjacent technical expressions.

patterns.name: Engineering principles and equipment background
patterns.context: A patent background explains that an electronic balance weighing module is based on a particular operating principle.

patterns.name: General statements of results and arguments
patterns.context: Discusses whether a quantity or object is well-defined, whether a result holds, or the methods underlying a proof or derivation; not all are synonymous with “construction.”

patterns.name: Possible local activation on word forms/tokenization
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences describing improving a scheme, deriving one from a construction, or developing a theory; activation is scattered and relatively weak.

patterns.name: Unexplained local activation
patterns.context: Sporadic activation in symbolic mathematical text; its relationship to the dominant lexical pattern is difficult to determine from the fragment.
patterns.domain: Mathematical paper formulas and typesetting fragments

1_1608.description: 跨领域学术与专利文本中，对 construction、principle 等方法、构造和原理相关表述反应明显；也响应证明、定义、理论及章节说明。量子科普、数学符号和工程背景等是不同语境，未见单一狭义主题。

patterns.name: 构造及其学术描述
patterns.context: 在论文摘要或正文中描述提出、使用或证明某种构造、方法、原理或理论结果；常见于名词前有定语或后接用途、证明依据
patterns.domain: 学术论文，跨量子信息、网络、数学、物理等领域

patterns.name: 专名中的 principle
patterns.context: 该词出现在特定方法或理论名称中，而非一般意义的原理：如“maximum entropy principle”“Kepler’s principle”“transfer principle”“principle layers”
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的专名、术语及技术定义

patterns.name: 量子理论术语
patterns.context: 讨论量子场、量子理论或真空效应；此处激活集中于相关术语中的“theory”和“principle”

patterns.name: 章节及定义性结构
patterns.context: 论文按章节回顾定义、固定符号，并说明后文需要的数学构造

patterns.name: 分层系统中的术语层
patterns.context: 描述分层系统，将原子分组为足够厚的层；激活覆盖“principle”及相邻技术表述
patterns.domain: 计算物理/材料科学论文

patterns.name: 工程原理及设备背景
patterns.context: 专利背景中说明电子天平称重模块基于某种工作原理

patterns.name: 一般的结果陈述与论证
patterns.context: 论述量或对象定义良好、结果成立，或解释证明/推导所依据的方法；并非都与“construction”同义

patterns.name: 可能的词形/分词局部激活
patterns.context: 出现在描述方案改进、方案由构造导出或理论发展的句子中，激活分散且强度较低

patterns.name: 未充分解释的局部激活
patterns.trigger: «principle»10之外的数字、公式及邻近碎片，如«3»4、«34»、«orb»6
patterns.context: 符号化数学文本中出现的零散激活，难以从片段确认其与主导词汇模式的关系
patterns.domain: 数学论文公式及排版片段

en.description: Primarily activates on the suffix -otomy, as in dichotomy and axotomy, which differ in meaning and domain; there is also sporadic activation in complex multi-task problem statements and an abstract on the Pontryagin maximum principle, neither clearly related to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Suffix -otomy
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the “otomy” substring at the end of words; prefixes and meanings vary, while the shared substring persists across word boundaries.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts, including academic papers, forum discussions, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: multi-task / compound problem expressions
patterns.context: Describes abstract texts involving complex, multi-task problems and their applications; has no clear connection to the suffix -otomy.

patterns.name: PMP terminology fragments
patterns.context: Terminology related to the geometric discrete-time Pontryagin maximum principle; activation is scattered across the terms and surrounding words.

1_1608.description: 主要对词尾 -otomy 激活，见 dichotomy 和 axotomy，语义及领域各异；另有复杂多任务问题表述和 Pontryagin 最大值原理摘要中的零散激活，二者与主模式无明显关联。

patterns.name: 词尾 -otomy
patterns.context: 激活集中在单词末尾的“otomy”子串；前缀和词义不同，跨越词边界时该子串仍是共同点。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括学术论文、论坛讨论和百科条目

patterns.name: multi-task / 复合问题表达
patterns.context: 描述涉及复杂、多任务问题及其应用的抽象文本；与词尾 -otomy 无明显联系。

patterns.name: PMP 术语片段
patterns.context: 几何离散时间 Pontryagin 最大值原理相关术语；激活分散在术语及其周边词上。

en.description: Primarily responds to approach (proposing or describing a method) and experimentation (research, development, or commercial attempts); also responds to split-written dichotomy, the century suffix eenth, and spirit in technical questions, with weaker connections for the latter cases.

patterns.name: approach
patterns.context: The word itself is repeatedly highlighted in statements proposing, studying, or applying a method; it can be a noun or a verb in “We approach ...”.
patterns.domain: Academic paper abstracts and main text

patterns.name: experimentation
