patterns.context: Refers to attempts and experiments in research, development, or pricing; [1] is adjacent to “extensive” and “comparing”, [8] is “quick”, and [10] is “some”.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, software development, startup discussions

patterns.name: dichotomy
patterns.context: The word is split across a line break or subword boundary and refers to a division or opposition; [7] discusses a long-running debate about particle production, and [9] discusses whether explanations of human nature are exhaustive.

patterns.name: century subword in time expressions
patterns.context: Appears in historical accounts of capitalism, income, and working hours; only part of a time expression is highlighted.

patterns.name: spirit in a question
patterns.context: Embedded in the technical question “Parsing a nested hierarchy in spirit qi”, surrounded by parsing and grammar; it is unclear whether the highlight reflects word meaning or an incidental local pattern.

1_1608.description: 主要响应 approach（提出或描述方法）及 experimentation（研究、开发或商业尝试）；也响应拆分书写的 dichotomy、年代词尾 eenth 和技术问句中的 spirit，后几类联系较弱。

patterns.name: approach
patterns.context: 词本身反复高亮，出现在提出、研究或应用某种方法的表述中；可作名词，也出现在“We approach ...”中作动词。

patterns.name: experimentation
patterns.context: 指研究、开发或定价中的尝试与实验；[1]紧邻“extensive”“comparing”，[8]为“quick”，[10]为“some”。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、软件开发、创业讨论

patterns.name: dichotomy
patterns.context: 词在换行或子词边界处拆开，指二分或对立；[7]讨论粒子产生的长期争论，[9]讨论人性解释是否穷尽。

patterns.name: 时间词中的 century 子词
patterns.context: 出现在关于资本主义、收入与工作时长的历史叙述中；只标亮年代词的一部分。

patterns.name: 问句中的 spirit
patterns.context: 嵌在“Parsing a nested hierarchy in spirit qi”这一技术问句中，周围涉及解析与语法；高亮是否反映词义或偶然局部模式不明。

en.concept: Principles, mechanisms, and methodological expressions in research
en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on research-expression terms such as principles, mechanism, analogues, and approach; principles occurs across disciplines, while mechanism is more common in abstracts. A few nearby activations fall on different technical terms and lack a unified explanation.

patterns.name: principles
patterns.context: Appears in collocations such as “first principles method”, “engineering principles”, “biological principles”, and “basic principles”; usually “principles” or “fundamentals” in a noun phrase.
patterns.domain: ArXiv abstracts, Wikipedia science articles, PubMed/NIH research abstracts, and textbook introductions

patterns.name: mechanism
patterns.context: Appears in collocations such as “study the mechanism”, “simple mechanism for constructing”, and “reaction mechanism”, referring to the mechanism of a research subject or an implementation method.

patterns.name: analogues/corresponding forms
patterns.context: Appears in “piecewise-linear and birational analogues of …”, referring to analogous forms or corresponding versions of an object.

patterns.name: research method or approach
patterns.context: Used in “approach the non-perturbative regime” and, with weaker activation, “a new approach to constructing …”; denotes a research approach or way of handling something.
patterns.domain: ArXiv theoretical physics and computational methods abstracts

patterns.name: Other unexplained activations
patterns.context: Highlights fall on several different words and cannot be adequately explained by the trigger patterns for principles, mechanism, analogues, or approach.

1_1608.concept: 科研中的原理、机制与方法表述
1_1608.description: 强激活主要落在 principles、mechanism、analogues、approach 等科研表述词上；其中 principles 跨学科出现，mechanism 多见于摘要。另有少量邻近标记落在不同技术词上，缺乏统一解释。

patterns.name: 原则
patterns.context: 出现在“first principles method”“engineering principles”“biological principles”“basic principles”等搭配中；多为名词短语中的“原则/原理”。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 摘要、Wikipedia 科普条目、PubMed/NIH 科研摘要与教材介绍

patterns.name: 机制
patterns.context: 与“study the mechanism”“simple mechanism for constructing”“reaction mechanism”等搭配，指研究对象的机制或实现方法。

patterns.name: 类比物/对应物
patterns.context: 出现在“piecewise-linear and birational analogues of …”中，表示某对象的类比形式或对应版本。

patterns.name: 研究方法或进路
patterns.context: 用于“approach the non-perturbative regime”，以及较弱激活的“a new approach to constructing …”；表示研究进路或处理方式。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论物理与计算方法摘要

patterns.name: 未解释的其他激活
patterns.trigger: 未见明显共同触发词；包括 «efficient»、«spin transfer tor…»、«pearling»、«Regge» 等邻近标记
patterns.context: 标记落在若干不同词上，无法由 principles、mechanism、analogues 或 approach 这几组触发模式充分解释。

en.description: Activations center on concepts expressed in academic texts, including principles, mechanisms, and research hypotheses, with one instance of the mathematical term “analogues”. The trigger words do not share a consistent syntax or semantics.

patterns.name: “principles” and compounds
patterns.context: The noun principles appears, especially with a domain modifier before it (engineering, basic) or an of-phrase after it; no particular sentence structure is required.
patterns.domain: Academic research, engineering education, architecture, and scientific discussion

patterns.name: “mechanism” and related mechanism expressions
patterns.context: Describes the mechanism of a research subject or a mechanism provided by a method; may occur in an abstract or research proposal.

patterns.name: Research-hypothesis lead-in
patterns.context: A research statement introduces a hypothesis in the first-person plural, followed by a research subject or proposition.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research abstracts or project text

patterns.name: Analogous forms of mathematical objects
patterns.context: A mathematics abstract describes defining an analogous form of an object; activation falls on analogues rather than the more common principles, mechanism, or hypothesize expressions.

1_1608.description: 激活集中在学术文本中的原则、机制、研究假设等概念表达，另有一次数学术语“analogues”。触发词的句法和语义并不统一。

patterns.name: “principles”及其复合表达
patterns.trigger: «principles»10，常见于“engineering principles”“basic principles”“basic principles of quantum theory”
patterns.context: 出现名词 principles，尤其前接领域修饰语（engineering、basic）或后接 of 短语；不要求特定句式。
patterns.domain: 学术研究、工程教育、建筑与科学论述

patterns.name: “mechanism”及相关机制表述
patterns.context: 描述某个研究对象的作用机制，或某种方法所提供的机制；可出现在摘要或研究计划中。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理、生物医学研究

patterns.name: 研究假设引导语
patterns.context: 研究陈述以第一人称复数提出假设，后接研究对象或命题。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要或项目文本

patterns.name: 数学对象的类比形式
patterns.context: 数学摘要中说明定义某对象的类比形式；激活落在 analogues，而非常见的 principles、mechanism 或 hypothesize 表达。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to mechanism and nearby collocations in scientific contexts, spanning stochastic estimation, instability, reactions, decoherence, defense, and encoder–decoder mechanisms; isolated cases also involve theoretical feasibility and equivalent alternatives, template literals, and mechanics theory.

patterns.name: mechanism and nearby terms
patterns.context: In scientific abstracts or explanatory text, mechanism describes a process, method, interaction, or model; it often appears with the, a, of, or related domain modifiers.
patterns.domain: Primarily scientific paper abstracts, also machine-learning explanatory text

patterns.name: Principled alternatives and possibility expressions
patterns.context: In discussion of theoretical systems, in principle introduces feasibility or equivalent alternatives; no mechanism trigger word appears.

patterns.name: Template literals
patterns.context: Discusses the use of template literals in JavaScript; activation falls on a split part of literals, with no evident semantic connection to scientific mechanisms.

patterns.name: Theory and model terminology
patterns.context: A materials mechanics abstract introduces vibration modes of beams and theoretical methods for calculations; mechanism does not appear.

1_1608.description: 主要对科学语境中的 mechanism 及其近邻搭配强烈响应，覆盖随机估计、失稳、反应、退相干、防御和编码器—解码器机制；另见理论可行性与等效替代、模板字面量及力学理论等孤例。

patterns.name: 机制一词及其近邻
patterns.context: 在科学摘要或说明性文字中，描述某过程、方法、相互作用或模型时出现 mechanism；常与 the、a、of、相关领域修饰语搭配。
patterns.domain: 主要为科学论文摘要，也包括机器学习说明文

patterns.name: 原理性替代与可能性表述
patterns.context: 讨论理论系统时，以 in principle 引出可行性或等效替代；未出现 mechanism 触发词。

patterns.name: 模板字面量
patterns.context: 讨论 JavaScript 中模板字面量的用法；激活落在 literals 的拆分部分，语义与科学机制无明显关联。

patterns.name: 理论与模型术语
patterns.context: 材料力学摘要中介绍梁的振动模式及用于计算的理论方法；未出现 mechanism。

en.description: Activations are scattered across academic expressions concerning theoretical possibility, mechanisms/methods/structures, and optimized solutions or optimal objects; they also involve the suffix als, photon discussions, and a Chinese annotation for “algorithm”. Trigger locations vary, and the acoustically generated example is difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Mechanism, method, or structure
patterns.context: Academic accounts introduce a mechanism, method, structure, principle, or model, often in contexts such as “propose/construct/provide/follow”; no fixed collocation is required.

patterns.name: Theoretical possibility and argument
patterns.context: Discusses a possibility, inference, or property to be proved, often with a conditional, future tense, or theoretical analysis.
patterns.domain: Scientific discussion, HackerNews technical discussions, and paper abstracts

patterns.name: Optimal objects and existence of solutions
patterns.context: In mathematical optimization or variational problems, mentions minimizers, optimal couplings, or the existence of an object; occurs near formulas, theorems, or problem definitions.

patterns.name: English subword -als
patterns.context: The word-final subword “als” is marked; the contexts are path functionals for stochastic differential equations and probability-distribution marginals.

patterns.name: Quantum and photons in physics
patterns.context: Discusses whether photons can be produced non-quantized; activation falls on common words such as “able” and the subword “St”, rather than only on physics terminology.

patterns.name: Algorithm in a Chinese technical annotation
patterns.context: A Chinese sentence says an algorithm has nlogk complexity; strong activation falls only on the character “法” in “算法”.

1_1608.description: 激活散见于学术文本中关于理论可能性、机制/方法/结构，以及优化解或最优对象的表述；还涉及词尾als、光子讨论和中文“算法”注释。各例触发位置并不统一，光声生成例难以解释。

patterns.name: 机制、方法或结构
patterns.context: 在学术叙述中介绍一种机制、方法、结构、原理或模型，常见于“提出/构造/提供/遵循”等上下文；并非固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 跨学科论文及技术说明

patterns.name: 理论可能性与论证
patterns.context: 讨论某种可能性、推论或待证明的性质，常伴随条件句、未来时或理论分析。
patterns.domain: 科学讨论、HackerNews 技术讨论及论文摘要

patterns.name: 最优对象与解的存在
patterns.context: 数学优化或变分问题中，提及极小化者、最优耦合，或某对象存在；在公式、定理或问题定义附近。

patterns.name: 英语词片段 -als
patterns.context: 单词末尾的“als”词片段被标记；上下文分别是随机微分方程路径泛函和概率分布边缘分布。

patterns.name: 物理学中的量子与光子
patterns.context: 讨论光子能否以非量子化方式产生；激活落在“able”等常见词及“St”词片段，而非只落在物理术语上。

patterns.name: 中文技术注释中的算法
patterns.context: 中文句子称某算法具有 nlogk 复杂度；强激活仅落在“算法”的“法”字。

en.description: Activations are scattered across hardcoded technical settings, expressions of priority, paper terminology, and a few proper nouns and hypothetical phrasing; many strong activations fall on split word fragments, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: hardcode and compounds
patterns.context: In code or technical discussion, refers to directly hardcoding settings, character sets, values, or protocol fields, contrasted with implementing an algorithm or following a specification.

patterns.name: Priority and tradeoffs
patterns.context: Discusses the ordering of priorities in a culture or the priority of one factor over others in research; also includes a reformulation of an existing claim.
patterns.domain: HackerNews cultural commentary; PhilPapers research abstracts

patterns.name: Fixed fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Mathematical physics papers describe denoising algorithms, random field models, and related theoretical quantities.

patterns.name: Paper abstract terminology
patterns.context: An abstract states the research topic and paper results.

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in Panama Canal Railway
patterns.context: A proper noun in a link is truncated, and activation falls on the final “al” in the name; the context mentions a wiki page, numbers, and wait times.

patterns.name: Conditional speculative phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses, hypothetically or in terms of possibility, another way of producing photons and its consequences.

patterns.name: Possessive pronouns and contractions
patterns.context: An abbreviated possessive or auxiliary form occurs in a sentence; the examples are in a code discussion and Q&A advice, respectively.

1_1608.description: 激活分散在技术写死配置、优先级表达、论文术语及少数专名和假设措辞上；多处强激活落在被切分的词片段，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: hardcode 及其复合词
patterns.context: 代码或技术讨论中，谈到直接写死配置、字符集、数值或协议字段，与实现算法或遵循规范相对照。

patterns.name: 优先级与取舍
patterns.context: 讨论文化中事情的优先次序，或研究中某因素优先于其他因素；也出现对既有说法的改述。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 文化评论；PhilPapers 研究摘要

patterns.name: 技术术语中的固定片段
patterns.context: 数学物理论文中，描述去噪算法、随机场模型及相关理论量。

patterns.name: 论文摘要术语
patterns.context: 摘要中陈述研究主题和论文结果。

patterns.name: Panama Canal Railway 词尾
patterns.context: 链接中的专名被截断，激活落在名称末尾的“al”上；上下文提及维基页面、数字和等待时间。

patterns.name: 条件式推测措辞
patterns.context: 以假设或可能性讨论另一种光子产生方式及其后果。

patterns.name: 代词所有格与缩写
patterns.context: 句中缩写所有格或助动词形式；所给例子分别处于代码讨论和问答建议中。

en.description: The strongest pattern is code in hardcode in programming contexts; there are also activations for yet to see in the perfect tense, katakana word endings, precedence, and a fragment of an academic citation name, with no clear shared semantics among the latter cases.

patterns.name: code in hardcode
patterns.context: Appears in programming advice or discussion, usually hardcode a value, character set, shape, or type; paragraph 5 opposes hardcoding HTTP header types.
patterns.domain: Programming discussions on StackExchange and HackerNews

patterns.name: yet meaning not yet seen/experienced
patterns.context: yet occurs in a perfect or similar construction, meaning the speaker has not seen something so far; paragraph 9 has the same construction followed by “to see”.

patterns.name: Japanese katakana
patterns.context: When discussing Japanese writing or names, activation centers on the ending of katakana.

patterns.name: Word ending in precedence
patterns.context: In discussions of time arrangements and priorities across cultures, the trigger is precedence, meaning order of priority.

patterns.name: Name fragment in a Jahn-Teller citation
patterns.context: Appears in author names and year citations in academic discussion of C60 and Jahn-Teller dynamics; the exact trigger boundary may be a tokenized fragment.

1_1608.description: 最强模式是编程语境中 hardcode 的 code；另对完成时 yet to see、katakana 词尾、precedence 及一处学术引文姓名片段激活，后几类彼此缺少明显共同语义。

patterns.name: hardcode 的 code
patterns.trigger: «code»10，前接 “hard” 或 “hard” 与 “code” 分开的 hard«code»
patterns.context: 出现编程建议或讨论时，通常是 hardcode 某个值、字符集、形状或类型；第 5 段是反对将 HTTP header types hardcode。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 HackerNews 的编程讨论

patterns.name: 尚未见到／经历某事的 yet
patterns.context: yet 位于完成时或类似结构中，表示说话者至今还未看到某事；第 9 段中相同结构后接 “to see”。

patterns.name: 日语片假名
patterns.context: 讨论日文书写或姓名时，激活集中在 katakana 的末尾部分。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 的语言与文化问答

patterns.name: precedence 的词尾
patterns.context: 谈不同文化中的时间安排、优先级时，触发于表示优先顺序的词 precedence。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 评论中的文化讨论

patterns.name: Jahn-Teller 文献引文中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C60、Jahn-Teller 动力学等学术论述的作者姓名与年份引文中；具体触发边界可能是分词片段。

en.concept: Specific word-form fragments and academic expressions
en.description: Primarily responds to the ending al in interventional in medical texts, and also to We hypothesize at the start of research abstracts; other activations are scattered across ak/ana in katakana and als in the machine-learning citation author name Vinyals.

patterns.name: Ending of interventional
patterns.context: al follows intervention to form the adjective interventional; activation is concentrated on the ending, not the entire word or intervention in general.
patterns.domain: Medical research, clinical, and educational texts

patterns.name: Hypothesis statement
patterns.context: Follows We at the start of a sentence, forming the research-hypothesis expression “We hypothesize that ...”.

patterns.name: Fragment in Japanese writing-system name
patterns.context: Occurs in katakana in a discussion of writing names with English characters rather than Japanese katakana.

patterns.name: Word ending in machine-learning terminology
patterns.context: Appears in the cited author name Vinyals, concatenated with a year and paper title; activation falls on the final fragment of the author name.

1_1608.concept: 特定词形片段与学术表达
1_1608.description: 主要响应医学文本中 interventional 的词尾 al，也响应研究摘要句首的 We hypothesize；另有 katakana 内的 ak/ana 和机器学习引文作者名 Vinyals 的 als。

patterns.name: interventional 的词尾
patterns.context: intervention 后接 al 构成形容词 interventional；激活集中在词尾，而非整个词或一般的 intervention。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、临床与教育文本

patterns.name: 假设提出用语
patterns.context: 位于句首 We 后，构成“We hypothesize that ...”的研究假设表达。

patterns.name: 日语文字名称中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在 katakana 一词中，讨论以英语字符而非日语片假名书写姓名。

patterns.name: 机器学习术语中的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在引用作者名 Vinyals 与年份、论文题名连写的文献引用中；激活落在作者名的末尾片段。

en.description: Most paragraphs activate on the suffix al in the medical term interventional (including a word-final fragment in procedural); the rest are scattered across less, the reference-name endings er/als, and the mathematical term theory, with no consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Suffix in interventional derivatives
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending al in interventional; the word modifies medical research, study design, radiology, cardiology, or healthcare.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, research proposals, and abstracts

patterns.name: English suffix -less
patterns.context: Activation falls on the adjective suffix less, describing smart homes making holiday life easier.

patterns.name: English suffix -er
patterns.context: Activation falls on the end of the reference author surname Bersuker; the context is a molecular physics paper and citation.

patterns.name: English suffix -als
patterns.context: Activation falls on the ending of the reference author name Vinyals, in a citation for an image classification paper.

patterns.name: Mathematical term theory
patterns.context: Activation falls on theory in Hardy space theory; the context discusses function-space results and their applicability.

1_1608.description: 多数段落激活在医学术语 interventional 的后缀 al（含 procedural 词尾片段）；其余分散落在 less、参考文献姓氏后缀 er/als 及数学术语 theory，缺少一致语义模式。

patterns.name: interventional 派生词后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在 interventional 的词尾 al；该词用于修饰医学研究、研究设计、放射学、心脏病学或医疗护理。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、研究计划及摘要

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -less
patterns.context: 激活落在形容词词尾 less，描述智能家居让节日生活更轻松。
patterns.domain: 生活方式或产品介绍类网络文章

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -er
patterns.context: 激活落在参考文献作者姓氏 Bersuker 的末尾；上下文为分子物理学论文及引用。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文与参考文献

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -als
patterns.context: 激活落在参考文献作者名 Vinyals 的词尾，处于图像分类论文引用中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文与参考文献

patterns.name: 数学术语 theory
patterns.context: 激活落在 Hardy space theory 中的 theory；上下文讨论函数空间结果及其适用性。

en.concept: Word-fragment recognition, with a primary bias toward Lotus/us
en.description: The most consistent triggers are us in Lotus (company, software, or place name) and -al in the medical term interventional. Other activations are scattered across fragments in less, Weeding, and several title words, without a unified context.

patterns.name: Subword within the proper noun Lotus
patterns.context: “Lotus” is part of the name of a company, software product, or bridge/place; activation falls on the subword us.
patterns.domain: Software, corporate email, geographic entries, and lists of people and companies

patterns.name: Word-final fragment in interventional
patterns.context: The ending -al in the medical term interventional is marked; it modifies cardiologist, radiology, and studies in different examples.
patterns.domain: Medical research and NIH grant applications

patterns.name: Local subwords in different words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments in less and Weeding; the former occurs in smart-home copy and the latter in a robotics headline. They have no evident shared semantics or contextual conditions.

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur in machine-learning papers and educational research titles, distributed across the beginnings, middles, or endings of different words; no stable common trigger condition is evident.

1_1608.concept: 词片段识别，主偏向 Lotus/us
1_1608.description: 最一致的触发是 Lotus 中的 us（公司、软件或地名），以及医学术语 interventional 的 -al。另有分散在 less、Weeding 及若干标题词中的片段激活，缺乏统一上下文。

patterns.name: Lotus 专名内部子词
patterns.context: “Lotus”作为公司、软件产品或地名桥梁名称中的一部分；激活落在 us 子词上。
patterns.domain: 软件、企业邮件、地理条目、人物与公司列表

patterns.name: interventional 词尾片段
patterns.context: 医学术语 interventional 的词尾 -al 被标记；分别修饰 cardiologist、radiology 和 studies。
patterns.domain: 医学研究与 NIH 资助申请

patterns.name: 不同词中的局部子词
patterns.context: 激活落在 less 和 Weeding 等词片段上，前者处于 smart-home 文案，后者出现在机器人标题；没有共同的明显语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 消费产品宣传；HackerNews 标题

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 在机器学习论文和教育研究标题中激活，分布于若干不同词的词首、词中或词尾；未见稳定的共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 机器学习论文；医学教育标题

en.description: Primarily responds to the uppercase DESCRIPTION label and the word difference in contexts involving group differences, statistical significance, or practical effects; also occurs in DES encryption suites, encoded certificate strings, and the name DESeq.

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION label or field name
patterns.context: The uppercase word DESCRIPTION appears as a field heading, HTML table header, or CSS/document-style label; its prefix may be split or partially encoded.

patterns.name: difference and semantic neighbors
patterns.context: The word difference appears in statements about differences, effects, or changes; biomedical statistical text reports group differences, while email and forum text describes effects.

patterns.name: Differences in statistical expressions
patterns.context: Adjacent to comparison targets, ratios, or significance judgments, as in “difference between”, “difference was not statistically significant”, and “no significant difference”.

patterns.name: DES encryption algorithm name
patterns.context: DES occurs as part of a cipher suite name, followed by markers such as CBC; it is not the ordinary word description.

patterns.name: DES substring in base64/certificate content
patterns.context: The string DES occurs within a long, encoded-looking string surrounded by certificate or public-key data, rather than readable natural language.

patterns.name: DES substring in statistical method names
patterns.context: DES occurs within method or tool names, such as edgeR/DESeq; the activation may correspond to a substring in the name rather than a standalone word.

1_1884.description: 主要响应大写 DESCRIPTION 标签，以及单词 difference 在组间差异、统计显著性或实际影响语境中的出现；另在 DES 加密套件、编码证书串和 DESeq 名称中出现。

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION 标签或字段名
patterns.context: 大写 DESCRIPTION 一词，在文本中作为字段标题、HTML 表头或 CSS/文档式标签出现；前缀可能被拆分或部分编码。

patterns.name: difference 及其语义近邻
patterns.context: 单词 difference 出现在陈述差异、影响或改变的句子中；医学统计文本报告组间差异，邮件和论坛文本描述产生的影响。

patterns.name: 统计表达中的差异
patterns.context: 与比较对象、比例或显著性判断相邻，如“difference between”“difference was not statistically significant”“no significant difference”。

patterns.name: DES 加密算法名称
patterns.context: DES 作为密码套件名的一部分，后接 CBC 等算法标记；并非普通单词 description。

patterns.name: base64／证书内容中的 DES 子串
patterns.context: DES 字符串出现在类似编码的长串中，周围是证书或公钥数据，而非可读自然语言。

patterns.name: 统计方法名中的 DES 子串
patterns.context: DES 出现在方法或工具名称内部，例如 edgeR/DESeq；激活位置可能对应名称中的子串，而非独立词。

en.concept: Spelling patterns of DES and difference
en.description: Activation concentrates on two spelling patterns: DES embedded in code, markup, or technical identifiers, and difference in natural language; the latter commonly appears in research-result comparisons and also in email and forum contexts.

patterns.name: DES and DESCRIPTION strings
patterns.context: The letter sequence DES is highlighted within words or configuration, markup-language, code, or encoded strings; some instances are followed by DESCRIPTION, while others are embedded in identifiers such as DES-CBC.
patterns.domain: Code, HTML/CSS, encryption configuration, encoded text, and bioinformatics papers

patterns.name: difference stem
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word difference; in papers it is used to compare groups, cases, or results, while in email and forum text it refers to a difference or effect.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, corporate email, forum posts

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: No independent activation pattern could be reliably attributed to DES strings or difference.

1_1884.concept: DES 与 difference 的拼写特征
1_1884.description: 激活集中在两种拼写模式：嵌入代码、标记或技术标识符的 DES，以及自然语言中的 difference；后者常见于研究结果比较，也见于邮件和论坛语境。

patterns.name: DES 与 DESCRIPTION 字符串
patterns.context: 在单词内部或配置、标记语言、代码/编码字符串中，字母序列 DES 被突出；有的实例后接 DESCRIPTION，有的嵌在 DES-CBC 等标识符中。
patterns.domain: 代码、HTML/CSS、加密配置、编码文本及生物信息学论文

patterns.name: difference 词干
patterns.context: 激活落在 difference 一词上；论文中用于比较组别、病例或结果，邮件和论坛文本中则指差异或影响。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、企业邮件、论坛帖子

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 片段中没有明显对应于上述两类的触发子串
patterns.context: 未发现可稳妥归入 DES 字符串或 difference 的独立激活模式。

en.description: The strongest and most recurrent trigger is difference, concerning differences, effects, or no significant difference; there is also one DES subword activation in the code-documentation heading DESCRIPTION. Other contexts vary widely.

patterns.name: Modifiers or complements after difference
patterns.context: The word is marked as strongly activating; it occurs in phrases expressing effects, differences, distinctions, or lack of effect, followed by a complement or near the end of a sentence.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: email, Q&A, news commentary, medical papers, IRC

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION in a description field
patterns.context: Appears in code documentation as an uppercase field name or delimited heading; activation falls on the initial subword DES in DESCRIPTION.

1_1884.description: 最强且反复出现的触发是 difference，涉及差异、效果或无显著差异；另有一次代码文档标题 DESCRIPTION 的 DES 子词激活。其余上下文差异很大。

patterns.name: difference 后的修饰或补语
patterns.context: 该词被标记为强激活；出现在表达影响、差异、区分或无影响的短语中，后接补语或位于句末附近。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：邮件、问答、新闻评论、医学论文、IRC

patterns.name: 描述字段中的 DESCRIPTION
patterns.context: 代码文档中以大写字段名或分隔标题形式出现；激活落在 DESCRIPTION 的开头子词 DES。

en.concept: The word form difference and the DES subword
en.description: The clearest pattern is strong activation on the complete word “difference” across email, commentary, forums, medical papers, and IRC, in contexts involving differences, effects, or comparisons. In technical documentation, “DES” also activates strongly as the initial subword of “DESCRIPTION”; this instance may be incidental to the main pattern, due to tokenization or spelling.

patterns.name: The word form difference
patterns.context: The complete word is marked in sentences expressing differences, effects, or comparisons; although the contexts vary, the target word is identical.
patterns.domain: Multiple domains: email, Q&A, forums, medical papers, chat

patterns.name: Split DESCRIPTION field
patterns.context: The uppercase field name “DESCRIPTION” in HTML/configuration documentation is split into subwords; strong activation falls on the initial subword “DES”.

1_1884.concept: difference 词形及 DES 子词
1_1884.description: 最明显的规律是对完整单词“difference”的强激活，跨邮件、评论、论坛、医学论文和 IRC，涵盖差异、影响或比较等语境。另在技术文档中，“DES”作为“DESCRIPTION”的开头子词也强激活；此例与主规律可能只是分词或词形巧合。

patterns.name: difference 词形
patterns.context: 被标记的完整单词，出现在表达差异、影响或比较的句子中；虽上下文不同，目标词完全相同。
patterns.domain: 多领域：邮件、问答、论坛、医学论文、聊天

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION 字段拆分
patterns.context: HTML/配置文档中的大写字段名“DESCRIPTION”被拆成子词；强激活落在开头子词“DES”。

en.description: Activation is scattered across DESCRIPTION text, emitted, Webb in Webbington, Java parameter args, DES encryption suites, and several identifier/metadata fragments; there is no clear unified semantics.

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION label
patterns.context: DESCRIPTION is split into DES and CRIPTION, or appears as complete HTML label text; it can occur in comments, file headers, or table cells.

patterns.name: emitted followed by an object
patterns.context: The past participle emitted is followed by a from phrase or the modal may; instances come from scientific descriptions and patent text.

patterns.name: Ending fragment in Webbington
patterns.context: In tabular biographical or organizational information, the name Webbington is tokenized, with activation falling on Webb.

patterns.name: Java parameter name args
patterns.context: The parameter name args in a Java main method declaration, following the type String[].

patterns.name: DES cipher-suite fragment
patterns.context: DES occurs repeatedly within algorithm names in TLS/cipher-suite strings.

patterns.name: Character fragments in IOCs headings
patterns.context: Sporadic character fragments within IOC filenames or hash-like identifiers; they appear in the same segment as a DESCRIPTION file header.

patterns.name: Subword in neutral
patterns.context: Culture=neutral in an assembly identifier; located among metadata fields such as version and public key token.

1_1884.description: 激活分散于 DESCRIPTION 文本、emitted、Webbington 的 Webb、Java 参数 args、DES 加密套件及若干标识符/元数据片段；没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: DESCRIPTION 标签
patterns.context: DESCRIPTION 被拆分为 DES 与 CRIPTION，或作为完整 HTML 标签文本出现；可位于注释、文件头或表格单元格中。

patterns.name: emitted 后接宾语
patterns.context: 过去分词 emitted 后接 from 短语或情态动词 may；分属科学描述与专利文本。

patterns.name: Webbington 的尾部片段
patterns.context: 表格化人物或组织信息中，名字 Webbington 被分词切分，激活落在 Webb 上。

patterns.name: Java 参数名 args
patterns.context: Java main 方法声明中的参数名 args，位于类型 String[] 之后。

patterns.name: DES 加密套件片段
patterns.context: TLS/密码套件字符串中 DES 出现在算法名称内，多次重复。

patterns.name: IOCs 标题中的字符片段
patterns.context: IOC 文件名或哈希样式标识符内的零散字符片段；并与 DESCRIPTION 文件头同段出现。

patterns.name: neutral 的子词
patterns.context: 程序集标识中的 Culture=neutral；处于版本与公钥令牌等元数据字段之间。

en.concept: CVD abbreviation and a few word forms/markers
en.description: Activation is concentrated on the abbreviation CVD, especially in biomedical text discussing disease, risk, or research outcomes; there are also two contexts for neutral and a Writer token in an XML type name, which do not fit into one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: CVD abbreviation
patterns.context: Occurs as an abbreviation for cardiovascular disease or in related contexts involving risk, outcomes, or prevalence; may appear with diabetes, older populations, risk factors, or research descriptions.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, research abstracts, and project abstracts

patterns.name: The word form neutral
patterns.context: Used as an ordinary adjective in the medical term “neutral glycolipid antibodies” or in the energy-related phrase “carbon neutral synthetic fuel”; neither occurrence is the CVD abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts; energy and shipping discussions

patterns.name: XML resource writer marker
patterns.context: Part of the .NET type name System.Resources.ResXResourceWriter in XML configuration content, capitalized with an initial uppercase letter.

1_1884.concept: CVD 缩写及少数词形/标记
1_1884.description: 激活主要集中在 CVD 缩写，尤其是生物医学文本中讨论疾病、风险或研究结局时；另有 neutral 的两种语境，以及 XML 类型名中的 Writer，无法归入同一词义模式。

patterns.name: CVD 缩写
patterns.context: 出现在心血管疾病（cardiovascular disease）的缩写或相关风险、结局、患病率语境中；可伴随糖尿病、老年人群、危险因素或研究描述。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、研究摘要及项目摘要

patterns.name: neutral 词形
patterns.context: 作为普通形容词出现在医学术语“neutral glycolipid antibodies”中，或能源语境的“carbon neutral synthetic fuel”中；两处均不是 CVD 缩写。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要；能源与航运讨论

patterns.name: XML 资源写入器标记
patterns.context: 作为 XML 配置内容中 .NET 类型名 System.Resources.ResXResourceWriter 的组成部分，大小写为首字母大写。

en.description: Activation centers on paired/unpaired and fragments within these words: it includes both ordinary senses of pairing or being unimpaired and contexts involving statistical tests, siRNA, drug leads, and device pairing.

patterns.name: paired/unpaired statistical tests
patterns.context: Occurs in statistical analyses or experimental results, modifying t-tests, samples, or comparison methods; includes un«paired» across token boundaries.

patterns.name: General senses of paired
patterns.context: Refers to a strictly paired siRNA duplex, paired drug leads, or unimpaired property rights; not a statistical-test usage.

patterns.name: Paired peripheral devices
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions such as “previously-paired peripheral device”, referring to a device already paired with a system.

patterns.name: Unimpaired physiological function
patterns.context: paired occurs within unimpaired, describing normal, unimpaired autonomic reflex function.

1_1884.description: 激活集中于 paired/unpaired 及其词内片段：既包括配对或未受损的普通词义，也包括统计检验、siRNA、药物线索和设备配对等语境。

patterns.name: paired/unpaired 统计检验
patterns.context: 出现在统计分析或实验结果中，修饰 t 检验、样本或比较方式；包括分词边界跨 token 的 un«paired»。

patterns.name: paired 的一般词义
patterns.context: 表示严格配对的 siRNA duplex、配对的药物线索，或未受损的产权（unimpaired）；并非统计检验用法。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、神经科学、法律

patterns.name: 配对外设
patterns.context: 出现在“previously-paired peripheral device”等表达中，指已与系统完成配对的设备。

patterns.name: unimpaired 生理功能
patterns.context: paired 位于 unimpaired 一词中，描述自主反射功能正常、未受损。

en.description: All passages contain judged or judges (the first passage contains the initial fragment of judicial); usages include judging, evaluating, assessing, and inferring, across varied domains and syntactic environments.

patterns.name: judged and inflected forms
patterns.context: Trigger forms include judged and judges; they function as active or passive predicates and as complement verbs meaning “determine/consider”. They occur in different contexts, including independently and embedded within words.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including news, encyclopedias, commentary, entertainment reporting, patents, and medical abstracts

1_1884.description: 所有段落都包含 judged 或 judges（第1段为 judicial 的词首片段）；涵盖裁判、评审、评价、判断及推断等用法，领域和句法环境多样。

patterns.name: judged 及其屈折形式
patterns.context: 触发词形包括 judged、judges；既可作主动谓语或被动谓语，也可作“判定/认为”的补语动词。不同语境下均出现，包括独立出现及嵌在词内的分词。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、评论、娱乐报道、专利、医学摘要等多种文体

en.description: Primarily responds to bound and its forms or compounds: it can refer to bookbinding, boundedness, traveling to a destination, directional movement, and also occurs in spellbound and boundless; the specific meaning depends on collocations and context.

patterns.name: bound meaning bookbound
patterns.context: Near books, booklets, or volumes, often paired with materials, colors, or binding methods, such as “bound in white and gold parchment”, “volumes bound in calf”, and “bound in cloth”.

patterns.name: bound meaning bounded or enclosed
patterns.context: Describes an opening delimited or enclosed by wire on one side or all around.

patterns.name: bound meaning traveling to a destination
patterns.context: After vehicles or people set out, bound is followed by a destination or direction, as in “Charleston bound for Hampton Roads” and “Red Sea-bound squad”.

patterns.name: bound in directional terms
patterns.context: Combines with directional words such as east, south, and north to form eastbound, southbound, and northbound, describing roads, platforms, or direction of travel.
patterns.domain: Legal text, transportation and geographic encyclopedias, news narratives

patterns.name: bound in spellbound
patterns.context: The latter part of spellbound, meaning captivated by magic or charm; nearby is “keeping him spellbound”.

patterns.name: bound in boundless
patterns.context: The stem portion of boundless, appearing in a username or signature, with the meaning “without bounds”.

1_1884.description: 主要响应 bound 及其词形或复合词：可指书籍装订、边界限定、驶往某地、方向行进，也出现在 spellbound、boundless 中；具体含义由搭配和上下文决定。

patterns.name: bound 表示装订
patterns.context: 书籍、书册或卷册附近，常与材料、颜色或装订方式搭配，如“bound in white and gold parchment”“volumes bound in calf”“bound in cloth”。

patterns.name: bound 表示界定或围住
patterns.context: 描述开口由线材在一侧或四周限定、围住。

patterns.name: bound 表示驶往某地
patterns.context: 交通工具或人员出发后，bound 后接目的地或方向，如“Charleston bound for Hampton Roads”“Red Sea-bound squad”。

patterns.name: 方位词中的 bound
patterns.context: 与 east、south、north 等方向词构成 eastbound、southbound、northbound，描述道路、站台或行进方向。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、交通与地理百科、新闻叙事

patterns.name: spellbound 中的 bound
patterns.context: 作为 spellbound 的后半部分，表示被魔法或魅力迷住；附近有“keeping him spellbound”。

patterns.name: boundless 中的 bound
patterns.context: 作为 boundless 的词干部分，出现在用户名或署名中，语义为无边界。

en.description: Activation is scattered across bound (boundaries, bookbinding, being bundled), associated, substrate, and the adhere word family in patent contexts, as well as wheel in vehicle-component descriptions and contact areas in car care; the chip-packaging passage has no clearly interpretable marked word.

patterns.name: bound/edge or bounded boundary
patterns.context: bound means delimited or enclosed by an edge, material, or binding method; this includes openings, bookbinding, and bundled materials.
patterns.domain: Patent material descriptions, books and binding, shipping narratives

patterns.name: Association or attachment in patents
patterns.context: In patent technical writing, associated indicates a relationship between components, their pairing, or the operations involved.

patterns.name: The term substrate
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of scanning and fracture surfaces of brittle substrates; the same word also occurs in a chip-packaging context, but is unmarked there.

patterns.name: The adhere word family
patterns.context: Describes adhesive sticking to a blade and its effect on subsequent cutting functions; the nearby word adhesive also activates more weakly.

patterns.name: Contact areas in detailing
patterns.context: Appears alongside car-cleaning and care operations such as wiping rubber seals and polishing.

patterns.name: Wheel
patterns.context: Occurs in mechanical descriptions involving ball joints, control arms, and supporting a vehicle's weight.

1_1884.concept: 局部词汇与专利关联描述
1_1884.description: 激活分散于 bound（边界、装订、成束）、专利语境的 associated、substrate、adhere 词族，以及车辆部件 wheel 和汽车护理中的 contact areas；芯片封装段无明显标记词可解释。

patterns.name: bound/卷边或受限边界
patterns.trigger: « bound»10 on« opposite»3 sides；« bound»10 in calf；« bound»9 in« white»；« bound»9 sheet« bundles»
patterns.context: bound 表示由边、材料或装订方式限定/包围；既包括开口边界，也包括书籍装订和成束材料。
patterns.domain: 专利材料描述、书籍与装订、航运叙述

patterns.name: 专利中的关联或附属关系
patterns.trigger: « associated»9 wheel；« associated»9 with the« motor» vehicle；« associated»9 with such manual insertion
patterns.context: 在专利技术文体中，associated 表示部件之间的关联、配套或所涉及的操作。
patterns.domain: 专利背景与机械/车辆技术

patterns.name: 基材一词
patterns.context: 出现在脆性基材的扫描、断裂表面描述中；同词还出现在芯片封装语境，但该处未标记。

patterns.name: 粘附词族
patterns.context: 描述胶粘剂粘在刀片上及其对后续切割功能的影响；附近的 adhesive 本身也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 细节护理中的接触区域
patterns.context: 与擦拭橡胶密封条、抛光等汽车清洁护理操作并列。

patterns.name: 车轮
patterns.context: 位于球窝接头、控制臂和承载车辆重量的机械说明中。

en.description: Most patent passages show strong activation on “associated” and often concern component associations and technical devices; “bound” also triggers in different senses, including delimiting, bookbinding, and heading toward a destination. Vehicle components, bookbinding, and sporadic patent terminology also occur, so the examples cannot all be assigned to one semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Terms expressing association
patterns.context: Indicates that a component, actuator, sensor, wheel, or key is linked to another object; often appears before a noun in patent technical descriptions

patterns.name: Multiple senses of bound
patterns.context: Used to describe an opening or slit delimited by edges or components, bookbinding, or a destination heading (“bound for”); the commonality is the word bound, not a single meaning
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions, literary descriptions, nautical narratives

patterns.name: Vehicle and door components
patterns.context: Describes vehicle door structures, track mounting, and ball joints on vehicle wheels; overlaps with the patent context of associated components

patterns.name: Components and control operations in patents
patterns.context: Technical texts describe device components, positioning, actuation, locking, or control; these terms occur sporadically and show no more specific shared trigger than the patent context

patterns.name: Bookbinding descriptions
patterns.context: Lists books from different periods, binding materials, and colors

patterns.name: Expressions for nautical destinations
patterns.context: Nautical narratives about vessels heading toward a destination

patterns.name: Other local technical terms
patterns.context: These occur around specific objects or actions in individual passages; apart from the patent technical context and a few shared word forms, no unified, more specific trigger condition is apparent

1_1884.description: 多数专利段落在“associated”处强激活，也常涉及部件关联和技术装置；“bound”在限定、装订、驶往等不同用法中亦触发。另有车辆部件、书籍装帧及分散的专利术语，不能完全归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 关联关系用语
patterns.context: 表示某部件、执行器、传感器、车轮或钥匙与另一对象相联系；多出现在名词前的专利技术描述中

patterns.name: bound 的多义用法
patterns.context: 用于描述由边缘或构件限定的开口/狭缝，书籍装订，或目的地航向（“bound for”）；共同点是 bound 一词，而非单一语义
patterns.domain: 专利技术描述、文学描写、航海叙述

patterns.name: 车辆与车门部件
patterns.context: 描述车辆车门结构、轨道安装及车辆车轮上的球窝关节；与关联部件的专利语境重合

patterns.name: 专利中的部件与控制操作
patterns.trigger: « power»、« drive»、« control»、« arm»、« load»、« position»、« locking»、« key»、« conveyor»、« stacking»、« transport»、« material»、« actuators»、« sp»、«ind»
patterns.context: 技术文本中描述装置构件、定位、驱动、锁定或控制；这些词分散出现，未显示比专利语境更具体的共同触发条件

patterns.name: 书籍装帧描写
patterns.trigger: « volumes»、« white»、« gold»、« black»、« bind»、«ings»、« mounted»3、« bound»10
patterns.context: 列举不同年代的书籍、装帧材料与颜色

patterns.name: 航行目的地表达
patterns.context: 船只驶往某地的航海叙述

patterns.name: 其他局部技术词
patterns.trigger: « rolled»、« opposite»、« surrounded»、« aperture»；« in-feed»、« discrete»、« packets»；« fl»«ings»、« act»；« bucket»、« accordance»、« carried»
patterns.context: 各段中围绕具体对象或动作出现；除技术专利语境及少数词形重合外，缺少统一的更细触发条件

en.description: Activation is concentrated on substrates, device components, and manufacturing structural relationships in patent technical texts, and also covers patent details such as tissue-anchoring anchors and opening-boundary geometry; nautical terminology and cleaning and polishing descriptions in car care also appear, without forming a unified sense.

patterns.name: “substrate” in patent corpora
patterns.context: The word occurs in manufacturing, device, or material descriptions, often alongside process terms such as layers, electrodes, etching, and patterning; one example also refers to a carrier substrate on a circuit board.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background, involving thin-film devices, microfabrication, electronic packaging, or electrochemical arrays

patterns.name: Structures, components, and their assembly relationships
patterns.context: Technical texts describe device components, their composition, installation, layering, or mutual relationships; the triggers are not identical across passages.
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions covering vehicle door mechanisms, strain gauges, TFTs, electronic circuits, and microfabrication

patterns.name: anchor as a fastening or nautical term
patterns.context: One occurrence refers to a medical device that anchors in tissue; another appears in a nautical glossary alongside “Coming to a landing.”

patterns.name: Geometric descriptions involving bound/side/opening
patterns.context: Compares opening boundaries formed by different arrangements of rolled or unrolled metal wires.

patterns.name: Contact-surface cleaning and polishing
patterns.context: Describes wiping a rubber seal with a wet towel and treating the rubber and contact area.

1_1884.description: 激活集中于专利技术文本中的基板、器件部件及制造结构关系，也覆盖组织固定锚、开口边界几何等专利细节；另见航海术语和汽车护理中的清洁抛光描述，未形成统一词义。

patterns.name: 专利语料中的“substrate”
patterns.context: 该词出现在制造、器件或材料描述中，常与层、电极、蚀刻、图案化等工艺词同现；也有一例指电路板上的承载基板。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，涉及薄膜器件、微加工、电子封装或电化学阵列

patterns.name: 结构、部件及其装配关系

patterns.domain: USPTO patents; mechanical structures and electronic circuits

patterns.name: Sliding and connection actions

patterns.name: under in a location or load description
patterns.context: In passage 5, indicates a dog hiding under a bed or clothes rack; in passage 10, indicates a TFT sustaining a high bias voltage for a long time. The only commonality is the word form.

patterns.name: 局部词形/语法触发
patterns.context: 这些词在各段中的激活较弱，且与上述结构关系并不稳定对应；可能是专利句式或邻近技术描述带来的零散触发

en.description: Activation is concentrated on component connection, installation, support, positioning, and assembly relationships in patent texts, especially passive «attached»; it also covers specific mechanical functions involving doors and vehicle restraints, spring supports, airflow transport, lubrication, sealing, chromatography, and spline drives.

patterns.name: Passive construction with attached
patterns.context: Usually follows linking or auxiliary verbs such as be/is/are/being and describes a component connected to another component; the object of connection is often indicated by to, between, or an implicit location.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of mechanical, vehicle, electrical, and equipment structures in patent background

patterns.name: Mechanical support and load-bearing structures
patterns.context: Describes a component supported, positioned, or assembled by a bracket, frame, deck, bearing, or support plate; some passages do not contain attached.
patterns.domain: Mechanical structures and equipment in patents

patterns.name: Component installation, positioning, or adjacency
patterns.context: Describes a component installed somewhere, located between two components, or resting on a support; related to connection but does not necessarily state a connection explicitly.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of device structures in patents

patterns.name: Doors, opening and closing, and vehicle restraint devices
patterns.context: Mentions a loading-dock door and a vehicle restraint assembly, describing a movable door that opens and closes and a restraint assembly installed on a wall.

patterns.name: Spring module connected to a deck
patterns.context: A spring module is positioned between a frame and a deck; the connection portion at its upper end interacts with the deck and connects the spring to it.

patterns.name: Contaminated airflow and hose connections
patterns.context: A vacuum-cleaner handle assembly’s duct transports dusty air and connects to the hose and body.

patterns.name: Low insertion force and rear connection of an electrical connector
patterns.context: A switch assembly is first installed in a dashboard opening, after which an electrical connector is attached to the rear of the assembly.

patterns.name: Gear transmission and lubrication
patterns.context: The position or gear of mating components in a transmission causes a countershaft to rotate; oil is splashed or delivered by an oil pump to lubricate components.

patterns.name: Guide grooves, injection molding, and seals
patterns.context: Describes molding guide grooves on the end face of a slide and on a seal, as well as a seal attached to or overlapping the end of the slide.

patterns.name: Thermal stability in liquid chromatography
patterns.context: The configuration of a chromatography column and inlet and outlet capillaries stabilizes the mobile phase in liquid chromatography; the capillaries connect to the column.

patterns.name: Torque transfer through splines and fastening of elastic material
patterns.context: A splined shaft transfers torque to a wheel through complementary shapes, while elastic material firmly connects inner and outer components.

1_1884.description: 激活集中于专利文本中部件连接、安装、支承、定位和装配关系，尤其是被动式«attached»；另覆盖门与车辆约束、弹簧支承、气流输送、润滑、密封、色谱及花键传动等具体机械功能。

patterns.name: attached 的被动结构
patterns.context: 通常位于 be/is/are/being 等系动词或助动词之后，描述部件与另一部件连接；连接对象常由 to、between 或隐含位置给出。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的机械、车辆、电气及设备结构描述

patterns.name: 机械支承与承载结构
patterns.context: 描述部件由支架、框架、甲板、轴承或支承板承托、定位或组合；部分段落并未出现 attached。
patterns.domain: 专利中的机械结构与设备

patterns.name: 部件安装、定位或相邻关系
patterns.context: 描述部件安装在某处、位于两部件之间，或搁置于支承件上；与连接关系相近但不一定明说连接。
patterns.domain: 专利中的装置结构描述

patterns.name: 门、开闭与车辆约束装置
patterns.context: 出现装卸平台的门及车辆约束组件，说明门可移动开闭且约束组件安装于墙面。

patterns.name: 弹簧模块连接甲板
patterns.context: 弹簧模块位于框架与甲板之间，上端的连接部分与甲板相互作用并将弹簧连接到甲板。
patterns.domain: 专利中的弹性支承结构

patterns.name: 污染气流与软管连接
patterns.context: 吸尘器手柄组件的导管输送含尘空气，并连接软管和机身。

patterns.name: 低插入力及电连接器后接
patterns.context: 开关组件先装入仪表板开口，随后电连接器连接到组件后部。

patterns.name: 齿轮传动与润滑
patterns.context: 变速箱中对偶件的位置或档位使副轴转动，油被飞溅或由油泵输送以润滑部件。

patterns.name: 导向槽、注塑及密封条
patterns.context: 描述滑片端面及密封条上的导向槽成型，以及密封条附接或与滑片端部重叠。

patterns.name: 液相色谱热稳定
patterns.context: 色谱柱及进、出毛细管的配置用于稳定液相色谱中的流动相，毛细管连接至色谱柱。

patterns.name: 花键传扭与弹性材料固定
patterns.context: 花键轴与轮之间通过互补形状传递扭矩，弹性材料牢固连接内外部件。

en.concept: Descriptions of relationships among patent mechanical components
en.description: All passages are patent mechanical or product descriptions; the neuron favors descriptions of component connections, installation, position, and support, while also responding to adjacent technical discussion of assembly composition, materials, processes, and operation.

patterns.name: Connection or assembly relationships in patent mechanical structures
patterns.context: Describes a component’s position relative to another component, its fastening, connection, or assembly; connection terms are often followed by to, between, or a specific supporting component.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of mechanical, vehicle, and equipment structures in USPTO patent background

patterns.name: Spatial configurations of components and support structures
patterns.context: In addition to component connections, specifies end positions, surfaces, vertical relationships, or relative layouts between components.

patterns.name: Components and their composition or function
patterns.context: Describes an object as an assembly consisting of several components, or explains how an assembly carries or supports other components; not every occurrence directly indicates a connection.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of devices and components in patents

patterns.name: Specific patent objects and application areas
patterns.context: Activation contexts cover various specific mechanical products rather than one industry or component category.
patterns.domain: Vehicle, household-appliance, sports-equipment, lighting, transmission-system, fan, and ship patents

patterns.name: Materials, manufacturing, and transfer processes
patterns.context: Describes material composition, forming processes, or the transfer of force or oil between components; these accompany mechanical descriptions but are not equivalent to the connection terms themselves.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of materials, manufacturing, and mechanical operating principles in patents

patterns.name: Conventional style introducing patent background or field of invention
patterns.context: Uses conventional patent phrasing to introduce the invention’s subject or application; the passage does not show a subsequent connection structure.

1_1884.concept: 专利机械部件关系描述
1_1884.description: 所有片段均为专利机械或产品说明；神经元偏向描述部件的连接、安装、位置与支撑关系，同时响应组件构成、材料、工艺及工作过程等相邻技术叙述。

patterns.name: 专利机械结构中的连接或装配关系
patterns.context: 描述部件相对于另一部件的位置、固定、连接或装配；连接词常后接 to、between 或具体承载部件。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景中的机械、车辆及设备结构说明

patterns.name: 部件与承载结构的空间配置
patterns.context: 在说明零件连接之外，标出端部、表面、上下位置或部件之间的相对布局。

patterns.name: 组件及其构成或功能
patterns.context: 将对象描述为由若干部件构成的组件，或说明组件承载、支撑其他部件；并非所有出现都直接表示连接。
patterns.domain: 专利中的装置与部件说明

patterns.name: 具体专利对象与应用领域
patterns.context: 激活上下文覆盖多种具体机械产品，而非单一行业或零件类别。
patterns.domain: 车辆、家用电器、运动器材、灯具、传动系统、风机与船舶专利

patterns.name: 材料、制造与传递过程
patterns.context: 说明材料构成、成型工艺或力、油等在部件间的传递；这些内容伴随机械描述出现，但与连接词本身不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 专利中的材料、制造及机械工作原理说明

patterns.name: 专利背景或发明领域的固定文体
patterns.trigger: «Field of the Invention»；«The present invention relates»
patterns.context: 以专利惯用表述引出发明主题或应用对象；该片段未展示后续连接结构。

en.description: Activations mainly fall on the word forms causes and pauses; capitalization and within-word segmentation vary. Fragments of departure and pause also appear. The pattern spans multiple genres and corresponds to cause/causation and pause semantics, respectively.

patterns.name: Causal forms of causes
patterns.context: The word form is causes, with varied capitalization. It appears in statements about causes, causation, or disease outcomes, as well as in directory headings and truncated text.
patterns.domain: Dialogue transcripts, directories, encyclopedias, medical papers, forum discussions, technical texts, project abstracts

patterns.name: Pause-related forms of pauses
patterns.context: The word form is pauses; it refers to pauses in speech or games, a program pausing, or a pause before drawing a card.
patterns.domain: Dialogue transcripts, encyclopedias, code comments, Q&A

patterns.name: Same fragments in other words
patterns.context: Markers fall on a within-word fragment of departure and on different forms of pause; these differ from the full forms causes/pauses.

1_1981.description: 激活主要落在 causes 与 pauses 的词形上，大小写和词内分段多变；另有 departure 和 pause 的片段。横跨多种文体，分别对应原因/成因与暂停语义。

patterns.name: causes 的因果词形
patterns.context: 词形为 causes，大小写不一；多处出现在原因、成因或疾病后果的陈述中，也有目录标题与截断文本。
patterns.domain: 对话转写、目录、百科、医学论文、论坛讨论、技术文本、项目摘要

patterns.name: pauses 的暂停词形
patterns.context: 词形为 pauses；表示说话或游戏暂停、程序暂停，或抽牌前的停顿。
patterns.domain: 对话转写、百科、代码注释、问答

patterns.name: 其他词中的相同片段
patterns.context: 标记落在 departure 的词内片段及 pause 的不同词形上；与 causes/pauses 的完整词形不同。

en.description: All ten segments activate inside the word causes, with markers covering the suffix a(u)ses; some also mark the initial c. The word may appear at the beginning or in the middle of a sentence, or after a proper noun. Neither context nor domain imposes a stable constraint.

patterns.name: Within-word stem/letter sequence in causes
patterns.context: Matches the word causes or a contiguous within-word fragment; observed forms include C«auses», «c»«auses», PXEc«auses», with variable capitalization and annotation boundaries
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose, dialogue, directories, code, and medical abstracts

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: All fragments contain the contiguous letter sequence causes; surrounding context and genre vary widely, with no stable additional semantic or syntactic condition

1_1981.description: 十段均在 causes 一词内部激活，标记覆盖其后缀 a(u)ses；部分还标记词首 c。词可处于句首、句中或专名后，语境与领域均不构成稳定限制。

patterns.name: 词内 causes 的词干/字母串
patterns.trigger: «auses»10；第8、9、10段中触发部分前有«c»5，第10段为«c»后接«auses»10
patterns.context: 命中单词 causes 或其词内连续片段；可见形式包括 C«auses»、«c»«auses»、PXEc«auses»，大小写及标注边界不固定
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、对话、目录、代码及医学摘要

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 无法确认有区别于 causes 词内片段的第二触发模式
patterns.context: 所有片段都包含 causes 的连续字母串；其前后文与文体差异很大，未见稳定的额外语义或句法条件

en.description: All passages strongly activate at the substring «auses» in causes; capitalization, syntactic position, topic, and genre vary. No reliable independent semantic or contextual pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Word-final causes
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the latter part of causes across sentence-internal text, headings, and directories; capitalization, preceding letters, and adjacent context are variable. The response may be local to the substring rather than to specific semantics or syntax.
patterns.domain: Multidomain texts, including oral transcripts, medical, Wikipedia, technical, historical, and legal texts

1_1981.description: 全部段落都在 causes 的子串 «auses» 处强激活，词形大小写、句法位置、主题和文体各异；未见可靠的独立语义或上下文模式。

patterns.name: 词尾 causes
patterns.context: 激活集中在 causes 的后半部分，横跨句中、标题和目录；大小写、前置字母及相邻语境不固定。可能是对该子串而非特定语义或句法的局部响应。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本，包括口语转录、医学、维基百科、技术、历史与法律文本

en.description: Strong activations are concentrated on local subword fragments produced by segmenting words such as causes, pauses, dummy, and member, especially auses in causes/pauses; weaker activations also occur on formatting tokens and common words.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of causes
patterns.context: After the full word causes is segmented, activation falls on the within-word substring auses; both sentence-initial uppercase Causes and sentence-internal lowercase causes occur.
patterns.domain: Academic discussion, technical explanations, and oral transcripts

patterns.name: Internal fragment of pauses
patterns.context: After the full word pauses is segmented, the within-word substring auses likewise activates; it appears in pause annotations or descriptions of someone pausing.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of dummy
patterns.context: After the full word dummy is segmented, the word-final substring ummy activates; one instance refers to an election test, and another occurs in an adult erotic context with the spelling yumm(y).

patterns.name: Internal fragment of member
patterns.context: The internal letters BER in uppercase MEMBERS / MEMBER are marked separately, surrounded by the recipients of a company notice.

patterns.name: Structural markers and formatting tokens
patterns.context: These activations are scattered across line breaks, HTML form tags, hyphens, and common function words; they have no stable local semantic condition and are markedly weaker than the main trigger in each segment.
patterns.domain: Forum questions, papers, notices, encyclopedias, web text

1_1981.description: 最强激活集中在 causes、pauses、dummy、member 等词被分词后的局部子串，尤以 auses 见于 causes/pauses 为主；另有低强度格式符及常见词激活。

patterns.name: causes 的内部片段
patterns.context: 完整词 causes 被切分后，激活落在词内子串 auses；既见句首大写 Causes，也见句中小写 causes。
patterns.domain: 学术论述、技术说明及口语转录

patterns.name: pauses 的内部片段
patterns.context: 完整词 pauses 被切分后，同样激活词内子串 auses；见于停顿标注或描述人物暂停。
patterns.domain: 口语转录、建议性文字、叙事

patterns.name: dummy 的内部片段
patterns.context: 完整词 dummy 被切分后，激活词尾子串 ummy；一处指选举测试，一处出现在成人色情语境中的 yumm(y) 拼写。

patterns.name: member 的内部片段
patterns.context: 大写排版中的 MEMBERS / MEMBER 内部字母 BER 被单独标出，周围是公司通知收件对象。

patterns.name: 结构性标记与格式 token
patterns.context: 这些激活分散在换行、HTML 表单标签、连字符和常见功能词上；没有稳定的局部语义条件，强度也明显低于各段的主触发。
patterns.domain: 论坛问题、论文、通知、百科、网页文本

en.description: Strong activations are concentrated on several within-word fragments: causes/cause, pauses, affirm/reaffirm, and the singleton Tray. They span diverse domains and meanings, with no unified grammatical or topical condition.

patterns.name: Segmented fragment of causes
patterns.context: Triggered inside causes, with the initial fragment c activating strongly; the word itself can mean a cause or function as a verb.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, technical explanations, historical documents, medical papers

patterns.name: Within-word fragment of pauses
patterns.context: Triggered in the middle of pauses, in contexts describing a brief pause or arranging a pause.
patterns.domain: Courtroom dialogue, life advice, card-game rules

patterns.name: Within-word fragment of affirm
patterns.context: Appears in affirm or reaffirm, involving confirmation, maintenance, or reconfirmation.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment of tray
patterns.context: In the technical phrase Java Tray Icon, Tray is segmented and triggers; the context is brief.

1_1981.description: 强激活集中于若干词内片段：causes/cause、pauses、affirm/reaffirm，以及单例 Tray。它们跨越多种领域和语义，未见统一的语法或主题条件。

patterns.name: causes 的分词片段
patterns.context: 在 causes 一词内部触发，词首片段 c 激活较强；词本身可指原因，也可作动词。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、技术说明、历史文献、医学论文

patterns.name: pauses 的词内片段
patterns.context: 在 pauses 一词中间触发，出现在叙述短暂停顿或安排暂停的语境。
patterns.domain: 法庭对话、生活建议、纸牌规则

patterns.name: affirm 的词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 affirm 或 reaffirm 中，涉及确认、维持或再次确认。

patterns.name: tray 的词内片段
patterns.context: Java Tray Icon 这一技术短语中，Tray 被拆分并触发；上下文很短。

en.concept: right angle bracket and right-shift symbol
en.description: Primarily responds to the right-shift operator in code, commonly used for byte splitting, bit-field extraction, hashing, and address conversion; it also responds to right-shift symbols in operator comparison tables and to double angle brackets surrounding an email attachment name.

patterns.name: Right-shift operator
patterns.context: Code shifts variables, integers, or bit fields to the right; often combined with & masks, |, assignment, or type conversion
patterns.domain: Programming code, especially bitwise operations and low-level data processing in C/C++, Go, VB, etc.

patterns.name: Operator comparison table
patterns.context: Comments or lists enumerate operators; no shift calculation is performed here

patterns.name: Email attachment filename delimiter
patterns.context: Attachment marker in an email body; angle brackets enclose the filename, with double angle brackets at the end

1_1981.description: 主要响应代码中的右移运算符，常见于字节拆分、位域提取、哈希和地址换算；也响应运算符对照表里的右移符号，以及邮件附件名两侧的双尖括号。

patterns.name: 右移位运算符
patterns.context: 代码中对变量、整数或位域做右移；常与 & 掩码、|、赋值或类型转换组合
patterns.domain: 编程代码，尤其 C/C++、Go、VB 等位运算与底层数据处理

patterns.name: 移位操作符对照表
patterns.context: 注释或列表枚举运算符，此处并非执行移位计算
patterns.domain: 编程语言语法/测试代码

patterns.name: 邮件附件文件名分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的附件标记；尖括号包围文件名，末尾出现双尖括号

en.description: Activations are distributed across diverse code contexts. More prominent local cues include flags, unsigned types, and C interface declarations; sporadic patterns also include ioctl, kernel system calls, cryptography, images, event flags, and PHP properties, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: Variable name flags
patterns.context: The identifier contains flags, especially in underscore-separated variable or member names; no fixed semantics are required
patterns.domain: System code, thread libraries, and PHP documentation/code

patterns.name: unsigned type declaration
patterns.context: unsigned appears in C/C++ function parameters, pointers, or variable declarations, often adjacent to types such as int, char, and long
patterns.domain: Systems programming, cryptography, and image-processing code

patterns.name: Kernel/filesystem interface declaration
patterns.context: Declares kernel or filesystem functions, with parameters including structure pointers, integers, or buffers
patterns.domain: Linux kernel and Unix-like system code

patterns.name: ioctl command-parameter interface
patterns.context: A function or function pointer uses cmd and arg as command and parameter, involving device or file-operation interfaces
patterns.domain: Linux kernel and POSIX device interfaces

patterns.name: Versioned secp256k1 symbol
patterns.context: Version number v2.0.0 is embedded in a Rust/C FFI symbol name

patterns.name: Image buffer naming
patterns.context: Image output arrays are named by RGB channels and maximum dimensions

patterns.name: personality system call definition
patterns.context: Linux kernel system call macro and its parameter declaration

patterns.name: AES unwrap interface
patterns.context: AES key-unwrapping function declaration, with parameters including key, iv, and input/output buffers

patterns.name: Timer system call comment
patterns.context: Source comment lists setitimer/getitimer and is adjacent to syscall definitions

patterns.name: Event flag group
patterns.context: An event flag group used to create a thread, with a numbered object name

patterns.name: PHP property documentation and cache options
patterns.context: Documentation comment describes property overrides and provides an array of options to disable caching

1_1981.concept: 代码标识符与类型声明
1_1981.description: 激活分布于多种代码上下文，较明显的局部线索是 flags、unsigned 类型及 C 接口声明；另有 ioctl、内核系统调用、加密、图像、事件标志和 PHP 属性等零散模式，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 变量名 flags
patterns.context: 标识符中出现 flags，特别是下划线命名的变量或成员；不要求固定语义
patterns.domain: 系统代码、线程库及 PHP 文档/代码

patterns.name: unsigned 类型声明
patterns.context: C/C++ 函数参数、指针或变量声明中出现 unsigned，常与 int、char、long 等类型相邻
patterns.domain: 系统编程、加密与图像处理代码

patterns.name: 内核/文件系统接口声明
patterns.context: 声明内核或文件系统函数，参数包含结构体指针、整数或缓冲区
patterns.domain: Linux 内核及类 Unix 系统代码

patterns.name: ioctl 命令参数接口
patterns.context: 函数或函数指针以 cmd、arg 作为命令与参数，涉及设备或文件操作接口
patterns.domain: Linux 内核及 POSIX 设备接口

patterns.name: 带版本号的 secp256k1 符号
patterns.context: 版本号 v2.0.0 嵌入 Rust/C FFI 符号名

patterns.name: 图像缓冲区命名
patterns.context: 图像输出数组按 RGB 通道及最大尺寸命名

patterns.name: personality 系统调用定义
patterns.context: Linux 内核系统调用宏及其参数声明

patterns.name: AES unwrap 接口

en.description: The most prominent recurring trigger across domains is the plus sign “+”; code punctuation, declarations, line-break boundaries, and a few comment headings and macro identifiers also activate. Co-occurrence cues are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Plus-sign token
patterns.context: The plus sign itself is strongly marked; it appears in regex questions, numeric and word-naming strategies, shopping-cart descriptions, array-length expressions, arithmetic problems, data descriptions in comments, and Laravel/React headings.

patterns.name: Punctuation and boundaries in code
patterns.context: Markers cover punctuation, type names, declarations, or line breaks in multiple code snippets; exact marker locations vary and are often interspersed with unmarked code.
patterns.domain: C/C++, hardware-description code, and programming Q&A code

patterns.name: Q&A line-break/format boundaries
patterns.context: Appears at the start of StackExchange questions or at structural boundaries in the body; especially visible in segments 1, 4, 7, and 10.

patterns.name: Separators and headings in code comments
patterns.context: Comment separators and section headings are marked, adjacent to graphics-rendering code.

patterns.name: Maximum/width identifiers
patterns.context: Markers appear in a hardware address-width macro and a UFS maximum-group-count macro; in both cases they are part of an identifier.

patterns.name: Type declarations and integer fields
patterns.context: Markers occur near type names or type/variable declarations; code also includes arrays, pointers, and structure fields.

patterns.name: Numeric-plus-word naming strategy
patterns.context: Discusses a strategy for names composed of a number plus a word, expressing annoyance.

1_1981.description: 最显著且跨领域反复出现的触发是加号「+」；此外，代码标点、声明、换行边界及少数注释标题和宏标识符也有激活。各处共现线索不完全一致。

patterns.name: 加号 token
patterns.context: 加号本身被强标记；出现在正则表达式问题、数字与单词命名策略、购物车描述、数组长度表达式、算术题、注释中的数据说明，以及 Laravel/React 标题中。

patterns.name: 代码中的标点与边界

patterns.context: 多处在代码片段中，标记覆盖标点、类型名、声明或换行；但具体标记位置并不一致，也常与未标记代码交错。

patterns.name: Free-shipping promotional wording

patterns.name: Detachable hardware product components

en.description: Activations occur in recipe steps and cooking states, Go unsafe pointers, liability language in disclaimers, product component descriptions, and the subsid substring within words in EU texts; no shared semantic or grammatical pattern is clear.

patterns.name: Recipe actions and cooking states

en.description: The activation pattern is scattered: until in recipes, liable in liability statements, code keywords and symbols, and isolated emphatic expressions in lyrics and novels; no unified trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Cooking steps introduced by until

patterns.name: Legal liability language with liable
patterns.context: Liable is followed by a statement about liability, damages, or risk of harm.

patterns.name: C/C++ types and declaration symbols

patterns.name: Verbs of intent or outcome in songs

patterns.name: Emphasis words in literature

1_1981.description: 激活模式分散：食谱中的 until、责任表述 liable、代码关键字与符号，以及歌词和小说中的个别强调表达；未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: until 引导的烹饪步骤

en.description: Strong activations occur in recipe actions, state changes, and liquid descriptions, and also in code syntax, within-word fragments, and Slovak and Hungarian word forms; aside from recipes, no stable common semantics are apparent.

patterns.name: Cooking steps in recipes

patterns.name: Hungarian word-internal fragments

en.description: Activation fragments are scattered across different words and contexts: word-final fragments in two instances of retribution, actions and ingredient words in several recipes, and isolated word fragments in literary dialogue, reviews, Swedish parliamentary speech, and war recollections; there is no unified trigger apart from some local contexts.

patterns.name: Fragments within retribution
patterns.context: Word-final fragments occur in contexts discussing compensation, punishment, or revenge for wrongdoing or harm: once, destroying heraldic records as revenge; once, arguing for compensation of at least equivalent value.
patterns.domain: Fictional narration; moral argument in email

patterns.name: Action or state words in cooking steps
patterns.context: Recipes or cooking instructions describe ingredients, utensils, heat, timing, and actions such as adding, heating, stirring, or freezing; activations span multiple adjacent words.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment at the end of a paragraph
patterns.context: In a film-review context, describes laughing after being prompted; the trigger is a word-internal fragment whose local meaning differs from the other highly activated fragments in the paragraph.

patterns.name: Ingredient- or food-related word fragments
patterns.context: A recipe mentions frozen tilapia loins; adjacent to the cooking-step pattern, but activation falls on fragments of these specific words.

patterns.name: Action words in character dialogue
patterns.context: Novel dialogue discusses the behavior of objects or things and whether people can act on them; the strongest marker falls on Only.

patterns.name: Swedish word-internal fragments
patterns.context: A Swedish excerpt from a European Parliament speech; high activation occurs within formal forms of address and related terms under discussion.

patterns.name: Colloquial negation and time expressions
patterns.context: A spoken quotation about war memories; triggers fall on punctuation around a negative word and fragments such as there and only, with no clear semantic link to the other patterns.

1_1981.description: 激活片段分散于多种词与语境：两处 retribution 词尾、数段食谱中的操作和食材词，以及文学对白、评论、瑞典语议会发言和战争回忆中的零散词片段；除部分局部语境外无统一触发特征。

en.concept: Recipe contexts and scattered word fragments
en.description: Strong activations cluster in recipe texts, especially cooking actions, heat, and food states, and also involve ingredients and utensils. Other isolated phenomena include fragments within English, Hungarian, and Slovak words, C code punctuation, and line breaks in literary dialogue; no single pattern fully explains them.

patterns.name: Degree and state words in cooking steps
patterns.context: Occurs in recipe instructions and describes changes, degree, or target states of liquids, food, or heat.

patterns.name: Verbs in cooking instructions
patterns.context: Actions such as preparing ingredients, heating, mixing, or removing appear in recipe imperatives or sequences of steps.

patterns.name: Ingredient or utensil words in cooking texts
patterns.context: Names of ingredients, seasonings, or cooking utensils appear within cooking steps.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within English words
patterns.context: In English review prose, activation falls on words or their subword fragments; the passage has no obvious cooking context.

patterns.name: Hungarian word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In Hungarian parliamentary speech, activation falls within inflected or longer words.

patterns.name: Slovak word-internal fragments
patterns.context: In Slovak political text, activation occurs on letter fragments inside words rather than on clearly independent semantic words.

patterns.name: Punctuation and syntax fragments in C code
patterns.context: In network socket code, activations occur near assignments, function calls, pointers, and struct syntax.

patterns.name: Emphasis and line breaks in older English dialogue
patterns.context: Dialogue includes emphatic phrases, exclamations, and typographic line breaks; activations often occur on line breaks or short words.

patterns.name: Evaluative and ingredient words in recipe reviews
patterns.context: Users review recipes, describe making them repeatedly, or discuss ingredient use; these are not exclusively cooking steps.

1_1981.description: 强激活集中于食谱文本，尤其烹饪动作、火候及食物状态，也涉及食材与器具；另有英文散文、匈牙利语和斯洛伐克语词内片段、C 代码标点及文学对白换行等离散现象，无法由单一模式充分解释。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的程度与状态词
patterns.trigger: «liquid»10 is« reduced»7 by half；«golden»2« brown»2；«cool»6« slightly»4；«gentle»1« heat»5；«Increase»9« the»2« heat»3 to« medium»5
patterns.context: 处于食谱的操作说明中，描述液体、食物或火候的变化、程度或目标状态。

patterns.name: 烹饪指令中的动词
patterns.context: 食谱祈使句或连续操作步骤中，出现备料、加热、混合或移除等动作。

patterns.name: 烹饪文本中的食材或器具词
patterns.trigger: « broth»4；« vinegar»2；« skillet»1；« sea»1« salt»5；« oil»8；« onions»
patterns.context: 烹饪步骤内出现食材、调味品或烹饪器具名称。

patterns.name: 英语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 英文评论散文中，激活落在词语或其子词片段上；这段缺乏明显的烹饪语境。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语议会发言中，激活落在屈折词或较长词语的内部片段。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录，匈牙利语

patterns.name: 斯洛伐克语词内片段
patterns.context: 斯洛伐克语政治文本中，激活位于词语内部的字母片段，而非清晰的独立语义词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录，斯洛伐克语

patterns.name: C 代码中的标点与语法片段
patterns.context: 网络套接字代码中，激活落在赋值、函数调用、指针和结构体语法附近。

patterns.name: 旧式英语对白中的强调与换行
patterns.context: 对话中有强调性短语、感叹和排版换行；激活常在换行或短词处。

patterns.name: 食谱评论中的评价与食材词
patterns.context: 用户评论食谱、介绍重复制作或食材用法；不完全是操作步骤。

en.concept: Sentence-initial Only/only and heterogeneous local patterns
en.description: The most stable common cue is Only/only at the start of a sentence or clause, covering emphasis, restriction, responses, and narrative closure; other isolated activations occur in recipe words, code brackets, and configuration entries, with no shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “Only” at the start of a sentence or turn
patterns.context: “Only” appears at the start of a sentence or clause to emphasize, respond, contrast, or introduce what follows; it may be followed by punctuation, a noun, or a full clause.

patterns.name: Non-trigger co-occurrence of “only” in cooking instructions
patterns.context: Ingredients, cooking degree, or results are described in recipe steps; these passages do not support a unified “Only” trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Code punctuation and syntax
patterns.context: Activations occur near function calls, type casts, parentheses, or configuration entries in C/C++ code and build configurations; no obvious link to the “Only” pattern.

patterns.name: Narrative turn at the end of a sentence
patterns.context: A narrative paragraph closes with “Only time will tell”, expressing that the outcome remains unknown.

patterns.name: General meanings of only
patterns.context: “only” restricts time, quantity, or degree, or appears in fixed polite responses; the specific syntax and pragmatics vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Online comments, novels, chat, interview transcripts

1_1981.concept: 句首 Only/only 及异质局部模式
1_1981.description: 最稳定的共同线索是句首或分句开头的 Only/only，涵盖强调、限定、回应及叙事收束；另有食谱词、代码括号与配置项等孤立激活，无法归入同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 句首/话轮中的“Only”
patterns.context: “Only”位于句首或分句开头，用于强调、回应、转折或引出后续内容；后面可接标点、名词或完整分句。
patterns.domain: 小说、网页文本、聊天、对话

patterns.name: 烹饪指令中的“only”非触发共现
patterns.trigger: “only”未出现；显著激活集中在«mixture»9等词，另有«heat»4、«medium»6、«minutes»3、«warm»5、«liquid»9
patterns.context: 食谱步骤中的食材状态、烹饪程度或结果描述；这些段落并不支持统一的“Only”触发模式。

patterns.name: 代码标点与语法结构
patterns.context: C/C++代码与构建配置中，函数调用、类型转换、括号或配置项附近出现激活；与“Only”模式无明显联系。

patterns.name: 句末叙事转折语
patterns.context: 叙事段落末尾以“Only time will tell”收束，表达结果尚待揭晓。

patterns.name: 一般性的只、仅含义
patterns.trigger: «only»9 recently；«only»9 half；«only»9 a pleasure；«only»9 about 60 years ago
patterns.context: “only”用于时间、数量、程度限定，或固定礼貌回应；具体句法和语用差异较大。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、小说、聊天、访谈转写

en.description: Activations occur in recipe steps, ingredients, and food preparation, and also on digit strings, within-word fragments, line breaks, common words in novels, and C code syntax; aside from the recipe subset, no stable trigger condition spans the passages.

patterns.name: Heat or cooking state in recipe steps
patterns.context: Recipe instructions describe heating, adjusting the heat, or softening ingredients; the words occur within a sequence of steps.

patterns.name: Quantities, units, and ingredients in ingredient lists
patterns.context: A line-separated recipe ingredient list, where numbers, units of measurement, and ingredient names occur together.

patterns.name: Preparing and assembling cooked food
patterns.context: Describes frying, draining, shredding, and assembling food.

patterns.name: Numbers and alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on numbers, identifiers, or alphanumeric strings; their semantics and format vary by context.

patterns.name: Substrings within English words
patterns.context: Markers fall within words or their components rather than on complete, independent words; there is no stable shared context.

patterns.name: Line breaks or layout boundaries in novels
patterns.context: Activation markers appear near line breaks in novel text, including dialogue breaks, body-text breaks, or line breaks in table-of-contents entries.

patterns.name: Assignment and struct-member syntax in C code
patterns.context: Network programming code declares or initializes an address structure and calls accept; markers cover operators, keywords, and member-name fragments.

patterns.name: Other isolated English words
patterns.context: These words occur separately in historical narration, novel narration, or character dialogue, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

1_1981.description: 激活分布于食谱步骤、配料与食物处理，也落在数字串、词内片段、换行、小说常用词及C代码语法上；除食谱子集外，未见贯穿各段的稳定触发条件。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的热度或烹饪状态
patterns.context: 食谱指令中描述加热、调节火力或食材软化；词语处在连续的操作步骤里。

patterns.name: 配料表中的数量、单位与食材
patterns.context: 换行分隔的食谱配料清单，数值、计量单位与食材名称相邻。

patterns.name: 烹饪食物的处理与组装
patterns.context: 叙述油炸、沥干、撕碎并组装食物的做法。

patterns.name: 数字与字母数字串
patterns.context: 激活落在数字、编号或字母数字串上；其语义与格式随上下文变化。

patterns.name: 英文分词内部的子串
patterns.context: 标记落在词内或词的组成部分上，而非完整、独立的词；没有稳定的共同语境。

patterns.name: 小说中的换行或版式边界
patterns.context: 激活标记出现在小说文本的换行附近，包括对话断行、正文断行或目录条目换行。

patterns.name: C 代码中的赋值与结构体成员语法
patterns.context: 网络编程代码中声明或初始化地址结构并调用 accept；标记覆盖运算符、关键字与成员名片段。

patterns.name: 其他孤立英文词语
patterns.context: 这些词分别出现在历史叙述、小说叙述或人物对话中，未见一致的语义或句法条件。

en.concept: Recipe cooking words and scattered word fragments
en.description: The clearest cluster is activations on ingredient, seasoning, and cooking-step words in recipes; the remaining activations are scattered across technical Q&A, chat, Danish, and fragments within English words, with no stable shared condition.

patterns.name: Action or measurement words in recipes
patterns.context: Words in cooking steps or ingredient lists involve food preparation, seasoning, heating, and timing; some activations fall on fragments within English words.

patterns.name: Fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activations occur on substrings within words rather than on complete words; the examples are not semantically or contextually consistent.

patterns.name: Restrictive expressions in programming Q&A
patterns.context: Technical Q&A describes constraints on a database identity column or the purpose of an interface port; activation concentrates on words expressing restriction, exclusion, or emphasis.

patterns.name: Update wording in IRC chat
patterns.context: A URL path contains update, followed by brief IRC chat.

patterns.name: Adverbs of emphasis or degree
patterns.context: A Danish sentence expresses increased urgency; the context concerns international cooperation and public health information.

patterns.name: Demonstrative pronouns
patterns.context: That appears in English narration or technical Q&A, referring to something or introducing a clause; no stable shared semantic role is evident.

patterns.name: Other scattered word fragments
patterns.context: Scattered across contexts such as recipes and novels, without a shared condition that would group them into the same semantic pattern.

1_1981.concept: 食谱烹饪词及零散词片段
1_1981.description: 最清晰的集中模式是食谱中对食材、调味与烹饪步骤词的激活；其余激活散布于技术问答、聊天、丹麦语及英文词内片段，缺少稳定共同条件。

patterns.name: 食谱中的动作或计量词
patterns.trigger: « diced»、« teaspoon»、« salt»、« ground»、« minutes»、« stirring»、« sprinkle»、« heat»
patterns.context: 烹饪步骤或配料表中，涉及食材处理、调味、加热和时间的词；部分激活落在英文词内部片段上。
