patterns.name: 英语词内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在词内子串而非完整词上；这些例子语义和上下文不统一。

patterns.name: 程序问答中的限定表达
patterns.context: 技术问答中，描述数据库标识列约束或接口端口用途，激活集中于限定、排除或强调的词。

patterns.name: IRC 聊天中的更新字样
patterns.context: 网址路径含 update，后接 IRC 简短聊天。

patterns.name: 强调程度的副词
patterns.context: 丹麦语句中表达紧迫程度增强；上下文谈国际合作与公共卫生信息。

patterns.name: 指示代词
patterns.context: 英语叙事或技术问答中出现 that，分别用于指代或引出从句；看不出稳定的共同语义作用。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 分散在食谱、小说等语境，缺少能将它们归为同一语义模式的共同条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across recipe instructions and ingredients, literary English, Spanish parliamentary text, and code identifiers; some fall on within-word fragments or line breaks, with no stable cross-domain semantic or morphological pattern.

patterns.name: Temperature changes in cooking steps
patterns.context: Recipe instructions describe heating, adjusting the heat, and then adding ingredients or cooking them.

patterns.name: Handling liquids or ingredients in cooking
patterns.context: Recipe steps describe adding ingredients to a pan, stirring, bringing to a boil, or reducing liquid.

patterns.name: Recipe ingredients and measurements
patterns.context: Ingredient lists specify ingredients, cuts, and quantities; activations are distributed across ingredient and measurement words.

patterns.name: English function words and sentence continuation
patterns.context: Sentence or quotation continuations in English prose; activations fall on common words and line-break markers, with inconsistent local semantics.

patterns.name: Fragments within Spanish words
patterns.context: In Spanish parliamentary text, activations occur on substrings within words rather than complete words; word forms and syntactic positions vary.

patterns.name: C++ identifier or keyword fragments
patterns.context: In code contexts, activations fall within keywords, API names, or identifiers; trigger types are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Fragments within words in build configurations
patterns.context: In CMake configuration files, activation occurs on fragments of underscore-separated directive names.

patterns.name: Fragments within long English words
patterns.context: An ordinary English noun in travel narration; the trigger word's connection to patterns in other passages is unclear.

1_1981.description: 激活分散于食谱指令与配料、文学英语、西班牙语议会文本及代码标识符中；有些落在词内片段或换行处，未见稳定的跨领域语义或词形规律。

patterns.name: 烹饪步骤中的温度变化
patterns.context: 食谱中描述加热、调节火力，以及随后加入食材或烹煮的指令。

patterns.name: 烹饪中的液体或食材处理
patterns.context: 食谱步骤叙述向锅中加入配料、搅拌、煮沸或收汁。

patterns.name: 食谱配料与计量文本
patterns.context: 配料表中列出食材、切法和数量；激活分布在食材及计量词上。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及句子延续
patterns.context: 英语散文中句子或引语延续处；激活落在常见词和换行标记上，局部语义不一致。

patterns.name: 西班牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语议会文本中，激活出现在词内子串而非完整词；词形与句法位置各异。

patterns.name: C++标识符或关键字片段
patterns.context: 代码上下文中，激活落在关键字、API名称或标识符内部；触发类型不完全相同。

patterns.name: 编译配置中的词内片段
patterns.context: CMake配置文件中，激活在带下划线的指令名称片段上。

patterns.name: 英文长词中的片段
patterns.context: 旅行叙述中的普通英文名词，触发词与其他段的模式联系不明。

en.description: Activations are scattered across recipe words, the mobility scooter collocation, C/Objective-C code, SQL errors, fragments within Polish words, literary dialogue, and Danish public-health text; there is no stable shared trigger form across passages.

patterns.name: Cooking and recipe action words
patterns.context: Near ingredients, quantities, or cooking steps; includes ingredient lists and sequences of cooking instructions.

patterns.name: Mobility scooter collocation
patterns.context: Mobility modifies scooter, followed by flat battery; occurs in an anecdote in a lighthearted narrative.

patterns.name: C code structure and types
patterns.context: Near struct types, sizeof, and length-related identifiers in C-style socket code.

patterns.name: Fragments of inflected Polish words
patterns.context: In a Polish prayer, activation markers fall inside tokenized words; the two word forms are not clearly the same morpheme.

patterns.name: SQL identity-column error
patterns.context: Describes a SQL exception raised by BindingSource.UpdateAll(); the error message contains explicit value.

patterns.name: Contrastive discourse particle in fictional narration
patterns.context: In colloquial character dialogue, an exclamation about things being difficult is followed by a command in the next sentence.

patterns.name: Danish public-health wording
patterns.context: Discusses an EU infectious-disease outbreak or diseases arriving from more distant regions; activation falls on the Danish word mere.

patterns.name: Objective-C method declaration
patterns.context: Near colon parameters, return types, and type declarations in Objective-C interfaces or method signatures.

1_1981.description: 激活分散于食谱词语、mobility scooter 搭配、C/Objective-C 代码、SQL 错误、波兰语词内片段、文学对白及丹麦语公共卫生文本；没有跨段稳定的共同触发形式。

patterns.name: 烹饪与食谱操作词
patterns.context: 食材、用量或烹饪步骤附近；包括配料表和连续的做菜指令。

patterns.name: mobility scooter 搭配
patterns.context: mobility 修饰 scooter，后文接 flat battery；位于轻松叙述中的人物轶事。

patterns.name: C 代码结构与类型
patterns.context: C 风格套接字代码中，结构体类型、sizeof 和长度相关标识符附近。

patterns.name: 波兰语屈折词片段
patterns.context: 波兰语祈祷文中，激活标记落在被切分的词内部；两处词形并非明显相同词素。

patterns.name: SQL identity 列错误
patterns.context: 说明 BindingSource.UpdateAll() 引发 SQL 异常，错误信息包含 explicit value。

patterns.name: 虚构叙述中的对比性语气词
patterns.context: 口语化人物对白中，感叹 things 难以对付后转入下一句命令。

patterns.name: 丹麦语公共卫生措辞
patterns.context: 讨论欧盟传染病暴发或疾病从更远地区传入；激活落在丹麦语 mere 上。

patterns.name: Objective-C 方法声明
patterns.context: Objective-C 接口或方法签名中，冒号参数、返回类型和类型声明附近。

en.concept: Coefficient terms and a specific substring
en.description: Primarily responds to “coefficient” in cross-domain coefficient terms, including material absorption, measurement-related, diffusion, Hall, mineralization, linear, variation, and reliability coefficients; also shows an isolated activation for “Neolog”.

patterns.name: Names of coefficients in statistics
patterns.context: A coefficient term appears in a statistical, measurement, or physical-quantity context; usually “coefficient” in a noun phrase, with modifiers before or after it
patterns.domain: Research papers, patent technical background, physics papers

patterns.name: The word form “coefficient” itself
patterns.context: Activation centers on this word even when the coefficient type and application domain differ; it may appear in a “coefficient of …” construction or with a preceding modifier

patterns.name: Specific substring in a proper name
patterns.context: Appears in the proper name “Neolog Jewish Community”, not in a coefficient term

1_2051.description: 主要响应跨领域系数术语中的“coefficient”，涵盖材料吸收、测量相关、扩散、霍尔、矿化、线性、变异及可靠性系数；另对“Neolog”有孤立激活。

patterns.name: 统计学中的系数名称
patterns.trigger: “coefficient”及其前置修饰语，如“absorption coefficient”“correlation coefficient”“Hall coefficient”“linear coefficient”“coefficient of variation”“reliability coefficient”
patterns.context: 出现统计、测量或物理量的系数术语；通常是名词短语中的 coefficient，修饰语可在前或后
patterns.domain: 科研论文、专利技术背景、物理学论文

patterns.name: “coefficient”词形本身
patterns.context: 触发集中在该词，即使上下文中的系数类型和应用领域不同；可处于“coefficient of …”结构，或由前置词修饰
patterns.domain: 跨领域技术与学术文体

patterns.name: 人名中的特定子串
patterns.context: 出现在“Neolog Jewish Community”这一专名中，而非系数术语

en.description: Primarily responds to the noun “coefficient” in scientific, medical, and technical texts, including coefficients of restitution, absorption, correlation, diffusion, Hall, mineralization, linearity, and reliability; also responds once to a subword fragment in the proper name Neolog.

patterns.name: The word coefficient
patterns.context: “coefficient” appears as a noun referring to a measurement, statistical, or physical quantity; often has a modifier before it or an explanation after it

patterns.name: Neolog string
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the proper name “Hungary's Neolog Jewish Community”, not a coefficient use

1_2051.description: 主要在科学、医学与技术文本中响应名词“coefficient”，涵盖恢复系数、吸收、相关、扩散、霍尔、矿化、线性及信度等系数；另在一处响应专名Neolog中的词片段。

patterns.name: 系数一词
patterns.context: “coefficient”作为名词出现，指某种测量、统计或物理量；前后常有修饰语或后续说明
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利技术文本

patterns.name: Neolog 字符串
patterns.context: 专名“Hungary's Neolog Jewish Community”中的词内片段，并非系数用法

en.description: All snippets contain “coefficient” in academic or technical contexts, covering various coefficients in materials and measurement, statistical correlation, physics, diffusion, soil mineralization, and analytical methods.

patterns.name: “coefficient” as a statistical/physical quantity
patterns.context: The term “coefficient” is followed by the name of a specific physical quantity or statistical indicator, such as restitution, absorption, correlation, Hall, diffusion, mineralization, linear, variation, or variance; there is no fixed grammatical structure around the word.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain academic papers, patent background, and method descriptions

1_2051.description: 所有片段均在学术或技术语境中出现“coefficient”，涵盖材料与测量、统计相关、物理、扩散、土壤矿化及分析方法等多种系数。

patterns.name: “coefficient”统计/物理量
patterns.context: 术语“coefficient”后接具体物理量或统计指标名称，如 restitution、absorption、correlation、Hall、diffusion、mineralization、linear、variation、variance；不限于该词前后的固定语法结构。
patterns.domain: 跨领域学术论文、专利背景及方法描述

en.description: All segments contain and activate “coefficient” in specialized technical contexts, covering coefficients of restitution, absorption, correlation, diffusion, Hall, mineralization, transformation, thermal expansion, friction, and variation; some segments also include measurement or parameter quantification.

patterns.name: Coefficient in technical terminology
patterns.context: “coefficient” occurs in a noun phrase for a measurement, calculation, or physical/statistical parameter; in many segments, the word itself is the strongest activation site
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patent technical background; mechanics, materials, statistics, physics, soil science, medicine, and image coding

patterns.name: Coefficient-related numerical and measurement contexts
patterns.context: Statements about calculations, measurements, parameter changes, numerical results, or performance evaluations appear alongside or near a coefficient; activation is weaker and not shared by all segments
patterns.domain: Quantitative technical descriptions in abstracts and patent specifications

1_2051.description: 所有段均在专业技术语境中出现并激活“coefficient”，涵盖恢复、吸收、相关、扩散、霍尔、矿化、变换、热膨胀、摩擦及变异系数；部分段另伴随测量或参数定量描述。

patterns.name: 专业术语中的 coefficient
patterns.trigger: “coefficient”及其后续限定词，如 “coefficient of restitution”“absorption coefficient”“intraclass correlation coefficient”“Diffusion coefficient”“Hall coefficient”“transform coefficient”“coefficient of thermal expansion”“friction coefficient”“coefficient of variance”
patterns.context: “coefficient”处于测量、计算或物理/统计参数的名词短语中；多段里该词本身是最强激活位置
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利技术背景；力学、材料、统计、物理、土壤、医学与图像编码

patterns.name: 系数相关的数值与测量语境
patterns.trigger: 如“modulus was calculated”“measurement repeatability”“values … of the parameters”“remains integer”“exceeded 14%”“can be improved”“validated … average”
patterns.context: 与系数并列或相邻的计算、测量、参数变化、数值结果或性能评价语句；激活较弱且并非各段共有
patterns.domain: 摘要与专利说明书中的定量技术描述

en.description: All snippets concern “coefficient” terminology in science or engineering and its quantitative parameters and measurement indicators; activation may cover the word and nearby function words, while the specific coefficient type varies across disciplines.

patterns.name: “coefficient” and the quantity it denotes
patterns.context: In descriptions of measurement, calculation, materials, or models, focus falls on the word coefficient and its adjacent technical collocation; it is sometimes preceded by a modifier and sometimes followed by an “of” phrase.
patterns.domain: Research papers and patent technical texts

patterns.name: Coefficients and quantitative measurement results
patterns.context: A coefficient occurs in a context of quantitative evaluation, statistical reliability, measurement validation, or experimental results; some contexts include values, units, or statistical indicators.

patterns.name: Engineering processes, coding, or material parameters
patterns.context: A coefficient serves as a parameter of a system, material, physical model, or engineering process, and is linked to absorption, diffusion, transformation, the Hall effect, or energy transfer.
patterns.domain: Patents, computer coding, physics, and materials research

patterns.name: Incidental activation of nearby non-coefficient words
patterns.context: These words occur near several high-activation sites, but their distribution is inconsistent and they cannot explain all instances on their own; they may be incidental signals from the syntax surrounding coefficient terminology.

1_2051.description: 所有片段均围绕科学或工程中的“coefficient”术语及其定量参数、测量指标展开；激活可能覆盖该词及邻近功能词，具体系数类型跨学科变化。

patterns.name: “coefficient”及其后续量名
patterns.trigger: “coefficient”后接或组成科学、工程术语，如“coefficient of restitution”“absorption coefficient”“reliability coefficient”“intraclass correlation coefficient”“Diffusion coefficient”“transform coefficient”“Hall coefficient”“mineralization coefficient”“coefficient of variance”“energy transfer coefficient”
patterns.context: 在测量、计算、材料或模型描述中，重点落在系数一词及紧邻的术语搭配；有时系数名词前有修饰语，有时后接“of”短语。
patterns.domain: 科研论文与专利技术文本

patterns.name: 系数与量化测量结果
patterns.trigger: “modulus was calculated”“areas under”“factor loading”“reliability coefficient was .95”“repeatability”“14%”“average coefficient of variance”
patterns.context: 系数处于定量评估、统计可靠性、测量验证或实验结果语境；部分上下文出现数值、单位或统计指标。

patterns.name: 工程处理、编码或材料参数
patterns.trigger: “absorption coefficient”“Diffusion coefficient”“transform coefficient”“Hall coefficient”“energy transfer coefficient”
patterns.context: 系数作为系统、材料、物理模型或工程处理的参数，与吸收、扩散、变换、霍尔效应或能量传递相连。
patterns.domain: 专利、计算机编码、物理与材料研究

patterns.name: 非系数的局部伴随词触发
patterns.trigger: “an”“the”“and”“from”“of”等常见功能词，以及“energy”“loading”“reliability”等邻近词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在若干高激活位置附近，但分布并不稳定，无法单独解释全部实例；可能是系数术语句法环境的伴随信号。

en.concept: TEM letter fragment and several lexical coincidences
en.description: The clearest activation is for the TEM letter fragment (legal CONTEMPT, microscope TEM, code TEMPLATE); also observed are commodity in commercial contexts and sporadic triggers such as Atomic, Reduce/Taken, and citation R3, across multiple domains.

patterns.name: TEM abbreviation and tokenization
patterns.context: In legal texts, “CONTEMPT TO” appears, with activation concentrated on the TEM letter fragment created by tokenization; electron microscopy abbreviation «TEM»10 also occurs.

patterns.name: commodity and commodity contexts
patterns.context: commodity refers to goods, energy, or the underlying asset of a futures contract; also appears in “lucrative commodity”, meaning information with commercial value.

patterns.name: Attribute template identifier
patterns.context: In the uppercase configuration key ATTR_BLOCKS_TEMPLATE, TEM is an internal fragment of TEMPLATE.

patterns.name: Energy-related proper name
patterns.context: Appears in the name of the statute 《Atomic Energy Act》.

patterns.name: Truncated word fragments in a disease/laboratory title
patterns.context: The title reads “Devices to Reduce the Volume of Blood Taken for Laboratory”; activation falls on fragments in Reduce and Taken.

patterns.name: Bibliographic citation marker
patterns.context: Appears in a bracketed citation marker in a passage about bacterial research; nearby are other activated words such as TEM and Atomic, but there is no apparent shared semantics here.

1_2051.concept: TEM字母片段及若干词汇偶合
1_2051.description: 激活最明显的是 TEM 字母片段（法律 CONTEMPT、显微镜 TEM、代码 TEMPLATE）；另见 commodity 商品语境，以及 Atomic、Reduce/Taken、引文 R3 等零散触发，整体跨领域。

patterns.name: TEM缩写与分词
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现“CONTEMPT TO”，激活集中在被切分的 TEM 字母片段；另有电子显微镜缩写 «TEM»10。

patterns.name: commodity及商品语境
patterns.context: commodity 指商品、能源或期货合约标的；另出现表示信息具有商业价值的 lucrative commodity。

patterns.name: 属性模板标识符
patterns.context: 大写配置键 ATTR_BLOCKS_TEMPLATE 中，TEM 是 TEMPLATE 的内部片段。

patterns.name: 能量相关专名
patterns.context: 出现在《Atomic Energy Act》这一法规名称中。
patterns.domain: 放射性管制与能源法规

patterns.name: 疾病/实验室标题中的截断词片段
patterns.context: 标题写作“Devices to Reduce the Volume of Blood Taken for Laboratory”，激活片段落在 Reduce 和 Taken。

patterns.name: 文献引文标记
patterns.context: 出现在细菌研究段落的方括号引文标记中；附近另有 TEM、Atomic 等激活词，但此处没有明显共同语义。

en.description: Activation is dispersed: clearer responses cover commodity in its goods/material sense, complex in complex relationships, and isolated words or expressions such as complete, a headline dash, constitute, and introduced; there are also subword fragments and function-word activations, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Use of commodity
patterns.context: In “a desired commodity” or “As a commodity”, refers to an item that can be obtained, produced, or traded; paragraph 4 also contains “commodity price effects”.

patterns.name: Complex structures or processes
patterns.context: Describes complexity in a life cycle, support mechanism, or the binding relationship between a drug and carrier molecule.

patterns.name: Complete/entire
patterns.context: “They are complete with the prior comments” describes attachments or exchanged files that include previous comments.

patterns.name: Dash after a newspaper name
patterns.context: A news item begins with an uppercase newspaper name and publisher information in parentheses, followed by a dash and the article text.

patterns.name: Nominalized causative/constitutive expression
patterns.context: constitute is used to describe parasites as a major disease burden.

patterns.name: Sample introduction expression
patterns.context: A blood sample is introduced into a sealed, evacuated test container.

patterns.name: Word forms and morphological fragments
patterns.context: Activation covers tokenized fragments within words; the bottled water fragment recurs, while another example comes from an uppercase proper name/headline.

patterns.name: Other local activations of common function words or technical terms
patterns.context: Scattered within sentences, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition.

1_2051.concept: 词汇与技术文本局部特征
1_2051.description: 激活分散：较明显地覆盖 commodity 的商品/物质用法、complex 的复杂关系，以及 complete、报头破折号、constitute、introduced 等孤立词或表达；另有词片段和功能词激活，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: commodity 用法
patterns.context: “a desired commodity”或“As a commodity”语境，指可供获取、生产或交易的物品；第4段另有 commodity price effects。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、投资/经济文本

patterns.name: 复杂结构或过程
patterns.context: 形容生命周期、支持机制或药物与载体分子的结合关系复杂。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 完整/齐全
patterns.context: “They are complete with the prior comments”，描述附件或交换文件包含此前评论。

patterns.name: 报纸名称后的破折号
patterns.context: 新闻条目以全大写报纸名称及括号内出版方信息开头，破折号后接报道正文。

patterns.name: 名词化使动/构成表达
patterns.context: 以 constitute 描述寄生虫构成重大疾病负担。

patterns.name: 样本导入表达
patterns.context: 血液样本被引入密封抽真空的测试容器。

patterns.name: 词形与构词碎片
patterns.context: 激活覆盖词内部的分词片段；bottled water 片段重复出现，另一例来自大写专名/报头。

patterns.name: 其他常见功能词或技术词局部激活
patterns.context: 零散落在句中，未见稳定的共同语义或句法条件。

en.description: The most stable trigger is the word form complex: it refers both to complex situations, objects, or processes and, as a noun, to molecular complexes; it occurs across genres, with local meaning varying by domain.

patterns.name: complex and its forms
patterns.context: The word form complex functions as an adjective or noun, modifying systems, medical conditions, processes, relationships, or residential facilities; it appears in different sentence positions, with no fixed surrounding context
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary English, including medical abstracts, patent background, Wikipedia, and lifestyle guides

patterns.name: Noun complex meaning molecular complex
patterns.context: complex is a noun referring to a complex associated with molecules, receptors, or immune substances, often in contexts of extraction, testing, or analysis

patterns.name: No clear shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: Only the word’s occurrence is shared; there are no other identifiable common semantic or contextual features

1_2051.description: 最稳定的触发是词形 complex：既指复杂的情形、对象或过程，也作名词指分子复合物；跨文体出现，局部语义随领域变化。

patterns.name: complex 及其形态
patterns.context: 词形 complex 作形容词或名词，修饰系统、病情、过程、关系或居住设施；出现在句中不同位置，前后文并不固定
patterns.domain: 跨学科英语，包括医学摘要、专利背景、维基百科及生活指南

patterns.name: 名词 complex 表示分子复合物
patterns.context: complex 作名词，指与分子、受体或免疫物质相关的复合物，常出现在提取、检测或分析的语境中

patterns.name: 未见明显共同触发模式
patterns.trigger: 标记词均为 «complex»10，但词义及局部搭配与其他段不一致
patterns.context: 仅有该词的出现，缺少可确认的其他共享语义或上下文特征

en.description: Primarily responds to the spelling sequence supers, covering supersede, superseding, and supersedeas in legal texts, and supersomes in biomedicine; also activates on “ઇન્ટરનેટ” and “શેર” in a Gujarati passage, which does not fit the main pattern.

patterns.name: The word fragment supers
patterns.context: Activation centers on the beginning or interior of words starting with supers; these include both uninterrupted spellings and forms split by corpus tokenization markers.

patterns.name: Gujarati social vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in Gujarati text following the Github string stream_notification_disable_button, with no clear connection to the legal root supers.

1_2051.description: 主要对 supers 拼写序列有反应，覆盖法律中的 supersede、superseding、supersedeas，以及生物医学中的 supersomes；另在一段 Gujarati 文本中激活于“ઇન્ટરનેટ”“શેર”，与主模式不符。

patterns.name: 单词片段 supers
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 supers 开头的词内部或词首；既包括普通连续拼写，也包括语料分词标记切开的形式。
patterns.domain: 法律文本与生物医学摘要

patterns.name: Gujarati 社交词汇
patterns.context: 出现在 Github 字符串 stream_notification_disable_button 后的 Gujarati 文本中，与法律词根 supers 无明显联系。
patterns.domain: 代码字符串及 Gujarati 文本

en.description: The most stable pattern is strong activation on the “раз” fragment in various Slavic words, including forms meaning development, difference, regulation, and separator. There are also weaker isolated activations for Polish “świętego” and English “essential”.

patterns.name: The “раз” stem in Slavic words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the “раз” stem fragment in Cyrillic or Latin transliteration; subsequent forms and meanings vary, with no required syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Bulgarian parliamentary text, Russian Q&A/encyclopedia, and programming text

patterns.name: Fragment in Polish religious text
patterns.context: Activation appears in Polish biblical/liturgical text, in religious titles such as “Listu świętego Pawła”; it has no clear morphological correspondence with the other highly activated fragments.
patterns.domain: Polish religious text (content hosted on Github)

patterns.name: Fragment in English Jainism vocabulary
patterns.context: Appears in the explanation of Jainism’s “six essential duties”; the word recurs, but activation is moderate, with other low-intensity markers nearby.

1_2051.description: 最稳定的模式是多种斯拉夫语词中“раз”片段的强激活，涵盖发展、不同、规定、分隔符等词形。另有波兰语“świętego”和英文“essential”的较弱孤立激活。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语词中的“раз”词干
patterns.context: 激活落在西里尔或拉丁转写的“раз”词干片段上；后续词形和词义各异，不要求特定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 保加利亚语议会文本、俄语问答/百科及编程文本

patterns.name: 波兰语宗教文本中的片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在波兰语圣经/礼仪文字中，处于“Listu świętego Pawła”等宗教称谓里；与其余高激活片段无明显词形对应。
patterns.domain: 波兰语宗教文本（Github 收录内容）

patterns.name: 英语 Jainism 词汇中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Jainism 的“six essential duties”说明中；该词重复出现，但激活仅为中等，附近有其他低强度标记。

en.description: Primarily responds to the in-word substring「раз」in Cyrillic text across varied word forms and styles; also responds to different words beginning with「ś」in two Polish passages, which cannot be explained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: Bulgarian root -раз-
patterns.context: 「раз」appears as a contiguous in-word substring in passages; following suffixes and sentence meanings vary, with no fixed syntactic position required
patterns.domain: Bulgarian political texts, technical Q&A, and other texts; also found in Russian word forms

patterns.name: Polish święt- word form
patterns.context: In Polish religious text, the activation marker falls on the initial letter ś of świętymi

patterns.name: Polish środk- word form
patterns.context: In a Polish sentence, the activation marker falls on the initial letter ś of środkami
patterns.domain: Polish EuroParl text discussing funds needed for biodiversity

1_2051.concept: 多语种特定字母串检测
1_2051.description: 主要响应西里尔文字中的词内子串「раз」，跨多种词形和文体；另在两段波兰语中响应以「ś」开头的不同词，二者不能由主模式解释。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词根-раз-
patterns.context: 片段中「раз」作为词内连续子串出现；后续词尾和句子含义多样，不要求固定句法位置
patterns.domain: 保加利亚语政治文本、技术问答及其他文本；也见俄语词形

patterns.name: 波兰语 święt- 词形
patterns.context: 波兰语宗教语句中，激活标记落在 świętymi 的首字母 ś
patterns.domain: Github 中的波兰语宗教文本

patterns.name: 波兰语 środk- 词形
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中，激活标记落在 środkami 的首字母 ś
patterns.domain: EuroParl 波兰语文本，讨论生物多样性所需资金

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the legal title “Defender” for attorneys, especially Public Defender and variants such as Federal, County, and Appellate; also activates on the personal title “the Defender of Gibraltar” in a book catalog.

patterns.name: Public Defender title
patterns.context: Appears in attorney lists or counsel descriptions in legal rulings, usually preceded by an institutional or rank modifier and followed by appointed, a possessive, a name, or a comma
patterns.domain: U.S. court rulings, appellate opinions, and attorney lists

patterns.name: Defender in book catalogs
patterns.context: A personal title in a book catalog entry, referring to the Defender of Gibraltar; not a legal professional title

1_2051.description: 主要对法律文本中律师职衔“Defender”强烈响应，尤其 Public Defender 及其 Federal、County、Appellate 等变体；另对书目中人物称号“the Defender of Gibraltar”激活。

patterns.name: Public Defender 职衔
patterns.context: 出现在法律判决的律师名单或代理人介绍中，通常前接机构或职级修饰语，后接 appointed、所有格、姓名或逗号
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、上诉意见及律师名单

patterns.name: 书名目录中的 Defender
patterns.context: 作为书籍目录条目中的人物称号，指直布罗陀的 Defender；不是法律职业职衔

en.description: Primarily responds to the split-written tambourine/tambourica stem and uppercase or nearly uppercase NEGLIGENCE in legal disclaimers; a few highlights fall on place names, personal names, or entry terms, which cannot be explained by these two patterns.

patterns.name: tambourine-related words
patterns.context: The word is split into a part beginning with tamb, followed by ourine/ourica; appears in contexts such as musical instruments, band members, and song descriptions.
patterns.domain: Music reviews and band profiles, ethnomusic introductions

patterns.name: negligence in legal disclaimers
patterns.context: Appears in disclaimers, damages, and liability clauses, often alongside words such as damages, liability, contract, and tort; the second passage also contains «REMEDIES FOR» before negligence.
patterns.domain: Legal disclaimers, software licenses, and liability clauses

patterns.name: Unexplained local collocations
patterns.context: These highlighted passages occur in personal names, place names, or entry text; the available context is insufficient to establish a connection to the main trigger patterns.

1_2051.description: 主要响应拆分书写的 tambourine/tambourica 词干，以及法律免责条款中大写或近似大写的 NEGLIGENCE；少数高亮落在地名、人名或条目词上，无法由这两类模式解释。

patterns.name: tambourine相关词
patterns.context: 词被拆分为以 tamb 开头、后接 ourine/ourica；出现在乐器、乐队人员、歌曲描述等语境。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论与乐队资料、民族音乐介绍

patterns.name: 法律免责声明中的 negligence
patterns.context: 出现在免责、损害赔偿及责任条款中，常与 damages、liability、contract、tort 等词同现；第2段还出现 negligence 前的 «REMEDIES FOR»。
patterns.domain: 法律免责声明、软件许可及责任条款

patterns.name: 未解释的局部搭配
patterns.context: 这些高亮片段分别处于人名、地名或条目文本中；现有上下文不足以确认它们与主要触发模式相关。

en.concept: Difficult to unify; favors specific word forms
en.description: Activations mainly fall on legal prohibition terms enjoined/enjoining; there are also strong activations on the coff stem in coffins and on screw (including screw it up), the latter two appearing respectively in burial accounts and technical or colloquial contexts.

patterns.name: Injunction and judicial prohibition terms
patterns.context: Appears in court rulings or legal discussions describing a court prohibiting a party or government from continuing an action, enforcing a law, or carrying out a project; often co-occurs with “court,” “restrained,” “from,” and “enforcement.”

patterns.name: coffins stem
patterns.context: Appears in accounts related to funerals, burial, or body transport; the stem is split in the annotation, and the complete word is「coffins」.

patterns.name: screw and screw it up
patterns.context: One occurrence is the noun「screw」in an orthopedic screw patent text; another is the verb in the colloquial phrase「screw it up」. They share only spelling, not meaning or context.
patterns.domain: Patent technical text; colloquial HackerNews comments

1_2051.concept: 难以统一；偏向特定词形
1_2051.description: 激活主要落在法律禁令词 enjoined/enjoining；另对 coffins 中的 coff 词干及 screw（含 screw it up）有强激活，后两类分别见于埋葬叙述和技术、口语语境。

patterns.name: injunction及司法禁令用语
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决或法律论述中，描述法院禁止当事人或政府继续行动、执行法律或开展项目；常与「court」「restrained」「from」「enforcement」等同现。

patterns.name: coffins 词干
patterns.context: 出现在葬礼、埋葬或尸体运输相关叙述中；词干被拆分标注，完整词为「coffins」。

patterns.name: screw 及 screw it up
patterns.context: 一处是骨科螺钉专利文本中的名词「screw」，另一处是口语短语「screw it up」中的动词；仅有共同字形，语义和语境不同。
patterns.domain: 专利技术文本；HackerNews 口语评论

en.description: Across all passages, the strongest activation occurs on Canal, usually referring to a canal or canal district; there are also proper-name uses in anatomical duct names, the horse name Canaletto, and Canal Rest House.

patterns.name: Canal (waterway)
patterns.context: The token Canal itself is a strong trigger across all passages; it is usually part of a proper name referring to a canal, waterway, canal district, or related facility.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic or explanatory texts about geography, transport, history, law, sports lists, and other topics

patterns.name: Bridges and waterway geography around canals
patterns.context: The canal is part of a bridge crossing, nearby water system, or geographic route; in some passages, Canal is part of a compound proper name.

patterns.name: Canals as historical transport and trade infrastructure
patterns.context: Canals appear alongside construction, freight, migration history, or shipping routes.
patterns.domain: Local history, transport history, and geographic encyclopedias

patterns.name: Panama Canal and Canal Zone
patterns.context: Contexts concerning the Panama Canal, the Canal Zone, vessel passage, treaties, or territorial jurisdiction.

patterns.name: Anatomical duct names
patterns.context: Canal appears in the proper name of a body structure, not a waterway; the other nearby entries are also anatomical terms.

patterns.name: Canaletto in a racehorse name
patterns.context: The activation falls on the substring Canal in the horse name Canaletto, not on the waterway meaning.

patterns.name: Canal Rest House facility name
patterns.context: Canal and Rest House form a facility name; surrounding text gives information about people’s positions and village locations.

1_2051.description: 所有片段都在 Canal 上出现最强激活，通常指运河或运河区；另有解剖学管道名、马名 Canaletto 和 Canal Rest House 等专名用法。

patterns.name: Canal（交通水道）
patterns.context: token Canal 本身是所有片段的强触发点；多为专名的一部分，指运河、航道、运河区或相关设施。
patterns.domain: 地理、交通、历史、法律、体育名单等百科或说明性文本

patterns.name: 运河周边的桥梁与水道地理
patterns.context: 运河作为桥梁跨越对象、邻近水系或地理路线的一部分；有些段落的 Canal 是复合专名。
patterns.domain: 交通基础设施与地理描述

patterns.name: 运河作为历史交通与贸易设施
patterns.context: 运河与修建、货运、移民史或航运路线共同出现。
patterns.domain: 地方史、交通史与地理百科

patterns.name: 巴拿马运河及运河区
patterns.context: 巴拿马运河、运河区及船只通行、条约或领土管辖语境。

patterns.name: 解剖学中的管道名称
patterns.context: Canal 出现在人体结构专名中，而非水道；其余附近条目也是解剖学术语。

patterns.name: 赛马专名中的 Canaletto
patterns.context: 激活落在马名 Canaletto 的子串 Canal 上，并非运河含义。

patterns.name: Canal Rest House 地名设施
patterns.context: Canal 与 Rest House 构成设施名称，周边是人物任职和村镇地点信息。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、地方地名介绍

en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on names or terms containing Huss (Hussain, Husserl, Hussars, etc.), and also respond clearly to the complete word overtime; the latter spans legal, poetic, and explanatory contexts, with no clear semantic connection between the two.

patterns.name: Huss- stem and proper names
patterns.context: Names, a philosopher’s surname, or a military unit name beginning with Huss; subsequent spellings vary and may span tokens
patterns.domain: Biographies, philosophical bibliographies, historical/military accounts, and web text

patterns.name: overtime word form
patterns.context: The complete word appears in wage/damages items or in general accounts such as poetry or superstition
patterns.domain: Legal documents, poetry, popular explanatory prose

1_2051.description: 激活主要集中于含 Huss 的人名或词项（Hussain、Husserl、Hussars 等），也明显响应完整词 overtime；后者跨法律、诗歌和说明文语境，二者未见明确语义联系。

patterns.name: Huss-词干与专名
patterns.context: 出现以 Huss 开头的姓名、哲学家姓氏或军团名称；后续拼写各异，可能跨 token
patterns.domain: 人物传记、哲学书目、历史/军事叙述及网页文本

patterns.name: overtime 词形
patterns.context: 完整词出现在工资/损害项目中，或诗歌、迷信等一般叙述中
patterns.domain: 法律文书、诗歌、通俗说明文

en.description: High activations fall respectively on a fragment of vulnerable, the beginning of the proper name Quad, the place name Cornwall, and a Portuguese corre- fragment; these word forms belong to different contexts, with no common semantics or stable syntactic condition.

patterns.name: vulneráveis
patterns.context: In Portuguese, describes people or infrastructure that are susceptible to harm or in a vulnerable state; the word is split in the annotation.
patterns.domain: European Parliament political texts, philosophical discussions

patterns.name: Quad names
patterns.context: Part of proper names: Quad-channel, Quad City, QuadSport; names span word boundaries or include hyphens.
patterns.domain: Hardware specifications, U.S. law, motorcycle advertising

patterns.name: Cornwall place name
patterns.context: The proper name Cornwall; one passage is a place name, and another is a historical account about the place.
patterns.domain: Historical figures and local history, encyclopedias

patterns.name: False-positive word endings
patterns.context: Portuguese words beginning with corre- are split; the high activation falls on an identically spelled fragment, but the continuations form correta and correio respectively.

1_2051.description: 高激活分别落在 vulnerable 的词片、Quad 专名开头、Cornwall 地名，以及葡语 corre- 词片；这些词形分属不同语境，未见共同语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: vulneráveis
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中形容人群或基础设施容易受损、处于脆弱状态；词被拆分标记。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会政治文本、哲学论述

patterns.name: Quad 名称
patterns.context: 作为专名的一部分：Quad-channel、Quad City、QuadSport；跨越单词边界或连字符组成名称。
patterns.domain: 硬件规格、美国法律、摩托车广告

patterns.name: Cornwall 地名
patterns.context: 专名 Cornwall；一段是地名，一段是关于该地的历史叙述。
patterns.domain: 古籍人物与地方史、百科全书

patterns.name: 错误响应词尾
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中 corre- 开头的词被切分；高激活落在拼写相同的片段，但后续分别构成 correta 和 correio。
patterns.domain: 软件问答、欧洲议会发言

en.description: Strong activations span multiple languages and domains, mainly falling on several word-form fragments: Portuguese vulner, English cris, overtime, and the applic stem; enlisted also occurs. There is no single stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Portuguese vulneráveis stem
patterns.context: In Portuguese, describes people or things that are vulnerable or susceptible to harm; in [1] it refers to impoverished groups, and in [2] to house foundations. High activation falls on the stem vulner.

patterns.name: English crispy stem
patterns.context: In English food descriptions, describes a crisp texture; [3] is part of the name of a refrigerator crisper drawer, and [4] describes the texture of caramel popcorn.

patterns.name: overtime stem
patterns.context: In English accounts, appears in the fixed expression minds will work overtime, or in poetry where the author writes overtime; both involve exceeding the usual degree or continuing creative work, but the contexts differ.

patterns.name: English enlisted
patterns.context: A biographical account of joining or serving in the military, specifically participating in the Mexican–American War.

patterns.name: Italian applicare stem
patterns.context: In Italian or French contexts involving policies, rules, or instruments, means to implement, apply, or be applicable; the two occurrences concern applying rules and the applicability of regulations for measuring devices.
patterns.domain: EU Parliament policy texts, regulatory texts

patterns.name: English applicator
patterns.context: In a medical experimental method, refers to an instrument used to deliver sound; it is orthographically similar to the preceding applicare/applicables stems, but differs in meaning and language.

1_2051.description: 强激活覆盖多种语言和领域，主要落在若干词形片段：葡语 vulner、英语 cris、overtime，以及 applic 词干；另有 enlisted。没有单一稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 葡语 vulneráveis 词干
patterns.context: 葡语中描述人群或事物容易受伤害、处于脆弱状态；在[1]指贫困群体，在[2]指房屋地基。高激活落在词干 vulner。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本；哲学/论述散文

patterns.name: 英语 crispy 词干
patterns.context: 英语食品介绍中描述食物的酥脆口感；[3]为冰箱保鲜抽屉名称的一部分，[4]为焦糖爆米花的口感描述。
patterns.domain: 产品说明、食品宣传文案

patterns.name: overtime 词干
patterns.context: 英语叙述中出现固定表达 minds will work overtime，或诗歌中作者写作 overtime；语义均涉及超出通常程度或持续创作，但语境不同。

patterns.name: 英语 enlisted
patterns.context: 人物传记叙述加入军队或服役，具体为参加美墨战争。

patterns.name: 意大利语 applicare 词干
patterns.context: 意大利语或法语中的政策、规则、器具等语境，表示实施、适用或可适用；两处分别是应用规则与适用测量装置法规。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会政策文本、法规文本

patterns.name: 英语 applicator
patterns.context: 医学实验方法中指用于传递声音的器具；与前述 applicare/applicables 词干在拼写上相似，但语义和语言不同。

en.concept: BSD licenses and code copyright text
en.description: Most strongly responds to BSD licenses and software copyright notices, including BSD, rights reservations, and line-break formatting; sporadic activations also occur in contract transaction language, VR product copy, and Portuguese social-assistance statements.

patterns.name: BSD license markers
patterns.context: BSD appears in license text, copyright notices, project metadata, or discussions of BSD systems and variants; it is sometimes adjacent to license, License, license numbers, or variants.
patterns.domain: Open-source software, legal texts, technical discussions, and software package metadata

patterns.name: Copyright and rights-reservation statements
patterns.context: Appears in source-code headers, copyright ownership, or contributor statements, often alongside BSD license information.
patterns.domain: GitHub source-code comments and license notices

patterns.name: Line separators and line-break markers
patterns.context: Appears in multi-line code comments with asterisks or in tabular text, marking line breaks or line boundaries.

patterns.name: Transaction language in legal clauses
patterns.context: Amendment clauses in contracts discuss BSD transactions and what they are deemed to constitute; shares the BSD string with other license notices but occurs in a different context.

patterns.name: Consumer product description terms
patterns.context: Product marketing copy describes a VR headset experience, followed by use cases such as gaming and movies; other highlighted words are distributed throughout the sentence.

patterns.name: Portuguese policy and assistance terms
patterns.context: Portuguese parliamentary text discusses emergencies, infrastructure, payments, and socially vulnerable groups; highlighted words include cross-word fragments.

1_2051.description: 最集中地响应 BSD 许可证及软件版权声明中的 BSD、保留权利和换行格式；另在合同交易用语、VR 商品文案及葡语社会援助语句中出现零散激活。

patterns.name: BSD 许可证标记
patterns.trigger: « BSD»，包括 « BSD»10-style« license»、« BSD»9-2-Clause-Patent、« BSD»93
patterns.context: 在许可证文本、版权声明、项目元数据或对 BSD 系统及其变体的讨论中出现 BSD；有时与 license、License、许可证编号或 variants 相邻。
patterns.domain: 开源软件、法律文本、技术讨论与软件包元数据

patterns.name: 版权与保留权利声明
patterns.context: 出现在源代码文件头、版权归属或贡献者声明中，常与 BSD 许可证信息并列。
patterns.domain: Github 源码注释及许可声明

patterns.name: 行分隔符及换行标记
patterns.context: 出现在带星号的多行代码注释或表格格式文本中，标记换行或行边界。
patterns.domain: 源码注释与格式化文本

patterns.name: 法律条款中的交易用语
patterns.context: 合同修订条款中讨论 BSD 交易及其被认定为何种情形；与其他许可证声明共享 BSD 字样，但语境不同。

patterns.name: 消费产品描述词
patterns.context: 商品宣传文案中描述 VR 头显体验，后接 gaming、movies 等使用场景；其余高亮词分布在句中。
patterns.domain: 消费电子产品营销文案

patterns.name: 葡语政策与援助词
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语议会文本谈及紧急事务、基础设施、支付及社会弱势群体；高亮词包含跨词片段。

en.description: Activations are scattered across code licenses and copyright notices, product strap descriptions, the historical place name Nashville, the patent term malfunctions, and the religious term indulgence; no single semantic pattern unifies them.

patterns.name: BSD license notices
patterns.context: BSD appears adjacent to license text in copyright or license notices in source-code headers; no particular project is required.

patterns.name: Chromium copyright notices
patterns.context: Appears in copyright notices at the beginning of code files, followed by an author name.

patterns.name: Nashville place name
patterns.context: Appears in a list of American Civil War battle locations, surrounded by state abbreviations and other place names.

patterns.name: -function malfunction ending
patterns.context: Appears in safety background text describing appliance malfunctions and a carbon monoxide poisoning incident; activation spans an internal word fragment.

patterns.name: Straps and adjacent word endings
patterns.context: Product descriptions discuss adjustable headbands for head-worn devices or shoulder straps on bags; activation may also relate to a modifier before strap.

patterns.name: Religious term indulgence
patterns.context: In a Hinduism and avoiding desire/sin Q&A, activation falls on an internal word fragment.

1_2051.description: 激活分散于代码许可与版权声明、商品 strap 描述、历史地名 Nashville、专利词 malfunctions 及宗教词 indulgence；没有单一语义模式可统一解释。

patterns.name: BSD 许可声明
patterns.trigger: « BSD»9，及相邻的« licensed»1 under、« license»3/4
patterns.context: 源码文件头部的版权或许可声明中，BSD 与许可文本相邻；不要求特定项目。

patterns.name: Chromium 版权声明
patterns.context: 出现在代码文件头部的版权声明中，后接作者名称。

patterns.name: 地名 Nashville
patterns.context: 出现在美国内战战役地点列表中，周围有州名缩写和其他地名。

patterns.name: 故障词尾 -function
patterns.context: 出现在描述炉具故障与一氧化碳中毒事故的安全背景文字中；激活跨越单词内部片段。

patterns.name: 肩带及相邻词尾
patterns.context: 商品描述中谈头戴设备的可调节头带，或包的肩带；激活也可能与 strap 前的描述词有关。
patterns.domain: 商品宣传、手工制品描述

patterns.name: 宗教术语 indulgence
patterns.context: 关于印度教与避免欲望/罪的问答中，激活落在单词内部片段。

en.description: All passages activate on the MAT letter sequence: primarily MAT in the all-caps “Materials and Methods” heading, but also the MAT abbreviation and split English word forms.

patterns.name: Materials and Methods section heading
patterns.context: An all-caps “Materials and Methods” heading appears in the body of an academic paper or at the end of a section; line breaks, section anchors, or divider lines often appear nearby.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, medical papers, and other academic papers

patterns.name: MAT abbreviation and letter sequence
patterns.context: The MAT letter sequence appears in tax abbreviations, headings, or split English words; the trigger is MAT itself, not a specific semantic concept.
patterns.domain: Financial texts, academic headings, and general English texts

1_2105.concept: MAT字母序列
1_2105.description: 所有段落都在 MAT 字母序列上激活：主要是全大写“材料与方法”标题中的 MAT，也包括 MAT 缩写及被拆分的英文词形。

patterns.name: 材料与方法章节标题
patterns.context: 学术论文正文或章节末尾出现全大写的“材料与方法”标题；标题前后常伴随换行、章节锚点或分隔线。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central、医学论文及其他学术论文

patterns.name: MAT缩写及其字母序列
patterns.context: MAT 字母序列出现在税务缩写、标题或被拆分的英文单词中；触发位置落在 MAT，而非特定语义概念。
patterns.domain: 财经文本、学术标题及一般英文文本

en.description: Activation almost entirely falls on the uppercase string MAT: primarily the MATERIALS AND METHODS heading in papers, but also MAT in INFLAMMATORY, the tax abbreviation MAT, and cross-word fragments such as FOR MAT.

patterns.name: Materials and Methods heading
patterns.context: Located at the boundary between the paper body and methods section, often as the all-caps section heading “MATERIALS AND METHODS”; in a few cases, the MAT string occurs in another word

patterns.name: MAT in an anti-inflammatory word
patterns.context: The word INFLAMMATORY is split into tokens, appearing in pharmacological or disease-related text; ANTI-INFLAMMATORY also occurs in the same passage

patterns.name: Minimum alternate tax abbreviation
patterns.context: Used in parentheses as an abbreviation for minimum alternate tax, in discussions of Indian budgets, special economic zones, and tax policy

1_2105.concept: 字母串 MAT
1_2105.description: 激活几乎都落在大写字母串 MAT 上：主要是论文的 MATERIALS AND METHODS 标题；也包括 INFLAMMATORY 中的 MAT、税务缩写 MAT，以及表单 FOR MAT 一类跨词片段。

patterns.name: Materials and Methods 标题
patterns.trigger: «MAT»10ERIALS，常与未标记的 AND METHODS 相邻；另有«FOR»MAT、«IN»FOR«MAT»
patterns.context: 位于论文正文与方法部分的分界处，常见大写章节标题“MATERIALS AND METHODS”；少数情况下是其他词中的字母串 MAT

patterns.name: 抗炎词中的 MAT
patterns.context: 词语 INFLAMMATORY 被分词拆开，位于药理或疾病相关文本；同段还有 ANTI-INFLAMMATORY

patterns.name: 最低替代税缩写
patterns.context: 括号内作为 minimum alternate tax 的缩写，讨论印度预算、经济特区及税收政策

en.concept: Specific word forms and initial fragments
en.description: High activation concentrates on Smart, the initial MAT in Materials, vegetables, and the initial fragment of Swedish Europaparlamentet; each occurs in a different context, with no common semantics or style apparent.

patterns.name: Word or stem Smart
patterns.context: Capitalized and lowercase forms of Smart occur in brands, headings, project names, technology, or proper nouns; position varies, and the word may be possessive or part of a longer name.
patterns.domain: Technology, news, book titles, urban planning, political projects, and general texts

patterns.name: Materials and Methods heading
patterns.context: The initial MAT in the Materials and Methods section heading of a medical paper is activated; nearby text may include a methods heading or section number.

patterns.name: Vegetable word form
patterns.context: The full word vegetables appears in lists of agricultural products, foods, or sources of antioxidants.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, agriculture, and disaster reporting

patterns.name: Initial fragment of European Parliament
patterns.context: The initial fragment of the Swedish word Europaparlamentet (European Parliament) is activated in the context of parliamentary explanations or statements.
patterns.domain: European politics and Swedish parliamentary texts

1_2105.concept: 特定词形与词首片段
1_2105.description: 高激活集中于 Smart、Materials 的词首 MAT、vegetables，以及瑞典语 Europaparlamentet 的词首片段；各自出现在不同语境，未见统一语义或文体。

patterns.name: 单词或词干 Smart
patterns.context: 大小写形式的 Smart 出现在品牌、标题、项目名称、技术或专名中；位置不限，可带所有格或与后续词组成名称。
patterns.domain: 科技、新闻、书名、城市规划、政治项目及一般文本

patterns.name: 材料与方法标题
patterns.context: 医学论文中 Materials and Methods 章节标题的词首 MAT 被激活；周围可见方法节标题或章节编号。

patterns.name: 蔬菜词形
patterns.context: vegetables 完整词形出现在列举农产品、食物或抗氧化物来源的语境中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究及农业、灾害报道

patterns.name: 欧洲议会词首片段
patterns.context: 瑞典语文本中 Europaparlamentet（欧洲议会）一词的词首片段被激活，位于议会解释或声明的语境。
patterns.domain: 欧洲政治、瑞典语议会文本

en.description: Activation concentrates on the contiguous uppercase substring MAT: most commonly in the paper heading MATERIALS, and elsewhere in INFLAMMATORY, the tax abbreviation MAT, and FORMAT.

patterns.name: Materials and Methods heading
patterns.context: Appears at the end of the paper body, at the start of a methods section heading; often accompanied by a line break or section number

patterns.name: MAT in an inflammatory word
patterns.context: The uppercase medical term “INFLAMMATORY” contains the contiguous uppercase substring MAT

patterns.name: Tax abbreviation MAT
patterns.context: MAT is an abbreviation for the tax term minimum alternate tax

patterns.name: MAT in a file format
patterns.context: FORMAT in an uppercase file-format instruction contains the contiguous substring MAT

1_2105.concept: 大写子串 MAT
1_2105.description: 激活集中在大写连续子串 MAT：最常见于论文标题 MATERIALS，其余出现在 INFLAMMATORY、税务缩写 MAT 和 FORMAT 中。

patterns.name: 材料方法标题
patterns.context: 出现在论文正文末尾、方法部分标题开头；常伴随换行或章节编号
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文及学术论文

patterns.name: 炎症词中的 MAT
patterns.context: 大写医学术语“INFLAMMATORY”内部包含连续大写子串 MAT
patterns.domain: 医学、神经炎症相关文本

patterns.name: 税务缩写 MAT
patterns.context: MAT 作为税务术语 minimum alternate tax 的缩写

patterns.name: 文件格式中的 MAT
patterns.context: 大写文件格式指令中的 FORMAT 包含连续子串 MAT

en.concept: Distance word forms and distance concepts
en.description: Primarily sensitive to distance and its compound long-distance, spanning spatial separation, travel distance, and abstract distance; there are also anomalous activations in two biomedical passages, one on a paper-heading fragment and the other on a kinase term.

patterns.name: Hyphenated distance word
patterns.context: Distance combines with the preceding long to form a hyphenated compound; passage 4 also describes a long-distance driving scenario.

patterns.name: Standalone distance
patterns.context: Distance is a noun denoting spatial separation, travel distance, or abstract distance from truth; it may occur with a preposition or in a measurement description.
patterns.domain: Philosophy, network technology, running, and nanomaterials

patterns.name: Other weakly related or anomalous activations
patterns.context: Activation falls on a split paper-heading fragment or biochemical term, with no apparent relation to the word form distance.

1_2105.concept: distance 词形及距离概念
1_2105.description: 主要对 distance 及其复合词 long-distance 敏感，涵盖空间间隔、行进距离和抽象距离；另有两段生物医学文本的异常激活，分别落在论文标题片段和激酶术语上。

patterns.name: 连字符距离词
patterns.context: distance 与前置 long 组成连字符复合词；第 4 段中还出现长距离驾驶情境。

patterns.name: 独立的 distance
patterns.context: distance 作为名词，表示空间间隔、行进距离或抽象的真理距离；可带介词或出现在测量描述中。
patterns.domain: 哲学、网络技术、跑步、纳米材料

patterns.name: 其他弱关联或异常激活
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的论文标题词片段或生化术语上，与 distance 词形无明显关系。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on stimul- medical vocabulary and formerly in former-name explanations; other cases include hyphenated compounds, competitions and after in event announcements, and site. The Swedish passage [1] has no clear corresponding trigger word.

patterns.name: “stimul” stem
patterns.context: The word occurs in physiological, medical, or pharmacological contexts, referring to a stimulant, stimulus, or substance with a stimulating effect; activation spans word forms

patterns.name: “formerly”
patterns.context: Used to introduce an object's former name or historical identity
patterns.domain: Legal cases, historical notes, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Hyphenated compounds
patterns.context: A hyphen occurs within a compound or numerical modifier; when present, it also marks nearby word fragments

patterns.name: “after” at the end of a passage
patterns.context: Appears in the event-scheduling phrase “right after”

patterns.name: Event and competition vocabulary
patterns.context: Descriptions of pet costume events, awards, and winners

patterns.name: “site”
patterns.context: Used as the name of a location or specific venue

1_2105.concept: 词形与局部搭配特征
1_2105.description: 激活主要落在 stimul- 医学词汇和 formerly 旧称说明；另有连字符复合形式、活动公告中的比赛及 after，以及 site。瑞典语段[1]未见明确对应触发词。

patterns.name: “stimul”词干
patterns.context: 该词出现在生理、医学或药理语境中，指刺激物、刺激因素或具有刺激作用的物质；跨词形激活

patterns.name: “formerly”
patterns.context: 用于引出对象的旧名称或历史身份
patterns.domain: 法律判例、历史说明、百科条目

patterns.name: 包含“-”的复合形式
patterns.context: 连字符位于复合词或数字修饰语内部；出现时同时标记邻近词片段

patterns.name: 段落结束处的“after”
patterns.context: 出现在活动安排的短语“right after”中

patterns.name: 活动与比赛词汇
patterns.context: 宠物装扮活动及奖项、获奖者的说明

patterns.name: “site”
patterns.context: 作为地点或特定场地的名称使用
patterns.domain: 活动公告、历史地理说明

en.concept: Common noun fragments such as number / devices
en.description: Activation mainly occurs on “number” and quantity expressions such as “a number of,” and is also common on “devices” in patents; other activations include medical services, cell expression, alcohol treatment, prime-number questions, and several intra-word subword fragments, with no unified semantics.

patterns.name: number and its collocations
patterns.context: In noun phrases, denotes a quantity, several objects, or a number; activation concentrates on number, commonly in “a number of” or “a prime number?”
patterns.domain: Patent, medical, public health, encyclopedic, literary, and mathematical texts

patterns.name: devices
patterns.context: The plural noun devices occurs in descriptions of technical or wireless communication devices

patterns.name: cells and mRNAs
patterns.context: Describes cells expressing mRNA, or cells in tissue or ligaments

patterns.name: Health service descriptors
patterns.context: Describes the principles, features, provision, and staffing of mental health services

patterns.name: Behavioral treatment context
patterns.context: Discusses alcohol dependence treatment and adjunctive treatment plans

patterns.name: Inflectional endings and intra-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls within or at the end of split words, including semiconductor, aseptic, rattlesnake, canyons, incompressible, portability, and communication; there is no consistent local semantic condition
patterns.domain: Patents, encyclopedic texts, and literary texts

patterns.name: Prime-number judgment format
patterns.context: Poses a truth-value judgment with “Is … a prime number?” followed by True/False

1_2105.concept: number / devices 等常见名词片段
1_2105.description: 主要激活于“number”及“a number of”等数量表达，也常见于专利中的“devices”；另有医学服务、细胞表达、酒精治疗、质数问句，以及若干词内子词片段激活，彼此语义并不统一。

patterns.name: number 及其搭配
patterns.context: 名词短语中表示数量、若干对象或一个数；激活位置集中在 number，常见于“a number of”或“a prime number?”
patterns.domain: 专利、医学、公共卫生、百科、文学及数学文本

patterns.name: devices
patterns.context: 复数名词 devices，出现在技术装置或无线通信装置的描述中

patterns.name: cells 与 mRNAs
patterns.context: 描述细胞表达 mRNA、组织或韧带中的细胞情况

patterns.name: 健康服务描述词
patterns.context: 描述心理健康服务的原则、特征、供给与人员配置

patterns.name: 行为治疗语境
patterns.context: 谈酒精依赖治疗及辅助治疗方案

patterns.name: 分词词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的词内部或词尾，涉及 semiconductor、aseptic、rattlesnake、canyons、incompressible、portability、communication 等不同词；没有一致的局部语义条件

patterns.name: 质数判断格式
patterns.context: 以“Is … a prime number?”提出真值判断，并跟随 True/False

en.description: Strongly responds primarily to circuits referring to U.S. judicial circuits in legal texts, sections preceding statutory citations, and scope of in contexts concerning legal applicability; it also responds to patent language using “is directed to” to introduce the technical subject matter.

patterns.name: “scope of” phrase in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears in sentences discussing the scope of applicability, authority, or liability, followed by statutory provisions, procedures, employment relationships, etc.; in multiple examples, the activation falls directly on scope.

patterns.name: circuits in legal texts
patterns.context: Mentions multiple federal courts of appeals and their rulings, views, or arguments.

patterns.name: sections in statutory citations
patterns.context: Used before a statutory or regulatory number to introduce a specific provision.

patterns.name: Technical subject matter of patent applications
patterns.context: Patent descriptions use “is directed to” to introduce the technical solution or purpose addressed by the application.

1_2105.concept: 法律范围与司法辖区用语
1_2105.description: 主要对美国法律文本中表示法院巡回区的circuits、条文编号前的sections及法律适用范围语境中的scope of强烈响应；另对专利文本中“is directed to”引出技术主题的表述响应。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的“scope of”短语
patterns.context: 出现在讨论适用范围、权限或责任边界的句子中，后接法律条款、程序、雇佣关系等；多个例子中直接激活的是 scope。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 circuits
patterns.context: 提及多个联邦巡回上诉法院及其裁判、观点或论证。

patterns.name: 法律条文引用中的 sections
patterns.context: 在法条或法规编号之前，用于引出具体条文编号。

patterns.name: 专利申请的技术主题
patterns.context: 专利说明中以“is directed to”引出申请所针对的技术方案或目的。

en.concept: Set phrases and statutory terminology in legal documents
en.description: Activation mainly concentrates on two types of word strings in legal documents: “set forth,” used to cite facts, reasons, or grounds, and “subdivision” in statutory or planning contexts; several other legal-term activations are scattered and lack a common trigger condition.

patterns.name: set forth in legal opinions
patterns.context: The phrase introduces, states, or refers to reasons, facts, claimed amounts, legal provisions, or agreements listed later or earlier; common in formal judicial writing.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, legal opinions, and litigation documents

patterns.name: subdivision in statutes
patterns.context: Appears in statutory provisions, citations, or land-planning contexts; activation concentrates on a subword fragment of subdivision.
patterns.domain: Statutory citations and land-planning legal texts

patterns.name: Legal-text activations not attributable to the above phrases
patterns.context: Also occurs in court opinions or regulatory texts, but high-activation words are scattered, and the provided context does not establish a common local trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Court opinions, regulations, and administrative legal documents

1_2105.concept: 法律文书固定表达与条文术语
1_2105.description: 激活主要集中在法律文书中两类词串：引述事实、理由或依据的“set forth”，以及法条或规划语境中的“subdivision”；另有若干分散的法律术语激活，缺乏共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的 set forth
patterns.context: 该短语用于引出、陈述或指向后文/前文所列的理由、事实、请求金额、法律规定或协议；常见于裁判文书的正式句式。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律意见及诉讼文书

patterns.name: 法律条文中的 subdivision
patterns.context: 出现在法律条文、法条编号或土地规划语境中；激活集中于 subdivision 一词的分词片段。
patterns.domain: 法律条文引用、土地规划法律文本

patterns.name: 无法归入上述短语的法律文本激活
patterns.trigger: 未见稳定重复的单一触发子串；如 «institution»1、«Board»5«Commission»4ers、«directions»7
patterns.context: 同为法律判决或法规文本，但高激活词分散，无法从所给上下文确认共同的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、法规及行政法律文书

en.description: The neuron primarily responds to the verb set in U.S. legal documents, especially set forth; it also responds to legal collocations such as set out, set off, and set aside, often used to state facts or reasons, offset amounts, or request vacatur or exemption.

patterns.name: “set forth” introducing reasons or facts
patterns.context: Introduces reasons below, earlier statements, or facts to be stated in legal opinions and court orders
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and judicial documents

patterns.name: “set out” introducing facts
patterns.context: Signals in a judgment that the facts have been set out in the court's opinion

patterns.name: “set off” as an offset
patterns.context: A counterclaim seeks to offset debt using a credit memorandum

patterns.name: “set aside” for vacatur or exemption
patterns.context: In legal contexts, requests vacatur of a default judgment, reversal or correction of a sentence, or treatment of property as exempt; the specific meaning depends on the object
patterns.domain: Civil litigation, bankruptcy law, and criminal procedure case law

1_2105.concept: 法律文书中的 set 搭配
1_2105.description: 神经元主要响应美国法律文书中的动词 set，尤其是 set forth；也响应 set out、set off、set aside 等法律固定搭配，常用于陈述事实、理由、抵销或请求撤销／豁免。

patterns.name: “set forth”引出理由或事实
patterns.trigger: «set»10 «forth»，如“reasons set forth below”“facts as set forth previously”“set forth the undisputed facts”
patterns.context: 法律意见书、法院命令中引出下文理由、先前陈述或待述事实

patterns.name: “set out”引出事实
patterns.context: 判决书中提示事实已在法院意见中列出

patterns.name: “set off”抵销
patterns.trigger: “to «set»10«off» credit memos against any amounts owed”
patterns.context: 反诉请求以贷项备忘录抵销欠款

patterns.name: “set aside”撤销或豁免
patterns.context: 法律语境中请求撤销缺席判决、撤销或更正刑罚，或将财产列为豁免；具体含义取决于宾语
patterns.domain: 民事诉讼、破产法与刑事程序判例

en.concept: Setups and rulings in legal documents
en.description: Primarily responds to “set” and its collocations in legal contexts, covering vacating, offsetting, stating, allocating, listing, and scheduling; also responds to court orders, motions, statutory citations, and judgment-document formats.

patterns.name: Set and its phrasal verbs
patterns.context: Describes matters raised, scheduled, or handled by a court or party in legal texts; different collocations indicate vacating or setting aside, offsetting, stating, retaining funds, allocating property, listing considerations, and scheduling trial dates.

patterns.name: Court orders and judicial actions
patterns.context: Describes court orders, rulings, motions, or related judicial proceedings; paragraph 3 specifically concerns removing a trustee and ordering the trustee to file suit.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments and descriptions of judicial proceedings

patterns.name: Legal citations and statutory numbering
patterns.context: Activated by citations to statutes, regulations, or cases, often co-occurring with motions, court proceedings, or government debt provisions.

patterns.name: Paragraph and formatting markers in judgments
patterns.context: Appears near paragraph breaks, case narratives, and quotation formats in legal opinions; some instances may reflect document layout rather than an independent semantic trigger.

1_2105.concept: 法律文书中的设定与裁定
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律语境中的“set”及其搭配，涵盖撤销、抵销、陈述、分配、列举和排期；也响应法院命令、动议、法条引用及判决文书格式。

patterns.name: set 及其短语动词
patterns.trigger: «set»，包括“set» aside”“set»off”“set» forth”“set»-asides”“set» apart”“set» out”“set» a trial date”
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述法院或当事人提出、安排或处理事项；不同搭配分别表示撤销/搁置、抵销、陈述、留置资金、分配财产、列举考量因素及安排审判日期。

patterns.name: 法院命令与司法行动
patterns.context: 叙述法院的命令、裁定、动议或相关司法程序；第3段尤其涉及撤换受托人并命令受托人提起诉讼。
patterns.domain: 法律判决与司法程序叙述

patterns.name: 法律引用与法规编号
patterns.context: 出现法条、法规或判例引用时激活，常与动议、法院程序或政府债务规定共现。

patterns.name: 判决文书的段落与格式标记
patterns.context: 法律意见书的换段、案件叙述和引文格式附近出现；部分可能反映文书排版而非独立语义触发。

en.description: Primarily responds to procedures, litigation participants, disputed issues, and statutory numbering in legal judgments and regulatory citations; also appears with sentencing terms and descriptions of corporate or railroad organizations. Several general-purpose words activate only in legal narratives.

patterns.name: Legal propositions and reasoning in court opinions
patterns.context: Appears when a court states an issue, lists grounds for appeal, or cites legal arguments; sometimes capitalized.

patterns.name: Statutory provisions and subdivisions
patterns.context: Near statute names, section numbers, subdivisions, or regulatory citations, commonly in criminal, bankruptcy, and tax-law texts.

patterns.name: Case and litigation terminology in judgments
patterns.context: In formal references to parties, creditors, estates, claims, procedures, or courts.

patterns.name: Legal procedure verbs and requests for relief
patterns.context: When describing procedural actions such as filing a motion, requesting court action, offsetting, or vacating or correcting a judgment.

patterns.name: Sentencing context
patterns.context: When discussing terms of imprisonment, consecutive sentences, or vacating or correcting a sentence.

patterns.name: Corporate and railroad organizational relationships
patterns.context: When describing railroad ownership, the place of organization of a foreign corporation, or tax exemptions.

patterns.name: Legal collocations outside litigation
patterns.context: Describes a bill’s passage through a proposal and its alternate name; the activated word itself is general-purpose and depends on legal enactment narratives.

patterns.name: Quotative connective in testimonial narrative
patterns.context: When witness testimony recounts violent conduct; viewed in isolation, it is general-purpose, with no clear specialized legal trigger.

1_2105.concept: 法律文本与诉讼术语
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律判决与法规引文中的程序、诉讼参与者、争点和法条编号；另见刑罚术语及公司/铁路组织描述。若干泛用词只在法律叙述中激活。

patterns.name: 法院意见中的法律命题/理由
patterns.context: 在法院陈述争点、列举上诉理由或引述法律论证时出现；有时首字母大写

patterns.name: 法律条文及细分编号
patterns.context: 法条名称、条号、款项编号或法规引文附近，常见于刑事、破产、税法等法律文本

patterns.name: 判决文书中的案件与诉讼术语
patterns.context: 当事人、债权人、遗产、诉讼请求、程序或法院的正式称谓与叙述中

patterns.name: 法律程序动词与救济请求
patterns.context: 描述提出动议、请求法院采取行动、抵销或撤销/更正判决等程序行为时

patterns.name: 刑罚与量刑语境
patterns.context: 讨论刑期、连续执行或撤销/更正刑罚时

patterns.name: 公司与铁路组织关系
patterns.context: 描述铁路所有权或外国公司组织地及税收豁免时

patterns.name: 非诉讼语境中的法律搭配
patterns.context: 描述法案经某提案通过及其别称；激活词本身较泛，依附于法律制定叙述

patterns.name: 叙事性证言中的引述连接词
patterns.context: 证人证言转述暴力行为时；孤立看属于泛用语，缺少明显的专门法律触发条件
patterns.domain: 刑事判决中的证据叙述

en.description: Activations come from varied legal judgment excerpts: prominent are the varied legal collocations of set, as well as proposition, litigation procedure, judgment remedies, and contract disputes. Oil and gas, real-estate terminology, and sporadic formatting terms also occur; the activations do not form a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Set and its phrases in legal litigation
patterns.context: Describes matters raised, scheduled, vacated, offset, or stated by a court or party in legal texts; activations span different collocations and need not share a single legal meaning.
patterns.domain: Judgments, litigation procedures, and legal reasoning

patterns.name: Issues, claims, or propositions in law
patterns.context: States or discusses a proposition, claim, or disputed issue in a legal opinion; forms include both the common noun and the name Proposition 47.

patterns.name: Designation, applications, and judgment dispositions in legal documents
patterns.context: Describes criminal convictions, sentences, and procedures for seeking relief from a court; no single stable trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Parties and court-procedure markers in legal cases
patterns.context: Legal contexts such as case captions, creditor objections, court rulings, and trial proceedings; triggers may be related to formatted captions or procedural terms.
patterns.domain: Legal case captions and procedural narratives

patterns.name: Contracts, agreements, and arbitration
patterns.context: Concerns agreement terms, arbitration, counterclaims, and disputes between parties; some words also occur in other legal patterns.

patterns.name: Transaction or asset terms in specific legal fields
patterns.context: Discusses oil and gas production interests, or real estate, homesteads, and mortgages; apart from belonging to legal corpora, these have no clear shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Oil and gas interests and real-estate law

patterns.name: Sporadic highlighted words or formatting markers
patterns.context: Appears in citations, proper names, punctuation, or formatting fragments; it is unclear whether activation is semantic or caused by tokenization or formatting.
patterns.domain: Citations and formatting in legal texts

1_2105.concept: 法律诉讼文本词汇
1_2105.description: 激活来自多类法律判决片段：突出 set 的多种法律搭配，以及命题、诉讼程序、判决救济和合同争议词。另有油气、不动产术语及零散格式词；难以归纳为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的 set 及其短语
patterns.trigger: «set»（如 «set»« aside»、«set»« off»、«set» a «trial» date、«set»« forth»、«set» out）
patterns.context: 法律文本中描述法院或当事人提出、安排、撤销、抵销或陈述事项；激活分布在多种不同搭配，未必共享单一法律含义。
patterns.domain: 判决、诉讼程序及法律论证

patterns.name: 法律中的议题、主张或命题
patterns.context: 法律意见书中陈述或讨论一项命题、主张或争议事项；词形既包括普通名词，也包括 Proposition 47 的名称。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的指定、申请与判决处置
patterns.context: 描述刑事定罪、刑罚及申请法院救济的程序；未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 法律案件当事人及法院程序标记
patterns.context: 案件标题、债权人异议、法院裁定和审判程序等法律语境；触发可能与格式化标题或程序词有关。
patterns.domain: 法律案件标题与程序叙述

patterns.name: 合同、协议与仲裁
patterns.context: 围绕协议条款、仲裁、反诉及当事人争议展开；部分词也出现在其他法律模式中。

patterns.name: 特定法律领域中的交易或资产术语
patterns.context: 讨论油气生产权益或不动产、宅地及抵押；除均属法律语料外，彼此没有明显共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 零散高亮词或格式标记
patterns.context: 出现在引文、专名、标点或排版片段中，无法确认是语义触发还是分词、格式造成的激活。
patterns.domain: 法律文本中的引文与格式

en.description: Activations are concentrated in procedural and statutory expressions in U.S. case law: court motions and decisions, criminal convictions and imprisonment, and citations to legal authority. They also cover specific contexts such as bankruptcy, trusts, tax summonses, and prison administration.

patterns.name: Procedural actions and rulings in legal litigation
patterns.context: Describes court proceedings, motions filed by parties or handled by a court, scheduling trials, and vacating or correcting judgments; often occurs alongside statutes and litigation documents.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Criminal convictions, sentences, and incarcerated persons
patterns.context: Involves prisoner status, convictions, sentences or imprisonment, and lawsuits brought by prisoners.
patterns.domain: Criminal case law and prisoner litigation

patterns.name: Statutory and regulatory citations
patterns.context: Specific code, chapter, or section numbers appear, often to identify the basis for litigation, an offense, or a legal rule.

patterns.name: Legal relationships, claims, and related actions
patterns.context: Describes legal relationships and actions such as party status in bankruptcy cases, trustees recovering property, summons investigations, or claims.
patterns.domain: Civil, bankruptcy, and tax case law

patterns.name: Criminal offenses, drugs, and related violations
patterns.context: States facts of an offense, charges, controlled substances, or violations of criminal laws; sometimes linked to a conviction or statutory citation.

patterns.name: County jail facilities and county prisoner administration
patterns.context: Distinguishes local detention facilities from sentenced prisoners and discusses county board authority over county prisoners.

patterns.name: Tax authority summons
patterns.context: Requires an attorney to testify before a special agent of the tax authority; the summons is issued under a provision of the Internal Revenue Code.

patterns.name: Bankruptcy case caption and objecting creditor
patterns.context: Lists the debtor under “In the Matter of” and identifies the creditor filing an objection.

patterns.name: Trustee recovery of trust property
patterns.context: The court orders a trustee to take necessary legal action to recover title to and possession of trust property.

patterns.name: Government motion to dismiss
patterns.context: The state seeks dismissal of a lawsuit; the court denies the motion and schedules a trial date.

1_2105.concept: 美国判例法律程序与法条
1_2105.description: 激活集中于美国判例中的法律程序与法条表达：法院动议和裁判、刑事定罪及服刑、法律依据引用，并涵盖破产、信托、税务传票、监狱管理等具体法律情境。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼中的程序动作与裁判
patterns.context: 描述法院审理、当事人提出或法院处理动议、安排审判及撤销或更正判决等程序；常与法条和诉讼文件并现。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪、刑罚与羁押人员
patterns.context: 涉及囚犯身份、定罪、刑罚或服刑，以及囚犯提起的诉讼。

patterns.name: 法条与法规引用
patterns.context: 出现具体法典、章节或条款编号，常用于说明诉讼依据、犯罪依据或法律规则。

patterns.name: 法律关系、请求及相关法律行为
patterns.context: 描述破产案件当事人身份、受托人追索财产、传票调查或诉讼请求等法律关系与行为。

patterns.name: 刑事犯罪、毒品与相关违法行为
patterns.context: 陈述犯罪事实、罪名、受管制物质或违反刑事法规；有时与定罪或法条引用相连。

patterns.name: 县级监狱设施与县囚管理
patterns.context: 区分地方羁押设施与服刑囚犯，并讨论县委员会对县囚的管理权限。

patterns.name: 税务机关传票
patterns.context: 要求律师到税务机关特别代理人面前作证，传票依据《国内税收法典》条文发出。

patterns.name: 破产案件标题与异议债权人
patterns.context: 以“In the Matter of”列出债务人，并标明提出异议的债权人。

patterns.name: 受托人追回信托财产
patterns.context: 法院命令受托人采取必要诉讼，以追回信托财产的产权和占有。

patterns.name: 政府一方的撤诉动议
patterns.context: 州政府申请驳回诉讼，法院拒绝并安排审判日期。

en.concept: Statutes and judicial procedure in U.S. legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to statutory citations, subsection numbering, and litigation-procedure language in U.S. legal texts; also covers criminal convictions and imprisonment, evidentiary standards, government agencies, bankruptcy captions, and employment during reentry into society.

patterns.name: Statutory numbering and subsection format
patterns.context: Statutes or subsections are cited in legal texts; activations cluster around section symbols, parentheses, and subsection structures. Numbers or letters themselves may also be marked.

patterns.name: Procedure and rulings in litigation documents
patterns.context: Procedural language in which a court discusses jurisdiction, review, applications, or a ruling; does not require a particular statutory format.

patterns.name: Criminal convictions, sentences, and imprisonment
patterns.context: Discusses offenses, convictions, incarceration, or sentence execution; some examples also include statutory citations.
patterns.domain: Criminal justice and related statutes and judgments

patterns.name: Subsection structure and legislative terminology
patterns.context: Cites a statute’s section, subdivision, and content, often with numbering, parentheses, and normative statements.
patterns.domain: Statutory interpretation and statutory analysis in judgments

patterns.name: Evidence and legal standards in case law
patterns.context: A court states a standard of review and lists evidentiary conditions; trigger words involve subjective statements and objective evidence.

patterns.name: Jurisdictions and government agency names
patterns.context: Mentions local government agencies or facilities and discusses their statutory classification, authority, or the people they oversee.
patterns.domain: Local government laws and judicial judgments

patterns.name: Bankruptcy parties and litigation captions
patterns.context: Case captions list debtors, objecting creditors, and opposing parties; markers cluster around caption terms or party labels.
patterns.domain: Bankruptcy judgment case names and captions

patterns.name: Reentry and employment arrangements
patterns.context: Describes arrangements for work at a reentry facility after imprisonment, possibly followed by a narrative of misconduct.

1_2105.concept: 美国法律文本中的法条与司法程序
1_2105.description: 主要响应美国法律文本中的法条引用、分款编号及诉讼程序措辞；也覆盖刑事定罪服刑、证据标准、政府机构、破产案名和再入社会就业等法律语境。

patterns.name: 法条编号与分款格式
patterns.trigger: «§»、«(»、«)»及相邻的数字、字母分款，如“§ 1252(a)(1)”“§ 137, subdivision (3b)”
patterns.context: 法律文本中引述法条或细分条款，激活集中在法条符号、括号和分款结构；数字或字母本身也可能被标记。

patterns.name: 诉讼文书中的程序与裁判用语
patterns.trigger: “petition”“jurisdiction”“review”“final order”“summary judgment shall be entered”“denial of his application”
patterns.context: 法院论述管辖权、审查、申请或裁判结果的程序性语句；不要求特定法条格式。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪、刑罚与服刑
patterns.context: 讨论犯罪、定罪、监禁或刑罚执行；部分例子也带有法条引用。
patterns.domain: 刑事司法及相关法规、判决

patterns.name: 法规的分款结构与立法术语
patterns.context: 引用法规的 section、subdivision 及其内容，常伴随编号、括号和规范性陈述。
patterns.domain: 法规解释与判决中的法条分析

patterns.name: 判例中的证据与法律标准
patterns.trigger: “subjective testimony of pain”“pain standard requires”“objective medical evidence”
patterns.context: 法院陈述判断标准，并列出证据条件；触发词涉及主观陈述和客观证据。

patterns.name: 司法辖区和政府机构名称
patterns.trigger: “Indiana Department of Natural Resources”“county boards”“municipal detention facilities”
patterns.context: 提及地方政府机构或设施，并讨论其法定分类、权限或管理对象。
patterns.domain: 地方政府法规与司法判决

patterns.name: 破产案件当事人与诉讼标题
patterns.context: 案件标题列举债务人、异议债权人及对立当事人；标记集中在标题词或当事人标签。
patterns.domain: 破产判决的案名与标题

patterns.name: 再入社会与就业安排
patterns.context: 描述服刑后在再入社会机构及工作岗位的安排，随后可能叙述违规行为。
patterns.domain: 刑罚执行与再入社会叙述

en.concept: Provisions and procedural terminology in legal texts
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly in statutory subdivisions or section citations and nearby litigation, criminal conviction, and bankruptcy terminology in legal documents; also includes legal fact terms for real-estate subdivision and estate administration.

patterns.name: Statutory subdivisions
patterns.context: A statutory subdivision is cited in legal reasoning, often near a section number, a parenthetical subdivision, and an explanation of its application or content.

patterns.name: Section in statutory citations
patterns.context: A legal number follows section, often alongside subdivision, title numbers, violations, or statutory elements.

patterns.name: Case captions and litigation roles
patterns.context: In case names, party identities, appellants, or judicial institutions, with activations on legal roles or institutional terms.
patterns.domain: Bankruptcy case captions and procedural information

patterns.name: Litigation procedure and ruling language
patterns.context: Appears when describing an appeal, request, ruling, or claim; the same passage may also contain statutory citations.

patterns.name: Legal status and conviction records
patterns.context: Discusses felonies, convictions, offense elements, or treatment of conviction records; may co-occur with subdivision citations.

patterns.name: Bankruptcy procedure, property, and claims
patterns.context: In bankruptcy cases, involves the debtor, petition date, property, liens, trustee, or creditor.

patterns.name: Controlled substances and criminal statutes
patterns.context: Lists controlled substances and cites relevant provisions of the United States Code.

patterns.name: Lots and zoning terminology
patterns.context: Describes the planning, lot numbers, and streets of a residential subdivision; subdivision here means land division, not a statutory subdivision.

patterns.name: Estate administration status
patterns.context: Introduces an estate administrator and their relationship to the plaintiff.

patterns.name: Standalone section-heading marker
patterns.context: Cites a Bankruptcy Act provision and its subsection in a bankruptcy-law passage discussing rights acquired by a trustee.

1_2105.concept: 法律文本中的条款与程序术语
1_2105.description: 激活主要集中于法律文书中的法条分项/section 引用及其邻近的诉讼、刑事定罪和破产术语；另见地产分区、遗产管理等法律事实用语。

patterns.name: 法条细分项
patterns.context: 法律论证中引用法条的 subdivision，常与 section 编号、括号内分项及其适用或内容说明相邻。

patterns.name: 法条引用中的 section
patterns.context: section 后接法律编号，常伴随 subdivision、标题编号、违规行为或法条要件。

patterns.name: 案件标题与诉讼角色
patterns.trigger: «Object»10ing« Cred»2itor；« Chapter»6 13« Trustee；« Bankruptcy»2« Appellate»1« Panel»9
patterns.context: 案件名称、当事人身份、上诉方或司法机构等标题信息中，激活落在法律角色或机构称谓上。
patterns.domain: 破产案件标题与程序信息

patterns.name: 诉讼程序与裁判措辞
patterns.context: 描述上诉、请求、裁判或主张时出现；同段还可能含法条引用。

patterns.name: 法律身份及定罪记录
patterns.context: 讨论重罪、定罪、罪名要件或定罪记录如何处理；有时与 subdivision 引用并现。

patterns.name: 破产程序与财产/债权
patterns.context: 破产案件中涉及债务人、申请日、财产、留置权、受托人或债权人。
patterns.domain: 破产法判决与案件标题

patterns.name: 刑事管制物质及刑法条文
patterns.context: 列举受管制物质并引用美国法典相关刑事条款。

patterns.name: 地块与分区用语
patterns.context: 描述住宅区增建地块的规划、地块编号及街道；“subdivision”在此为土地分区而非条文分项。
patterns.domain: 地产、土地规划法律事实

patterns.name: 遗产管理身份
patterns.context: 介绍遗产管理人及其与原告的关系。

patterns.name: 单独出现的章节标题标记
patterns.context: 破产法段落中引用 Bankruptcy Act 条款及其子款，周围讨论受托人取得的权利。

en.concept: Statutory subdivisions and appellate phrasing in U.S. judgments
en.description: Activations are concentrated in U.S. legal texts, with “subdivision/subd” and parenthetical numbering in statutory citations as the most stable pattern; other contexts include “point/error” formats for appellate grounds, and criminal, procedural, tax, engineering, and family-law terminology.

patterns.name: Subdivision in statutory numbering
patterns.context: A specific statute or subdivision is cited in a legal text; activations mainly involve fragments of subdivision and parenthetical numbers, especially hierarchical statutory numbering.

patterns.name: Claims of error in appellate judgments
patterns.context: An appellate opinion or judgment summary describes a party’s grounds for appeal; common formats include point of error/point followed by alleged trial-court error.

patterns.name: Criminal conviction and sentencing terminology
patterns.context: Criminal cases discuss convictions, offenses, sentences, prior records, or the admissibility of evidence; some terms occur incidentally in statutory text.

patterns.name: Judgment and litigation-procedure language
patterns.context: Describes litigation history, court rulings, or appeals; words are broadly distributed and are not necessarily the most direct activation triggers.

patterns.name: Partition legal terminology and service of materials
patterns.context: Discusses contractors, owners, material supply, and deadlines for service of notice; “material” is marked as split in the source, and it is uncertain whether the word itself is the trigger.

patterns.name: Tax rates and tax provisions
patterns.context: Involves statutory interpretation of taxes, tax rates, or tax revenues; activations still mainly fall on adjacent fragments of statutory numbering terms.

patterns.name: Death or personal injury damages context
patterns.context: Describes the division of marital property or retirement benefits; co-occurs with appellate-court claims of error phrasing in other passages.

1_2105.concept: 美国判决中的法条分项与上诉表述
1_2105.description: 激活集中于美国法律文本，尤以法条引用中“subdivision/subd”及括号编号最稳定；另见上诉理由的“point/error”格式，以及刑事、程序、税务、工程和家庭法术语。

patterns.name: 法律条文编号中的 subdivision
patterns.trigger: “subdivision”/“subd”以及紧随其后的“(”和字母、数字编号，如“Sub»4«division»10« (»1i)” “subd»5.« (»2a)”“«sub»4«division»9« (»1a...)”
patterns.context: 法律文本中引用具体法条或分项；激活主要落在 subdivision 的词片及括号编号，尤其是条文层级编号。

patterns.name: 上诉判决中的错误主张
patterns.trigger: “point”及邻近的“error”或“the trial court erred”，如“first point of error” “first point ... the trial court erred”
patterns.context: 上诉意见或判决摘要叙述一方提出的上诉理由；常见格式为 point of error/point followed by alleged trial-court error。
