patterns.name: 刑事定罪及刑罚相关词语
patterns.context: 刑事案件中讨论定罪、罪名、刑罚、前科或证据是否可采；部分词语仅偶然出现在法条内容中。

patterns.name: 判决与诉讼程序措辞
patterns.context: 叙述诉讼经过、法院裁决或上诉；词语分布较广，且未必是最直接的激活触发点。

patterns.name: 分割的法律术语及材料送达
patterns.context: 讨论承包商、业主、材料供应与通知送达期限；“material”在原文中被切分标记，触发是否与该词本身有关不确定。
patterns.domain: 建筑工程款或留置权判决

patterns.name: 税率与税收条款
patterns.context: 涉及税款、税率或税收收入的法规解释；激活点仍主要落在相邻的条文编号词片上。

patterns.name: 死亡或人身伤害赔偿语境
patterns.trigger: “wife be paid $10,000”“retirement plan’s payments”“interest in the benefits”
patterns.context: 叙述夫妻财产或退休福利分配；与其他段落中上诉法院错误主张的措辞并存。

en.description: Primarily responds to statutory names, subdivision numbers, and their interpretation in legal texts, commonly in case-law and regulatory citations; also responds to one case caption, a passage of litigation language, and the suffix in Auctions in an email, with the latter patterns of unclear relation to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Statutory subdivisions and parenthetical numbering
patterns.context: In statutory citations or legal texts, a statute name is adjacent to numeric or lettered subdivision numbers; especially token fragments Sub/division or Sub/section followed by a number.
patterns.domain: Case law, statutes, and legal opinions

patterns.name: Explanation of subdivisions in statutory language
patterns.context: Legal texts explain the scope, content, or elements of a statutory subdivision; co-occurs with the statutory numbering pattern.

patterns.name: Court litigation and appellate language
patterns.context: Describes a party’s appeal, a court ruling, or a claim that a lower court erred; some passages also cite statutes.

patterns.name: Case citations and party captions
patterns.context: Citations, case captions, and party identity information at the beginning of judgments or bankruptcy cases.

patterns.name: Auction-related word form
patterns.context: The name of the Yahoo! Auctions website in a commercial email; unrelated to statutory or litigation contexts.

1_2105.concept: 法律条款及分项编号
1_2105.description: 主要响应法律文本中法条名称、分项编号及其释义，常见于判例和法规引用；也响应一处案件标题、一段诉讼措辞及邮件里的 Auctions 词尾，后几类与主模式关系不明。

patterns.name: 法条分项与括号编号
patterns.trigger: «section»、«subdivision»、«subdivisions»、«Sub»«division»、«Sub»«section»，以及紧随其后的如« (»1b)、« (»1i)、« (»1a) 等编号
patterns.context: 法条引用或法律文本中，法条名称与数字、字母分项编号相邻；尤其分词片段 Sub/division 或 Sub/section 后接编号。

patterns.name: 法条措辞中的细分说明
patterns.context: 法律文本解释某个分项适用范围、条款内容或构成要件；与法条编号模式同现。

patterns.name: 法院诉讼与上诉措辞
patterns.context: 叙述当事人上诉、法院裁判或主张下级法院错误；部分段落同时引用法条。

patterns.name: 判例引注与案件当事人标题
patterns.context: 判决或破产案件开头的引注、案件标题与当事人身份信息。

patterns.name: 拍卖相关词形
patterns.context: 商业邮件中的 Yahoo! Auctions 网站名称；与法条、诉讼语境无关。

en.concept: Statutes and litigation language in U.S. case law
en.description: Primarily responds to statutory subdivision citations and language about criminal convictions and appellate grounds in U.S. case law; also appears in tax provisions, estate litigation, court procedure, and sex-offense statutes.

patterns.name: Statutory subdivision and subdivision/section terminology
patterns.context: When statutes or judgments cite provisions, especially when explaining the content, scope, or legal effect of a subdivision or subsection.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and statutory law

patterns.name: Criminal convictions and appeals
patterns.context: Litigation narratives describing a defendant’s conviction, criminal charges, post-conviction relief, or appeal from a conviction.

patterns.name: Listing appellate grounds
patterns.context: An appellate opinion or judgment summary introduces multiple legal claims or alleged errors raised by a party.

patterns.name: Estate administrator in estate litigation
patterns.context: Introduces a party to estate litigation and their status as an estate administrator.

patterns.name: Statutory provisions for taxes and interest penalties
patterns.context: Statutes specify tax rates or taxable parties, or prescribe how interest and penalties are to be retained.

patterns.name: Court, trial, and judgment citations
patterns.context: Marks the trial process, court rulings, or judge information in a judgment; often adjacent to a case’s appellate narrative.

patterns.name: Sex-offense statutes
patterns.context: Cites statutes addressing child sex offenses and describes the categories of offenses listed in them.

1_2105.concept: 美国判例中的法律条文与诉讼措辞
1_2105.description: 主要响应美国判例中法条分项引用及刑事定罪、上诉理由等措辞；也出现在税法规定、遗产诉讼、法院程序和性犯罪法规语境。

patterns.name: 法条分项与 subdivision/section 术语
patterns.context: 法条或判决引用法规条文时，尤其是说明 subdivision、subsection 的内容、适用范围或法律效果。

patterns.name: 刑事定罪与上诉
patterns.context: 描述被告定罪、犯罪指控、定罪后救济或对定罪提出上诉的诉讼叙述。

patterns.name: 上诉理由的列举
patterns.context: 上诉意见或判决概述中，介绍当事人提出的多个法律主张或错误理由。

patterns.name: 遗产诉讼中的遗产管理人
patterns.context: 介绍遗产诉讼当事人及其作为遗产管理人的身份。

patterns.name: 税款与利息罚金的法定规定
patterns.context: 法规规定税率、征税对象，或规定利息与罚金如何保留。

patterns.name: 法院、审判及判决引用
patterns.context: 判决书中标示审判过程、法院裁判或法官信息；常与案件上诉叙述相邻。

patterns.name: 性犯罪案件法规
patterns.context: 引用针对儿童性犯罪案件的法规，并说明法规列举的犯罪类别。

en.concept: Legal procedure and statutory language in U.S. judgments
en.description: Primarily responds to statutory and subsection citations, appellate issues, and post-conviction relief in U.S. judgments; also covers judgment captions, litigation procedures and sentencing narratives, case citations, estate parties, and tax provisions.

patterns.name: Judgment opinion titles and party/court information
patterns.context: Jurisdiction, court, and opinion title at the beginning of a legal judgment, followed by the appellant and their appeal or conviction.

patterns.name: Statutory subsections and interpretation
patterns.context: Cites a statutory subsection and explains its scope, legal effect, or elements.

patterns.name: Applications for post-conviction relief
patterns.context: Describes an application by a convicted person for post-conviction review, or to vacate or correct a sentence, in state or other court.

patterns.name: Listing issues and grounds for appeal
patterns.context: A court states multiple legal issues, claims of error, or grounds for vacating a judgment raised by a party.

patterns.name: Procedural documents and counts of charges
patterns.context: Describes a grand jury indictment and multiple charges; activations cluster around procedural descriptions of charges and counts.

patterns.name: Consecutive sentences
patterns.context: States that a new sentence is to run consecutively to the term of imprisonment then being served.

patterns.name: Case citations and judgment conclusions
patterns.context: Cites prior cases to support the court’s conclusion about a trial-court ruling or appellate ground.

patterns.name: Estate administrator and civil litigation status
patterns.context: Identifies a person as an estate administrator and as a plaintiff in a civil case.

patterns.name: State-law tax rate provision
patterns.context: States the tax burden established by a bill and the tax rates applicable to different taxpayers.

1_2105.concept: 美国判决中的法律程序与法条表达
1_2105.description: 主要响应美国判决中的法条及分款引用、上诉争点和刑事定罪后救济；也覆盖判决标题、诉讼程序与刑罚叙述、判例引证、遗产当事人及税法条款。

patterns.name: 判决意见标题与当事人/法院信息
patterns.context: 法律判决开头的司法辖区、法院和意见书标题，后接上诉人及其上诉/定罪事项

patterns.name: 法条分款及条文解释
patterns.trigger: «section» 数字、«sub»«division»及« (»字母/数字分款；如 «Sub»«division»« (»1i)
patterns.context: 引用法条分款，并说明其适用范围、法律效果或构成要件
patterns.domain: 成文法解释与判例分析

patterns.name: 刑事定罪后的救济申请
patterns.trigger: «post»«conviction» relief；«§» 2254« petition»；«motion»…« to vacate», «set»« aside»…« sentence»
patterns.context: 描述被定罪者在州法院或其他法院提出的定罪后审查、撤销或更正刑罚申请

patterns.name: 列举争点与上诉理由
patterns.trigger: « propositions»…« for»« reversal»；« raises»…« propositions»« of error»；«Points» of «Error»
patterns.context: 法院陈述当事人提出的多个法律争点、错误主张或撤销判决理由

patterns.name: 诉讼程序文书与指控列项

patterns.name: Response and transition
patterns.context: After describing a band releasing a live album and disbanding, a transition word connects to what follows.

patterns.name: Participation in an activity
patterns.context: A historical account of participation in an activity after Belgium's independence; the specific activity is not given in the excerpt.

1_2341.concept: 销量与发行叙述，兼有多种零散触发
1_2341.description: 主要在唱片或游戏销量叙述中对 copies 及发行相关词激活；另见独立、宗教创造、赛车统计、文学对话、音乐生涯与转折词等零散模式。

patterns.name: copies 销量单位
patterns.trigger: « copies»（含 « 000» 与 «copies» 分开的写法）
patterns.context: 唱片或电子游戏的销量叙述中，数字后报告售出数量，常与 sold、release、专辑或游戏相邻。
patterns.domain: 音乐、电子游戏销量条目

patterns.name: release 发行
patterns.context: 描述专辑或游戏发行及其后的销售、榜单表现；常与 copies、album 或 sold 同段出现。

patterns.name: 独立/脱离
patterns.context: 国家独立或脱离军队这一语义；分别出现在 Algeria 的独立斗争和 Belgium 独立后的叙述中。

patterns.name: 最高级/数量范围词
patterns.context: 固定表达“at least”，描述比赛中至少领跑一圈。

patterns.name: 文学对话中的词语
patterns.context: 茶话邀请之后的小说对话及人物动作、回答描写；激活落在多个彼此不连续的词上。

patterns.name: 宗教语汇
patterns.context: 讲述上帝创造宇宙与人类、并要求人谦卑顺服的宗教段落。

patterns.name: 赛季统计与零胜
patterns.context: 赛车手已领跑许多圈却仍无胜绩，使用“winless drought”概括这一反差。

patterns.name: 相邻 token 的局部激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在榜单排名、游戏评价与销量叙述中，除销量用法外没有足够证据支持一个统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 职业与作品经历
patterns.context: 歌手生涯小标题及首张专辑、金唱片的介绍；激活分布在专名和相邻表达上。

patterns.name: 回应与承接
patterns.context: 介绍乐队发行现场专辑并解散之后，以转折词承接后文。

patterns.name: 参与活动
patterns.context: 比利时独立后参与某项活动的历史叙述，具体活动未在片段中给出。

en.concept: Vocabulary of work releases and sales
en.description: Primarily responds to vocabulary related to work releases, sales statistics, and associated publishing, gaming, and music terms, especially copies denoting items after a number; sporadic triggers include game-genre terms, within in a poem, and contained in a project context.

patterns.name: copies after a quantity sold
patterns.context: Immediately follows a sales figure to indicate the number of physical or digital copies sold; sometimes followed by sold at the end of the sentence.
patterns.domain: Sales statistics for records, games, bestsellers, etc.; encyclopedia and email text

patterns.name: Work releases and reissues
patterns.context: Describes the release or re-release of a work, game, or film, or a release date; not every occurrence is adjacent to sales.

patterns.name: Work and media categories or release-channel vocabulary
patterns.context: In contexts involving publishing, games, or work releases, triggers include terms related to media categories, publishers, or work titles.
patterns.domain: Romance author biographies, game and film encyclopedias

patterns.name: Music charts and sales performance
patterns.context: Descriptions of album or single chart positions, weekly chart performance, and sales figures.

patterns.name: Fantasy/action genre labels in game titles
patterns.context: A genre description after a game title, categorizing it as a dark fantasy action-adventure game.

patterns.name: within in a phrase
patterns.context: within indicating place or an internal position in a poem; no clear connection to work sales or publishing contexts.

patterns.name: contained in project setup
patterns.context: Discusses a project, domain names, and online services being brought together in one place; activation falls on contained, not a sales term.

1_2341.description: 主要响应作品发行、销量统计及其相关出版、游戏和音乐语汇，尤其是数字后表示副本的 copies；另有游戏类型词、诗句中的 within 和项目语境中的 contained 等零散触发。

patterns.name: 售出数量后的 copies
patterns.context: 紧接销量数字，用于表示售出的实体或数字副本；有时句尾再接 sold。
patterns.domain: 唱片、游戏、畅销书等销量统计；百科和邮件文本

patterns.name: 作品发布及再版
patterns.context: 描述作品、游戏或电影的发行、再发行或发行节点；并非所有出现都紧邻销量。

patterns.name: 作品与媒体类别或发行渠道词汇
patterns.context: 围绕出版、游戏或作品发行的语境，触发点是媒体类别、出版方或作品命名相关词。
patterns.domain: 爱情小说作者简介、游戏与电影百科

patterns.name: 音乐榜单与销售表现
patterns.context: 专辑或单曲的榜单名次、周榜表现及销售数量描述。

patterns.name: 游戏名称中的 fantasy/action 题材标签
patterns.context: 游戏标题之后的类型描述，组合成暗黑奇幻动作冒险游戏的类别介绍。

patterns.name: 短语中的 within
patterns.trigger: “« within»5 thine own deep sunken eyes”
patterns.context: 诗句中表示处所或内在位置的 within；与作品销量或出版语境无明显联系。

patterns.name: 项目搭建中的 contained
patterns.context: 谈论项目、域名与在线服务被集中在同一处；激活落在 contained，而非销量词。

en.description: Activations are distributed across specific words or subword fragments: able in laughable, contained, deleted scenes, and sensibility, absent, and independently; contexts span film, sports, reviews, military, and music, with no unified theme apparent.

patterns.name: Suffix in laughable
patterns.context: Evaluates a person or viewpoint as absurd or ridiculous; modifies comparisons involving a player and descriptions of a company.

patterns.name: contained
patterns.context: Describes something as confined, controlled, or kept in a closed state; examples include a ghost being imprisoned, gambling being difficult to control, and rations being self-contained.
patterns.domain: Film plots, social commentary, military ration descriptions

patterns.name: deleted scenes
patterns.context: Mentions deleted footage in film releases or production materials.
patterns.domain: Film reviews, descriptions of film extras

patterns.name: sensibility
patterns.context: Discusses an author's judgment or perception in writing articles.

patterns.name: absent
patterns.context: Discusses whether political factors are lacking in certain companies.

patterns.name: independently
patterns.context: Describes a musician independently releasing an album.

1_2341.description: 激活分散在若干具体词项或子词上：laughable 中的 able、contained、deleted scenes，以及 sensibility、absent、independently；语境跨影视、体育、评论、军事与音乐，未见统一主题。

patterns.name: laughable 的后缀
patterns.context: 评价某人或某观点荒唐、可笑；分别修饰对球员的比较和对公司的描述。
patterns.domain: 体育评论、科技/商业评论

patterns.name: contained
patterns.context: 描述某物被限制、控制或维持在封闭状态；包括幽灵被关押、赌博难以管控，以及口粮自成一体。
patterns.domain: 影视剧情、社会评论、军事口粮介绍

patterns.name: deleted scenes
patterns.context: 提及电影发行或制作资料中的删减片段。
patterns.domain: 电影评论、电影附加内容介绍

patterns.name: sensibility
patterns.context: 谈论作者具备写作文章的判断力或感知力。

patterns.name: absent
patterns.context: 讨论某些公司是否缺少政治因素。

patterns.name: independently
patterns.context: 描述音乐人独立发行专辑。

en.description: Strong activations often fall on the English or French adjective endings -able/-ible, especially in laughable and lovable in English; there are also released, titled, and multiple within-word fragment activations in French sentences.

patterns.name: Judgments of ridiculousness, implausibility, or absurdity
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of negatively evaluative adjectives; the target may be a comparison, claim, opinion, or market idea.

patterns.name: Describing people or things as lovable
patterns.context: Describes appealing qualities of a person, group, or character.
patterns.domain: Literary narratives, film reviews, children's book descriptions

patterns.name: The English adjective endings -able/-ible
patterns.context: Activation falls on adjective or noun ending fragments; different roots have different meanings, and the endings themselves do not always convey the same semantics.

patterns.name: The French adjective ending -able
patterns.context: Activation falls on French adjective endings, in contexts evaluating the effects of a crisis and describing product quality, respectively.

patterns.name: released in English participles/derivatives
patterns.context: Activation falls on the string released in contexts related to release or re-release; one occurrence has a negative prefix, and another has the re- prefix.

patterns.name: Local activation on the English ending -itled
patterns.context: Activation covers titled in a phrase describing the naming of a work; its relation to the strongly activated endings in other passages is unclear.

patterns.name: Within-word character-fragment activation in French
patterns.context: Multiple internal subword fragments in words are marked in a long French sentence, including “par conséquent,” “les effets,” and “pleinement évaluables”; they do not map exactly to a single morpheme.

patterns.name: Within-word character-fragment activation in French (legal text)
patterns.context: Multiple internal word fragments are activated in a sentence about EU legislation and the quality of animal-origin products; there is also the explicit ending in “irréproch«able».”

1_2341.description: 强激活多落在英语或法语的形容词词尾 -able/-ible，英语中尤见 laughable、lovable；另有 released、titled及法语句中多处词内片段激活。

patterns.name: 可笑、不可信或荒谬的判断
patterns.context: 出现在带有负面评价的形容词结尾；对象可以是比较、论断、观点或市场设想。

patterns.name: 形容人物或事物可爱
patterns.context: 描述人物、群体或角色的讨喜特质。
patterns.domain: 文学叙述、电影评论、儿童读物介绍

patterns.name: 英语形容词的 -able/-ible 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在形容词或名词的词尾片段；不同词根对应不同含义，词尾本身并不总带有相同语义。

patterns.name: 法语形容词词尾 -able
patterns.context: 激活落在法语形容词的词尾，分别处于评价危机影响、描述产品质量的语境。

patterns.name: 英语过去分词/派生词中的 released
patterns.context: 激活落在与发行、重发有关的 released 字符串中；一处是否定前缀，一处是 re- 前缀。
patterns.domain: 百科音乐条目、电影资料

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -itled 的局部激活
patterns.context: 在描述作品命名的短语中，激活覆盖 titled；与其他段的高激活词尾是否相关不明。

patterns.name: 法语词内字符片段激活
patterns.context: 长法语句中多个词的内部子词片段被标记，包含“par conséquent”“les effets”“pleinement évaluables”；不完全对应单一词素。

patterns.name: 法语词内字符片段激活（法律文本）
patterns.context: 关于欧盟立法、动物源产品质量的句子里，多个词内部片段有激活，另有明确的“irréproch«able»”词尾。

en.description: Activations often fall on the ending of the Swedish word “grundläggande,” the English word “borderline,” and fragments of the French word “heureusement”; others occur across different words and languages, with no unified contextual condition and no clear overall pattern.

patterns.name: Core fragment of the Swedish word “grundläggande”
patterns.context: The word occurs in expressions such as “basic freedoms and democracy,” “basic issues,” “basic debate,” and “of fundamental importance”; the target activation falls on a word-ending fragment, not a consistent syntactic position.
patterns.domain: Formal political texts in Swedish from the European Parliament

patterns.name: English borderline
patterns.context: The word form itself is highlighted; in one instance it modifies RB (running back), and in another describes a woman, with clearly different meanings and contexts.
patterns.domain: English sports discussions and online commentary

patterns.name: French heureusement
patterns.context: The adverb occurs in a sentence to mean “fortunately”; the surrounding meaning differs between the two examples.

patterns.name: Other highlighted within-word fragments
patterns.context: Highlights fall on within-word fragments or endings in different languages, with no pattern explained by shared semantics or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Swedish, English, and other European Parliament languages; parliamentary and encyclopedia texts

1_2341.description: 激活多落在瑞典语“grundläggande”词尾、英语“borderline”和法语“heureusement”片段；其余散见不同词语与语种，缺少统一上下文条件，整体规律不清。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词形“grundläggande”的核心片段
patterns.context: 该词出现在“基本自由与民主”“基本问题”“基本辩论”“基本重要性”等表达中；目标激活落在词尾片段，而非一致的句法位置。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语欧洲议会正式政治文本

patterns.name: 英语 borderline
patterns.context: 词形本身被突出；一处修饰 RB（跑卫），另一处形容 woman，语义与语境差异明显。
patterns.domain: 英语体育讨论与网络评论

patterns.name: 法语 heureusement
patterns.context: 副词出现在句中，表达“幸运地／令人庆幸地”；两例周围句意不同。

patterns.name: 其他词内高亮片段
patterns.context: 高亮落在不同语言的词内片段或词尾，未见可由共同语义或句法条件解释的模式。
patterns.domain: 瑞典语、英语及其他欧洲议会语种；议会与百科文本

en.description: All excerpts are Project Gutenberg production credits; the strongest trigger is concentrated on “Distributed,” commonly in “Online Distributed Proofreading Team.” URLs and other wording in production notes also occasionally show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Project Gutenberg proofreading team credits
patterns.context: Production credits at the beginning of an e-book list contributors, followed by the proofreading team name; “Distributed” is the most consistent and strongest trigger, often alongside “Online” and “Proofreading Team.”

patterns.name: URL in production credits
patterns.context: A URL pointing to the Project Gutenberg website appears at the end of the credit line; URL token activation is weak and is unmarked in some excerpts.

patterns.name: Alternative production-note wording
patterns.context: Introduces production staff with “E-text prepared by” instead of “Produced by,” then still mentions the proofreading team.

1_2341.concept: Project Gutenberg 校对团队署名
1_2341.description: 所有片段均为 Project Gutenberg 制作署名；最强触发集中在“Distributed”，常见于“Online Distributed Proofreading Team”，网址及制作说明的其他措辞也偶有较弱激活。

patterns.name: Project Gutenberg 校对团队署名
patterns.trigger: « Distributed»10/« Distributed»9；常与« Online»相邻，出现在“the Online Distributed Proofreading Team”中
patterns.context: 电子书开头的制作人员说明中，列出贡献者后接校对团队名称；“Distributed”是最稳定、最强的触发词，周围常有“Online”“Proofreading Team”。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg 电子书前置说明

patterns.name: 制作人员说明中的网址
patterns.context: 署名行末尾出现指向 Project Gutenberg 网站的 URL；网址 token 的激活较弱，个别片段中未标记。
patterns.domain: 电子书制作说明中的网址

patterns.name: 替代制作说明措辞
patterns.context: 以“E-text prepared by”而非“Produced by”引出制作人员，随后仍提到校对团队。
patterns.domain: Project Gutenberg 电子书前置说明

en.description: Activation patterns are scattered: several Swedish parliamentary texts contain far+ande forms, alongside other Swedish fragments; the remaining cases involve attraction in an academic title, the ending of Horace, released in a song entry, and a Teradata technical title.

patterns.name: Swedish ending “farande”
patterns.context: This word form and nearby word fragments activate in Swedish; no sentence-initial position or specific syntactic position is required.

patterns.name: “Sexual Attraction” in a title
patterns.context: A phrase in an English paper title describing men's same-sex sexual attraction and hiding that attraction in offline settings.

patterns.name: Dean within a proper name
patterns.context: A final fragment of the English name Horace; the name is repeated immediately afterward in the same entry.

patterns.name: released in a song entry
patterns.context: Describes a song's release; often co-occurs with words such as song, single, band, or release year.
patterns.domain: English song entries and music descriptions

patterns.name: Time interval macro parameter
patterns.context: A StackExchange question title concerns Teradata macro parameters and time intervals.

patterns.name: Other Swedish word fragments
patterns.context: Falls within words or near word boundaries in Swedish sentences; the fragments differ, and the available contexts are insufficient to identify a shared trigger condition.

1_2341.description: 激活模式分散：瑞典语议会文本中多次出现 far+ande 词形，也有其他瑞典语片段；其余分别涉及论文标题中的吸引、Horace 词尾、歌曲条目的 released，以及 Teradata 技术标题。

patterns.name: 瑞典语词尾「farande」
patterns.context: 瑞典语中该词形及其附近词片段激活；不要求句首或特定句法位置

patterns.name: 标题中的“Sexual Attraction”
patterns.context: 英文论文标题中描述男性对同性的性吸引、且在离线环境隐藏该吸引的短语

patterns.name: 专名内部的 Dean
patterns.context: 英文人名 Horace 的词尾片段；同一条目紧接着重复该人名
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物条目标题

patterns.name: 歌曲条目中的 released
patterns.context: 歌曲介绍中说明歌曲发行；常与 song、single、乐队或发行年份等词共现
patterns.domain: 英文歌曲条目及音乐介绍

patterns.name: 时间间隔宏参数
patterns.context: StackExchange 问题标题以 Teradata macro 参数和 time interval 为主题

patterns.name: 瑞典语其他词片段
patterns.context: 在瑞典语句子中落在词内或词边界附近；这些片段彼此不同，现有上下文不足以确定共同触发条件

en.concept: Weakly related words and tokenization fragments
en.description: Strong activations are distributed across multilingual token fragments, copies in record sales, players being released by teams, and local terms related to music albums, dance, academic titles, parliamentary speeches, and event editions; no reliable correspondence is evident in the Swedish passages.

patterns.name: Multilingual fragments within tokenized words
patterns.context: When a word is split into multiple tokens, activation falls on part of the word; the word meanings and full parts of speech are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Mixed English, Swedish, French, and other-language corpus

patterns.name: copies in release and sales data
patterns.context: Album sales are expressed as a number followed by copies, often preceded by sold, million, or a specific sales figure; this is the strongest trigger in all three passages.
patterns.domain: Music encyclopedias and record sales descriptions

patterns.name: released in professional sports
patterns.context: A player is released by a team or no longer retained, usually after season or appearance records.

patterns.name: Music album-related words
patterns.context: Descriptions of album releases, charts, and editions; apart from copies, activations are weaker and the words are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Highlighted fragments in fixed titles
patterns.context: Occurs in a research title describing men's same-sex sexual attraction and online dating; activation is distributed across title words.

patterns.name: Areas of action in parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: A French political speech mentions several areas of action during the president's term.

patterns.name: Groups/soloists in dance terminology
patterns.context: Explains ballet dancer categories and groups made up of non-soloists.

patterns.name: Dates and editions
patterns.context: An event page lists dates and mentions the tenth edition of an event; strong activation is concentrated on edition.

1_2341.concept: 弱相关的词项与分词片段
1_2341.description: 强激活分散于多语言分词片段、唱片销量中的 copies、球员被球队 released，以及音乐专辑、舞蹈、学术标题、议会讲话和活动版次等局部词项；瑞典语段未见可靠对应。

patterns.name: 分词内部的多语言片段
patterns.context: 词被拆成多个 token 时，激活落在词的一部分；词义和完整词类并不一致。
patterns.domain: 英语、瑞典语、法语等混合语料

patterns.name: 发行与销售数据中的 copies
patterns.context: 专辑销量以数字加 copies 表达，前文常有 sold、million 或具体销量；在三个段落中均为最强触发。
patterns.domain: 音乐百科及唱片销量描述

patterns.name: 职业体育中的 released
patterns.context: 球员被球队释放或不再留用，通常出现在赛季、出场记录之后。

patterns.name: 音乐专辑相关词
patterns.context: 专辑发行、排行榜、版次等描述；除 copies 外，触发较弱且词项不完全一致。

patterns.name: 固定标题中的高亮片段
patterns.context: 出现在研究标题中，描述男性同性性吸引及线上约会；激活分散在标题词中。

patterns.name: 议会讲话中的行动领域
patterns.context: 法语政治讲话中提及主席任期的若干行动领域。

patterns.name: 舞蹈术语中的团体/独舞者
patterns.context: 解释芭蕾舞者类别及非独舞者组成的群体。

patterns.name: 日期与版次
patterns.context: 活动页面列出日期，并提到某活动的第十届；强激活集中在 edition。

en.description: Activations span English, French, and German texts and webpage and encyclopedia genres, often falling on within-word fragments or short words; other sporadic semantic themes include ballet categories, electricity prices, performances, food service, and album information, with no stable unified trigger.

patterns.name: English within-word suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on cross-morpheme fragments or word endings, while the words and sentence meanings vary considerably.

patterns.name: French within-word fragments and function words
patterns.context: Within French sentences, within-word fragments and short function words are marked, with no stable semantic trigger words apparent.

patterns.name: Multilingual within-word fragments
patterns.context: Highlights fall on fragments within a Spanish place name and words in a French sentence.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary texts involving events in Spain

patterns.name: German within-word fragments and articles
patterns.context: Within a German sentence, within-word fragments and articles activate; the content concerns comparisons and a meeting.

patterns.name: Ballet dancer category terms

patterns.name: Electricity price units

patterns.name: Performance versions and ordinals

patterns.name: Chef career and food-service business

1_2341.description: 激活跨英语、法语、德语文本及网页和百科体裁，常落在词内片段或短词；另有芭蕾类别、电价、演出、餐饮和专辑信息等零散语义主题，未见统一稳定触发。

patterns.name: 法语词内片段与功能词
patterns.context: 法语句子中，词内片段和短功能词被标记，未见稳定的语义触发词。

patterns.name: 德语词内片段及冠词

patterns.name: 芭蕾舞者类别词

patterns.name: 电价单位
