patterns.name: 专辑发行与销量
patterns.context: 描述音乐专辑发行、榜单排名和销量。

en.description: Activations are scattered across word-initial, medial, and final fragments, as well as complete words, in English and French; they cover inflection, domain terminology, and function words across corpora and styles, with no stable semantic condition apparent.

patterns.name: English word-final fragments and word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation often falls on complete English words or parts of words; marked positions vary from word-initial to medial or final, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition apparent.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedias, food webpages, film reviews, and literary narratives

patterns.name: French within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across multiple subword fragments within French words, involving stems, affixes, or participle/conjugated forms; no unified meaning or grammatical category is apparent.

patterns.name: English past tense and related forms
patterns.context: English past-tense forms occur in descriptions of people's experiences or events; however, activation is not limited to past tense (other words also activate in the same passage), and the same forms occur in different contexts.
patterns.domain: English biographical and sports encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Dance terminology and compounds
patterns.context: Ballet entries contain terms such as soloist and ballet company; activation also falls on ordinary word fragments in the same passage, so a domain-semantic trigger cannot be established.

patterns.name: Function words or word beginnings in French phrases
patterns.context: Activation occurs on short words or the beginnings of longer words in French sentences; these coexist with other within-word fragments in the same passage, without a clear independent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in literary narrative
patterns.context: In a passage of English literary description, activation falls on internal fragments of adverbs, nouns, and other words, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Award and film-song-related words
patterns.context: Activations occur in film-review and award-category contexts, but the fragments belong to different words, so a stable thematic trigger cannot be confirmed from a single passage.

1_2341.description: 激活散布在英语和法语词的词首、词中、词尾及完整词上；涵盖词形变化、领域术语和功能词，跨语料与文体，未见稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 英语词尾片段与词形边界
patterns.trigger: « Solo»、« group»、« solo»、« overall»、« character»、« Draft»、« released»、« competition»、« Original»、« Division»
patterns.context: 激活常落在英语完整词或词的一部分上；标记位置有时处于词首，有时在词内或词尾，未见稳定的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 英语百科、饮食网页、电影评论及文学叙述

patterns.name: 法语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于法语词内部的多个子词片段，涉及词干、词缀或分词/变位形式；没有显示统一的词义或语法类别。

patterns.name: 英语过去式及相关词形
patterns.context: 叙述人物经历或事件时出现的英语过去式；但激活并不只限于过去式（如同段还有其他词），且相同词形在不同语境出现。
patterns.domain: 英语百科人物与体育条目

patterns.name: 舞蹈术语与复合词
patterns.context: 芭蕾舞条目中出现独舞者、芭蕾舞团等术语；同一段也有激活落在普通词片段上，不能确定是领域语义触发。

patterns.name: 法语短语中的功能词或词首
patterns.context: 激活出现在法语句子中的短词或较长词的开头；与同段其他词内片段并存，缺乏明确的独立语义模式。

patterns.name: 文学叙述中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 一段英文文学性描述中，激活落在副词、名词及其他词的内部片段上，未呈现一致的词义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 奖项与电影歌曲相关词
patterns.context: 影评及奖项类别语境中出现激活，但这些片段分属不同词，无法从单段确认稳定的主题触发。

en.concept: Evan strings and adjacent name text
en.description: Primarily responds to Evan at a word boundary, covering personal names and the place name Evanston; activation usually falls on Evan, with a few cases extending to adjacent name fragments. The Danny Welbeck/transfer headline in segment 9 cannot be explained by this pattern.

patterns.name: Evan string
patterns.context: “Evan” appears at a word boundary in text such as names and institutional addresses; it is followed by different strings, including Sharp, Herod, Hughes, Rodriguez, Blass, Vucci, and ston.
patterns.domain: Personal names, news, emails, and addresses across domains

patterns.name: Evan concatenated in a name entry
patterns.context: In comma-separated lists of people and companies/roles, Evan is immediately followed by Sharp; other names in the same segment include Kevin O’Connor.
patterns.domain: HackerNews people and company profile lists

patterns.name: Name order in Enron lists
patterns.context: In semicolon-separated name lists, Evan is followed by Herod; activation also falls on adjacent name fragments.

patterns.name: Place name Evanston
patterns.context: The substring Evan in the place name Evanston is marked; it occurs in a railway route description and a university address.

patterns.name: Author/cartoonist names
patterns.context: In comic credits, Evan is followed by a nickname and surname; nearby text also includes author and artist credits.

patterns.name: Player name Evan Rodriguez
patterns.context: In a sports roster, Evan is followed by a surname, alongside ranking, height, position, and school information.

patterns.name: Journalist byline Evan Blass
patterns.context: In technology news, Evan Blass is named as the source of leaked images.

patterns.name: Photographer credit Evan Vucci
patterns.context: In news photo captions, Evan Vucci is followed by a wire-service marker.

patterns.name: Evan Hughes in an email address
patterns.context: In Enron email address/contact fields, Evan Hughes is followed by department and email information.

patterns.name: Welbeck in a football report
patterns.context: In a headline-style phrase, Danny Welbeck is followed by transfer and sparks frenzy; there is no Evan substring.

1_2469.concept: Evan 字符串及其邻近姓名文本
1_2469.description: 主要响应词界处的 Evan，覆盖人名和 Evanston 地名；激活位置通常落在 Evan，少数延伸到邻近姓名片段。第9段的 Danny Welbeck/transfer 标题无法由此解释。

patterns.name: Evan 字符串
patterns.context: 姓名、机构地址等文本中出现词界上的 “Evan”；后接 Sharp、Herod、Hughes、Rodriguez、Blass、Vucci、ston 等不同内容。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的人名、新闻、邮件及地址文本

patterns.name: 名字条目中的 Evan 拼接
patterns.context: 以逗号分隔的人物姓名及公司/职位列表中，Evan 紧接 Sharp；同段另有 Kevin O’Connor 等姓名。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 人物与公司简介列表

patterns.name: Enron 名单姓名次序
patterns.context: 分号分隔的姓名列表中，Evan 后接 Herod；激活也落在相邻姓名片段上。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的联系人列表

patterns.name: 地点名 Evanston
patterns.context: 地名 Evanston 中的 Evan 子串被标记；分别出现在铁路线路叙述和大学地址中。

patterns.name: 作者/漫画家姓名
patterns.context: 漫画作品署名中 Evan 后接昵称和姓氏；附近还有作者、艺术家等署名信息。

patterns.name: 球员姓名 Evan Rodriguez
patterns.context: 体育名单中，Evan 后接姓氏，并附名次、身高、位置和学校。

patterns.name: 记者署名 Evan Blass
patterns.context: 科技新闻中，Evan Blass 被称为发布泄露图片的消息来源。

patterns.name: 摄影署名 Evan Vucci
patterns.context: 新闻图片说明中，Evan Vucci 后接通讯社标记。

patterns.name: 邮件地址中的 Evan Hughes
patterns.context: Enron 邮件地址/通讯录字段中，Evan Hughes 后接部门和邮箱信息。

patterns.name: 足球报道中的 Welbeck
patterns.context: 报道标题式短语中，Danny Welbeck 后接 transfer 与 sparks frenzy；没有 Evan 子串。

en.description: Many activations focus on the name Evan (with different surnames and Evanston) and Sharp, appearing in lists, news bylines, and email addresses; sporadic triggers also occur in formatting separators, comics, transport, sports news, and mathematical fragments, with no unified context.

patterns.name: Evan name fragment
patterns.context: Evan is followed by different surnames or subsequent parts of a name; it may also occur near line breaks, punctuation, or list boundaries.

patterns.name: Sharp in name lists
patterns.context: Occurs in personal names or parallel lists; segment [1] has Evan Sharp, and segment [2] has Steve Sharp.
patterns.domain: Entrepreneur profiles and email contact lists

patterns.name: Numbering and line breaks in formatted text
patterns.context: Formatting tokens such as line breaks, numbering, and separators in web excerpts or lists; may co-occur with name triggers, but not always.
patterns.domain: Web pages, sports rosters, and other structured text

patterns.name: Discussion and comic-production terms
patterns.context: In comic entries, descriptions of works, authors, and illustrators.

patterns.name: Transport routes and direction terms
patterns.context: Descriptions of a railway branch and its service direction, including the proper noun Evanston.

patterns.name: Names and positions in player rosters
patterns.context: Numbered lists of players, position abbreviations, and schools.

patterns.name: Reporting terms in technology product articles
patterns.context: Technology news sentences describing Moto X/Z products and the source of leaked images.

patterns.name: News photo credits
patterns.context: In political news, photo captions credit a photojournalist by name and include a wire-service marker.

patterns.name: Football news word fragments
patterns.context: A headline-style phrase describing Danny Welbeck's transfer sparking a frenzy; activation is distributed across word fragments.

patterns.name: Enron email addresses and recipients
patterns.context: Names embedded in email directories or address strings made up of departments, locations, and email formats.

patterns.name: Mathematical expression fragments
patterns.context: An algebraic expression containing ind, i, numbers, multiplication signs, and plus signs; lacks name or list context.

1_2469.concept: Evan/Sharp 字符串及杂项片段
1_2469.description: 多段激活集中于人名 Evan（不同姓氏、Evanston）及 Sharp，并见于名单、新闻署名、邮箱等；另有格式分隔、漫画、交通、体育新闻和数学片段等零散触发，未形成统一语境。

patterns.name: Evan 姓名片段
patterns.context: Evan 后接不同姓氏或姓名后续部分；也可能处于换行、标点或名单边界附近。

patterns.name: 名字列表中的 Sharp
patterns.context: 出现在人物姓名或并列名单中；第[1]段 Evan Sharp，第[2]段 Steve Sharp。
patterns.domain: 创业者介绍、邮件联系人名单

patterns.name: 格式化文本中的编号与换行
patterns.context: 网页摘录或名单的换行、编号、分隔符等格式 token；与姓名触发可能共同出现，但不总是如此。
patterns.domain: 网页、体育名单及其他结构化文本

patterns.name: 讨论与漫画制作词
patterns.context: 漫画条目介绍中，描述作品及作者、画师。

patterns.name: 交通线路与方向词
patterns.context: 关于铁路支线及其服务方向的叙述，包含专名 Evanston。

patterns.name: 球员名单中的姓名及位置
patterns.context: 编号列表中列出球员、位置缩写与学校。

patterns.name: 科技产品文章中的报道词
patterns.context: 描述 Moto X/Z 产品及泄露图片来源的科技新闻语句。

patterns.name: 新闻图片署名
patterns.context: 政治新闻中，照片说明以摄影记者姓名和通讯社标记署名。

patterns.name: 足球新闻词语片段
patterns.context: 标题式短句，描述 Danny Welbeck 转会引发轰动；激活分布在词内片段。

patterns.name: Enron 邮件地址与收件人
patterns.context: 姓名嵌在部门、地点及邮箱格式构成的邮件目录或地址串中。

patterns.name: 数学公式片段
patterns.context: 代数表达式中出现 ind、i、数字、乘号与加号；缺乏姓名或名单语境。

en.description: Activations focus on two types of strings: Evan (including Evanston) and auditory in biomedical contexts; a mathematical expression also has sporadic activations and may represent an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Evan string
patterns.context: The name or word form Evan occurs; it may be followed by a surname or serve as the beginning of a compound word.
patterns.domain: Name lists, research text, Wikipedia, news, and comic descriptions

patterns.name: Auditory-related terms
patterns.context: auditory occurs in contexts involving the auditory system, stimuli, or pathology.

patterns.name: Numbers or formatting markers
patterns.context: Numbers, letters, and punctuation interleave in a mathematical expression; activations in this segment are sporadic.

1_2469.concept: 特定字符串触发
1_2469.description: 激活集中在两类字符串：Evan（含 Evanston）以及生物医学语境中的 auditory；另有一段数学表达式出现零散激活，可能是独立模式。

patterns.name: Evan 字符串
patterns.context: 人名或词形 Evan 出现；可接姓氏，也可作为复合词开头
patterns.domain: 人名列表、科研文本、维基百科、新闻及漫画介绍

patterns.name: 听觉相关词
patterns.context: 听觉系统、刺激或病理等语境中出现 auditory

patterns.name: 数字或格式化标记
patterns.context: 数学表达式中数字、字母与标点交错；该段触发分布零散

en.concept: Polysemous features of Evan and auditory terms
en.description: Strongly activates on the string “Evan” (a personal name or Evanston) and “auditory” in medical neuroscience; sporadic activations also occur on formulas, years, some name fragments, and terms from several domains, with no stable single trigger condition.

patterns.name: “Evan” as a name or place
patterns.context: Occurs in names (e.g., Evan Sharp, Evan Blass, Evan Vuc…) or in the place name Evanston; there is no fixed sentence pattern.
patterns.domain: Technology personnel lists, comic credits, geographic entries, news photo credits, and email contact lists

patterns.name: “auditory” and hearing-related terms
patterns.context: Occurs in neuroscience or medical contexts, modifying neocortical dysfunction, nerve fibers, or stimulation.
patterns.domain: NIH research project descriptions and PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: Mathematical notation and numbers
patterns.context: Isolated mathematical expression fragments; there is insufficient context to identify a specific trigger condition.

patterns.name: Date and year numbers
patterns.context: Years embedded in descriptions of engineering construction or historical service development.

patterns.name: Surname fragments in name lists
patterns.context: Names are listed separated by commas or semicolons; this partially overlaps with the “Evan” name pattern, but not every name list contains it.
patterns.domain: Technology company staff lists, comic credits, and email contact lists

patterns.name: Sporadic activations in ordinary words and titles
patterns.context: Occurs separately in slogans, work descriptions, section headings, and research project descriptions, with no stable shared condition.
patterns.domain: Web text, encyclopedia entries, and research descriptions

patterns.name: Terms in firearm and public safety reporting
patterns.context: Occurs in news excerpts related to the president, gun violence, and campus safety.

patterns.name: Clinical outcomes and temporal-lobe terms
patterns.context: Describes clinical changes in epilepsy patients and temporal-lobe discharges; occurs in the same medical context as auditory stimuli in this segment.

1_2469.concept: Evan与听觉词的多义特征
1_2469.description: 主要对“Evan”字样（人名或 Evanston）及医学神经科学中的“auditory”强烈激活；另对公式、年份、部分姓名片段及若干领域词语有零散激活，无法归为稳定单一触发条件。

patterns.name: “Evan”人名或地名
patterns.context: 出现在人名中（如 Evan Sharp、Evan Blass、Evan Vuc…）或地名 Evanston 中；并非固定句式。
patterns.domain: 科技人物名单、漫画署名、地理条目、新闻图片署名及邮件通讯录

patterns.name: “auditory”听觉相关词
patterns.context: 出现在神经科学或医学语境，修饰 neocortical dysfunction、nerve fibers，或 stimulation。

patterns.name: 数学记号及数字
patterns.context: 孤立的数学表达式片段；缺乏足够上下文判断具体触发条件。

patterns.name: 日期与年份数字
patterns.context: 年份嵌在工程建设或历史服务沿革的叙述中。

patterns.name: 人名列表中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 姓名以逗号、分号分隔列出；与“Evan”人名模式有一定重叠，但并非每个姓名列表都出现。
patterns.domain: 科技公司人员名单、漫画署名、邮件通讯录

patterns.name: 普通词语及标题中的零散激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在宣传语、作品介绍、章节标题和科研项目描述中，未见稳定共同条件。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、百科条目、科研简介

patterns.name: 枪支与公共安全报道词语
patterns.context: 出现在总统与枪支暴力、校园安全相关报道片段中。

patterns.name: 临床结果与时间叶相关词语
patterns.context: 描述癫痫患者的临床变化及颞叶放电；与本段的 auditory 刺激同处医学语境。

en.description: Activations focus on Evan (including Evanston) and auditory in research contexts; a mathematical expression also activates on variables, numbers, and symbols. The contexts of these patterns differ markedly.

patterns.name: Evan in names or place names
patterns.context: The proper noun Evan occurs as a personal name or as part of a place name; the surrounding context is not fixed.
patterns.domain: News, technology personnel lists, comic credits, photo credits, railway entries, and email contact lists

patterns.name: Hearing-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of auditory nerves, auditory stimulation, or the auditory cortex.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and variables
patterns.context: Variables, numbers, and operators occur in a mathematical expression; activation is distributed near the beginning of the expression and around numbers.

1_2469.concept: none
1_2469.description: 激活集中于 Evan（含 Evanston）和科研语境中的 auditory；另有一段数学表达式中的变量、数字及符号激活。各模式语境差异明显。

patterns.name: 名字或地名中的 Evan
patterns.context: 出现专名 Evan，作为人名或地名的一部分；周围语境并不固定。
patterns.domain: 新闻、科技人物名单、漫画署名、照片署名、铁路条目及邮件联系人名单

patterns.name: 听觉相关词汇
patterns.context: 出现在听觉神经、听觉刺激或听觉皮层等研究描述中。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、医学及科研摘要

patterns.name: 数学符号与变量
patterns.context: 数学表达式中出现变量、数字及运算符；激活分布在表达式开头及数字周围。

en.concept: Blues strings and occasional word fragments
en.description: Most activations fall on Blues-related strings, including music genre terms, song and album titles, and the Russian Blue cat breed; there are also isolated substring activations on astics in microplastics and lay in the name Findlay.

patterns.name: Word-final Blues
patterns.context: Blues occurs in a music genre, song title, album title, or cat breed name; it also appears in names joined to preceding modifiers, such as «Russian»«Blues».
patterns.domain: Music entries, biographies, song/album catalogs, and animal breed entries

patterns.name: Microplastics term
patterns.context: Occurs in the word “microplastics” at the start of a scientific abstract; activation focuses on an internal subword fragment.

patterns.name: Final substring in the name Findlay
patterns.context: The final substring of the name “Polly Findlay” activates; the preceding text concerns a theater work and director information.

1_2469.concept: Blues 字符串及偶发词片段
1_2469.description: 多数激活落在 Blues 相关字符串中，涵盖乐种术语、歌曲与专辑名，以及俄罗斯蓝猫品种；另有微塑料词中 astics 和人名 Findlay 的 lay 两个孤立子串激活。

patterns.name: 词尾 Blues
patterns.context: 在乐种、曲名、专辑名或猫品种名称中出现 Blues；也包括被前置修饰语连在一起的名称，如«Russian»«Blues»。
patterns.domain: 音乐条目、人物传记、歌曲/专辑目录，也有动物品种条目

patterns.name: 微塑料词项
patterns.context: 出现在科学摘要开头的“microplastics”词中；激活集中于词的内部子词片段。

patterns.name: 人名末尾 Findlay
patterns.context: 人名“Polly Findlay”末尾子串激活，前文为剧院作品及导演信息。

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the capitalized form Blues, commonly in descriptions of music genres and proper names for songs, albums, and bands; it also responds to the cat name Russian Blues. The activation on wizards in segment 10 has no visible connection.

patterns.name: Blues in music genre names
patterns.context: Occurs in music styles, genre names, or explanations of genres; often listed alongside other genres or included in the full name of R&B.
patterns.domain: Music terminology, music history, or music descriptions

patterns.name: Blues in proper names
patterns.context: Blues is part of a proper name, including a work title, music group, or genre name; the text need not be explaining the meaning of blues.
patterns.domain: Music and artist entries, record catalogs, and encyclopedia categories

patterns.name: Blues in cat breed names
patterns.context: Blues refers to Russian Blue cats and occurs in descriptions of breed traits and behavior, rather than in a musical context.
patterns.domain: Animal encyclopedias and cat breed descriptions

patterns.name: Blues string matching
patterns.context: The word form Blues, with this capitalization, may trigger activation; the cat-breed usage shows that the pattern is not limited to musical meaning.

patterns.name: Other word forms without an apparent Blues trigger
patterns.context: Occurs in a sentence about a data-processing and marketing company; the local context contains no Blues or clear musical meaning.
patterns.domain: Digital marketing and business data descriptions

1_2469.concept: Blues 词形
1_2469.description: 主要强烈响应大小写形式 Blues，常见于音乐流派说明及歌曲、专辑、乐队等专名；也响应 Russian Blues 猫名。第10段的 wizards 激活缺乏可见关联。

patterns.name: 音乐流派名称中的 Blues
patterns.context: 出现在音乐风格、流派名称或流派解释中，常与其他音乐类型并列，或作为 R&B 全称的一部分。
patterns.domain: 音乐术语、音乐史或音乐介绍

patterns.name: 专名中的 Blues
patterns.trigger: «Blues»10／«Blues»9，嵌在专辑、歌曲、乐队或其他专名中，如 «2»«Frets» from «the» «Blues»、«Island» «Blues»、«Sligo River» «Blues»、«A Shot of Rhythm and Blues»、«St.» «Louis» «Blues»、«Telemark» «Blues»lag
patterns.context: Blues 是专名的组成部分；涉及作品标题、音乐团体或流派名称，不要求正文正在解释 blues 的含义。
patterns.domain: 音乐作品与音乐人条目、唱片目录、百科分类

patterns.name: 猫品种名称中的 Blues
patterns.context: Blues 指 Russian Blue 猫，出现在品种特征及其行为描述中，而非音乐语境。

patterns.name: Blues 字符串匹配
patterns.context: 只要出现大小写为 Blues 的词形就可能激活；猫品种用法表明该模式不局限于音乐语义。

patterns.name: 无明显 Blues 触发的其他词形
patterns.context: 出现在描述数据处理与营销公司的句子中，局部上下文未见 Blues 或明显音乐含义。
patterns.domain: 数字营销、商业数据说明

en.description: Primarily activates on the spelling fragment ighter in English words, especially lighter; it also covers freighter, highlighter, straighter, and brighter. Some contexts happen to discuss reduced weight, but the trigger spans meanings and does not necessarily require that semantic connection.

patterns.name: -ighter spelling fragment
patterns.context: The activated fragment is usually inside a word, often in words ending in -ighter or containing ighter; the words need not share a meaning.
patterns.domain: English text across domains, including forums, emails, encyclopedias, patents, and literary descriptions

patterns.name: lighter and descriptions of reduced weight
patterns.context: Describes a lighter door, lens, or engine component; the activated fragment still corresponds to the spelling in lighter.
patterns.domain: Consumer products, photography equipment, and engineering patents

patterns.name: ighter in other words
patterns.context: The trigger is embedded in different words such as freighter, highlighter, straighter, and brighter, with meanings related to ships, reading tools, direction, or brightness, respectively.

patterns.name: lighter in engineering and equipment contexts
patterns.context: Explicitly compares weight or describes the engineering effect of reducing a component's weight.
patterns.domain: Product descriptions, photography forums, and engineering patents

1_2469.concept: 英语中的 ighter 字符串片段
1_2469.description: 主要激活英语单词中的 ighter 拼写片段，尤其是 lighter；也涵盖 freighter、highlighter、straighter、brighter 等。部分上下文恰好谈轻量化，但触发跨词义，未必要求该语义。

patterns.name: -ighter 拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活片段多位于单词内部，常见于以 -ighter 结尾或包含 ighter 的拼写；并不要求这些词具有相同词义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的英语文本，包括论坛、邮件、百科、专利及文学介绍

patterns.name: lighter 及轻量化表述
patterns.context: 描述重量较轻的门、镜头或发动机部件；其中激活片段仍对应 lighter 的拼写部分。
patterns.domain: 生活用品、摄影器材、工程专利

patterns.name: ighter 出现在其他词中
patterns.context: 触发部分嵌在 freighter、highlighter、straighter、brighter 等不同词中，意义分别涉及船、阅读工具、方向或亮度。

patterns.name: 工程与设备语境中的 lighter
patterns.context: 显式比较重量，或说明减轻部件重量的工程效果。
patterns.domain: 产品说明、摄影论坛、工程专利

en.description: Most segments activate in bird(s) or compounds containing it, often on word-final birds/bird; there are also activations on the arner substring in learner and on birdsong in a citation marker, indicating responses to several orthographic fragments rather than a unified meaning.

patterns.name: Word-final birds
patterns.context: Activation falls on the birds part of bird(s); it occurs in contexts involving hummingbirds, cardinals, birds in flight, and also URLs or quoted titles.
patterns.domain: Nature, sports, news, and web text

patterns.name: bird-related identifiers
patterns.context: bird is part of a compound or a URL/project-path identifier, rather than the ordinary standalone word birds.

patterns.name: Embedded substring learner
patterns.context: Activation falls on the internal substring arner in learner; the word is unrelated to birds and occurs in the educational expressions learner-centered and learner.

patterns.name: Reference author-name fragment
patterns.context: birds followed by ong forms part of a reference author's name/citation marker; the context discusses cervical screening automation and is unrelated to birds.

1_2469.concept: 含 bird(s) 的字形片段
1_2469.description: 多数段落在 bird(s) 或其复合词中激活，常落在词尾 birds/bird；另在 learner 的 arner 子串及引文标识 birdsong 中激活，显示对若干字形片段的响应，而非统一语义。

patterns.name: 词尾 birds
patterns.context: 激活落在 bird(s) 词形的 birds 部分；出现在蜂鸟、红雀、飞行中的鸟等语境，也出现在网址或被引用标题中。
patterns.domain: 自然、体育、新闻及网页文本

patterns.name: bird 相关标识符
patterns.context: bird 是复合词或 URL/项目路径标识符的一部分，并非普通独立的 birds。

patterns.name: 嵌入式子串 learner
patterns.context: 激活落在 learner 的内部子串 arner；词义与鸟类无关，出现在 learner-centered 与 learner 两种教育表达中。

patterns.name: 参考文献作者名片段
patterns.context: birds 与后续 ong 构成参考文献作者名/引文标识的一部分；上下文讨论宫颈筛查自动化，与鸟类无关。

en.concept: Final subword token in bird-final words
en.description: All segments activate on the final part of words or proper names ending in bird, including earlybird, Firebird, warbird, Nightbird, Blackbird, Thunderbird, Bluebird, and Greybird; the pattern spans domains and does not depend on a particular writing style.

patterns.name: Final part of the earlybird compound
patterns.context: The trigger word ends in bird, especially earlybird; it occurs in a ticketing sentence.

patterns.name: Final part of the Firebird compound
patterns.context: Part of the song title “Firebird Suite”.

patterns.name: Final part of the warbird compound
patterns.context: Describes vintage aircraft or aircraft models, following war.

patterns.name: Final part of the Nightbird compound
patterns.context: The proper name Nightbird refers to a San Francisco food-service provider.

patterns.name: Final part of the proper name Blackbird
patterns.context: Suggests naming an educational project Blackbird Pi.

patterns.name: Final part of the Thunderbird software name
patterns.context: The final part of the name of the Thunderbird email client.

patterns.name: Final part of the Thunderbird street name
patterns.context: The proper name Thunderbird Rd. in an address.

patterns.name: Final part of the Bluebird model name
patterns.context: The final part of the model name Bluebird Sylphy.

patterns.name: Final part of the Greybird theme name
patterns.context: The final part of the desktop theme name Greybird.

1_2469.concept: bird 结尾词的末尾子词元
1_2469.description: 所有段均在 bird 结尾的词或专名的末尾部分激活，包括 earlybird、Firebird、warbird、Nightbird、Blackbird、Thunderbird、Bluebird、Greybird；跨领域且不依赖特定文体。

patterns.name: earlybird 复合词末尾
patterns.context: 触发词以 bird 结尾，尤其是 earlybird；出现于票务句中

patterns.name: Firebird 复合词末尾
patterns.context: 作为曲名 “Firebird Suite” 的一部分

patterns.name: warbird 复合词末尾
patterns.context: 描述老式飞机或飞机模型，位于 war 之后
patterns.domain: 电脑硬件论坛/航空爱好

patterns.name: Nightbird 复合词末尾
patterns.context: 专名 Nightbird，指旧金山餐饮服务方

patterns.name: Blackbird 专名末尾
patterns.context: 建议将教育项目命名为 Blackbird Pi
patterns.domain: 教育/编程与音乐课程讨论

patterns.name: Thunderbird 软件名末尾
patterns.context: Thunderbird 邮件客户端名称的末尾部分

patterns.name: Thunderbird 地址名末尾
patterns.context: 地址中的专名 Thunderbird Rd.

patterns.name: Bluebird 车型名末尾
patterns.context: 车型专名 Bluebird Sylphy 中的末尾部分

patterns.name: Greybird 主题名末尾
patterns.context: 桌面主题专名 Greybird 中的末尾部分

en.concept: Letter fragments in the middle and at the ends of words
en.description: Activations often fall on contiguous letter fragments in the middle or at the ends of words: leman (including gentleman, Alleman, audleman), bird, fish, boxes, and son. Some fragments may relate to meaning or domain, but their behavior varies across contexts.

patterns.name: gentleman / -leman spelling fragment
patterns.context: Activations fall on the leman letter fragment in gentleman or similarly spelled names/words; may occur in possessives, quotations, book titles, or literary prose.

patterns.name: -man surname or name fragment
patterns.context: Activations fall on the final letter fragment of the name Alleman, possibly sharing character features with the gentleman pattern.

patterns.name: -bird ending
patterns.context: Activations fall on the bird ending in the compounds earlybird and warbird; the contexts differ in their specific meanings.

patterns.name: -fish ending
patterns.context: Activations fall on the final fish fragment of the surname Lowenfish.
patterns.domain: Book titles and author names in baseball articles

patterns.name: -box / boxes fragment
patterns.context: Activations fall on the final boxes in the compound mailboxes.

patterns.name: -son surname fragment
patterns.context: Activations fall on the final fragment of the name Claeson in a bibliographic citation.

1_2469.concept: 词中及词尾字母片段
1_2469.description: 激活多落在词中或词尾的连续字母片段：leman（含 gentleman、Alleman、audleman）、bird、fish、boxes、son。部分片段可与词义或领域关联，但跨语境表现不一。

patterns.name: gentleman / -leman 拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 gentleman 或拼写相近的人名/词的 leman 字母片段；可出现在所有格、引语、书名或文学正文中。

patterns.name: -man 姓氏或姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人名 Alleman 的末尾字母片段，与 gentleman 模式可能共享字符特征。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、拼字比赛报道

patterns.name: -bird 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在 bird 这一词尾片段，分别出现在复合词 earlybird 和 warbird 中；语境与其具体含义不同。
patterns.domain: 活动公告、航空爱好者论坛

patterns.name: -fish 词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在姓氏 Lowenfish 的末尾 fish 片段。
patterns.domain: 棒球文章中的书名及作者姓名

patterns.name: -box / boxes 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在复合词 mailboxes 的词尾 boxes。

patterns.name: -son 姓氏片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人名 Claeson 的末尾片段，出现在文献引用中。

en.concept: thumbnail subword fragment, with occasional proper-name activations
en.description: The strongest recurring pattern is the nail fragment when thumbnail is split; other activations include castle in Newcastle/Rockcastle, Theatre/borough in theater listings, and sporadic triggers for Board, steeper, waters, riot, and several weak fragments.

patterns.name: thumbnail ending/segmentation
patterns.context: Activates on the nail subword fragment when thumbnail is split as thumb«nail»; adjacent suffixes may also activate, such as «er»2, «Image»2.
patterns.domain: Web markup, forum discussions, programming Q&A, place-name entries

patterns.name: Proper names and the stem castle
patterns.context: Occurs at the ends of place names, especially Newcastle upon Tyne and Rockcastle County.

patterns.name: theatre term
patterns.context: In performance listings, Theatre follows a theater or region name; borough also activates strongly when Finborough and Theatre are adjacent.

patterns.name: steep in medical curves
patterns.context: Describes equivalent curves becoming steeper as the number of doses increases; activation falls on the initial fragment of steeper.

patterns.name: Patent Board
patterns.context: Occurs in the institution name Patent Trial & Appeal Board.

patterns.name: riot
patterns.context: In the phrase riot grrrls, as part of a subculture name; activation is weak.

patterns.name: waters
patterns.context: Occurs in the geographic description headwaters of the Green River.

patterns.name: Past-participle suffix indicating completion
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across multiple words or phrase fragments split into subwords, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition; these weak activations may be incidental co-occurrences.

1_2469.concept: thumbnail 词片段，兼有专名偶发激活
1_2469.description: 最强且反复的模式是 thumbnail 被拆分时的 nail 片段；另有 Newcastle/Rockcastle 的 castle、戏剧条目中的 Theatre/borough，以及零散触发 Board、steeper、waters、riot 和若干弱片段激活。

patterns.name: thumbnail 词尾/分词
patterns.context: 在 thumbnail 被拆分为 thumb«nail» 的词片段中激活；有时相邻后缀也激活，如 «er»2、«Image»2。
patterns.domain: 网页标记、论坛讨论、编程问答、地名条目

patterns.name: 专名与词干 castle
patterns.context: 出现在地名末尾，尤其是 Newcastle upon Tyne 和 Rockcastle County。

patterns.name: theatre 词项
patterns.context: 剧目演出记录中，Theatre 前接剧院或地区名称；Finborough 与 Theatre 相邻时 borough 也强烈激活。

patterns.name: 医学曲线中的 steep
patterns.context: 描述等效曲线随分次数增加而变陡；激活落在 steeper 的词首片段。

patterns.name: Patent Board
patterns.context: 出现在 Patent Trial & Appeal Board 这一机构名称中。

patterns.name: riot
patterns.context: 短语 riot grrrls 中，作为亚文化名称的一部分；激活较弱。

patterns.name: waters
patterns.context: 出现在地理描述 headwaters of the Green River 中。

patterns.name: 表示完成的过去分词后缀
patterns.context: 激活分散在多个被分词切开的词或短语片段中，未见一致的语义或句法条件；这些弱激活可能是偶然共现。

en.description: Strong activations cluster on several specific within-word fragments: inates in discriminate, ateur in Amateur, and a few endings such as rees, yard, and inaries. These fragments occur across different semantics and styles and cannot be explained by a single theme.

patterns.name: Within-word fragment in discriminate
patterns.context: The trigger occurs on the final fragment “inates” in discriminate/discriminates; in [1] it means distinguishing light levels, in [2] government discrimination, in [3][4] discrimination against groups or users, and in [7] distinguishing disease categories; the meanings differ
patterns.domain: Patents, political commentary, online discussions, medical abstracts

patterns.name: Endings such as -ateur/-yard
patterns.context: Activations fall on specific endings within complete words; [5] is Amateur in a golf event name, [9] is Amateur as a programmer category, and [8] is Halfyard in a personal name

patterns.name: Occupational ending -rees
patterns.context: Activates on the plural ending of referee in descriptions of NBA referees and their hiring

patterns.name: Mathematical term ending -aries
patterns.context: Activates at the end of preliminaries, referring to preparatory material containing definitions in a paper

1_2469.concept: 特定词内片段
1_2469.description: 高激活集中在若干特定词内片段：discriminate 的 inates、Amateur 的 ateur，以及少数词尾 rees、yard、inaries；这些片段跨不同语义与文体出现，不能统一解释为某个主题。

patterns.name: discriminate 的词内片段
patterns.context: 触发位置位于 discriminate/discriminates 的词尾片段“inates”；在 [1] 表示辨别光照水平，在 [2] 表示政府歧视，在 [3][4] 表示对群体或用户的歧视，在 [7] 表示区分疾病类别，语义不同
patterns.domain: 专利、政治评论、网络讨论、医学摘要

patterns.name: -ateur/-yard 等词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在完整词内部的特定词尾片段；[5] 为高尔夫赛事名称中的 Amateur，[9] 为程序员类别 Amateur，[8] 为人名 Halfyard
patterns.domain: 邮件、网络讨论、体育传记

patterns.name: 职业词尾 -rees
patterns.context: 激活在 referee 的复数词尾，处于 NBA 裁判及聘用叙述中

patterns.name: 数学术语词尾 -aries
patterns.context: 激活在 preliminaries 一词的末尾，指论文中给出定义的预备内容

en.description: Strong activations often fall on English word endings or subword fragments: away, toileting, referees, remained, room, and less; fragments in Dutch and proper names also occur. Semantics and styles are scattered, with no unified trigger condition.

patterns.name: away ending component
patterns.context: In English compounds, away occurs at the end; contexts concern dietary advice or steal statistics in sports games

patterns.name: Place or region ending
patterns.context: Plural region or country name components in geographical or political contexts
patterns.domain: Dutch European Parliament texts; English conspiracy texts

patterns.name: Internal fragment in the proper name FreeType
patterns.context: Occurs in the FreeType project name and its license description

patterns.name: toileting in activities of daily living
patterns.context: Lists activities of daily living requiring assistance or attention, alongside eating, drinking, and showering

patterns.name: NBA referee ending
patterns.context: In descriptions of basketball league referees’ hiring and career histories, activations fall on the ending of referees

patterns.name: Ending of remained
patterns.context: Indicates that something continued to be in a given state, referring respectively to unopened books and unpaid fines

patterns.name: room ending in restroom
patterns.context: Describes being escorted to the restroom in a legal account

patterns.name: less ending in needless
patterns.context: The fixed expression “Needless to say” introduces commentary

patterns.name: Unexplained isolated triggers
patterns.context: No stable, shared trigger condition is apparent in the available contexts
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias; Dutch parliamentary texts; several other texts with low-intensity activations

1_2469.concept: 词尾及子词片段
1_2469.description: 强激活多落在英文词尾或子词片段：away、toileting、referees、remained、room、less；另见荷兰语与专名中的片段。语义和文体分散，触发条件并不统一。

patterns.name: away 词尾成分
patterns.context: 英文复合词中 away 是词尾，语境与饮食建议或体育比赛的抢断统计有关

patterns.name: 地名或地区词尾
patterns.context: 地理或政治语境中的复数区域、国家名称成分
patterns.domain: 荷兰语欧洲议会文本；英文阴谋论文本

patterns.name: FreeType 专名的内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在 FreeType 项目名称及其许可说明中

patterns.name: 日常生活活动中的 toileting
patterns.context: 列举需要协助或注意的日常生活活动，周围包含 eating、drinking、showering

patterns.name: NBA 裁判词尾
patterns.context: 篮球联盟裁判的聘用、履历描述中，激活落在 referees 的词尾

patterns.name: remained 的词尾
patterns.context: 表示某物仍处于某状态，分别用于未开启的书籍和未缴罚款

patterns.name: restroom 的 room 词尾
patterns.context: 法律叙述中描述被护送去洗手间

patterns.name: needless 的 less 词尾
patterns.context: 固定表达“Needless to say”引出评论

patterns.name: 未解释的孤立触发
patterns.context: 现有上下文中看不出稳定、共同的触发条件
patterns.domain: 体育百科；荷兰语议会文本；其余文本中多处低强度激活

en.description: The main activation is on the ending its in limits, across disciplines and contexts; strong activations also occur on the ending of the Dutch verscheidenheid and the ending of the title Takeaway. The latter two have no clear semantic connection to the main pattern.

patterns.name: Ending of limits
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the noun limits in titles, body text, book titles, and technical texts; no specific semantic domain is required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts: philosophy, mathematics, news, energy trading, etc.

patterns.name: Ending of variety
patterns.context: Occurs in a sentence describing the diversity of specific characteristics of a coastal region; differs from the English limits pattern.

patterns.name: Title ending
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the article subheading Takeaway, followed by a colon and a summary; has no clear semantic connection to limits.
patterns.domain: Online fitness and dietary advice articles

1_2469.concept: 词尾片段识别（以 limits 的 -its 为主）
1_2469.description: 主要对 limits 的词尾 its 激活，跨学科与语境出现；另对荷兰语 verscheidenheid 的词尾及标题 Takeaway 的词尾强烈激活，后二者与主模式无明显语义联系。

patterns.name: limits 的词尾
patterns.context: 出现在名词 limits 的词尾，涵盖标题、正文、书名及技术文本；不要求特定语义领域。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本：哲学、数学、新闻、能源交易等

patterns.name: variety 的词尾
patterns.trigger: “versche«iden»10«heid»6”，即荷兰语 verscheidenheid 的词尾部分
patterns.context: 出现在描述沿海地区具体特征多样性的句子中；与英文 limits 模式不同。

patterns.name: 标题词尾
patterns.context: 出现在文章小标题 Takeaway 的词尾，后接冒号并引出总结；与 limits 无明显语义联系。
patterns.domain: 健身、饮食建议类网络文章

en.description: The most stable strong trigger is the ending fragment its in limits, appearing across titles and body text in multiple domains. Other activations include disagrees in legal contexts and a local activation in the proper name Landmark; the remaining activations are weaker and lack a shared explanation.

patterns.name: Limits word form and title use
patterns.context: Strongly responds to the ending fragment its in the word form limits; appears in body text, paper titles, book titles, or title-like phrases, with no fixed preceding semantics.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts; philosophy, mathematics, science, and general writing

patterns.name: Expression of disagreement in legal rulings
patterns.context: Occurs in court opinions where the subject is the court or a party, describing disagreement with a claim, fact, or issue.

patterns.name: Fragment in the proper name Landmark
patterns.context: Activations fall within the proper name Landmark; occurs in company names and legal case-related contexts.

1_2469.concept: 词形片段 its（尤其 limits）
1_2469.description: 最稳定的强触发是 limits 的词尾片段 its，跨标题与正文、多个领域出现。另有法律语境中的 disagrees，以及专名 Landmark 的局部激活；其余激活较弱且缺少共同解释。

patterns.name: Limits 词形及标题用法
patterns.context: 对 limits 词形中的词尾片段 its 有强反应；出现在正文、论文标题、书名或标题式短语中，前置语义不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；哲学、数学、科学及一般文字

patterns.name: 法律判决中的分歧表达
patterns.context: 出现在法院意见中，主语为 court 或当事方，描述对主张、事实或问题持不同意见。

patterns.name: Landmark 专名中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 Landmark 这个专名内部；分别出现在公司名称及法律案件相关语境。

en.description: Strong activations are scattered across several endings and proper-name fragments: Delegates and highways are most prominent, with additional examples including -ones, -erton, -bound, -lands, -ways, -ists, and -ends. Other fragments lack shared semantics or context.

patterns.name: Delegates
patterns.context: Occurs in contexts involving people’s names, state legislatures, or conference members; the word is often split and marked as Deleg + ates
patterns.domain: Law, state government, historical conferences, and biographies

patterns.name: Plural highways
patterns.context: Plural forms highways/highways appear in road names, transport infrastructure, or highway systems described by law
patterns.domain: Law, traffic news, place names, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Plural ending -ones
patterns.context: Occurs in the plural ending of co-chaperones in a biology context; may be sensitive to the segmented ones fragment or plural suffix

patterns.name: -erton in a proper name
patterns.context: Occurs in the place-name ending of Cal State Fullerton

patterns.name: -bound ending
patterns.context: Occurs in directional compounds such as eastbound, describing road traffic

patterns.name: -lands ending
patterns.context: Occurs as part of the place name Highlands

patterns.name: -ways / ways ending
patterns.context: Occurs in the book title Byways, adjacent to place names or road-related words such as highways and highlands

patterns.name: -ists ending
patterns.context: Occurs in motorists, referring to road users; nearby words include detoured, bridge, and ramps

patterns.name: -ends ending
patterns.context: Occurs in ancient legends, referring to historical or legendary figures

patterns.name: Unclear spelling fragments
patterns.context: Appear respectively in shutout, State, the number 5, interred, Havana, Skye, and Wattis; no contextual conditions unify these fragments
patterns.domain: Sports news, financial reporting, biographies, encyclopedia entries

1_2469.concept: 复数词尾与专名/词尾片段
1_2469.description: 强激活分散在若干词尾和专名片段：Delegates、highways 最显著，另见 -ones、-erton、-bound、-lands、-ways、-ists、-ends；其余片段缺少共同语义或语境。

patterns.name: 委托代表（Delegates）
patterns.context: 出现在人名、州议会或会议成员等语境中，词通常被拆分标记为 Deleg + ates
patterns.domain: 法律、州政、历史会议与人物传记

patterns.name: 复数 highways
patterns.context: 道路名称、交通设施或法律所述公路体系中出现 highways/highways 的复数形式
patterns.domain: 法律、交通新闻、地名与百科条目

patterns.name: 复数词尾 -ones
patterns.context: 出现在 co-chaperones 一词的复数词尾，生物学语境；可能对拆分后的 ones 片段或复数后缀敏感

patterns.name: 专名中的 -erton
patterns.context: 出现在 Cal State Fullerton 的地名后缀中

patterns.name: 词尾 -bound
patterns.context: 出现在 eastbound 这类方向复合词中，描述道路交通

patterns.name: 词尾 -lands
patterns.context: 出现在 Highlands 这一地名组成部分中

patterns.name: 词尾 -ways / ways
patterns.context: 出现在书名 Byways 中，与 highways、highlands 等地名或道路相关词相邻

patterns.name: 词尾 -ists
patterns.context: 出现在表示道路使用者的 motorists 中，附近有 detoured、bridge、ramps 等交通词

patterns.name: 词尾 -ends
patterns.context: 出现在 ancient legends 中，指历史人物或传奇人物

patterns.name: 未明确的拼写片段
patterns.context: 分别见 shutout、State、数字 5、interred、Havana、Skye、Wattis；未见足以统一这些片段的上下文条件
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、财政报道、传记、百科条目

en.description: Activations are distributed across within-word fragments in words from many domains and sporadic whole words; the more recognizable local clusters are solicits and disagrees in legal contexts and terms related to plasmapheresis in medical contexts, but overall there is no unified semantic or grammatical pattern.

patterns.name: Within-word suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments or endings of longer words, including biomedical terminology, general vocabulary, and legal language, with no unified meaning.

patterns.name: solicits word form
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences describing soliciting, requesting, or attracting attention; often in legal contexts, but also in philosophical discussion.

patterns.name: disagrees word form
patterns.context: Used to express that a court or party holds a different opinion.

patterns.name: Terms related to plasmapheresis
patterns.context: Concerns plasma exchange and its clinical applications or experimental evaluation; activations span within-word fragments after segmentation.

patterns.name: Function words in phrase structures
patterns.context: These markers are scattered across different syntactic environments, with no stable, consistent local structure or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Other terms in medical research contexts
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of platelet immunoadsorption, dental measurements, or clinical research; no unified trigger condition is evident among other activated words in the same passage.

patterns.name: Judicial terms in legal arguments
patterns.context: Occurs in argumentation where a court states its position.

1_2469.concept: none
1_2469.description: 激活分布于多领域词语的词内片段及零散完整词；较可辨认的局部簇是法律语境的solicits、disagrees，以及医学语境的plasmapheresis相关词，但整体缺乏统一语义或语法模式。

patterns.name: 词内后缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词的内部片段或词尾；包括生物医学术语、一般词汇和法律用语，未见统一词义。

patterns.name: solicits词形
patterns.context: 出现在描述招揽、请求或吸引注意的句子中；多次为法律语境，也有哲学论述。

patterns.name: disagrees词形
patterns.context: 用于表达法院或当事方持不同意见。

patterns.name: plasmapheresis相关词
patterns.context: 涉及血浆置换及其临床用途或实验评估；激活覆盖拆分后的词内片段。

patterns.name: 短语结构中的功能词
patterns.context: 这些标记分散出现在不同句法环境中，没有稳定一致的局部结构或语义条件。

patterns.name: 医学研究语境中的其他术语
patterns.context: 出现在血小板免疫吸附、牙齿测量或临床研究描述中；与同段其他激活词未显示统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律论证中的裁判词
patterns.context: 出现在法院表明立场的论证语句中。

en.description: Activations mainly occur on English word endings or derivational suffix fragments, commonly -ases, -its, -leases, -ation, and -iling; TeX command fragments, short words, and whitespace also appear, so a single semantic explanation is not possible.

patterns.name: Verb endings such as -ases/-ates
patterns.context: Markers cluster on word suffixes or endings, especially at the junction between a stem and ending; they cover different meanings and contexts and cannot be attributed to a single semantic category
patterns.domain: Biomedical, legal, encyclopedia, news, and technical texts

patterns.name: Longer within-word suffixes or derived forms
patterns.context: Activations fall on derivational suffixes or final portions within words, occurring in nouns or gerunds

patterns.name: Common short words and root endings
patterns.context: A few high-frequency words or root endings also activate; contextual conditions are unclear, making them difficult to unify with the main word-form pattern

patterns.name: Internal fragments in TeX commands
patterns.context: Activations occur on word fragments in LaTeX macro commands and their arguments, in formatting code contexts

patterns.name: Whitespace marker
patterns.context: Activations fall on spaces near an HTML image placeholder; may be a formatting or tokenization effect

1_2469.concept: 词形后缀与词尾片段
1_2469.description: 主要激活英语词的词尾或派生后缀片段，常见于 -ases、-its、-leases、-ation、-iling 等；也见 TeX 命令片段、短词及空白，无法由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: 动词词尾 -ases/-ates 等形式
patterns.context: 标记集中在词的后缀或词尾，尤其是由词干与词尾拼接处；涵盖不同词义和语境，不能仅归为某个语义类别
patterns.domain: 生物医学、法律、百科、新闻、技术文本

patterns.name: 词中较长后缀或派生形式
patterns.context: 激活落在词内的派生后缀或词尾部分，出现在名词或动名词中

patterns.name: 常见短词与词根尾部
patterns.context: 少量高频词或词根尾部也有激活；上下文条件不明显，难以与主要词形模式统一

patterns.name: TeX 命令内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在 LaTeX 宏命令及其参数中的词片段，格式化代码语境

patterns.name: 空白标记
patterns.context: 激活落在 HTML 图片占位符附近的空格；可能是格式或分词效应
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的网页内容

en.concept: Specific subword fragments and word forms
en.description: Activations are scattered across within-word fragments, endings, proper names, and code indentation, including solicits, replicase, unveiling, tutored/tutoring, and -ed; no unified semantic or domain condition is apparent, and activations may primarily respond to specific subword fragments and their segmentation.

patterns.name: Verb ending -sits
patterns.context: English third-person singular verbs ending in -sits; contexts include solicits, meaning to solicit, invite, or attract.

patterns.name: Replicase word form
patterns.context: The word ending -ase/-ases in the biological term Q-beta replicase.

patterns.name: Performer word form
patterns.context: The plural ending in the proper name Mona Lisas and Mad Hatters.

patterns.name: unveiling word form
patterns.context: A within-word fragment in the noun unveiling, or quotation marks immediately following it; occurs in contexts such as releases and unveilings.

patterns.name: Code indentation spaces
patterns.context: Eight spaces at the beginning of Python code lines, used to indent docstrings and statements.

patterns.name: Segmentation and word endings
patterns.context: Within-word fragments involving inflections of tutored/tutoring and segmentation of spreadsheets.
patterns.domain: Personal profiles, teaching, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Compound-internal segmentation
patterns.context: The child word segment and the preposition of in ordinary phrases; local activations show no clear semantic condition.

patterns.name: Within-word segmentation: wide
patterns.context: The internal fragment in worldwide.

patterns.name: -ed ending
patterns.context: The past-participle ending of restored in a description of natural teeth.

1_2469.concept: 特定子词片段与词形
1_2469.description: 激活分散于不同词内片段、词尾、专名及代码缩进：包括 solicits、replicase、unveiling、tutored/tutoring、-ed 等；未见统一语义或领域条件，可能主要响应特定子词片段及其切分。

patterns.name: 动词词尾 -sits
patterns.context: 英语第三人称单数动词以 -sits 结尾；上下文中出现 solicits，表示招揽、邀请或吸引。

patterns.name: 复制酶词形
patterns.context: 生物学术语 Q-beta replicase 的词尾 -ase/-ases。

patterns.name: 演出者词形
patterns.context: 专名 Mona Lisas and Mad Hatters 中的复数词尾。

patterns.name: unveiling 词形
patterns.context: 名词 unveiling 的词内片段，或紧邻其后的引号；出现在发布、揭幕等语境。

patterns.name: 代码缩进空格
patterns.context: Python 代码中行首的八个空格，用于缩进文档字符串及语句。

patterns.name: 分词与词尾
patterns.context: 词内片段，涉及 tutored/tutoring 的词形变化及 spreadsheets 的切分。
patterns.domain: 个人简介、教学与技术讨论

patterns.name: 复合词内部切分
patterns.context: 普通短语中的 child 词段及 of 介词；局部激活未显示明确语义条件。

patterns.name: 词内切分：wide
patterns.context: worldwide 一词的内部片段。

patterns.name: 词尾 -ed
patterns.context: 自然牙齿的描述中，restored 的过去分词词尾。

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on contiguous AMP letter sequences in mixed case, within words or identifiers; this includes timestamps, technical abbreviations, API constants, paths, and ordinary words. The trigger sometimes extends to neighboring tokens.

patterns.name: AMP substring
patterns.context: Activation falls on AMP substrings in varying case, which may occur in standalone abbreviations, within identifiers, path names, or ordinary words.

patterns.name: Timestamp-related identifiers
patterns.context: AMP is part of timestamp, timestamping, or UNIX_TIMESTAMP, commonly appearing in time conversion, field names, or SQL queries.

patterns.name: AMP product or technical abbreviation
patterns.context: AMP abbreviates Accelerated Mobile Pages or loop-mediated isothermal amplification.

patterns.name: MAMP path component
patterns.context: AMP appears in a MAMP development environment path or name; activation may also extend to adjacent characters.
patterns.domain: Software paths, personal names in legal texts

patterns.name: Graphics API constant
patterns.context: AMP is a substring within the OpenGL constant GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE.

patterns.name: CAMP in place names
patterns.context: AMP occurs in Campbell or CAMPUS and is not the abbreviation AMP.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, personal or organization names

patterns.name: CHAMPION in a book title
patterns.context: AMP is an internal letter sequence in CHAMPION in narrative text.

1_2918.description: 激活最稳定地落在大小写混合、词内或标识符中的连续 AMP 字母序列；涵盖时间戳、技术缩写、API 常量、路径及普通词，触发范围有时延伸到邻近 token。

patterns.name: AMP 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在大小写不一的 AMP 子串中；可处于独立缩写、标识符内部、路径名或普通词内部。

patterns.name: 时间戳相关标识符
patterns.context: AMP 是 timestamp、timestamping 或 UNIX_TIMESTAMP 的一部分，常见于时间转换、字段名或 SQL 查询。

patterns.name: AMP 产品或技术缩写
patterns.context: AMP 是 Accelerated Mobile Pages 或 loop-mediated isothermal amplification 的缩写。

patterns.name: MAMP 路径组件
patterns.context: AMP 出现在 MAMP 开发环境路径或名称中；激活也可能延伸到相邻字符。
patterns.domain: 软件路径、法律文本中的人名

patterns.name: 图形 API 常量
patterns.context: AMP 是 OpenGL 常量 GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE 的内部子串。

patterns.name: 地名中的 CAMP
patterns.context: AMP 位于 Campbell 或 CAMPUS 中，并非缩写 AMP。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、人名或机构名

patterns.name: 书名中的 CHAMPION
patterns.context: AMP 是叙事文本中 CHAMPION 一词的内部字母序列。

en.description: All snippets activate on the contiguous characters AMP: they may cross tokenization boundaries and occur in forms such as timestamp, MAMP, CAMP, campus, champion, and AMP/LAMP; the remaining contexts vary widely.

patterns.name: amp substring
patterns.context: Occurs in varying case within longer words or abbreviations, including AMP, CAMP, CLAMP, TIMESTAMP, MAMP, CHAMP, and LAMP.
patterns.domain: Mixed text including code, web pages, legal, literary, and medical content

patterns.name: Timestamp-related identifiers
patterns.context: AMP occurs at the end of timestamp/timestamping in SQL, system identifiers, and code.

patterns.name: MAMP name or path
patterns.context: AMP occurs in MAMP, as a software path and as a capitalized name in text.

patterns.name: CAMP in proper names
patterns.context: AMP is a sequence of letters in Campbell or campus, not an obvious standalone semantic marker.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, accounts involving religious institutions

patterns.name: Standalone or abbreviated AMP
patterns.context: AMP appears as a web technology abbreviation, as part of the medical abbreviation LAMP, or as a letter sequence in champion.
patterns.domain: Web articles, medical papers, literary texts

patterns.name: CLAMP macro name
patterns.context: AMP occurs in the OpenGL constant GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE.

1_2918.description: 所有片段都激活于连续字符 AMP：它可横跨分词边界，出现在时间戳、MAMP、CAMP、campus、champion、AMP/LAMP 等形式中；其余上下文差异很大。

patterns.name: amp子串
patterns.context: 大小写均出现于更长的词或缩写内部；包括 AMP、CAMP、CLAMP、TIMESTAMP、MAMP、CHAMP、LAMP。
patterns.domain: 代码、网页、法律、文学、医学等混合文本

patterns.name: 时间戳相关标识符
patterns.context: AMP 位于 timestamp/timestamping 的末尾，出现在 SQL、系统标识符和代码中。

patterns.name: MAMP名称或路径
patterns.context: AMP 位于 MAMP 中；分别是软件路径和文本中的大写名称。

patterns.name: 专名中的CAMP
patterns.context: AMP 是 Campbell、campus 中连续字母的一部分，而非明显的独立语义标记。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、宗教机构相关叙述

patterns.name: 独立或缩写AMP
patterns.context: AMP 作为网页技术缩写、医学缩写 LAMP 的组成部分，或单词 champion 的字母序列出现。
patterns.domain: 网页文章、医学论文、文学文本

patterns.name: CLAMP宏名
patterns.context: AMP 位于 OpenGL 常量 GL_CLAMP_TO_EDGE 中。

en.description: All segments mark the uppercase character sequence AMP: it may be embedded in timestamp, code identifiers, and proper names, or occur as the abbreviation AMP or the beginning of amplification; it appears across domains and meanings.

patterns.name: AMP in TIMESTAMP
patterns.context: Embedded in TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPING, usually in SQL timestamp functions, types, or system identifiers.

patterns.name: AMP in other code identifiers
patterns.context: Uppercase AMP is part of a longer identifier, such as a path or constant name, rather than a standalone word.

patterns.name: AMP in proper names
patterns.context: The uppercase sequence AMP is embedded in proper names, including personal names, place names, or chapter text.

patterns.name: AMP abbreviation or amplification term
patterns.context: Uppercase AMP appears alone as a name/abbreviation or at the beginning of AMPlification; there is no clear shared meaning.

1_2918.description: 所有段都标记了大写字符序列 AMP：它可嵌在 timestamp、代码标识符和专名中，也可作为 AMP 缩写或 amplification 的词首；跨领域、跨语义出现。

patterns.name: TIMESTAMP 中的 AMP
patterns.context: 嵌在 TIMESTAMP/TIMESTAMPING 中；多为 SQL 时间戳函数、类型或系统标识符。

patterns.name: 其他代码标识符中的 AMP
patterns.context: 大写 AMP 是较长标识符的一部分，如路径名或常量名，并非单独词语。
patterns.domain: JavaScript 堆栈信息、图形/API 代码

patterns.name: 专名中的 AMP
patterns.context: 大写字母序列 AMP 嵌在专名中；包括人名、地名或章节文本。

patterns.name: AMP 缩写或扩增术语
patterns.context: 大写 AMP 单独出现作名称/缩写，或作为 AMPlification 词首；没有明显共同语义。

en.description: Activation locations are scattered: the Chinese word “内容”, SQL TIMESTAMP, the product name Motorola RAZR, and purchases in various contexts; there is also a protocol constant. No stable contextual pattern unifies these triggers.

patterns.name: Text related to Chinese “内容”
patterns.context: “内容” appears in Chinese sentences or comments, with the marker on “内”; also includes descriptions of file contents.
patterns.domain: Chinese GitHub comments, documentation, or mixed-language text

patterns.name: SQL timestamp expression
patterns.context: TIMESTAMP appears in SQL, often near time functions such as CAST, CURRENT_TIME, or UNIX_TIMESTAMP.

patterns.name: RAZR product name
patterns.context: A news headline mentions the Motorola RAZR foldable phone.

patterns.name: Example of customers buying online
patterns.context: Describes a company providing customers with a software application for purchasing goods online.
patterns.domain: Patent background or commercial service description

patterns.name: Purchasing activity in court records
patterns.context: Legal narrative mentions someone selling cattle and hay, or related buyers.

patterns.name: purchases in a financial context
patterns.context: Discusses banking, private banking, or asset management, and says they require low capital.

patterns.name: Isolated protocol constant
patterns.context: A timestamp status constant in an ICMP/socket-related structure or enum definition.

1_2918.description: 激活落点分散：中文“内容”、SQL 的 TIMESTAMP、产品名 Motorola RAZR，以及多种语境中的 purchases；另有协议常量。未见足以统一这些触发项的稳定上下文模式。

patterns.name: 中文“内容”相关文本
patterns.context: 中文句子或注释中出现“内容”，标记落在“内”字；也包括与文件内容有关的描述。
patterns.domain: GitHub 中文注释、文档或混合语言文本

patterns.name: SQL 时间戳表达式
patterns.context: SQL 中出现 TIMESTAMP，常与 CAST、CURRENT_TIME 或 UNIX_TIMESTAMP 等时间函数相邻。

patterns.name: RAZR 产品名
patterns.context: 新闻标题中提及 Motorola RAZR 可折叠手机。

patterns.name: 客户在线购买示例
patterns.context: 描述企业为客户提供软件应用，以便在线购买商品。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术或商业服务说明

patterns.name: 法院记录中的购买行为
patterns.context: 法律叙述中提及某人售出牛和干草，或相关购买者。

patterns.name: 金融语境中的 purchases
patterns.context: 谈论银行业务、私人银行或资产管理，并称其需要低资本。

patterns.name: 孤立协议常量
patterns.context: ICMP/套接字相关结构或枚举定义中的时间戳状态常量。

en.description: All ten segments highlight might, followed by anything from a simple verb to have constructions and negation, expressing possibility, speculation, hypothesis, or a polite suggestion. Topics and styles vary widely, and other words and phrases differ substantially.

patterns.name: might in modal constructions
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on might, which often introduces a possibility, hypothesis, suggestion, or uncertain outcome; it may be followed by a bare verb, have + participle, or not.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain styles including explanations, narratives, emails, commentary, and advice

patterns.name: Expressions of uncertainty and speculation
patterns.context: The context concerns an uncertain future, speculation, or unrealized outcome; however, not all specific expressions in these snippets are marked as positive activations. The primary activation remains on might.
patterns.domain: Personal correspondence, news commentary, sports narratives, and general explanations

patterns.name: First- and second-person and communication contexts
patterns.context: Possibilities or requests concern the speaker, recipient, or a shared relationship; person marking itself is not consistently activated across segments and cannot be treated as a stable trigger on its own.
patterns.domain: Emails, interpersonal narratives, and religious/reflective writing

patterns.name: Diverse content following might
patterns.context: The content following might varies widely, involving knowledge, communication, emotions, relationships, competition, sports goals, and difficulties; there is no shared lexical theme.
patterns.domain: Science headlines, business emails, religious essays, personal emails, news commentary, game/town discussions, sports reporting, and legal advice

patterns.name: Possibility judgments in contrast or transition
patterns.context: A possibility judgment appears in a sentence with a transition, contrast, or revised expectation; these are local pragmatic contexts for might, not shared by all segments.
patterns.domain: Psychological advice, personal emails, and news commentary

1_2918.description: 全部十段都突出激活 might，后接从简单动词到 have 结构及否定结构，表达可能、推测、假设或委婉建议。话题和文体跨度很大，其他词句差异明显。

patterns.name: 情态结构中的 might
patterns.trigger: “might”及其后的动词或动词短语，如 “might not know”“might have”“might find”“might seem”“might be”“might not be able”
patterns.context: 主要激活落在 might；它常引出可能、假设、建议或不确定结果，后面可接动词原形，也可接 have + 分词或 not。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的说明、叙事、邮件、评论与劝告等文体

patterns.name: 不确定性与推测表达
patterns.trigger: “Who knows what the future brings”“It appears”“could have entirely envisioned”“not look bright”等与可能性相关的表达
patterns.context: 语境围绕尚未确定的未来、推测或未实现的结果；但这些片段中的具体表达并非都标记为正激活，主要激活仍在 might。
patterns.domain: 个人通信、新闻评论、体育叙事及一般说明

patterns.name: 第一、二人称及交流语境
patterns.trigger: “you might”“we might”“I was hoping that you might”“relates to us”
patterns.context: 可能性或请求涉及说话者、收信者或共同关系；不同段落中人称本身的激活并不一致，不能单独视为稳定触发条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、人际叙述与宗教/反思性文字

patterns.name: 话题各异的后续内容
patterns.trigger: “about fish”“a hole in communications”“incredible joy”“someone better than me”“better shops”“high goals”“a way out”等
patterns.context: might 后接内容差异很大，分别涉及知识、沟通、情绪、关系、竞争、体育目标和困境；未见共同的词汇主题。
patterns.domain: 科普标题、商务邮件、宗教随笔、私人邮件、新闻评论、游戏/城镇讨论、体育报道及法律建议

patterns.name: 对比或转折中的可能判断
patterns.trigger: “These two ideas might seem contradictory but…”；“Even so … you might find…”；“might have been moved a little bit”
patterns.context: 可能性判断嵌在转折、对照或修正预期的语句中；这些是 might 的局部语用环境，并非所有段落共有。
patterns.domain: 心理建议、个人邮件与新闻评论

en.description: Activation is mainly on might, followed by various possible outcomes; there is also activation on the compensate word family and a few words such as gear, relationship, searching, and potential. Contexts span multiple domains, with no unifying semantic theme.

patterns.name: Tokens following might
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the modal verb might, especially when followed immediately by an unmarked verb or phrase; in [1], might may also function as a prediction at the sentence level.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain web, email, religious/philosophical, legal, and game text

patterns.name: Compensation word family
patterns.context: Contexts include compensating someone for their time, mitigating famine risk, or compensating a litigant; the trigger itself is unmarked, while compensate is marked.
patterns.domain: Business emails, health information, legal texts

patterns.name: Other sporadic triggers
patterns.context: These highlighted words each occur in different contexts, with no stable shared local pattern.
patterns.domain: Science communication, personal emails, religious philosophy

1_2918.description: 主要激活于 might，后接各种可能性内容；另对 compensate 词族及少数 gear、relationship、searching、potential 等词有激活。语境跨领域，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: might 后的词元
patterns.context: 激活集中出现在情态动词 might，尤其是它后面紧跟未标记的动词或短语时；[1]中 might 也可能表示整句位置上的预测。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的网页、邮件、宗教哲学、法律及游戏文本

patterns.name: 补偿词族
patterns.context: 在补偿某人时间、弥补饥荒风险或赔偿诉讼对方等语境中；触发词本身未标出，标记在 compensate。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、健康科普、法律文本

patterns.name: 其他零散触发
patterns.context: 这些高亮词各自出现在不同语境，未见稳定的共同局部模式。
patterns.domain: 科普、私人邮件、宗教哲学

en.concept: «lems» letter fragment and similar word segments
en.description: Most activations fall on «lems» in Danish and Swedish forms of “member states”; activation also occurs on similar letter fragments in golems and underscore/underscored, as well as on y after Beck in an email, possibly mixing word-form and local token features.

patterns.name: Member-state stem in Danish compounds
patterns.context: Activation falls on the cross-token fragment «lems», followed by Danish staters; the surrounding text discusses EU member states, solidarity, and policy.

patterns.name: Danish “member state” word forms
patterns.context: Activation appears on the stem fragment of the word for member state; surrounding text concerns member-state measures, funding, or implementation.

patterns.name: Swedish “member state” word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls within med«lems»staterna; the context discusses member-state responsibilities, legal implementation, or policy.

patterns.name: Local fragment in Swedish member-state policy contexts
patterns.context: The same word form appears in policy discussions involving transfers, response deadlines, and similar topics; activation remains localized within the word.

patterns.name: Same letter fragment in the English plural golems
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs in go«lems», not in “member states”; adjacent text discusses golems.

patterns.name: Underscore word in PHP post data
patterns.context: Activation falls on the undersc...core word segment; the original text is underscore. The title asks how to iterate over formatted PHP post data.

patterns.name: Underscore word in a medical abstract
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-initial fragment of underscored; the sentence says accountability pressures underscore the need for standardized measurement.

patterns.name: y after a name and an upward-trend phrase
patterns.context: The name Beck is followed by y, then “going up in Jan”; activation falls mainly on y, with uncertain semantic connection.

1_2918.description: 多数激活落在丹麦语、瑞典语“成员国”词形的 «lems»；另在 golems、underscore/underscored 的相似字母片段激活，另有邮件中 Beck 后的 y，可能混合词形与局部 token 特征。

patterns.name: 丹麦语复合词中的成员国词干
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词片段 «lems»，后接丹麦语 staters；周围是欧盟成员国、团结与政策表述。

patterns.name: 丹麦语“成员国”相关词形
patterns.context: 激活出现在成员国一词的词干片段，周围涉及成员国措施、资金或实施。

patterns.name: 瑞典语“成员国”相关词形
patterns.context: 激活落在 med«lems»staterna 内，语境讨论成员国的责任、法律实施或政策。

patterns.name: 瑞典语成员国政策语境中的局部片段
patterns.context: 同一词形出现在转移、答复期限等政策讨论中；激活仍定位于词内片段。

patterns.name: 英语复数 golems 中的相同字母片段
patterns.context: 触发片段位于 go«lems» 中，不是“成员国”；相邻文本谈及 golems。

patterns.name: PHP 帖子数据中的下划线词
patterns.context: 激活落在 undersc...core 词段，原文为 underscore；标题询问如何遍历格式化的 PHP 帖子数据。

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的下划线词
patterns.context: 激活落在 underscored 的词首片段；句中表示问责压力凸显标准化测量的需要。

patterns.name: 姓名后的 y 与上涨短语
patterns.context: 姓名 Beck 后接 y，随后出现“going up in Jan”；激活主要落在 y，语义联系不确定。

en.description: Activation is mainly on the spect spelling fragment and its various word forms, and also on the clim- climate-word stem; there is additionally a hyd- fragment seen only in Rhyd-uchaf. The trigger locations and meanings are not consistent across these patterns.

patterns.name: spect- stem
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the spect spelling fragment within words, covering different forms such as spectator, spectacles, spectre, spectrofluorimetry, and specter, with varying meanings and syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary: materials science, ophthalmology, literature, research methods, and law

patterns.name: clim- stem
patterns.context: Occurs in vocabulary related to climate or climatic conditions, including climatic and climates.
patterns.domain: Agriculture, meteorology, environmental health, patent background

patterns.name: hyd- fragment
patterns.context: The short string “Rhyd-uchaf” in a Wikipedia snippet; there is insufficient context to determine whether it is an independent lexical pattern.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia proper name or article text

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: The snippet concerns wartime deprivation and a lack of food in the South, but the markers fall only on a fragment within “privations” and words such as “became”; this cannot be explained by the main stem pattern.

1_2918.description: 主要对 spect 拼写片段及其多种词形激活，也对 clim- 气候词词干激活；另有仅见于 Rhyd-uchaf 的 hyd- 片段。各模式触发位置与词义并不统一。

patterns.name: spect-词干
patterns.context: 激活集中于单词内部的 spect 拼写片段；覆盖 spectator、spectacles、spectre、spectrofluorimetry、specter 等不同词形，词义和句法位置不一。
patterns.domain: 跨学科：材料科学、眼科、文学、科研方法、法律

patterns.name: clim-词干
patterns.context: 出现在气候或气候条件相关词汇中，包括 climatic 和 climates。
patterns.domain: 农业、气象、环境健康、专利背景

patterns.name: hyd-片段
patterns.context: 维基百科片段中的短字符串“Rhyd-uchaf”；缺少足够上下文判断它是否是独立词汇模式。
patterns.domain: 维基百科专名或条目文本

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 未见与上述片段相符的明确触发词
patterns.context: 片段内容涉及战争时期匮乏及南方缺少食物，但标记只落在“privations”内部的片段和“became”等词上；无法由主要词干模式解释。

en.concept: function word family and local vocabulary
en.description: The most stable trigger is the function/functions/functional word family, covering functions, uses, and the mathematical sense of “a function of a variable”; several sporadic lexical activations remain unexplained by the main pattern.

patterns.name: functions word forms
patterns.context: functions/function(s) appears in terminology or descriptions, especially when explaining the function or use of an object; it is sometimes preceded by modifiers such as its/their/basic/physiological and followed by of/by/as.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, patent technology, materials and device descriptions

patterns.name: functions as a noun
patterns.context: functions refers to the basic or physiological functions of proteins, in biological discussion of HSP, NF-kappaB, and regulation of nuclear signaling.

patterns.name: function in variable-related terminology
patterns.context: function appears in the mathematical/experimental measurement expression “as a function of pressure,” rather than its usual sense of function or use.

patterns.name: Other local lexical activations
patterns.context: These activations occur respectively in micro/nanotechnology, electronic devices, the title of an academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, and the resistivity notation varrho(T); there is no shared local trigger condition.

1_2918.description: 最稳定的触发是 function/functions/functional 词族，涵盖功能、用途和数学上的“关于某变量的函数”用法；另有若干零散词汇激活，无法由主模式解释。

patterns.name: functions 词形
patterns.context: 术语或描述中出现 functions/function(s)，尤其在说明某对象所承担的功能或用途时；有时前接 its/their/basic/physiological 等限定词，后接 of/by/as。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、专利技术、材料与器件描述

patterns.name: functions 作名词
patterns.trigger: «functions»10 in «the» life cycle of «proteins»（第 1 段）；«functions»9 of these «proteins»（第 2 段）
patterns.context: functions 指蛋白质的基本或生理功能；置于有关 HSP、NF-kappaB 与核信号调节的生物学论述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及项目描述

patterns.name: function 作变量相关术语
patterns.context: function 出现在“as a function of pressure”这一数学／实验测量表达中，并非通常的功能用途义。

patterns.name: 其他局部词汇激活
patterns.trigger: «Micro»（第 4 段）；«electronic»（第 5 段）；«academ»（第 9 段）；«var»与«T»（第 10 段）
patterns.context: 这些激活分别落在微/纳米技术、电子器件、中国科学院院士称谓，以及电阻率记号 varrho(T) 中；未见共同的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 专利、人物简介、物理摘要

en.description: All snippets activate on the same word form, analytic, across contexts including physics, biomedicine, psychology, cybersecurity, computer science, and philosophy. Following words and meanings vary, with no unified domain or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Word form analytic
patterns.context: The word analytic appears directly, followed by different nouns or phrases; it does not depend on a specific domain.

patterns.name: analytic continuation
patterns.context: analytic modifies continuation; discusses analytic continuation in dimension D in the Luttinger model.

patterns.name: analytic strategies
patterns.context: analytic modifies strategies, referring to analytical strategies used in research.

patterns.name: analytic expressions
patterns.context: analytic modifies expressions, describing expressions for dark matter signals limited by thermal noise.

patterns.name: analytic processing
patterns.context: analytic is coordinated with synthetic and refers to a type of sound processing.

patterns.name: analytic resources
patterns.context: analytic is coordinated with personal and financial, referring to resources that a cyberattack may obtain.

patterns.name: analytic procedures
patterns.context: analytic modifies procedures, referring to methods designed for a specific problem.

patterns.name: analytic query processing
patterns.context: analytic query processing is contrasted with neural query processing; the phrase crosses a line break.
patterns.domain: Technical discussion, databases, and computer hardware

patterns.name: analytic models
patterns.context: analytic modifies models, used to simplify modeling, predict observed results, or assist instrument design.

patterns.name: analytic philosophy
patterns.context: analytic is part of the name of a philosophical school, alongside pragmatism, phenomenology, and others.

1_2918.description: 全部片段都激活在同一词形 analytic 上，覆盖物理、生物医学、心理学、网络安全、计算机、哲学等语境；后接词及含义多样，未见统一的领域或语义条件。

patterns.name: analytic 的词形
patterns.context: 直接出现单词 analytic，后接不同名词或短语；不依赖某一特定领域。

patterns.name: analytic continuation
patterns.context: analytic 作定语，修饰 continuation；讨论 Luttinger 模型中对维数 D 的解析延拓。

patterns.name: analytic strategies
patterns.context: analytic 修饰 strategies，指研究中采用的分析策略。

patterns.name: analytic expressions
patterns.context: analytic 修饰 expressions，描述热噪声受限暗物质信号的表达式。

patterns.name: analytic processing
patterns.context: analytic 与 synthetic 并列，指声音加工的一种类型。

patterns.name: analytic resources
patterns.context: analytic 与 personal、financial 并列，指网络攻击可能获取的资源。

patterns.name: analytic procedures
patterns.context: analytic 修饰 procedures，指针对特定问题制定的方法。

patterns.name: analytic query processing
patterns.context: analytic query processing 与 neural query processing 对照；词组跨换行。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、数据库与计算机硬件

patterns.name: analytic models
patterns.context: analytic 修饰 models；用于简化建模、预测观测结果或辅助仪器设计。

patterns.name: analytic philosophy
patterns.context: analytic 作为哲学流派名称的一部分，与 pragmatism、phenomenology 等并列。

en.description: Strong activations occur across different word forms or phrases, including function(s), conduc-, trainers, and analytic, referring respectively to function, conductive/conducive, trainers, and mathematical physics terminology; no clear, unified semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: function(s) word forms
patterns.context: Nouns describing the function of devices, mitochondria, or biological components; strong activation falls on function/functions
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical abstracts, NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: conductive/conducive word forms
patterns.context: The stem conduc- appears in the adjectives conductive or conducive; strong activation falls on the stem

patterns.name: SME trainers
patterns.context: Describes trained and certified SME trainers; strong activation is on trainers

patterns.name: analytic continuation
patterns.context: Developing the analytic continuation in a physics paper; strong activation is on analytic

1_2918.description: 强激活分布在 function(s)、conduc-、trainers 和 analytic 等不同词形或短语上，分别涉及功能、导热/有利于、培训人员及数学物理术语；未见统一的明显语义触发条件。

patterns.name: function(s) 词形
patterns.context: 名词，描述器件、线粒体或生物元件的功能；强激活落在 function/functions
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: conductive/conducive 词形
patterns.context: 词干 conduc- 出现在形容词 conductive（导热/导电）或 conducive（有利于）中；强激活落在词干上
patterns.domain: 专利技术描述、法律判决

patterns.name: SME trainers
patterns.context: 描述受训且经认证的 SME trainers，强激活在 trainers

patterns.name: analytic continuation
patterns.context: 物理学论文中 developing the analytic continuation；强激活在 analytic

en.description: Primarily activates on the word function and its phrase structures, covering physiological roles, material functions, and variable-function relationships; there are also sporadic activations on replacement, parenthesized numbering, and isotope mass numbers.

patterns.name: function-related phrases
patterns.context: Occurs in technical statements describing material uses, biological roles, or a variable as a function of another variable; activations often concentrate on function
patterns.domain: Patents, life sciences abstracts and proposals, physics papers

patterns.name: Biological terms preceding function
patterns.context: Biomedical contexts discussing the physiological roles of cellular components, proteins, or channels; activation falls on function

patterns.name: Material or cellular terms preceding function
patterns.context: Refers respectively to the electronic function of materials and mitochondrial function; the trigger remains function, but its referent differs

patterns.name: as a function of construction
patterns.context: Describes the dependence of resistivity on pressure in physics

patterns.name: Replacement/substitution noun
patterns.context: In studies of enzyme properties, replacement introduces a substitution operation; it is not clearly related to the main function pattern

patterns.name: Parenthesized numbering
patterns.context: Parenthesized numbers in a list of research objectives; may be triggered by local punctuation or formatting

patterns.name: Isotope mass numbers
patterns.context: Superscript mass numbers of radioactive nickel and cobalt isotopes in astrophysics text

1_2918.description: 主要对 function 一词及其短语结构激活，涵盖生理作用、材料功能和变量函数关系；另有 replacement、括号编号及同位素质量数等零散激活。

patterns.name: function 相关词组
patterns.trigger: “function”及其前后的限定词，如“electronic function materials”“mitochondrial function”“physiological function”“as a function of pressure”
patterns.context: 出现于技术性陈述中，描述材料用途、生物学作用，或某变量作为另一变量的函数；多处激活集中在 function
patterns.domain: 专利、生命科学摘要与申请书、物理学论文

patterns.name: function 前置的生物学术语
patterns.trigger: “physiological function”“physiological function of TRPC channels”“physiological function of the FMR protein”
patterns.context: 生物医学语境中讨论细胞成分、蛋白质或通道的生理作用；激活落在 function
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: function 前置的材料或细胞术语
patterns.context: 分别指材料的电子功能、线粒体功能；触发词仍为 function，但所指不同

patterns.name: as a function of 结构
patterns.context: 物理学中描述电阻率随压力变化的依赖关系

patterns.name: 替换/取代名词
patterns.context: 酶性质研究中，以 replacement 引出替换操作；与 function 主模式不明显相关

patterns.name: 编号括号
patterns.context: 研究目标列表中的括号编号；可能是局部标点/格式触发

patterns.name: 同位素质量数
patterns.context: 天体物理文本中放射性镍、钴同位素的上标质量数

en.description: Primarily responds to nuclides, neutrons, and nuclear spin terminology in nuclear physics text, and also to wheezing in clinical respiratory text; it additionally activates in descriptions of material electronic function and mitochondrial function.

patterns.name: Nuclear reactions and nuclide notation
patterns.context: Nuclide symbols, isotopes, and neutron-related terms, including nuclear reaction, nucleosynthesis, and nuclear physics experimental contexts.

patterns.name: wheezing in medical text
patterns.context: Wheezing in descriptions of respiratory disease or clinical examinations; often listed alongside asthma, dyspnea, chest symptoms, or lung auscultation.

patterns.name: Material and electronic function
patterns.context: Describes organic compounds used in optical or electronic materials; activation is concentrated on the word function.

patterns.name: DNA repair and mitochondrial function
patterns.context: Medical research statements about the effects of inhibiting mitochondrial function on DNA repair in human cells.

1_2918.concept: 科学文本中的专门术语
1_2918.description: 主要响应核物理文本中的核素、中子及核自旋术语，也响应临床呼吸文本中的 wheezing；另在材料电子功能和线粒体功能表述中激活。

patterns.name: 核反应与核素记号
patterns.context: 核素符号、同位素及中子相关术语；包括核反应、天体核合成与核物理实验语境。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 wheezing
patterns.context: 呼吸道疾病或临床检查描述中出现喘鸣；常与哮喘、dyspnea、胸部症状或肺部听诊并列。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要／临床法律记录

patterns.name: 材料功能与电子功能
patterns.context: 描述有机化合物用于光学或电子材料；激活集中在 function 一词。
patterns.domain: 专利背景／有机电子材料

patterns.name: DNA 修复与线粒体功能
patterns.context: 关于抑制线粒体功能对人类细胞 DNA 修复影响的医学研究表述。

en.concept: Mixed response to the intraword fragments «e» and «in»
en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on the intraword «e» fragment, found in dynein, wheezing, peephole, and dye; there is also activation on «o f» in legal citations. Medical passages center on motor proteins or wheezing.

patterns.name: Biomedical text related to dynein
patterns.context: Appears in sentences about cellular motility, cytoskeletal motors, dynein subtypes, or their inhibitors; triggers center on the intraword fragments «ne»«in».

patterns.name: wheezing spelling fragment
patterns.context: Activation on the «e» within wheezing; the context concerns wheezing, asthma symptoms, lung examinations, or bronchoconstriction.
patterns.domain: Medical records, asthma research, clinical abstracts, and medical encyclopedias

patterns.name: Peephole-related word fragment
patterns.context: Appears in peephole in a narrative; this is a single instance, and the activated fragment is the same «e» as in wheezing.

patterns.name: o f in statutory citations
patterns.context: Separated letter fragments form of and appear near statutory provisions and legal citations.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in dye
patterns.context: Appears in compounds such as water-soluble-dye-containing ink; an isolated instance with no matching immediate medical context.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology involving aqueous inks and dyes

1_2918.concept: 词内片段«e»及«in»的混合响应
1_2918.description: 强激活主要落在词内的 «e» 片段：见于 dynein、wheezing、peephole、dye；另在法律引文的 «o f» 上激活。医学段落集中于运动蛋白或喘鸣。

patterns.name: dynein 相关生物医学文本
patterns.context: 出现在关于细胞运动、细胞骨架马达、dynein 亚型或其抑制剂的句子中；触发集中于词内片段 «ne»«in»。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究提案

patterns.name: wheezing 拼写片段
patterns.context: 词语 wheezing 中间的 «e» 激活；上下文涉及喘鸣、哮喘症状、肺部检查或支气管收缩。
patterns.domain: 医学记录、哮喘研究、临床摘要及医学百科

patterns.name: 窥视孔相关词片段
patterns.context: 出现在叙事中的 peephole（门上的窥视孔）；仅此一例，激活片段与 wheezing 中的 «e» 相同。

patterns.name: 法条引文中的 o f
patterns.context: 分开的字母片段构成 of，出现在法条条文和法律引文附近。

patterns.name: 染料词内部片段
