patterns.context: 出现在 water-soluble-dye-containing ink 一类复合词中；孤立例子，未见相同的眼前医学语境。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术，涉及水性墨水和染料

en.description: The strongest activations are concentrated on the ne/in fragments in dynein; the remaining hits are scattered across intraword fragments such as e and ne, punctuation, and forum formatting, and cannot be explained by a consistent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Intraword tokenization of dynein
patterns.context: In biomedical text, dynein is split into marked fragments, especially when describing cytoplasmic dynein, motility, and ATPase.

patterns.name: ne substring
patterns.context: The trigger appears on the letter fragment ne across word boundaries or within words; it also occurs in other fragments ending or beginning with ne.

patterns.name: Word fragments containing e
patterns.context: The marker falls on the character e or a fragment containing it in split words, across varied meanings and contexts.

patterns.name: Punctuation and hyphens
patterns.context: Appears near abbreviations, compounds, or sentence boundaries in technical text; intensity is lower, with no stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Notable phrase fragments
patterns.context: Appears in separators in HackerNews posts and in word fragments at sentence beginnings, with no shared context.

patterns.name: ne-related word fragments
patterns.context: Hits the character fragment ne in obstetric terms.

patterns.name: e-related word fragments
patterns.context: Hits intraword e fragments in peephole, Dogetipping, pigeons, and other words, with inconsistent meanings.

patterns.name: Unmerged word fragments
patterns.context: Scattered hits on proper nouns and short fragments in word endings or ordinary words, with no confirmed unifying condition.

1_2918.description: 主要高激活集中在 dynein 的 ne/in 词片；其余分散命中 e、ne 等词内碎片、标点及论坛格式，无法由一致语义模式解释。

patterns.name: dynein 词内分词
patterns.context: 在生物医学文本中，dynein 被拆分为带标记的词片，尤见于描述细胞质 dynein、运动和 ATPase。

patterns.name: ne 子串
patterns.context: 触发形式出现在跨词边界或词内的 ne 字母片段；也见于其他以 ne 为结尾或起始的词片。

patterns.name: 含 e 的词片
patterns.trigger: «e»10（Pa«ik»2 实为分词碎片处的 e、dy«e»10、pig«e»9«ons»6、Dog«e»9）
patterns.context: 标记落在被拆分词语中的 e 字符或词片上，语义和上下文各异。
patterns.domain: 专利、论坛及 NIH 文本

patterns.name: 标点与连字符
patterns.context: 在技术文本的缩写、复合词或句子边界附近出现；强度较低，未显示稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 显著短语片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在 HackerNews 帖子的分隔符和句首单词片段，缺乏共同语境。

patterns.name: ne 相关词片
patterns.context: 在妇产科名词中命中 ne 字符片段。

patterns.name: e 相关词片
patterns.context: 命中 peephole、Dogetipping、pigeons 等词内 e 字符片段，语义不一致。

patterns.name: 未能归并的词片段
patterns.context: 零散命中专名、词尾或普通词中的短片段，缺少可确认的统一条件。

en.description: Strong responses often fall on intraword fragments: dynein, interspersed, gynecology, as well as peephole, pee, and tycoon; they also occur on periods in species abbreviations. Triggers are scattered, and some may be subword or character patterns.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in dynein
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within dynein; the context discusses cellular transport, molecular motors, drugs, or ATPase.

patterns.name: ers in interspersed
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within interspersed, describing DNA sequence distribution in the genome or interspersed text and images.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment related to gynecology
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within gynecology, near obstetrics, as a field of application for ultrasound diagnostics.

patterns.name: e in peephole
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within peephole; the passage narrates a character at home hearing someone kick the door.

patterns.name: e in pee
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within pee; the context discusses filtering water from wastewater and drying the solids for fertilizer.
patterns.domain: Online forum discussion, sustainable resource use

patterns.name: on in a word related to Maximov
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs at the end of tycoon; the context introduces an entrepreneur, wealth, and company shares.

patterns.name: Period in the name S. mansoni
patterns.context: Activation is marked on the period in the abbreviation S., next to the species name mansoni and genome research content.

1_2918.description: 强响应多落在词内片段：dynein、interspersed、gynecology，以及 peephole、pee、tycoon 等；也出现于物种缩写句点。触发分散，部分可能是子词或字符模式。

patterns.name: dynein 词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在 dynein 这个词内部；上下文讨论细胞运输、分子马达、药物或 ATPase。

patterns.name: 穿插词中的 ers
patterns.context: 触发片段位于 interspersed 一词内部，描述 DNA 序列在基因组中的分布，或图文穿插排列。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、百科说明

patterns.name: 妇科相关词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在 gynecology 一词内部，邻近 obstetrics，属于超声诊断的适用领域。

patterns.name: peephole 中的 e
patterns.context: 触发片段位于 peephole 一词内部；此段是人物在家中听到有人踹门的叙事。

patterns.name: pee 中的 e
patterns.context: 触发片段位于 pee 一词内部；上下文谈从废水中过滤水并将固体物干燥作肥料。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛讨论、可持续利用

patterns.name: Maximov 相关词中的 on
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在 tycoon 一词末尾；上下文介绍企业家、财富与公司股权。

patterns.name: S. mansoni 名称中的点
patterns.context: 激活标在缩写 S. 的句点上，邻近物种名 mansoni 和基因组研究内容。

en.concept: Intraword e and specific subword fragments
en.description: Primarily activates on e inside various words, especially split words; it also activates on intraword fragments in dynein and Nippon, and on wavy-line separators in forums. Examples span different domains and cannot all be grouped into the same semantic theme.

patterns.name: Intraword e
patterns.context: Activation falls on e within words, especially when a word is split into tokens and e is followed by an ending or hyphen; however, the words and contexts vary widely.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: news, literature, patents, medicine, research, and online discussion

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in dynein
patterns.context: Occurs in research text about cellular transport or molecular motors, in cytoplasmic dynein or dynein isoforms.

patterns.name: Intraword fragment in Nippon
patterns.context: Appears after Nippon in the names of Japanese organizations or brands; one instance concerns an airline and another a feed manufacturer.

patterns.name: Word ending in gynecology
patterns.context: Appears in a list of fields of application for ultrasound diagnostics, as the latter part of obstetrics and gynecology.

patterns.name: Specific formatting marker
patterns.context: Appears in the separator position in a HackerNews post, surrounded by comments and cryptocurrency tipping discussion.

1_2918.concept: 词内 e 与特定子词片段
1_2918.description: 主要激活于多种词内部的 e，尤其是被切分的词；另对 dynein、Nippon 等词内片段及论坛波浪线分隔符有激活。各例领域分散，不能都归为同一语义主题。

patterns.name: 词内的 e
patterns.trigger: «e»（包括 «e» 后接被拆开的词尾，如 «e»10«hy»1«de»1、«e»9«-»2）
patterns.context: 激活位置落在词内部的 e 上，尤其是词被分词切分、该 e 后还有词尾或连字符时；但覆盖词类和上下文多样。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；新闻、文献、专利、医学、科研和网络对话

patterns.name: dynein 词内片段
patterns.context: 在细胞运输或分子马达相关科研文本中，出现在 cytoplasmic dynein 或 dynein isoforms 中。
patterns.domain: 细胞生物学、科研资助摘要

patterns.name: Nippon 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在日本机构或品牌名称 Nippon 后；一次为航空公司，一次为饲料制造商。
patterns.domain: 航空新闻、动物实验方法

patterns.name: gynecology 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在超声诊断适用领域的并列列表中，作为 obstetrics and gynecology 的后半词。

patterns.name: 特定格式标记
patterns.context: 出现在 HackerNews 帖子的分隔符位置，周围是留言和加密货币小费讨论。

en.concept: Mixed intraword fragments and formatting features
en.description: Activations mainly cover intraword character fragments in various words, especially on; there are also scattered responses to the neocons word form, webpage layout symbols, time colons, and abbreviation fragments, with weak semantic consistency across passages.

patterns.name: Intraword suffix “on”
patterns.context: Activation often falls on character fragments inside or at the end of English words, rather than on complete words; it spans proper nouns, ordinary words, and scientific terms, with no consistent neighboring meaning
patterns.domain: Mixed corpus: news, scientific literature, catalogs, and tables

patterns.name: Neoconservative word forms
patterns.context: Appears in contexts discussing a political faction or its political influence; activation is concentrated on intraword fragments in “neocon(s)/neoconservative” forms

patterns.name: Formatting symbols and markers
patterns.context: Appears near code fences, wiki tables, or heading/formatting markers; these activations have no clear semantic connection to intraword “on” or political word forms

patterns.name: Punctuation in quantitative conditions
patterns.context: A colon is highlighted in an expression of a time range in experimental animal husbandry conditions

patterns.name: English spelling fragment
patterns.context: A suffix fragment inside the negative contraction “Don't”; this example has no confirmed shared semantics

1_2918.concept: 混杂的词内片段与格式特征
1_2918.description: 激活主要覆盖多种词内字符片段，尤其是on；另对neocons词形及网页排版符号、时间冒号和缩写片段有零散反应，跨段语义一致性弱。

patterns.name: 词内后缀“on”
patterns.trigger: «on»，尤其在“Nipp«on»”“Neut«ron»”“Bret Hart«e»”附近；也包括“Bret Hart«e»”中触发的末尾字符
patterns.context: 激活常落在英文词内部或词尾的字符片段，而非完整词；跨越专名、普通词和科学术语，邻近词义并不统一
patterns.domain: 混合语料：新闻、科学文献、目录与表格

patterns.name: 新保守主义词形
patterns.context: 出现在谈论政治派别或其政治影响的语境中；激活集中在“neocon(s)/neoconservative”词形的内部片段

patterns.name: 格式符号与标记
patterns.context: 出现在代码围栏、维基表格或标题/排版标记中；这些激活与词内“on”及政治词形缺乏明确语义联系

patterns.name: 量化条件中的标点
patterns.context: 在实验动物饲养条件的时间范围表达中，冒号被突出

patterns.name: 英语拼写片段
patterns.context: 否定缩写“Don't”内部的后缀片段；该例中没有可确认的共同语义

en.concept: Local intraword letter fragments (biased toward in)
en.description: Activations mainly fall on intraword in fragments, as in dynein, cyclin, and Nippon, and also occur in neocon forms; there are additionally scattered punctuation, formatting, and ordinary word fragments that are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Word-final/intraword “in” fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on letter fragments across token boundaries or within words, commonly in words containing in; surrounding word meanings and syntax vary greatly.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary prose, proper nouns, and bibliographic text

patterns.name: neocon conservative forms
patterns.context: neocons or neoconservatives occur in political commentary, with activation concentrated on internal word fragments.

patterns.name: Numbers, punctuation, and formatting fragments
patterns.context: Local fragments near numbers, times, units, URLs, or formatting markers; different passages show no stable shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods, news, webpage markup, bibliographic formatting

patterns.name: Short words and common word fragments
patterns.context: Scattered occurrences in ordinary sentences, with no consistent syntactic position or semantic role; may be secondary activations or unrelated to the main trigger.
patterns.domain: News, commentary, narrative, and academic text

patterns.name: Letter fragments in names
patterns.context: Local characters in proper nouns or titles/bibliographic entries are marked, with no stable name category or semantic condition apparent.
patterns.domain: Historical figure entries, bibliographies, and catalogs

1_2918.concept: 词内局部字母片段（偏 in）
1_2918.description: 激活主要落在词内的 in 片段（如 dynein、cyclin、Nippon），也见于 neocon 词形；另有零散标点、格式及普通词片段，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 词尾/词内「in」片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨分词边界或词内部的字母片段上，常见于含 in 的词；周边词义和句法差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨学科正文、专名与书目文本

patterns.name: neocon 保守派词形
patterns.context: 政治评论中出现 neocons 或 neoconservatives，激活集中在词的内部片段。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、博客/网页文本

patterns.name: 数字、标点与格式片段
patterns.context: 数字、时间、单位、URL或排版标记附近的局部片段；不同段落中没有稳定的共同语义条件。
patterns.domain: 实验方法、新闻、网页标记、书目排版

patterns.name: 短词及常见词片段
patterns.context: 零散出现在普通句子中，未见一致的句法位置或语义角色；可能是次要激活或与主触发无关。
patterns.domain: 新闻、评论、叙事及学术文本

patterns.name: 姓名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 专名或标题/书目条目中的局部字符被标记，未显示稳定的姓名类别或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 历史人物条目、书目和目录

en.concept: Word-form fragments and the string on
en.description: The strongest pattern is fragments within neocons/neoconservative forms; however, the neuron also responds to various unrelated words containing on (Nippon, neutron, dynein, tycoons). There are also weak activations on of, punctuation/formatting, and several isolated word fragments, which are difficult to group into a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: neo-cons/neoconservative word forms
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on intraword fragments in neocons or neoconservative(s); sometimes these span token splits or are followed by word endings.
patterns.domain: Political commentary, history, and public policy; passages 1–3

patterns.name: English word ending -on
patterns.context: Activation falls on words ending in on or containing corresponding split fragments; these occur in different words, including Japan, Japan Airlines, neutron, midbody protein names, and tycoons, without requiring a connection to political topics.
patterns.domain: Scientific text, aviation news, business/literary profiles; passages 4–10

patterns.name: Token “of” in ordinary words
patterns.context: Weak activation occurs when the preposition of appears in noun phrases; not limited to passages related to neocons.

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting tokens
patterns.context: Scattered activations occur near numbers, hyphens, URLs, Markdown code fences, or heading markers; trigger conditions are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Paper methods, news, forums, and webpage formatting; passages 2, 4–6, 9

patterns.name: Scattered ordinary word fragments
patterns.context: These fragments each have only weak activation, with no common, stable word meaning or contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Commentary, news, research abstracts, and astronomy papers; passages 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9

1_2918.concept: 词形片段及 on 字符串
1_2918.description: 最强模式是 neocons/neoconservative 词形中的片段；但神经元也响应多种含 on 的无关词（Nippon、neutron、dynein、tycoons）。另有 of、标点格式及若干孤立词片段的弱激活，难以归入统一语义主题。

patterns.name: neo-cons／neoconservative 词形
patterns.context: 激活集中在 neocons 或 neoconservative(s) 的词内片段；有时跨 token 拆分或后接词尾。
patterns.domain: 政治评论、历史与公共政策；段 1–3

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -on
patterns.context: 激活落在以 on 结尾或含相应拆分片段的词中；出现于 Japan、日本航空、neutron、中间蛋白名称及 tycoons 等不同词里，并不要求与政治主题相关。
patterns.domain: 科学文本、航空新闻、商业／文学简介；段 4–10

patterns.name: 普通词中的 token「of」
patterns.context: 在名词短语中出现介词 of 时有弱激活；不只见于 neocon 相关段落。

patterns.name: 标点与格式 token
patterns.context: 数字、连字符、网址、Markdown 代码围栏或标题标记附近出现零散激活；触发条件不一致。
patterns.domain: 论文实验方法、新闻、论坛及网页格式；段 2、4–6、9

patterns.name: 零散普通词片段
patterns.context: 这些片段各自仅有弱激活，未见共同而稳定的词义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻、科研摘要与天文学论文；段 1、3、5、6、8、9

en.description: High activations often fall on the strings opin/Chopin, the plural ending itors, the proper-name fragment talbahn, and shine. These examples span multiple genres; local word-form overlap is more apparent than a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Chopin in titles or words
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the name Chopin or the fragment opin across a word boundary. The same letters occur in the full name, truncated words, or ordinary words, and do not always refer to Chopin.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, academic papers, legal and financial texts

patterns.name: Editor ending
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the word editors, sometimes preceded by a hyphenated word form; the local trigger resembles a subword fragment rather than sentence meaning.

patterns.name: Synthetic capacitor ending
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of supercapacitors, embedded in a materials-synthesis paper title; it may share the same ending pattern as editors.

patterns.name: MEK inhibitor ending
patterns.context: Occurs in Inhibitors in a medical title, preceded by MEK and describing therapeutic use.

patterns.name: Bahn in a railway name
patterns.context: Occurs near the end of the German proper name Wern talbahn; the context also describes a railway.

patterns.name: Cosmetics product review
patterns.context: Describes the natural sheen of a lip product after application, with evaluations of its texture, effect, and degree of disappointment.

1_3010.concept: 混合词形片段响应
1_3010.description: 高激活多落在字符串 opin/Chopin、复数词尾 itors、专名 talbahn 片段及 shine；这些例子分属多种文体，局部词形重合比统一语义主题更明显。

patterns.name: 标题或词中的 Chopin
patterns.context: 激活集中在 Chopin 这个姓名或跨词边界的片段 opin 上；出现于完整姓名、残缺词或普通词中的相同字母串，并不总是指肖邦。
patterns.domain: 百科、学术论文、法律与金融文本

patterns.name: 编辑者词尾
patterns.context: 出现在单词 editors 的词尾，前文可有连字符构成的词形；局部触发更像子词片段而非句义。
patterns.domain: 医学论文及临床科学讨论

patterns.name: 合成电容器词尾
patterns.context: 出现在 supercapacitors 的词尾，嵌于材料合成论文标题；可能与 editors 的同一词尾模式相同。

patterns.name: MEK 抑制剂词尾
patterns.context: 出现在医学标题中的 Inhibitors，前接 MEK，描述治疗用途。

patterns.name: 铁路名称中的 Bahn
patterns.context: 出现在德语专名 Wern talbahn 的末尾附近；同时上下文介绍一条铁路。

patterns.name: 化妆品产品评价
patterns.context: 描述唇部产品上唇后的自然光泽，伴随对质地、效果和失望程度的评价。

en.description: Activations often fall on string fragments in different words: -itors, Chopin/segmented opin, and part of Wern(tal)bahn. They occur in heterogeneous contexts such as titles, proper names, ordinary words, drug names, and German compounds.

patterns.name: English word ending -itors
patterns.context: The trigger is the suffix fragment “itors” within full words, appearing in “supercapacitors” and “Inhibitors”; both examples occur in titles.
patterns.domain: PubMed paper titles on materials and medicine, respectively

patterns.name: Chopin in a proper name
patterns.context: Triggers the string Chopin, both as the pianist’s name and in a cited author’s name.

patterns.name: Segmented opin
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the in-word fragment “opin” in opinion(s), while the following “ions” activates weakly; it occurs in contexts about authority and opinions, and disclaimers.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg legal discussion, Enron financial disclaimer

patterns.name: opin in a mathematician’s surname
patterns.context: The fragment “opin” occurs near the end of the mathematician’s surname Duminil-Copin.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics paper body and citations

patterns.name: opin in a drug name
patterns.context: The fragment “opin” occurs in the drug name lopinavir.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical abstracts, drug data in liver cells

patterns.name: talbahn in a German railway word
patterns.context: Activation falls on the “talb” portion of the German compound Wern(tal)bahn; the context is a railway name and its description.

patterns.name: Editor ending -editors
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on the ending fragment “itors” in the word editors following stakeholders.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central discussion of conflicts of interest in clinical science

1_3010.concept: 特定字符串片段
1_3010.description: 激活多落在不同词中的字符串片段：-itors、Chopin/切分出的 opin，以及 Wern(tal)bahn 的局部；对应标题、专名、普通词、药名和德语复合词等异质语境。

patterns.name: 英文词尾 -itors
patterns.context: 触发点是完整单词中的后缀片段 “itors”，分别出现在 “supercapacitors” 和 “Inhibitors”；两例都位于标题中。
patterns.domain: PubMed 论文标题，分别涉及材料与医学

patterns.name: 专名中的 Chopin
patterns.context: 触发字符串 Chopin，既作为钢琴家姓名，也出现在参考文献作者姓名中。

patterns.name: 切分出的 opin
patterns.context: 激活集中在 opinion(s) 的词内片段 “opin”，而后续 “ions” 激活弱；出现在关于权威与意见、以及免责声明的语境中。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 法律论述、Enron 金融免责声明

patterns.name: 数学作者姓氏中的 opin
patterns.context: 片段 “opin” 位于数学家姓氏 Duminil-Copin 的词尾附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文正文与引文

patterns.name: 药名中的 opin
patterns.context: 片段 “opin” 出现在药物名称 lopinavir 内。
patterns.domain: PubMed 医学摘要，肝细胞中的药物数据

patterns.name: 德语铁路词中的 talbahn
patterns.context: 激活落在德语复合词 Wern(tal)bahn 的 “talb” 部分；上下文是铁路名称及其介绍。

patterns.name: 编辑者词尾 -editors
patterns.context: 激活集中在 stakeholders 后的 editors 一词词尾片段 “itors”。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 关于临床科学利益冲突的论述

en.description: All segments contain the marked substring itors, commonly in endings such as inhibitors, itors, editors, monitors, and visitors. A few segments also mark nearby fragments or punctuation, but these variations have no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Ending itors
patterns.context: Activations fall on the ending substring itors in a word; prefixes and semantics vary with context.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including medical papers, web code, and technical articles

patterns.name: Other endings or in-word fragments
patterns.context: A few activations occur on short word fragments other than itors; there is no consistent lexical meaning or local syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Special markers and code structure
patterns.context: Activations fall on citation markers, HTML/script punctuation, or adjacent code fragments, alongside itors activations in the same segment.

1_3010.concept: itors 词尾子串
1_3010.description: 所有段都含有被标记的 itors 子串，常见于 inhibitors、itors、editors、monitors、visitors 等词尾；少数段还标记了邻近片段或标点，但这些变化缺乏统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 词尾 itors
patterns.context: 激活落在单词的词尾子串 itors 上；前缀和语义随上下文变化。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、网页代码、技术文章等多种文体

patterns.name: 其他词尾或词内片段
patterns.trigger: «ac»（[1]、[7] 的 supercap«ac»itors）、«Mon»（[5] 的 Monitors）、«S»（[7] 的 S2）、«p»（[9] 的 piano）
patterns.context: 少数激活出现在 itors 以外的短词片段；没有一致的词义或局部句法条件。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、技术文档、传记

patterns.name: 特殊标记与代码结构
patterns.context: 激活落在引文标记、HTML/脚本标点或相邻代码片段，伴随同段的 itors 激活。

en.description: The main response is to the segmented plural ending “itors,” covering words such as capacitors, inhibitors, editors, and visitors. There are also isolated activations on Valley, Chopin, and shine, with no shared contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Plural suffix -itors
patterns.context: The ending is segmented separately and activates strongly; preceding text includes supercap«ac»itors, MEK Inhib«itors», ed«itors», Vis«itors», Medical Ed«itors», and Inhib«itors».
patterns.domain: Materials science, biomedicine, web HTML, general English

patterns.name: Valley in a place name
patterns.context: Occurs in the proper name Wern Valley Railway, forming part of the place name.

patterns.name: Pianist’s surname in a person’s name
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of a pianist and people associated with piano competitions.

patterns.name: shine in a code example
patterns.context: Occurs in StackExchange text explaining the advantages of Python list comprehensions, preceded by list-comprehensions.

1_3010.concept: 复数词尾 itors
1_3010.description: 主要响应被切分出的复数词尾“itors”，涵盖电容器、抑制剂、编辑和访客等词；另对 Valley、Chopin、shine 有孤立激活，缺少共同上下文模式。

patterns.name: 复数后缀 -itors
patterns.context: 词尾被单独切分并强激活；前文包括 supercap«ac»itors、MEK Inhib«itors»、ed«itors»、Vis«itors»、Medical Ed«itors»，以及 Inhib«itors»。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、生物医学、网页 HTML、通用英文

patterns.name: 地名中的 Valley
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Wern Valley Railway 中，构成地名的一部分。
patterns.domain: 维基百科地理／铁路条目

patterns.name: 人名中的钢琴家姓氏
patterns.context: 出现在钢琴家及钢琴比赛相关的人名叙述中。
patterns.domain: 维基百科音乐人物传记

patterns.name: 代码示例中的 shine
patterns.context: 出现在解释 Python 列表推导式优势的 StackExchange 文字中，前有 list-comprehensions。

en.description: Every segment contains the contiguous letter fragment “opin,” whether in opinion words such as opinions/opinione, proper names such as Chopin/Duminil-Copin, or the drug name lopinavir; the domains and meanings vary widely.

patterns.name: opin stem
patterns.context: The trigger fragment contains opin; it is often followed by endings forming opinions, opinione, opinion, or lopinavir
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; contexts include people’s names, academic citations, legal discussion, disclaimers, forum opinions, and drug names

patterns.name: opin followed by opinion-related endings
patterns.context: opin is followed by the English plural ending -ions or the Italian ending -ione; semantically, these occur in expressions about opinions, views, or commentary
patterns.domain: Parliamentary speeches, legal prose, financial disclaimers, forum discussions

patterns.name: opin as a spelling fragment in a proper name
patterns.context: opin is embedded in the proper names Chopin or Duminil-Copin, not in opinion-related words
patterns.domain: Pianist and competition descriptions; mathematics papers and references

patterns.name: opin embedded in the drug name lopinavir
patterns.context: opin occurs within the drug name lopinavir, near content about antiviral drugs, COVID-19, drug interactions, or liver-cell studies

1_3010.concept: 字符串“opin”特征
1_3010.description: 所有段均含有连续字母片段“opin”，无论它属于 opinions/opinione 等意见词、Chopin/Duminil-Copin 等专名，还是药物名 lopinavir；领域和语义差异很大。

patterns.name: opin 词干
patterns.context: 触发片段含有 opin；后续常接词尾构成 opinions、opinione、opinion 或 lopinavir
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；不同语境包括人物姓名、学术引文、法律论述、免责声明、论坛观点及药物名称

patterns.name: opin 后接意见类词尾
patterns.context: opin 后接英语复数词尾 -ions 或意大利语词尾 -ione；语义上分别出现在意见、观点或评论相关表述中
patterns.domain: 议会发言、法律散文、金融免责声明、论坛讨论

patterns.name: opin 作为人名拼写片段
patterns.context: opin 嵌在专名 Chopin 或 Duminil-Copin 中，并非意见类词语
patterns.domain: 钢琴家与比赛介绍；数学论文及参考文献

patterns.name: opin 嵌入药物名 lopinavir
patterns.context: opin 位于药物名称 lopinavir 内，邻近抗病毒药物、COVID-19、药物相互作用或肝细胞研究内容

en.description: Activations concentrate on the contiguous letters opin: they occur in opinions/opinion words, Chopin, and various unrelated proper names and URLs. This looks more like recognition of a character fragment than a unified semantic feature.

patterns.name: opinions stem
patterns.context: opin is followed by an ending to form a word meaning a view or opinion; preceding text may discuss people, committees, or arguments
patterns.domain: General discussion, parliamentary speeches, forum discussions, legal disclaimers

patterns.name: Chopin name
patterns.context: Occurs in names related to the pianist or his works

patterns.name: opin as an in-word fragment
patterns.context: Matches only the in-word letter fragment, unrelated to the meanings of opinions or Chopin

patterns.name: opin in a web path
patterns.context: Occurs in the URL path of a legal opinion webpage

1_3010.concept: 字符片段 opin
1_3010.description: 激活集中于连续字母 opin：它出现在 opinions/意见词形、Chopin，以及多个无关专名和 URL 中；更像识别字符片段，而非统一语义。

patterns.name: opinions 词干
patterns.context: opin 后接词尾，组成表示观点或看法的词；前文可谈人物、委员会或论证
patterns.domain: 一般论述、议会发言、论坛讨论、法律免责声明

patterns.name: Chopin 姓名
patterns.context: 出现在钢琴家或作品相关的人名中

patterns.name: opin 作为词内片段
patterns.context: 只匹配词内字母片段，与 opinions 或 Chopin 的词义无关
patterns.domain: 生物医学名称、数学家姓名

patterns.name: opin 网页路径片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律意见网页的 URL 路径中

en.description: All segments match the substring opin inside a full word. Strong activations span opinion forms and various unrelated proper names; the local pattern appears to respond to a letter fragment rather than a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: “opin” stem fragment
patterns.context: The trigger occurs inside different full words: opinione, opinions, opinlindex, Chopin, Duminil-Copin, nyctalopin, Scopinaro; it does not correspond to a single meaning.

patterns.name: Opinion/view word forms
patterns.context: Occurs in words for opinions or views, in discussions of authority and evidence, financial disclaimers, programming comments, and European Parliament speeches.
patterns.domain: Legal discussion, financial disclaimers, technical discussion, parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: Incidental substring in proper names
patterns.context: The substring is only part of a name or label and is unrelated to “opinion”: Chopin (including the surname and its referent), Duminil-Copin, nyctalopin, Scopinaro, and the URL fragment opinlindex.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on people and music, mathematics literature, neuroscience research, medical papers, legal URLs

1_3010.concept: 字符串片段“opin”
1_3010.description: 所有片段都在完整词内部命中 opin 子串，强激活跨越 opinion 词形与多种无关专名；局部模式更像对字母片段的响应，而非单一语义。

patterns.name: “opin”词干片段
patterns.context: 触发点出现在不同完整词的内部：opinione、opinions、opinlindex、Chopin、Duminil-Copin、nyctalopin、Scopinaro；并非只对应单一词义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的词语子串模式

patterns.name: 意见／观点词形
patterns.context: 位于意见、看法等词中；分别出现在权威与证据的讨论、金融免责声明、编程评论，以及欧洲议会发言。
patterns.domain: 法律论述、金融免责声明、技术讨论、议会发言

patterns.name: 专名中的偶然子串
patterns.context: 该子串只是姓名或名称的一部分，与“意见”无关：Chopin（包括姓氏及其所指对象）、Duminil-Copin、nyctalopin、Scopinaro，以及网址片段opinlindex。
patterns.domain: 百科人物与音乐、数学文献、神经科学研究、医学论文、法律网址

en.description: Activations mainly fall on fragments inside multilingual words, especially subword fragments such as nature and Ne that can continue into different words. Other activations include atta in the French s’attaquer and 313 in a number table.

patterns.name: Suffixes or stem suffixes in nature words
patterns.context: Activations fall on initial subword fragments of nature-related words, with following characters or tokens completing different words; they span word contexts and capitalization forms.
patterns.domain: French, English, Romanian, and legal texts

patterns.name: Segmentation boundary in French attaquer
patterns.context: The reflexive structure s'attaquer follows a pronoun; strong activations concentrate on the stem fragment atta in attaquer. The surrounding text concerns attacking or targeting something.

patterns.name: 313 in a number sequence
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the number 313 in a comma-separated, line-by-line ascending comparison table; other numbers in the same table also activate more weakly.
patterns.domain: Number tables in code or data files

patterns.name: Typography and structural markers in written text
patterns.context: Different texts contain sentence-initial words, title-style capitalized words, or numbered labels; these may also be incidental cues accompanying the word-fragment triggers, and evidence is insufficient to confirm an independent pattern.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary texts, news headlines, patents and legal documents, data tables

1_3010.concept: 多语种词内片段与边界
1_3010.description: 主要激活落在多语种词语内部的片段，尤其是 nature、Ne 等可续接成不同单词的子串；另有法语 s’attaquer 的 atta，以及数字表中的 313。

patterns.name: 自然词中的词尾或词干后缀
patterns.context: 激活落在自然词的前部子词片段上，后续字符或 token 接续完成不同单词；跨越词语境与大小写形式。
patterns.domain: 法语、英语、罗马尼亚语及法律文本

patterns.name: 法语 attaquer 的分词边界
patterns.context: 代词后的反身结构 s'attaquer，强激活集中在 attaquer 的词干片段 atta；周围谈及攻击或针对某对象。

patterns.name: 数字序列中的 313
patterns.context: 逗号分隔、逐行递增的数字对照表中，激活出现在编号 313；同一表内其他编号也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: 代码或数据文件中的数字表

patterns.name: 书面文本的排版与结构标记
patterns.context: 不同文本中出现句首词、标题式大写词或数字编号；这些现象也可能只是上述词片段触发的伴随线索，证据不足以确认独立模式。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、新闻标题、专利与法律文书、数据表

en.concept: C++ template syntax and French fragments
en.description: Most code segments activate around C++ template declarations and adjacent types, structs, implementations, or aliases. Two French parliamentary text segments also activate on in-word fragments and sentence-internal words, which the code pattern cannot explain.

patterns.name: C++ template declarations
patterns.context: Activations concentrate around template declarations and their parameter lists, especially after typename, type parameters, or parameter packs; they are usually near the beginning of a declaration.
patterns.domain: C++ code from Github and StackExchange

patterns.name: Template implementations and type utility code
patterns.context: Around template declarations are implementations, structs, type aliases, or generic helper functions; these may reinforce the first pattern, but these terms are not shared by all template segments.
patterns.domain: C++ generic libraries and project source code

patterns.name: French in-word fragments and sentence-internal connectives
patterns.context: Activations occur in continuous French prose concerning Europe, Asia, Russia, recent developments, or hope; there is no apparent template or code context.

patterns.name: French negation and pronouns
patterns.context: These fragments occur in French discussion of Europe, its history, wars, and the common market, constituting prose activations independent of the code pattern.

1_3010.concept: C++模板语法与法语片段
1_3010.description: 多数代码段在 C++ 模板声明及相邻的类型、结构体、实现或别名处激活；两段法语议会文本也在法语词内片段和句中词语上激活，无法由代码模式解释。

patterns.name: C++ 模板声明
patterns.context: 激活集中在模板声明及其模板参数列表附近，尤其是 typename、类型参数或参数包之后；通常处于声明开头。
patterns.domain: Github 和 StackExchange 的 C++ 代码

patterns.name: 模板实现与类型工具代码
patterns.context: 模板声明周围是实现、结构体、类型别名或泛型辅助函数；可能加强第一种模式，但这些词并非所有模板段共有。
patterns.domain: C++ 泛型库与项目源码

patterns.name: 法语词内片段与句中连接词
patterns.context: 激活出现在连续的法语正文中，涉及欧洲、亚洲、俄罗斯、近况或希望；没有明显的模板或代码语境。

patterns.name: 法语否定与代词
patterns.context: 这些片段出现在关于欧洲及其历史、战争和共同市场的法语论述中，构成独立于代码模式的正文激活。

en.concept: Tokenization boundaries and local word-form fragments
en.description: Activations mainly concentrate on local fragments in segmented French and Romanian word forms (especially forms meaning “also” and future-tense verbs), as well as C++ template angle brackets and type syntax. Other parliamentary words are sporadic and lack a unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Word-form fragments meaning “also/continue”
patterns.context: Romanian “de asemenea” (“also”) and in-word fragments in French future-tense verb forms; activations fall on spelling fragments spanning tokens.

patterns.name: C++ template and type syntax
patterns.context: Template parameter lists, angle brackets, type names, and template-instantiation syntax in C++ code; angle brackets and type-related tokens are especially prominent.

patterns.name: Other French conjunctions and function words
patterns.context: Occurs in ordinary syntax in parliamentary texts; these words are scattered across different topics and do not individually form a stable, specific semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Social and policy topics
patterns.context: Concerns health, the environment, agriculture, the EU, or religious politics; there is no consistent evidence of high activation on these topic words themselves.

patterns.name: Romanian emotional-expression fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences condemning events and mentioning victims; the fragments are Romanian in-word or cross-word tokenizations, with no clear connection to the other patterns.

patterns.name: Prefatory terms in French legal/procedural text
patterns.context: Concerns a proposed directive and its future safeguards; it occurs in a single segment, and it is difficult to determine whether the trigger is semantic or a tokenization coincidence.

patterns.name: C++ string-parsing call
patterns.context: A templated tag parameter is near angle brackets in a string-parsing function call; it is adjacent to the template syntax pattern, but may simply co-occur with code here.

patterns.name: Fragments near names or proper nouns
patterns.context: Token fragments near names or proper nouns in parliamentary speeches; there is insufficient context to determine their semantic role.

1_3010.concept: 分词边界与局部词形片段
1_3010.description: 激活主要集中于法语、罗马尼亚语词形被拆分后的局部片段（尤其同样、将来时动词），以及 C++ 模板尖括号和类型语法。其余议会词项分散，缺乏统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 表示“同样／继续”的词形片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语“de asemenea”（同样），以及法语将来时动词词形中的词内片段；激活落在跨 token 拼写片段上。
patterns.domain: 罗马尼亚语、法语议会发言

patterns.name: C++ 模板与类型语法
patterns.context: C++ 代码中模板参数列表、尖括号、类型名和模板实例化语法；尖括号及类型相关 token 尤其显著。

patterns.name: 其他法语连词与功能词
patterns.context: 出现在议会文本的普通句法中；这些词分散于不同主题，单独看不构成稳定的特定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 社会与政策议题词
patterns.context: 涉及健康、环境、农业、欧盟或宗教政治；未见这些主题词本身有一致的高激活证据。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语情感表达片段
patterns.context: 出现在谴责事件、提及受害者的句子中；片段是罗马尼亚语词内或词间分词，未显示与其他模式的明确联系。

patterns.name: 法语法律／程序文本中的序言词
patterns.context: 指令提案及其将来保障作用；单段出现，且难以确认是语义触发还是分词偶合。

patterns.name: C++ 字符串解析调用
patterns.context: 字符串解析函数调用中，模板化 tag 参数靠近尖括号；与模板语法模式相邻，但此处也可能只是代码共现。

patterns.name: 姓名或专名附近的碎片
patterns.context: 议会发言姓名或专名周边的分词片段，没有足够上下文判断其自身语义作用。

en.description: Responds primarily to C++ template declarations and parameter-list closing symbols, also covering code identifiers and fragments inside macros. It also responds to in-word subwords, common short words, and a few sentence-initial speech markers in French parliamentary text; no unified semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: C++ template parameter-list closing symbol
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the closing angle bracket of a template parameter list, often followed by a function, struct, or alias definition; the closing symbol alone stands out more than the overall semantics.

patterns.name: C++ template declarations and type parameters
patterns.context: Keywords and type parameters near template declarations also activate, typically alongside template parameter lists and their closing symbols.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within French words
patterns.context: Long or common French words are split into multiple tokens, with activation on internal word fragments and their local combinations; no consistent word meaning or syntactic position is apparent.

patterns.name: Common French short words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in French sentences, including conjunctions, negation structures, and apostrophe tokenization; some fragments recur, but not all tokens of the same type are marked.

patterns.name: Fragments inside C++ macro names
patterns.context: Occurs inside all-caps, underscore-separated preprocessor macro identifiers; activation is distributed across identifier fragments and is not limited to template syntax.

patterns.name: Identifier fragments in code
patterns.context: Occurs in C++ identifiers or type names, some of which are split stems; no stable, specific semantic category is evident.
patterns.domain: C++ source code and technical Q&A code

patterns.name: French sentence-initial or speech contexts
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of sentences, in forms of address, or in questions in parliamentary speeches or minutes.

1_3010.concept: 局部 token 形态与边界
1_3010.description: 主要响应 C++ 模板声明及参数列表闭合符号，也覆盖代码标识符和宏内部片段；另在法语议会文本中响应词内子词、常见短词及少量句首发言标记，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: C++ 模板参数列表结束符
patterns.context: 激活集中在模板参数列表的闭合尖括号，常在后面接函数、结构体或别名定义；单独的闭合符号而非整体语义最突出。

patterns.name: C++ 模板声明及类型形参
patterns.context: 模板声明附近的关键字和类型形参也有激活；通常与模板参数列表及其结束符同现。

patterns.name: 法语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 法语长词或常用词被分成多个 token，激活落在词内部片段及其局部组合；未见一致的词义或句法位置。

patterns.name: 法语常见短词与词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在法语句子中，涉及连词、否定结构和撇号分词；有些片段多次出现，但并非所有同类 token 都被标记。

patterns.name: C++ 宏名内部片段
patterns.context: 出现在全大写下划线分隔的预处理宏标识符内部；激活分布于标识符片段，并非只限于模板语法。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符片段
patterns.context: 出现在 C++ 标识符或类型名中，部分是被切分的词干；未显示稳定的具体语义类别。
patterns.domain: C++ 源码及技术问答代码

patterns.name: 法语句首或发言语境
patterns.context: 出现在议会发言或议事记录中的句首、称呼或提问位置。

en.concept: C++ template closers and type declarations
en.description: High activation often occurs at closing C++ template angle brackets, especially in nested type aliases. There are also sporadic triggers such as category, Callback, Scanner, and parameter packs, along with several local symbol/identifier activations that cannot be covered by a single pattern.

patterns.name: Template angle brackets and template-parameter endings
patterns.context: In C++ template declarations, instantiations, or function templates, angle brackets close the template parameter list; a type name or parameter pack sometimes immediately precedes them.

patterns.name: Nested closing brackets at the end of type lists
patterns.context: In nested template type aliases, the inner template argument list closes before the outer closing bracket.

patterns.name: category substring in an identifier
patterns.context: Occurs in the member field name “_side_category;”, near other type declarations such as typedef, Line, and Segment.

patterns.name: Callback substring in a callback class name
patterns.context: Template forward declarations and their concrete typedef instantiations; the identifier is Callback.

patterns.name: Type-name substring in scanner declarations
patterns.context: The Scanner type recurs in forward declarations, function-pointer parameters, and struct definitions.

patterns.name: Parameter-pack ellipsis
patterns.context: A typename parameter-pack declaration in a C++ variadic template, followed by Args and a closing angle bracket.

patterns.name: Other local identifier or symbol activations
patterns.context: Occur respectively in template static-member initialization, rectangle callback types, lookup-function comments/return values, TODO comments, and parse tag dispatch; there is no shared, obvious local trigger.
patterns.domain: C++ source code, comments, and test markers

1_3010.concept: C++ 模板闭合符及类型声明
1_3010.description: 高激活多见于 C++ 模板尖括号闭合，尤其嵌套类型别名；另有 category、Callback、Scanner、参数包等零散触发，及若干局部符号/标识符激活，无法用单一模式覆盖。

patterns.name: 模板尖括号及模板参数收尾
patterns.trigger: «>»、«>»10、«>»8，常出现在模板参数列表或模板实参列表的闭合处
patterns.context: C++ 模板声明、实例化或函数模板中，尖括号闭合模板参数列表；有时前面紧邻类型名或参数包

patterns.name: 类型列表中的末尾嵌套闭合
patterns.context: 嵌套模板类型别名中，内层模板实参列表闭合后接外层闭合符

patterns.name: 标识符中的 category 子串
patterns.context: 出现在成员字段名“_side_category;”中，附近还有 typedef、Line、Segment 等类型声明

patterns.name: 回调类名中的 Callback 子串
patterns.context: 模板前向声明及其具体 typedef 实例化，标识符为 Callback

patterns.name: 扫描器声明中的类型名子串
patterns.context: 前向声明、函数指针参数和结构体定义反复出现 Scanner 类型

patterns.name: 参数包省略号
patterns.context: C++ 可变参数模板的 typename 参数包声明，后接 Args 和尖括号闭合

patterns.name: 其他局部标识符或符号激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在模板静态成员初始化、矩形回调类型、查找函数注释/返回值、TODO 注释及 parse 的 tag 分派中；没有共同的明显局部触发条件
patterns.domain: C++ 源码、注释与测试标记

en.concept: C++ type and template declaration patterns
en.description: Responds primarily to typedef, typename, template/scope separators, and compound identifiers in C++ type declarations and template code, also covering Boost.MPL metaprogramming. It also activates on an English code comment and fragments within French words.

patterns.name: C++ type aliases and typedef declarations
patterns.context: Declares nested types, container types, function pointers, or local types in C++ templates or class/function definitions; commonly occurs in declaration statements.

patterns.name: Boost.MPL template metaprogramming
patterns.context: Boost.MPL represents compile-time operations using template specializations, type tags, and nested type/apply.

patterns.name: Token boundaries and naming fragments within identifiers
patterns.context: Long underscore-connected type names, member names, or compound identifiers, often adjacent to typedef declarations.

patterns.name: Parameter-wrapper description in an English code comment
patterns.context: An English documentation comment before a function template describes the behavior of a parameter wrapper.

patterns.name: Fragments within French words
patterns.context: Subword fragments occur within words in continuous French text; no obvious C++ syntax context is present.

1_3010.concept: C++ 类型与模板声明模式
1_3010.description: 主要响应 C++ 类型声明和模板代码中的 typedef、typename、模板/作用域分隔符及复合标识符，也覆盖 Boost.MPL 元编程；另对一段英文代码注释和法语词内片段有激活。

patterns.name: C++ 类型别名与 typedef 声明
patterns.context: 在 C++ 模板或类/函数定义中声明嵌套类型、容器类型、函数指针或局部类型；常见于声明语句

patterns.name: Boost.MPL 模板元编程
patterns.context: Boost.MPL 中以模板特化、类型标签及嵌套 type/apply 表示编译期操作

patterns.name: 标识符内的分词边界与命名片段
patterns.context: 下划线连接的长类型名、成员名或复合标识符，常与 typedef 类型声明相邻

patterns.name: 英文代码注释中的参数包装说明
patterns.trigger: “wraps the argument into a file_name named argument”
patterns.context: 函数模板前的英文文档注释，说明包装参数的行为

patterns.name: 法语词语内部片段
patterns.context: 连续法语正文中出现词内子词片段；没有明显 C++ 语法上下文

en.description: Activation falls mainly into two groups: fragments within words and a few function words in French parliamentary text; and templates, type declarations, and related punctuation in C++ source code. The code group is primarily Boost/MPL, with some ordinary C++ declarations.

patterns.name: Fragments within or at the ends of French words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within or at the ends of segmented French words, including common words and inflected forms; the words occur mostly in continuous French prose.
patterns.domain: French parliamentary debates and formal political text

patterns.name: C++ template and type syntax
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on template parameters, type names, qualified names, and punctuation in C++ declarations; mostly Boost/MPL code, but also other C++ code.

patterns.name: Fragments of common French function words
patterns.context: Common pronouns, prepositions, or articles occur in French sentences; some words are near punctuation or syntactic boundaries.

patterns.name: Angle brackets and declaration structures in code
patterns.context: Delimiters and declaration-ending symbols in C++ template declarations, structs, or function signatures; they occur alongside type/template syntax.

1_3010.concept: 词片段与声明语法
1_3010.description: 激活主要分两组：法语议会文本中的词内片段及少量功能词；C++ 源码中的模板、类型声明和相关标点。代码组以 Boost/MPL 为主，另有普通 C++ 声明。

patterns.name: 法语词内/词尾片段
patterns.trigger: « plus»1«ieurs»4、« Ét»1«ats»1、« res»4sources、« mis»5ère、« Mes»2dames、« voud»2«rais»2、« félic»iter»9
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的法语词内部或词尾，涉及常见词及屈折形式；词片段所在句子多为连续法语正文。
patterns.domain: 法语议会辩论与正式政治文本

patterns.name: C++模板及类型语法
patterns.context: 激活集中在 C++ 声明中的模板参数、类型名、限定名及标点；多为 Boost/MPL 代码，也包括其他 C++ 代码。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C++ 源码

patterns.name: 普通法语功能词片段
patterns.context: 法语句子中出现常见代词、介词或冠词；部分词位于标点或句法边界附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的尖括号与声明结构
patterns.context: C++ 模板声明、结构体或函数签名中的界定符与声明结束符；与类型/模板语法共同出现。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 C++ 源码

en.concept: C++ template syntax and French subword fragments
en.description: Activation is seen mainly on keywords and punctuation in C++ templates/type declarations. In French text, some subwords also activate, especially in “féliciter” in parliamentary addresses; there are also sporadic fragments in medical text, so no single semantic feature accounts for them.

patterns.name: C++ type aliases and template-metaprogramming punctuation
patterns.context: C++ code containing template parameter packs, type qualifiers, type aliases, or complex template types; activation is distributed across keywords, punctuation, and nearby type names.

patterns.name: Congratulations in formal French addresses
patterns.context: Parliamentary speeches address or congratulate members, often using «je voudrais féliciter»; the word is split into subwords.

patterns.name: Subword/word-form fragments within French words
patterns.context: In continuous French text, internal subword fragments and parts of word forms are marked in several words; aside from explicit parliamentary addresses, the triggering semantics are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Fragments within French medical terms
patterns.context: In French medical papers, marked activations fall on internal subword fragments in medical terms such as adrenalectomy, as well as in ordinary words.

1_3010.concept: C++模板语法及法语子词片段
1_3010.description: 激活主要见于 C++ 模板/类型声明中的关键字与标点；法语文本中也激活部分词内子词，尤见议会致辞的“féliciter”，另有医学文本零散片段，无法归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: C++ 类型别名与模板元编程标点
patterns.context: C++ 代码中出现模板参数包、类型限定、类型别名或复杂模板类型；激活分散于关键字、标点及类型名附近。

patterns.name: 法语正式致辞中的祝贺
patterns.context: 议会发言中向议员致意或祝贺，常见搭配 «je voudrais féliciter»；词被切分为子词。

patterns.name: 法语词内子词/词形片段
patterns.context: 法语连续文本中，若干词的内部子词片段及词形部分被标记；除明确的议会致辞外，触发语义不一致。

patterns.name: 法语医学术语的词内片段
patterns.context: 法语医学论文中，标记落在肾上腺切除等医学术语及普通词的内部子词片段上。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 法语医学论文

en.description: Responds primarily to typed declarations and syntax structures in code, especially C++ templates, dependent types, and declarators; it also covers function/pointer declarations, Java classes and interfaces, and Boost code. There is also an unrelated French parliamentary address.

patterns.name: C++ template types and metaprogramming declarations
patterns.context: Occurs in C++ template or type-alias declarations, often combined with dependent types, template specializations, nested scopes, and punctuation; most evident in excerpts 1, 2, 3, 6, and 7.

patterns.name: C++ pointers, references, and declarator symbols
patterns.context: References, function pointers, variadic parameters, and declaration-ending punctuation occur in type declarations or function parameters; these fragments are not always part of template metaprogramming.

patterns.name: C++ return types and function implementations
patterns.context: Function definitions, wrapper functions, or simple return implementations; names occur next to their implementation bodies.

patterns.name: Java class and member declarations
patterns.context: Java inheritance declarations and field declarations, including generic wildcards; unlike C++ template declarations, these are also typed code declarations.

patterns.name: Type-conversion/state-type interface
patterns.context: Documentation comments describe retrieving state by requested type and returning null on failure, followed by a Java method declaration.
patterns.domain: Java API documentation and interface code

patterns.name: C++ namespaces and container/sequence operations
patterns.context: Template declarations in a Boost namespace; the excerpt also contains version comments.

patterns.name: Forms of address and polite expressions in French
patterns.context: At the beginning of a European Parliament speech, addressing members and expressing congratulations; unrelated to the code patterns.

patterns.name: C interface and function-pointer declarations
patterns.context: C-style struct and callback function-pointer type declarations, including a forward struct declaration and variadic parameters.

1_3010.concept: 类型化声明与代码语法
1_3010.description: 主要响应代码中的类型化声明与语法结构，尤其是 C++ 模板、依赖类型和声明符；也覆盖函数/指针声明、Java 类与接口、Boost 代码。另有一段无关的法语议会致辞。

patterns.name: C++ 模板类型与元编程声明
patterns.context: 出现在 C++ 模板或类型别名声明中，常与依赖类型、模板特化、嵌套作用域及标点组合；第 1、2、3、6、7 段最明显。
patterns.domain: C++/Boost 泛型与模板元编程代码

patterns.name: C++ 指针、引用与声明符号
patterns.context: 类型声明或函数参数中出现引用、函数指针、可变参数和声明结束标点；这些片段不总是模板元编程的一部分。

patterns.name: C++ 返回类型与函数实现
patterns.context: 函数定义、包装函数或简单返回实现；名称与实现体相邻。

patterns.name: Java 类及成员声明
patterns.context: Java 类继承声明和字段声明，含泛型通配符；与 C++ 模板声明不同，但同样是类型化代码声明。

patterns.name: 类型转换/状态类型接口
patterns.context: 文档注释描述按请求类型获取状态及失败时返回 null，随后是 Java 方法声明。
patterns.domain: Java API 文档与接口代码

patterns.name: C++ 命名空间与容器/序列操作
patterns.context: Boost 命名空间中的模板声明；片段还包含版本注释。

patterns.name: 法语议会称呼与礼貌表达
patterns.trigger: « Mes»dames et Messieurs les Députés,« je» voud«rais» ... «félic»«iter»
patterns.context: 欧洲议会发言开头，向议员致意并表达祝贺；与代码模式无关。

patterns.name: C 接口与函数指针声明
patterns.context: C 风格结构体及回调函数指针类型声明，包含前置结构体声明与可变参数。

en.concept: Code generic syntax and incidental word fragments
en.description: Responds primarily to angle brackets, parameter packs, type aliases, and generic declarations in C++ template code; there are also sporadic activations on class-member declarations. In EuroParl text, activations are scattered across French, Hungarian, and Romanian word fragments and function structures, with no unified word meaning or cross-language rule apparent.

patterns.name: C++ template parameter packs and their declarations
patterns.context: In template declarations, an ellipsis is adjacent to the parameter-pack name Args, followed by a right angle bracket; type parameters in template parameter lists also occur.

patterns.name: C++ type aliases and template metaprogramming
patterns.context: In type aliases, typedefs, nested types, iterators, or Boost/MPL template expressions, activation is concentrated on angle brackets, type names, and nearby symbols.

patterns.name: C++ operator overload declarations
patterns.context: An assignment operator and move-assignment operator are declared in the VertexBuffer class interface.

patterns.name: Java class and generic member declarations
patterns.context: In a Java class definition, the field type is an abstract class with generic parameters.

patterns.name: French first person and complement structures
patterns.context: In parliamentary speeches, first-person expressions convey wishes or reminders, followed by a que clause; activation falls on function words and word fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments within Hungarian words and expressions of ability
patterns.context: In continuous Hungarian text, activation falls within words or at affix boundaries; forms meaning “be able to” are included.

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary forms of address and fragments within words
patterns.context: Formal forms of address in parliamentary speeches and internal fragments of Romanian word forms; preposition/article and noun combinations also occur.

1_3010.concept: 代码泛型语法与偶发词片段
1_3010.description: 主要响应 C++ 模板代码中的尖括号、参数包、类型别名及泛型声明；另对类成员声明有零星响应。EuroParl 中则分散落在法语、匈牙利语、罗马尼亚语词片段与功能结构上，未见统一词义或跨语言规则。

patterns.name: C++ 模板参数包及其声明
patterns.context: 模板声明中省略号紧邻参数包名 Args，后接右尖括号；也见于模板参数列表中的类型参数。

patterns.name: C++ 类型别名与模板元编程
patterns.context: 类型别名、typedef、嵌套类型、迭代器或 Boost/MPL 模板表达式中，激活集中在尖括号、类型名及其邻近符号。
patterns.domain: Github C++ 模板/泛型代码

patterns.name: C++ 运算符重载声明
patterns.context: VertexBuffer 类接口中声明赋值运算符及移动赋值运算符。

patterns.name: Java 类及泛型成员声明
patterns.context: Java 类定义中，字段类型为带泛型参数的抽象类。

patterns.name: 法语第一人称及其补语结构
patterns.trigger: « je»7 voudrais rapp«eler»；« chose»10 que nous« demand»
patterns.context: 议会发言中第一人称表达愿望或提醒，后接 que 从句；激活落在功能词和词语片段上。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段及能力表达
patterns.context: 匈牙利语连续正文中，激活落在词内部或词缀边界；包含“能够”一类形式。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会发言

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会称呼与词内片段
patterns.context: 议会发言的正式称呼及罗马尼亚语词形内部片段，另有介词/冠词与名词连写。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会发言

en.concept: Local patterns in formal discourse and code structures
en.description: Activation occurs in C++ template and declaration syntax, as well as in formal French and Romanian parliamentary discourse and a French Q&A about expression. Cross-language fragments within words and function words cannot be reduced to a single clear trigger.

patterns.name: C++ templates and type declarations
patterns.context: C++ code contains template parameter packs, type names, member functions, or operator declarations; activation is distributed across punctuation, identifier fragments, and nearby template syntax.

patterns.name: Formulaic expressions in French parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: French parliamentary speeches or formal debate text, including addresses, congratulations, and statements of committee requests; triggers fall on internal word fragments and common function words.

patterns.name: Explanatory questions and quotations in French
patterns.context: Explanatory text discussing French expressions or accents, with suggested phrasing and example questions.

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary speeches and government statements
patterns.context: Romanian parliamentary speeches or formal statements, including addressing the President and members, thanking them for the opportunity to speak, expressing support, or introducing policy issues. Activation often falls on segmented fragments within words.

patterns.name: Specific triggers that could not be grouped
patterns.context: These activations may come respectively from code declaration details or fragments within French words; the available context is insufficient to determine stable conditions distinct from the patterns above.

1_3010.concept: 正式语篇与代码结构中的局部模式
1_3010.description: 激活见于C++模板与声明语法，也见于法语、罗马尼亚语正式议会语篇及一段法语表达问答；跨语言的词内片段和功能词无法归结为单一明确触发。

patterns.name: C++模板与类型声明
patterns.context: C++代码中出现模板参数包、类型名、成员函数或运算符声明；激活分布在标点、标识符片段和模板语法附近。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C++ 代码

patterns.name: 法语议会发言套语
patterns.trigger: «Mes»dames et Messieurs les Députés、«je» voudrais、«féliciter»，以及 «il» y «a»
patterns.context: 法语议会演讲或正式辩论文本；包括致辞、祝贺、陈述委员会请求等表达，触发落在词语内部片段及常见功能词上。

patterns.name: 法语说明性问句与引用
patterns.context: 讨论法语表达方式或重音的说明文字，以建议措辞并举例问句为语境。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会发言与政务陈述
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会发言或正式陈述，包括称呼主席与议员、感谢发言机会、表达支持或介绍政策议题。激活常落在词内切分片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会记录

patterns.name: 未能归并的具体触发
patterns.trigger: C++ 中的 «const» «&» «from»，以及法语议会段落中 «long»«tem»ps、«bud»gétaire 等局部片段
patterns.context: 这些激活可能分别来自代码声明细节或法语词内片段；现有上下文不足以确定独立于上述模式的稳定条件。
patterns.domain: Github C++ 与 EuroParl 法语

en.concept: Code template structures and multilingual word fragments
en.description: Most samples are C++ template code, where activation often falls on template parameters, type metaprogramming, underscore-compound identifiers, and declaration punctuation. There are also activations on fragments within words in French and Romanian parliamentary text, which are difficult to explain together with the code patterns.

patterns.name: C++ template parameter declarations
patterns.context: Template declarations contain type parameters, parameter packs, or template closing symbols; often adjacent to class, struct, function, or type aliases.

patterns.name: C++ references and assignment operators
patterns.context: Class member-function or special-member-function declarations, especially copy/move assignment operators and reference return types.

patterns.name: C++ template specialization and type metaprogramming
patterns.context: Template specialization, nested type deduction, or Boost-style compile-time type computation.

patterns.name: Underscores and compound identifiers in C++ type names
patterns.context: Templates or type aliases with underscored identifiers, commonly implementation-detail names.

patterns.name: C++ declaration and punctuation boundaries
patterns.context: End or separator positions in declarations, function bodies, or template lists; activation falls near punctuation and is not necessarily specific to a semantic structure.

patterns.name: Fragments within French word forms
patterns.context: In continuous French parliamentary speech, activation is distributed across fragments within words and common short words; no obvious local syntactic condition shared with C++ patterns is apparent.

patterns.name: Fragments within Romanian word forms
patterns.context: In Romanian parliamentary speeches, activation occurs in forms of address, affixes, or fragments within words.

1_3010.concept: 代码模板结构与多语词片段
1_3010.description: 多数样本是 C++ 模板代码，激活常落在模板参数、类型元编程、下划线复合标识符及声明标点；另有法语、罗马尼亚语议会文本中的词内片段激活，难与代码模式统一解释。

patterns.name: C++ 模板参数声明
patterns.context: 模板声明中出现类型参数、参数包或模板闭合符；常与 class、struct、函数或类型别名相邻。

patterns.name: C++ 引用与赋值运算符
patterns.context: 类成员函数或特殊成员函数声明，尤其是复制/移动赋值运算符及引用返回类型。

patterns.name: C++ 模板特化及类型元编程
patterns.context: 模板特化、嵌套类型推导或 Boost 风格的编译期类型计算。

patterns.name: C++ 类型名中的下划线与复合标识符
patterns.context: 标识符含下划线的模板或类型别名，常见于实现细节名称。

patterns.name: C++ 声明及标点边界
patterns.context: 声明、函数体或模板列表的结束/分隔位置；激活落在标点附近，未必专属于某一语义结构。

patterns.name: 法语词形内部片段
patterns.context: 法语议会发言的连续文本中，激活分布在词内片段及常用短词；没有明显与 C++ 模式相同的局部语法条件。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词形内部片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会发言中，激活出现在称呼、词缀或词内片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会记录

en.description: Activation covers type markers in C++ template and type declarations, as well as various word fragments and function words in French and Romanian parliamentary texts and French-language discussions; it spans languages and domains, with no single clear triggering semantics.

patterns.name: C++ templates and type declarations
patterns.context: Occurs in C++ template parameters, type aliases, or class declarations; activation often falls on type names and adjacent symbols.

patterns.name: Function words and fragments within words in French parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Embedded in French sentences, especially parliamentary statements or debates; activation is scattered across pronouns, negation structures, verb fragments, and internal parts of ordinary words, and does not always fall on complete words.

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary forms of address and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in formal forms of address to the Speaker and members; activation covers multiple subword fragments within terms of address.

patterns.name: Discussions of French pronunciation and spelling
patterns.context: Examples discuss question intonation, accents, and natural phrasing; activation falls on the words used in the discussion and their fragments.

1_3010.concept: none
1_3010.description: 激活涵盖 C++ 模板与类型声明中的类型标记，以及法语、罗马尼亚语议会文本和法语语言讨论中的多种词片段与功能词；跨语言、跨领域，未见单一明确触发语义。

patterns.name: C++ 模板与类型声明
patterns.context: 出现在 C++ 代码的模板参数、类型别名或类声明中；激活常落在类型名及其相邻符号上。

patterns.name: 法语议会发言中的功能词和词内片段
patterns.trigger: «je»、«Il»、«ne»、«ont»、«faire» 的片段 «fa»、以及 «jour»、«merc» 等词内片段
patterns.context: 嵌在法语句子中，尤其是议会陈述或辩论；激活散布于代词、否定结构、动词片段及普通词内部，并不总落在完整词上。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会称谓及词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在对议长和议员的正式称呼中；激活覆盖称谓词内部的多个子词片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议会记录

patterns.name: 法语发音与拼写讨论
patterns.context: 围绕疑问语调、口音及措辞自然度举例，激活落在讨论用的词语及其片段上。

en.description: Most segments activate the substring «eper» within English words, including deeper, steeper, sweeper, sleeper, and beeper; two other segments activate Devanagari characters or adjacent boundaries, appearing respectively in an honorific in Hindi and a sequence of month names.

patterns.name: -eper fragments within words or at morphological boundaries
patterns.context: Primarily in English words, activation is concentrated on the substring eper; it can occur in comparative endings such as deeper and steeper, as well as in different word forms such as sweeper, sleeper, and beeper.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text, including encyclopedias, blogs, philosophy, law, and academic papers; [2] is non-English script date text that cannot be explained by this English substring pattern

patterns.name: Sanskrit letters and word-segmentation boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on Devanagari characters or their surrounding space markers; in [1], it occurs in a Hindi honorific at the end of a temple entry, and in [2], in an underscore-separated sequence of Hindi month names.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia text interspersed with Hindi; Hindi date/month strings on GitHub

1_3058.description: 多数段在英文单词内激活子串«eper»，涵盖 deeper、steeper、sweeper、sleeper、beeper 等；另两段激活天城文字符或相邻边界，分别出现在印地语敬称和月份序列中。

patterns.name: 词内或形态边界上的 -eper 片段
patterns.context: 主要在英文单词中，激活集中于 eper 子串；可出现在比较级词尾 deeper、steeper，也出现在 sweeper、sleeper、beeper 等不同词形中。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文文本，包括百科、博客、哲学、法律和学术论文；[2]为非英语脚本日期文本，无法由该英文子串模式解释

patterns.name: 梵文字母及分词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在天城文字符或其周围的空标记上；[1]中位于寺庙条目末尾的印地语敬称，[2]中组成按下划线分隔的印地语月份序列。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 印地语夹杂文本、GitHub 上的印地语日期/月份字符串

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to the -eper substring in English spelling, commonly in sweeper, sleeper, deeper, and steeper; it also responds to Devanagari characters and their segmented fragments.

patterns.name: English word-final -eper
patterns.context: The triggering substring occurs in the -eper spelling fragment at the end of or within English words; it sometimes crosses subword boundaries.
patterns.domain: Across encyclopedia, blog, legal, philosophy, and scientific texts

patterns.name: Sanskrit/Hindi Devanagari fragments
patterns.context: Devanagari characters and letter/diacritic combinations split by the tokenizer; [1] immediately follows the end of an English sentence, and [2] is continuous date text.
patterns.domain: Multilingual Wikipedia text and code repository content

1_3058.description: 主要对英语拼写中的 -eper 子串强烈响应，常见于 sweeper、sleeper、deeper、steeper；另对天城文字符及其拆分片段有响应。

patterns.name: 英语词尾 -eper
patterns.context: 触发子串出现在英语单词词尾或词内的 -eper 拼写片段；有时跨子词边界。
patterns.domain: 跨百科、博客、法律、哲学与科学文本

patterns.name: 梵文/印地语天城文片段
patterns.context: 天城文字符及其被分词器拆开的字母、附标组合；[1]紧接英文句子末尾，[2]是连续的日期文本。
patterns.domain: 多语种维基文本与代码仓库内容

en.description: Activation is concentrated on the string fragment “eper” and its surrounding letters, commonly in sleeper, sweeper, deeper, and beeper; it also occurs in non-English character fragments containing similar substrings. The segments' contexts vary widely in topic.

patterns.name: Words containing sleeper
patterns.context: The triggering token occurs at the end of or within English words, especially words containing sleeper/sweeper/deeper/beeper; in [4] it also occurs in non-English character fragments
patterns.domain: English encyclopedia, reviews, legal texts, and web text; also Hindi character sequences on Github

1_3058.description: 激活集中在字符串片段“eper”及其周边字母，常见于 sleeper、sweeper、deeper、beeper；也会出现在含类似子串的非英语字符碎片。各段上下文主题差异很大。

patterns.name: 含 sleeper 的词
patterns.context: 触发 token 出现在英文单词末尾或内部，尤其是带有 sleeper/sweeper/deeper/beeper 字样的词；在 [4] 中还出现于非英语字符碎片
patterns.domain: 英文百科、评论、法律文本及网页文本；另有 Github 上的印地语字符序列

en.description: Primarily responds to the -eper string across morpheme boundaries, including steeper, deeper, sleeper, and beeper; it also activates on the word form gullies and temple-related segmented fragments, with one Devanagari fragment activation.

patterns.name: Word-final -eper (comparative/derived forms)
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-final substring -eper split across morpheme boundaries, involving greater depth/steepness, sleep products, or occupational nouns; the preceding stems and meanings vary.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, religious texts, product reviews, social policy, philosophy, astronomy, law, etc.

patterns.name: Word forms related to gullies
patterns.context: Occurs in entries or geomorphology studies introducing gullies and ditch clearing; activation is distributed across multiple in-word subword fragments.

patterns.name: Transliterated fragments in Indian temple names
patterns.context: Indian religious site names and temple descriptions; markers fall on segmented fragments of Temple and deity names.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, Indian religion and local descriptions

patterns.name: Opaque Hindi/Sanskrit text fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in a mixed Latin-script and Devanagari string at the end of a paragraph; the specific meaning and triggering boundary are unclear.

1_3058.description: 主要响应跨词素切分后的 -eper 字符串，涵盖 steeper、deeper、sleeper、beeper；另对 gullies 词形及寺庙相关拆分片段有激活，且有一处天城文碎片激活。

patterns.name: 词尾 -eper（比较级/派生形式）
patterns.context: 激活落在跨词素边界拆分出的词尾子串 -eper 上，涉及更深/更陡、睡眠用品或职业名词；前面的词干和含义各异。
patterns.domain: 百科、宗教文字、商品评论、社会政策、哲学、天文学、法律等

patterns.name: gullies 相关词形
patterns.context: 出现在介绍 gullies（沟壑、排水沟）及清理沟渠的词条或地貌研究中；激活分布在词内多个子词片段。

patterns.name: 印度寺庙名称中的音译碎片
patterns.context: 印度宗教场所名称与寺庙介绍；标记落在 Temple 的拆分片段及神祇名称片段。
patterns.domain: 百科条目，印度宗教与地方介绍

patterns.name: 不透明的印地语/梵文文字碎片
patterns.context: 出现在段落末尾一处混合拉丁字母与天城文的字符串中，具体词义及触发边界不明。
patterns.domain: 百科文本，含印地语/天城文内容

en.description: The most stable pattern is several (sometimes unmarked) introducing multiple countable objects; there is also local word-final activation in the proper name Sleeper and the occupation term sweeper. Segments 2 and 5 have no clear corresponding trigger and cannot be reliably classified.

patterns.name: Plural objects following several
patterns.context: When describing multiple countable people, things, problems, or time units, several introduces a following plural noun or noun phrase; the target activation falls on several.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narratives, paper abstracts, patent backgrounds, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Sleeper in proper names or compounds
patterns.context: The band name Oh, Sleeper appears in sentences about tours/performances; activation is concentrated on the final word of the proper name.

patterns.name: Suffix -er in occupational/tool names
patterns.context: When listing people or machines that clean ditches or streets, word-final -sweeper refers to a tool or occupation performing the sweeping action; activation falls on the final part.

1_3058.description: 最稳定模式是 several（有时未标记）引出多个可数对象；另有 Sleeper 专名和 sweeper 职业名中的词尾局部激活。第2、5段无明确对应触发，不能可靠归类。

patterns.name: several 后接复数对象
patterns.trigger: «several»10，后接« friends»4、« known»8 links、« yeast»…« screens»1、« problems»1、« decades»2、« smaller»…（以及第2段“several”未标记）
patterns.context: 在描述多个可数人、事物、问题或时间单位时，several 引出后续复数名词或名词短语；目标激活落在 several 上。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、论文摘要、专利背景和百科条目

patterns.name: 专名或复合词中的 Sleeper
patterns.context: 乐队名称 Oh, Sleeper 出现在巡演/演出相关句子中；激活集中在专名的末词。

patterns.name: 职业/工具名称的后缀 er
patterns.context: 在列举清洁沟渠或街道的人或机器时，词尾 -sweeper 指执行清扫动作的工具或职业；激活落在词尾部分。

en.concept: Specific word forms in academic texts
en.description: Primarily responds to “several” and the “alkaloid(s)” stem in natural-products literature; there are also a few sporadic word-fragment activations. The former means “a number of” across academic fields, while the latter is concentrated in biomedical and chemical contexts.

patterns.name: The word “several”
patterns.context: Often used to mean “a number of/several types” in academic sentences summarizing research, species, diseases, prevention studies, or experiments; no narrower fixed collocation is apparent.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, research proposals, and social psychology papers

patterns.name: The “alkaloid(s)” stem
patterns.context: When discussing secretions, pharmacologically active compounds, or plant-based medicinal compounds; the trigger position falls on the beginning of the stem across plural and singular forms.

patterns.name: Sporadic word activations
patterns.context: Appear sporadically, with no shared context or stable semantic relation; some may be split word fragments.

1_3058.concept: 学术文本中的特定词形
1_3058.description: 主要响应“several”，以及天然产物文献中的“alkaloid(s)”词干；另有少量分散词片段激活。前者跨多个学术领域表示“若干”，后者集中于生物医学和化学语境。

patterns.name: “several”一词
patterns.context: 在概述研究、物种、疾病、预防研究或实验的学术句子中，常用于表示“若干/多种”；无明显更窄的固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、研究计划及社会心理学论文

patterns.name: “alkaloid(s)”词干
patterns.context: 涉及分泌物、药理活性成分或植物药成分时；触发位置落在词干开头，跨越复数和单数形式。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与天然产物化学文献

patterns.name: 零散词语激活
patterns.context: 分散出现，未见共同上下文或稳定语义关系；部分可能是被拆分的词片段。

en.description: Activation commonly occurs on “under” followed by conditions, models, or clauses; it also appears across statistical research phrasing, name fragments, medical diagnoses, license headers, imaging, condensed-matter physics, and materials chemistry terminology, spanning a wide range of fields.

patterns.name: “under” and its following context
patterns.context: “under” appears as a preposition, a compound prefix, or license wording; it is followed by content such as models, conditions, illumination, mathematical mappings, or license clauses.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain, especially academic papers and technical documents

patterns.name: Statistical research phrasing
patterns.context: Researchers describe conducting experiments, inferential problems in research, or mathematical objects.

patterns.name: Names and name fragments
patterns.context: A person's full name appears or forms part of a compound proper name; activation falls on several subword fragments of the name.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries and condensed-matter physics papers

patterns.name: Medical terminology and diagnostic methods
patterns.context: Describes urine cytology as a method for diagnosing acute problems with kidney transplants.

patterns.name: License header format
patterns.context: Software license statements and contributor clauses in newline-separated comments.

patterns.name: Microscopic imaging and transparent samples
patterns.context: Introduces optical microscopy and the transparency of biological samples under visible light.

patterns.name: Spin-orbit and materials phase-transition terminology
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of material parameters, symmetry, and spin-orbit interactions on transitions.

patterns.name: Mitochondrial granules and experimental conditions
patterns.context: Mentions studies of mitochondrial granules and molecular probes under equilibrium and time-resolved conditions; the initial “rial” is a truncated word fragment.

patterns.name: Material properties and crystal polymorphs
patterns.context: Describes the thermal properties and phase transition of a cubic polymorph of a magnesium borohydride.

1_3058.description: 激活常见于“under”及其后接条件、模型或条款，也散见统计研究措辞、姓名片段、医学诊断、许可标头、成像、凝聚态物理和材料化学术语，领域跨度很大。

patterns.name: “under”及其后续语境
patterns.trigger: «under»；[1]“under the model”，[3]“under misspecification”，[4]“underused”，[5]“under”$h$，[6]“under one or more”，[7]“under visible light”，[9]“under equilibrium”
patterns.context: “under”作为介词、复合词前缀或许可证措辞出现；后接模型、条件、光照、数学映射或许可条款等内容。
patterns.domain: 跨领域，尤见学术论文与技术文档

patterns.name: 统计研究措辞
patterns.context: 研究者描述开展实验、研究推断问题或考虑数学对象时。

patterns.name: 姓名与姓名片段
patterns.context: 人名完整出现或作为复合专名的一部分；激活落在姓名的若干子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 百科条目与凝聚态物理论文

patterns.name: 医学术语与诊断方法
patterns.context: 描述尿液细胞学作为诊断肾移植物急性问题的方法。

patterns.name: 许可证标头格式
patterns.context: 换行注释中的软件许可证声明及贡献者条款。

patterns.name: 显微成像与透明样本
patterns.trigger: «Opt»«ical» «microscopy»、“«a» commonly used method”、“quite transparent under visible light”
patterns.context: 介绍光学显微镜及生物样本在可见光下的透明性。

patterns.name: 自旋轨道与材料相变术语
patterns.context: 讨论材料参数、对称性及自旋轨道相互作用对转变的影响。

patterns.name: 线粒体颗粒与实验条件
patterns.context: 提及线粒体颗粒及分子探针在平衡和时间分辨条件下的研究；开头的“rial”是截断词片段。

patterns.name: 材料性质与晶体多形
patterns.context: 描述一种镁硼氢化物立方多形的热学性质和相变。

en.description: Activation primarily falls on under in paper contexts, where it often introduces a condition, environment, or scope; it also appears after an abstract opening, in hydrostatic-pressure conditions, and in the fixed term area under the curve. Segment 7 has no clear under trigger.

patterns.name: under after an abstract marker
patterns.context: At the start of an abstract, the immediately following under is marked with strong activation; different segments have under followed by misspecification, local laser intensity, shared-memory architecture, or a magnetic field.

patterns.name: under conditions or scope
patterns.context: under introduces a condition, intervention, or scope, followed by a specific context; examples include under very general conditions, under arbitrary interventions, and under the action of transformations such as de Sitter.
patterns.domain: Scientific paper bodies or abstracts, covering statistics, physics, and causal inference

patterns.name: under the curve
patterns.context: In the fixed term area under the curve, under and curve form the name of an evaluation metric.

patterns.name: under hydrostatic pressure
patterns.context: Describes the stability or phase behavior of materials under hydrostatic pressure.

patterns.name: under + conditional noun phrase
patterns.context: under introduces an external-field condition in a physical experiment or model.

patterns.name: Continuation after under in paper statements
patterns.context: Activation occurs on under in academic statements; the following content is not necessarily a common fixed collocation; all examples express a condition, environment, or scope.

1_3058.description: 激活主要落在论文语境中的 under：它常引出条件、环境或适用范围；也见于摘要开头后的 under、静水压力条件和固定术语 area under the curve。第7段未见明确 under 触发。

patterns.name: 摘要标记后的 under
patterns.context: 摘要起始处，紧接其后的 under 被标记为强激活；不同片段中 under 后接 misspecification、局部激光强度、共享内存架构或磁场等内容。

patterns.name: under 条件或作用域
patterns.context: under 引出某个条件、干预或作用域，后接具体情境；包括在非常一般的条件下、任意干预下，以及在 de Sitter 等变换作用下。
patterns.domain: 科学论文正文或摘要，涵盖统计、物理与因果推断

patterns.name: under the curve
patterns.context: 固定术语 area under the curve 中，under 与 curve 组成评价指标名称。
patterns.domain: 生物医学/分类器性能评估

patterns.name: under hydrostatic pressure
patterns.context: 描述材料在静水压力条件下的稳定性或相行为。

patterns.name: under + 条件性名词短语
patterns.context: under 引出物理实验或模型的外场条件。

patterns.name: 论文陈述中的 under 后延续
patterns.context: 激活发生在学术陈述中的 under，后续内容不一定是紧邻的常见固定搭配；各例均表达条件、环境或适用范围。

en.description: Primarily responds to citation cues in academic papers: author names followed by “et al.”, often accompanied by a year, parentheses, or reference labels; it also responds to “see:” formats listing related literature. There is also an isolated high activation on “under misspecification” in a statistical abstract.

patterns.name: Author-year academic citations
patterns.context: Cites research in the body of an academic paper, especially author names followed by et al. and a year, reference number, or citation parentheses.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers from ArXiv and PubMed Central, involving astronomy, agriculture, medicine, protein research, etc.

patterns.name: Bibliography lists and directive-style citations
patterns.context: Lists multiple references around a topic such as related research or structures; formatting often includes italicized authors, years, and reference labels.
patterns.domain: Literature references or related-work descriptions in papers, covering fields such as chemistry.

patterns.name: under in a statistics context
patterns.context: Appears in an abstract describing the model-misspecification condition under which generalized Bayesian inference is considered; the high activation here is isolated, with no citation format shared with the other segments.

1_3058.description: 主要响应学术论文中的引文线索：作者名后接“et al.”，常伴随年份、括号或文献标签；也响应列举相关文献的“see:”格式。另有统计摘要中“under misspecification”的孤立高激活。

patterns.name: 作者-年份式学术引文
patterns.trigger: “et al”及其后的“10”标记，常与作者名、年份和括号或方括号引文相邻；如“Grove et al. 1998”“Bloom et al.”
patterns.context: 学术论文正文中引用研究，尤其是作者名后接 et al. 和年份、文献编号或引用括号。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与 PubMed Central 的科学论文，涉及天文学、农业、医学、蛋白质研究等。

patterns.name: 文献列表与指引式引用
patterns.trigger: “see:”以及多次出现的“*et al.*”“[@…]”和年份，如“see: Balalaie *et al.* (2003[@bb21])”
patterns.context: 以相关研究或结构为主题，列出多条参考文献；格式常含斜体作者、年份和文献标签。
patterns.domain: 论文中的参考文献指引或相关工作说明，涵盖化学等领域。

patterns.name: 统计学语境中的 under
patterns.context: 出现在摘要中，描述广义贝叶斯推断所处的模型误设条件；此处高激活是孤立现象，未见与其他段相同的引文格式。

en.concept: Academic paper text markers and citations
en.description: Activation is distributed across academic paper contexts, commonly including abstract/introduction/figure structure markers and author/reference citation formats; the body topics vary widely, including astrophysics, biology, mathematical statistics, and computer vision, making a single-topic explanation difficult.

patterns.name: Academic paper structure markers
patterns.context: At the beginning of a paper abstract or introduction, and near figure citations in the body; the structure markers themselves activate, while body content varies

patterns.name: Black holes and accretion in astrophysics
patterns.context: When discussing high-energy radiation, Galactic black hole candidates, accretion disks, or observations of outbursts; some instances contain only black-hole-related words

patterns.name: Author formatting in literature citations
patterns.context: When citing researchers in the body, usually following author names and possibly accompanied by a year or bracketed citation marker

patterns.name: Reference markers and bibliography keys
patterns.context: LaTeX/BibTeX-style bibliography keys appear in the body or immediately adjacent to a citation; the same segment may also contain ordinary literature descriptions

patterns.name: Biological species and research subjects
patterns.context: Introduces plant species, crops, or protein interactions in an introduction or research background

patterns.name: Methods and theoretical terminology
patterns.context: Introduces statistical inference conditions or mathematical operators in abstracts; no specific content-word pattern shared with other segments is apparent

patterns.name: Motion information and video frames
patterns.context: Reviews recent work and explains approximating motion information using differences between adjacent frames

1_3058.concept: 学术论文文本标记与引用
1_3058.description: 激活分布于学术论文语境，常见摘要/引言/图表结构标记、作者与文献引用格式；正文主题跨度很大，包括天体物理、生物学、数学统计及计算机视觉，难以由单一主题解释。

patterns.name: 学术论文结构标记
patterns.context: 论文摘要或引言开头，以及正文中的图表引用附近；结构标记本身有激活，正文内容多样

patterns.name: 天体物理中的黑洞与吸积
patterns.context: 讨论高能辐射、银河系黑洞候选体、吸积盘或爆发源观测时；有些实例仅出现黑洞相关词语

patterns.name: 文献引用中的作者格式
patterns.context: 正文引用研究者时，通常跟随作者姓名，并可能带年份或方括号引用标记

patterns.name: 参考文献标记与文献键
patterns.context: 正文引用或紧邻引用处出现 LaTeX/BibTeX 风格的文献键；同一段也可能包含普通文献叙述

patterns.name: 生物学物种与研究对象
patterns.context: 引言或研究背景中介绍植物物种、作物或蛋白质相互作用
patterns.domain: 植物学、农业、生物学论文

patterns.name: 方法与理论术语
patterns.context: 摘要中介绍统计推断条件或数学算子；未见与其他段落共享的特定内容词模式
patterns.domain: 统计学与数学论文摘要

patterns.name: 运动信息与视频帧
patterns.context: 回顾近期工作，说明以相邻帧差异近似运动信息

en.concept: Proper names and citations in academic papers
en.description: Activates in formatted academic papers, especially astronomical texts involving celestial terminology, object identifiers, observational or theoretical accounts, and citations; also responds to titles, acronym definitions, and citations, methods, and crop introductions in interdisciplinary papers.

patterns.name: Astrophysical and observational object names
patterns.context: Occurs in astronomical paper narratives, often alongside object names, physical processes, observational results, or model descriptions; it is not triggered by a single word in these terms.
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, observational astronomy, and cosmology papers

patterns.name: Literature citations in astronomy papers
