patterns.context: Cites prior studies, authors, and years, often after descriptions of objects or research results; this pattern also appears in agronomy and crystallography papers.

patterns.name: Author names and reference formats
patterns.context: Activation spans multiple parts of author surnames, et al., and numeric years or reference markers; it is not necessarily limited to one discipline.

patterns.name: Numbers and alphanumeric identifiers in proper names
patterns.context: Numbers and alphanumeric strings are embedded in celestial names, source identifiers, or years; nearby context identifies objects or describes event dates.
patterns.domain: Astronomical object naming and academic narratives

patterns.name: Paper section headings
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of papers or around titles and section boundaries; activation falls on headings and some adjacent formatting markers.

patterns.name: Definitions or abbreviations following proper names
patterns.context: An object name or abbreviation is introduced first, followed by hereafter to establish a shorter name used later.

patterns.name: Interdisciplinary scientific methods and experimental/computational descriptions
patterns.context: Describes computations or methods performed according to established protocols, with citations; unrelated to astrophysical subject matter.

patterns.name: Crop introductions and yield descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces a crop’s importance, cultivation range, or yield, accompanied by author–year citations; activation is concentrated near the crop name.

1_3058.concept: 学术论文中的专名与引文
1_3058.description: 激活见于格式化学术论文，尤其天文学文本中的天体术语、对象编号、观测或理论叙述及引文；也响应标题、简称定义和跨学科论文中的引文、方法、作物介绍。

patterns.name: 天体物理与观测对象名称
patterns.trigger: “black hole”“galactic”“star”“SNe”“Hubble Deep Field”“gravitational entropy”“AM E”“accretion disk”等天体、天文现象或观测对象术语
patterns.context: 处于天文学论文叙述中，常与对象名称、物理过程、观测结果或模型描述相邻；并非这些术语中的某个单词单独触发。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、观测天文学与宇宙学论文

patterns.name: 天文论文中的文献引证
patterns.trigger: “et al.”、“1998”、“1997a”、“[@B16]”及作者名与年份构成的引文
patterns.context: 引用既有研究、作者和年份，常出现在天体或研究结果描述之后；此模式也见于非天文的农学及晶体学论文。

patterns.name: 作者名与参考文献格式
patterns.trigger: “Grove et al. 1998”、“Fox et al. 1998”、“Bond et al. 2003”、“Merrill 1933”、“Gao et al.”、“Tan et al.”等作者—引文片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖作者姓氏、et al. 和数字年份或文献标记的多个部分；未必局限于某个学科。
patterns.domain: 跨学科的学术引文文本

patterns.name: 专名中的数字与字母数字编号
patterns.context: 数字和字母数字串嵌在天体名称、来源编号或年份中；相邻上下文为对象识别或事件年代说明。
patterns.domain: 天文学对象命名与学术叙述

patterns.name: 论文结构标题
patterns.context: 出现在论文开头或标题、章节边界处；激活落在标题及部分紧邻格式标记。

patterns.name: 专名之后的定义或简称说明
patterns.context: 先给出对象名称或缩写，再用 hereafter 引入下文简称。
patterns.domain: 学术论文中的术语定义

patterns.name: 跨学科科学方法与实验/计算描述
patterns.context: 描述计算或方法依照既有协议执行，并附引文；与天体物理主题无关。

patterns.name: 农作物介绍与产量描述
patterns.trigger: “a … is an important food crop cultivated in over 100 countries”“Its high yielding”
patterns.context: 介绍作物的重要性、种植范围或产量，伴随作者—年份引文；主要激活集中在作物名称附近。

en.description: Activates mainly in astrophysics papers, covering galaxies, stars, black holes, gas accretion, supernovae, and observational projects; one passage from an animal behavior introduction has a different topic.

patterns.name: Galaxy stellar populations and near-infrared spectra
patterns.context: Discusses the use of the near-infrared to probe galaxy stellar populations and predictions of stellar models for their contributions to spectra.

patterns.name: Black hole accretion and high-energy radiation
patterns.context: Describes radiation from accretion disks around black holes or the high-energy spectrum of a Galactic black hole candidate.

patterns.name: Cold gas accretion in galaxy formation
patterns.context: Explains mass assembly and fueling in high-redshift galaxies, and gas inflow along filamentary structures.

patterns.name: Hot gas in galaxy clusters and groups
patterns.context: Compares hot gas in rich galaxy clusters and smaller galaxy groups, and mentions cooling flows.

patterns.name: Supernovae and unusual stellar events
patterns.context: Lists supernovae and unusual stellar events in literature reviews or object catalogs.

patterns.name: Observational indicators of star formation activity
patterns.context: Notes that an observational indicator is suitable for measuring star formation in galaxies, is well calibrated, and is relatively unaffected by extinction.

patterns.name: Infrared space telescope observing projects
patterns.context: Introduces target galaxies and observing projects and instruments of the Herschel Space Observatory.

patterns.name: Praying mantises and sexual cannibalism
patterns.context: An introduction states the association between mantises and sexual cannibalism; it has no evident semantic connection to the other astronomy passages.

1_3058.concept: 天体物理科学论文语境
1_3058.description: 激活主要出现在天体物理论文中，涵盖星系、恒星、黑洞、气体吸积、超新星及观测项目；另有一段动物行为学引言，主题不同。

patterns.name: 星系恒星族与近红外光谱
patterns.context: 讨论近红外波段用于探测星系恒星族，以及恒星模型对光谱贡献的预测。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、星系光谱研究

patterns.name: 黑洞吸积与高能辐射
patterns.trigger: “accretion disk”“supermassive black hole”；“broad band high energy emission spectra”“galactic black hole candidates”
patterns.context: 描述黑洞周围吸积盘的辐射，或银河系黑洞候选体的高能光谱。

patterns.name: 星系形成中的冷气体吸积
patterns.trigger: “cold gas accretion onto galaxies”“high redshift”“cold gas streaming along filaments”
patterns.context: 解释高红移星系的质量组装、供料及气体沿丝状结构流入。

patterns.name: 星系团与星系群中的热气体
patterns.trigger: “vast quantities of hot gas”“rich clusters of galaxies”“compact groups”
patterns.context: 比较丰富星系团与较小星系群中的热气体，并提及冷却流。

patterns.name: 超新星与特殊恒星事件
patterns.context: 在文献回顾或对象清单中列举超新星及特殊恒星事件。

patterns.name: 恒星形成活动的观测指标
patterns.trigger: “census of star formation activity”“star-forming galaxies”“modest extinction”
patterns.context: 说明某观测指标适于测量星系恒星形成，且校准良好、受消光较小。

patterns.name: 红外空间望远镜观测项目
patterns.context: 介绍目标星系及赫歇尔空间望远镜的观测项目和仪器。

patterns.name: 祈祷螳螂与性 cannibalism
patterns.context: 引言中陈述螳螂与性同类相食的关联；与其余天文学片段缺少明显语义联系。

en.description: Responds mainly to galaxy, star formation, feedback, black hole, and observational vocabulary in astrophysics papers, and also to paper abstract formats; there are also passages on gravitational entropy theory and an evolutionary biology example, which do not fit a single narrow topic.

patterns.name: Astrophysics and cosmology research contexts
patterns.context: Occurs in research paper abstracts or body text discussing galaxies, star formation, galaxy clusters, black holes, cosmological models, and observational evidence; no particular fixed term or syntactic position is required.

patterns.name: Stellar populations and star formation
patterns.context: Discusses stellar composition in galaxies, star formation activity, or stellar evolution and its impact on observed spectra.

patterns.name: Feedback mechanisms in galaxy formation
patterns.context: Treats feedback or hot gas as a component of galaxy formation models and connects it to observations or model interpretation.

patterns.name: Astronomical facilities and radio properties
patterns.context: Mentions a specific observing satellite or lists the radio properties of celestial objects with literature citations; the pattern need not relate to the same observing band.

patterns.name: Black hole entropy and gravitational theory
patterns.context: The title and abstract discuss the definition or validity of gravitational entropy for black holes, rather than galaxy observations.

patterns.name: Evolutionary convergence and molecular-level biological examples
patterns.context: Uses morphological or molecular-level examples to illustrate similar evolutionary problems and convergent outcomes.
patterns.domain: Biology, evolutionary biology PubMed Central papers

patterns.name: Astronomical observation case: black hole accretion disk and emission lines
patterns.context: Describes observations of emission lines or line profiles in a specific galaxy, suggesting an accretion disk around a supermassive black hole.

patterns.name: Abstract and research-statement formats
patterns.context: Occurs near paper abstracts, titles, or statements of research aims; it may co-occur with astrophysical content but cannot by itself explain all activations.

1_3058.description: 主要响应天体物理论文中的星系、恒星形成、反馈、黑洞及观测语汇，也见论文摘要格式；另有引力熵理论和一段进化生物学例子，不能归入统一的狭义主题。

patterns.name: 天体物理与宇宙学研究语境
patterns.context: 出现在研究论文摘要或正文中，讨论星系、恒星形成、星系团、黑洞、宇宙学模型及其观测证据；不要求某个固定术语或句法位置。
patterns.domain: 天体物理、宇宙学 ArXiv 论文

patterns.name: 恒星族群与恒星形成
patterns.trigger: “stellar population”“star formation activity”“star-forming galaxies”“TP-AGB stars”“stellar winds”
patterns.context: 讨论星系中的恒星组成、恒星形成活动或恒星演化及其对观测光谱的影响。
patterns.domain: 星系天文学、恒星天体物理

patterns.name: 星系形成反馈机制
patterns.trigger: “feedback”“hot gas contribution”“heated by SNe and stellar winds”“active galactic nuclei (AGN)”
patterns.context: 把反馈或热气体作为星系形成模型的组成机制，并联系观测或模型解释。

patterns.name: 天文观测设施及射电性质
patterns.context: 提及具体观测卫星，或以文献引证串列出天体的射电性质；该模式不必与同一观测波段有关。

patterns.name: 黑洞熵与引力理论
patterns.context: 标题及摘要谈论黑洞的引力熵定义或其有效性，而非星系观测。

patterns.name: 演化趋同与分子层面的生物例子
patterns.trigger: “similar solutions”“similar evolutionary problems”“eyes and wings”“echolocation in bats”
patterns.context: 以形态学或分子层面的例子说明相似演化问题及其趋同结果。
patterns.domain: 生物学、进化生物学 PubMed Central 论文

patterns.name: 天体观测个例：黑洞吸积盘与发射线
patterns.context: 描述特定星系中发射线或谱线轮廓的观测，并据此提示超大质量黑洞周围的吸积盘。

patterns.name: 论文摘要与研究陈述格式
patterns.trigger: “abstract:”“In this paper”“Based on our previous work”“we investigate here”
patterns.context: 处于论文摘要、标题或研究目标陈述附近；可能与天体物理内容共同出现，但不能单独解释所有激活。

en.description: Activations fall on subword fragments within terms from different fields: Majorana, Stokes, Dhyana, X-ray, Stieltjes, stress, and erg; there are also the number 10 and broad. Apart from a shared “ana” fragment, there is no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragment within the term Majorana
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within the physics term Majorana, not as a standalone word; both occurrences relate to Majorana particles, matrices, or associated theoretical contexts.
patterns.domain: Theoretical physics, particle physics, and condensed matter physics

patterns.name: Ending of the acronym RANS
patterns.context: Occurs at the end of the Navier–Stokes equation name, near mentions of RANS flow solutions, velocity, and pressure fields.
patterns.domain: Fluid mechanics, machine learning application papers

patterns.name: Name fragment in Dhyana
patterns.context: Occurs within the actor’s name Dhyana in a cast list; there is no evident physics or technical context.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in X-ray
patterns.context: Occurs in X-ray, near discussion of redshift, galaxy clusters, and scaling relations.

patterns.name: Ending fragment in Stieltjes
patterns.context: Occurs within the mathematical term Stieltjes-type, in a discussion of quark vacuum polarization.

patterns.name: Subword fragment in stress
patterns.context: Occurs within the word stress in an introduction to myocardial perfusion imaging.

patterns.name: Fragment in the unit of excitation energy
patterns.context: A word-internal part of the physical unit erg, occurring near luminosity expressions for high-redshift objects.

patterns.name: Anomalous activation in an SFR numeric expression
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in a formula or numeric expression for a galaxy star formation rate range; the activated token is a number rather than an evident shared term fragment.

patterns.name: Dipole interaction context
patterns.context: Activation occurs in a description of a general range of systems; the paragraph concerns ubiquitous dipole interactions, with no clear correspondence to the forms of other activated words.

1_3058.description: 激活多落在不同领域术语的词内片段：Majorana、Stokes、Dhyana、X-ray、Stieltjes、stress、erg；另有数字10与broad。除相似的“ana”片段外，缺少统一语义模式。

patterns.name: Majorana 术语内部片段
patterns.trigger: «ana»（[1] 中为 “Major«ana» K…”，[10] 中为 “Major«ana» matrices”）
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在物理术语 Majorana 的词内，而非独立词；两处均与 Majorana 粒子、矩阵或相关理论语境相连。
patterns.domain: 理论物理、粒子物理与凝聚态物理

patterns.name: RANS 缩写末尾
patterns.context: 出现在 Navier–Stokes 方程名称末尾，附近提及 RANS 流动解、速度和压力场。
patterns.domain: 流体力学、机器学习应用论文

patterns.name: Dhyana 人名片段
patterns.context: 出现在演员姓名 Dhyana 的词内，位于演员名单中；没有明显物理或技术语境。

patterns.name: X-ray 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 X-ray 一词中，附近谈红移、星系团及尺度关系。

patterns.name: Stiel末尾片段
patterns.context: 出现在 Stieltjes 类型这一数学术语的词内，讨论夸克真空极化。

patterns.name: stress 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在 stress 一词内，语境为心肌灌注成像的医学介绍。

patterns.name: 兴奋能量单位片段
patterns.context: 作为物理量单位 erg 的词内部分，出现在高红移天体的光度表达式附近。

patterns.name: SFR 数值表达中的异常激活
patterns.context: 触发在星系恒星形成率范围的公式或数值表达中；激活 token 是数字而非明显的共同术语片段。

patterns.name: 偶极相互作用语境
patterns.context: 激活位于泛指系统范围的描述中，段落主题是普遍存在的偶极相互作用；与其他激活词形没有清楚对应关系。

en.concept: The subword fragment forming, with sporadic word-form and proper-name triggers
en.description: Activations mainly fall on the subword fragment forming in different words: star-forming, Fourier-transforming, and transforming growth factor; there are also the ending of the word for rickets and internal fragments of the proper names Stieltjes and Majorana.

patterns.name: Stieltjes proper-name segmentation
patterns.context: A physics abstract discusses a function type describing quark vacuum polarization as a function of external momentum; strong activation falls on an internal subword fragment of the proper name Stieltjes.

patterns.name: Rickets-related word ending
patterns.context: The final subword of the word rickets; occurs in descriptions of a disease caused by loss of PHEX function and in accounts related to phosphate metabolism and vitamin D deficiency.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of the proper name Majorana
patterns.context: A topological superconducting qubit abstract mentions Majorana zero modes / Kramers pairs; activation falls on an internal fragment of the proper name.

patterns.name: Word ending related to galaxy formation
patterns.context: An astronomy abstract describes a galaxy or galaxy sample forming stars; activation falls on the compound word forming.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in Fourier transform
patterns.context: Discusses PDEs in inhomogeneous systems and states that eigenmodes cannot be obtained via Fourier transform; the forming fragment is activated, but the context does not concern star formation.

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in TGF-beta
patterns.context: The word forming is part of transforming in the name transforming growth factor beta; it does not describe star formation.

1_3058.concept: 词片段 forming，兼有零散词形/专名触发
1_3058.description: 激活主要落在不同词中的 forming 子词片段：恒星形成、Fourier-transforming 和 transforming growth factor；另有佝偻病词尾，以及 Stieltjes、Majorana 专名内部片段。

patterns.name: Stieltjes 专名切分
patterns.context: 物理学摘要中讨论夸克真空极化随外部动量变化的函数类型；强激活落在专名 Stieltjes 的内部子词片段。

patterns.name: 佝偻病相关词尾
patterns.context: 佝偻病一词的末尾子词；分别出现在 PHEX 功能缺失导致的疾病描述，以及磷代谢、维生素 D 缺乏相关叙述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与医学文献

patterns.name: Majorana 专名中段
patterns.context: 拓扑超导量子比特摘要中出现 Majorana 零模／Kramers 对；激活落在专名内部片段。

patterns.name: 星系形成相关词尾
patterns.context: 天文学摘要中描述星系（或星系样本）正在形成恒星；激活落在复合词 forming 上。

patterns.name: Fourier 变换词内片段
patterns.context: 讨论非均匀系统的 PDE，指出不能通过 Fourier 变换来获得特征模；forming 片段被激活，但不涉及恒星形成语义。
patterns.domain: 非线性动力学／数学物理

patterns.name: TGF-beta 词内片段
patterns.context: 转化生长因子 beta 的名称中，forming 作为 transforming 的组成部分；不是描述恒星形成。

en.concept: Subword fragments of rare technical terms
en.description: Activations often fall within or at the end of subwords in technical terms, proper names, or compounds across fluid mechanics, physics, astronomy, medicine, and materials science; triggers are not limited to a single discipline and often occur in fragments of rare words split into subwords.

patterns.name: Navier–Stokes token fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a technical context describing RANS flow solutions; strong activation falls on the split ending token «okes».

patterns.name: Stieltjes word-ending fragment
patterns.context: The vacuum polarization function is described as a Stieltjes-type function of external momentum q²; activation is concentrated on the split token of the proper name.

patterns.name: “tail” fragments in astronomical terms
patterns.context: Subword fragments in astronomical proper names or terms, including instrument names, survey names, lensing, reddening, line of sight, and gamma rays; not all fragments activate equally strongly.

patterns.name: Medical term endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on endings or subwords of medical vocabulary in disease names, hair types, and biopsy descriptions.

patterns.name: PDE operation ending
patterns.context: In a discussion of obtaining eigenmodes from partial differential equations in inhomogeneous systems, activation occurs on the suffix token of a compound verb.

patterns.name: Author surname fragment in a material name
patterns.context: Author surnames and citation abbreviations activate strongly in citations for an effective force field used in molecular dynamics simulations.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a personal name
patterns.context: A researcher’s name in a list of immunology projects; activation is concentrated on the final token of the split name.

1_3058.concept: 罕见专业词的子词片段
1_3058.description: 激活多落在专业术语、专名或复合词的内部/词尾子词：流体、物理、天文、医学、材料领域及人名中均有；触发条件并不局限于单一学科，常见于被拆分的罕见词片段。

patterns.name: Navier–Stokes 分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在描述 RANS 流动解的技术语境中；强激活落在被拆分的词尾 token «okes»。

patterns.name: Stieltjes 词尾片段
patterns.context: 真空极化函数被描述为外部动量 q² 的 Stieltjes 类型函数；激活集中在拼写被拆分的专名 token。

patterns.name: 天体术语中的「尾」片段
patterns.context: 天文学专名或术语的子词片段，包括仪器名、巡天名、透镜、颜色变红及视线、伽马射线等；并非每个片段强度相同。

patterns.name: 医学术语词尾
patterns.context: 在疾病名称、毛发类型及活检描述中，激活落于医学词汇的词尾或子词。

patterns.name: PDE 操作词尾
patterns.context: 讨论非均匀系统中由偏微分方程求本征模态时，激活出现在复合动词的后缀 token。

patterns.name: 材料名称中的作者姓氏片段
patterns.context: 分子动力学模拟所用有效力场的引文中，作者姓氏及引用缩写出现较强激活。

patterns.name: 人名内部片段
patterns.context: 免疫研究项目列表中的研究者姓名；激活集中在人名拆分后的末段 token。

en.description: Activations concentrate on several word-form fragments: sight in the astronomy phrase “line of sight,” the suffix ickets in the medical word rickets, and ana in the proper names Lana and Haryana; these patterns span different fields, with one additional unexplained passage.

patterns.name: sight in the phrase “line of sight”
patterns.context: In astronomy or radio astronomy contexts, describes properties of an object along the line of sight; in both passages, the final word “sight” in the phrase activates strongly.

patterns.name: Subword in the disease word rickets
patterns.context: The name of rickets appears in medical texts; the trigger is the word suffix “ickets”.
patterns.domain: Biomedicine, clinical medicine, and medical reviews

patterns.name: Lana in a name
patterns.context: The substring Lana in a proper name or organization name; contexts include a list of names and an airline name.

patterns.name: Suffix in the place name Haryana
patterns.context: The Indian place name Haryana; occurs in contexts describing an industrial development agency or gotra distribution, with strong activation on “ana”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, Indian geography and society

1_3058.description: 激活集中于若干词形片段：天文学短语“line of sight”的 sight、医学词 rickets 的后缀 ickets，以及专名中的 Lana、Haryana 的 ana；这些模式领域各异，另有一段无法解释。

patterns.name: 短语 “line of sight” 中的 sight
patterns.context: 天文学或射电天文学语境中，描述观测对象沿视线方向的性质；在两个片段里均是短语末尾的 “sight” 强激活。

patterns.name: 疾病词 rickets 的子词
patterns.context: 医学文本中出现佝偻病名称；触发部分是单词后缀 “ickets”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、临床与医学综述

patterns.name: 名称中的 Lana
patterns.context: 专名或机构名称中的 Lana 子串；上下文分别是名称列表和航空公司名称。

patterns.name: 地名 Haryana 的后缀
patterns.context: 印度地名 Haryana；在描述工业开发机构或 gotra 分布的语境中出现，强激活落在 “ana”。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、印度地理与社会

en.concept: Fragments of technical terms and proper names
en.description: Activations often fall on internal fragments of technical terms, abbreviations, proper names, or terminology: covering diseases, fluid and condensed matter terms, systematic review phrasing, institutional place names, and paper titles; triggers are scattered and lack a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragment in the name Lancaster
patterns.context: Activation falls on English subword fragments within proper or other names: an astronomical survey name, an airline name, and a lentivirus-related name; the complete word meanings are not consistent.

patterns.name: Cancer institution place names
patterns.context: Table entries combining cancer types with research institutions or place names; activation is within an institutional abbreviation or place name.

patterns.name: The disease word «rickets»
patterns.context: In contexts involving hypophosphatemia or FGF23-related diseases, activation falls on the latter part of the disease name.

patterns.name: The phase term «stripped»
patterns.context: Algebraic local impurities affect phases in one-dimensional space; activation falls within the phase term.

patterns.name: The fluid mechanics term «RANS»
patterns.context: Technical contexts involving CNN prediction of flow fields and the Reynolds-averaged Navier–Stokes equations.

patterns.name: Systematic review phrasing «Reviews»
patterns.context: Descriptions of study selection methods for systematic reviews and meta-analyses.

patterns.name: Immunology research topic lists
patterns.context: Lists immunology research projects and project leads; activation falls on name fragments.

patterns.name: «Reporter» in a paper title
patterns.context: Describes the Wnt pathway and existing reporter constructs, followed by a fluorescent reporter lentivirus subsection heading.

patterns.name: Unexplained items
patterns.context: Trigger locations are scattered across astronomy research abstracts and immunology topic lists, and cannot be adequately explained by the proper-name, disease, or terminology patterns above.

1_3058.description: 激活多落在专业名词、缩写、专名或术语的内部片段：涵盖疾病、流体与凝聚态术语、系统综述措辞、机构地名及论文标题；触发类别分散，缺少统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 兰开斯特名称中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或名称内部的英文子词片段：天文巡天名、航空公司名、慢病毒相关名称；并非完整词义一致。
patterns.domain: 天文学、百科条目、分子生物学

patterns.name: 癌症机构地名
patterns.context: 癌症类型与研究机构/地名组成的表格条目，激活位于机构缩写或地名内部。

patterns.name: «rickets»疾病词
patterns.context: 低磷血症或FGF23相关疾病语境中，激活疾病名称后半部分。

patterns.name: «stripped»相态词
patterns.context: 代数局域杂质影响一维空间中的相，激活相态术语内部。

patterns.name: «RANS»流体术语
patterns.context: CNN预测流场、雷诺平均纳维–斯托克斯方程的技术语境。

patterns.name: «Reviews»系统综述措辞
patterns.context: 系统综述与荟萃分析的研究筛选方法描述。

patterns.name: 免疫研究主题列表
patterns.context: 列举免疫研究项目及负责人姓名；激活落在姓名片段。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的«Reporter»
patterns.context: 描述Wnt通路及现有报告构建体，随后出现荧光报告慢病毒小标题。

patterns.name: 未解释的条目
patterns.trigger: 未见一致的局部触发串；包括«field»«unit»«observations»及«host»等
patterns.context: 触发位置分散于天文学研究摘要和免疫主题列表，无法由上述专名、疾病或术语模式充分解释。

en.description: Activations are scattered across internal fragments of proper names, models, or terms, as well as medical review titles and subsection headings; they span fields and vary in position and function. Only the two review-title passages are approximately repeated, so no single semantic feature can be inferred.

patterns.name: Specific subword fragments in place names or proper names
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within proper names, including survey names, place names, and personal names; the context has no consistent semantic function.
patterns.domain: Astronomical survey names, encyclopedia entries, NIH project lists

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on components of personal names, model names, or terms in scientific or technical texts; meanings and grammatical positions vary.
patterns.domain: Fluid mechanics, medical risk models, astrophysics

patterns.name: Disease or medical term fragments
patterns.context: Within disease names, activation concentrates on suffix fragments of disease words.

patterns.name: Word fragments in systematic review titles
patterns.context: Occurs in names of systematic review methods or reporting guidelines; activation falls on title fragments, and the two passages are nearly repeated.

patterns.name: Subsection headings and fragments of research tool names
patterns.context: One activation occurs in a subsection heading, another in the name of a fluorescent reporter system; there is no evident shared semantic condition.

1_3058.description: 激活分散在专名、模型或术语的内部片段，以及医学综述标题和小节标题；跨领域且位置、功能不一，只有综述标题两段近似重复，无法归纳为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 地名或专名中的特定子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部的子词片段，涉及调查名称、地名或人名；上下文没有统一的语义功能
patterns.domain: 天文学调查名称、百科条目、NIH项目列表

patterns.name: 技术术语中的专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在科学或技术文本中的人名、模型名或术语组成部分；词义和语法位置各异
patterns.domain: 流体力学、医学风险模型、天体物理

patterns.name: 疾病或医学术语片段
patterns.context: 在疾病名称中，激活集中于疾病词的后缀片段

patterns.name: 系统综述标题中的词片段
patterns.context: 出现在系统综述方法或报告规范名称中；激活落在标题词片段，且两处文本近似重复
patterns.domain: 医学研究方法、系统综述

patterns.name: 报告小节标题及研究工具名片段
patterns.context: 一处激活于小节标题，另一处激活于荧光报告系统名称；没有明显共同语义条件

en.description: Activations are triggered by various proper names and technical terms: Navier–Stokes in fluid mechanics, systematic review guidelines, and sporadic surveys, risk models, scientific names, and names containing the syllable Ana; there is no unified semantic pattern covering all examples.

patterns.name: Navier–Stokes fluid mechanics terminology
patterns.context: Flow, turbulence, or convection modeling contexts, especially near terms such as equations, flow fields, velocity, or pressure.
patterns.domain: Fluid mechanics, computational fluid dynamics, and astrophysics

patterns.name: Systematic review methodology phrases
patterns.context: Describes reporting guidelines, screening, or research workflows for systematic reviews/meta-analyses.

patterns.name: The syllable Ana inside names or words
patterns.context: Occurs inside proper names or personal names, without a stable semantic context; the marked positions form similar character fragments.
patterns.domain: Proper names, organization names, or personal names

patterns.name: Scientific-name fragment for a biological species
patterns.context: Occurs as part of a Latin scientific name in a gene or species characteristics table.

patterns.name: Galaxy cluster lensing survey name
patterns.context: Follows Cluster in the name of a galaxy cluster survey project, as part of a proper name.

patterns.name: Cancer risk model name
patterns.context: Mentions a model that predicts absolute breast cancer risk.

1_3058.description: 激活由多种专名和技术词触发：流体力学中的 Navier–Stokes、系统综述规范，以及零散的巡天、风险模型、学名和含 Ana 音节的名称；没有覆盖所有样例的统一语义模式。

patterns.name: Navier–Stokes 流体力学术语
patterns.context: 流动、湍流或对流建模语境，尤其紧邻方程、流场、速度或压力等术语。
patterns.domain: 流体力学、计算流体与天体物理

patterns.name: 系统综述方法学短语
patterns.context: 描述系统综述/荟萃分析的报告规范、筛选或研究流程。

patterns.name: 名称或词内部的 Ana 音节
patterns.context: 出现在专名或人名内部，缺少稳定的语义上下文；标记位置均形成类似的字符片段。

patterns.name: 生物物种学名片段
patterns.context: 基因或物种特征表中，作为拉丁学名的一部分出现。

patterns.name: 星系团透镜巡天名称
patterns.context: 紧随星系团巡天项目名称中的 Cluster，作为专名的一部分。

patterns.name: 癌症风险模型名称
patterns.context: 提及预测乳腺癌绝对风险的模型。
